### 📋 Abstract
> An artificial intelligence enhanced system for designing and optimizing environmentally resilient semiconductor devices integrates wave-based thermal modeling with multi-physics simulation and neuro-symbolic computing capabilities. The system enables comprehensive consideration of environmental effects throughout the semiconductor design process, incorporating traditional diffusive heat transfer models and wave-like heat transfer phenomena alongside other environmental stressors such as radiation exposure, mechanical strain, and chemical corrosion. A federated data-centric graph architecture manages and interconnects knowledge across multiple physics domains and environmental scenarios, while a physics model integration layer coordinates multi-scale simulations incorporating quantum-level effects and system-level behaviors. The system employs advanced uncertainty quantification and multi-objective optimization techniques to ensure robust designs for extreme environments. Real-time optimization capabilities enable dynamic adjustment of design and manufacturing parameters based on continuous monitoring and prediction of device behavior under various environmental conditions. The system's comprehensive approach bridges the gap between quantum-scale phenomena and macro-scale performance in extreme environment applications.

- **AI Relevancy Score**: N/A (UNAUDITED)

### 📋 Abstract
> A robotic surgical system incorporates artificial intelligence to enhance intraoperative performance and surgical decision-making. The system includes a surgeon console, one or more robotic arms, and a control module with an AI-driven model generalization engine. The AI engine leverages cross-procedure transfer learning, enabling it to apply models trained on one type of surgery to others exhibiting latent procedural similarity. Intraoperative data including endoscopic video, robotic arm kinematics, force and haptic feedback, biometric signals, and audio commands is analyzed to support real-time guidance, anomaly detection, and adaptive control. The system comprises modules for surgical planning, predictive analytics, autonomous task execution, and surgeon fatigue monitoring. Feedback from multimodal sensors informs dynamic trajectory adjustment and surgical decision support. Continuous learning from both historical and live surgical data refines the AI model over time. This integrated framework enables improved precision, efficiency, and safety in robotic-assisted surgical procedures.

The disclosed approach features an automated, iterative alignment process in which a generative model generates responses to training examples using an initial prompt. An optimizer model evaluates each response against a reference answer based on a specified objective function, producing alignment instructions to improve the generative model's outputs. These alignment instructions are used to refine the prompt, directing the generative model toward closer agreement with reference answers and better performance on desired metrics. - **AI Relevancy Score**: N/A (UNAUDITED)

### 📋 Abstract
> In accordance with various embodiments of the present disclosure, a pre-biasing circuit is provided. In some embodiments, the pre-biasing circuit comprises a capacitor circuit connected between a common node and ground; a diode connected in parallel with the capacitor circuit; a derivative circuit connected to the common node; a summing circuit; a pre-biasing current source; and a test voltage source. The test voltage source outputs a test voltage to the summing circuit, causing the pre-biasing current source to inject a test current into the common node. If a voltage at the common node is less than a forward voltage of the diode, the injected test current causes the voltage at the common node to increase, causing the derivative circuit to output a voltage to the summing circuit corresponding to a rate of increase of the voltage, causing the pre-biasing current source to inject a pre-biasing current into the common node.

If the global recall risk value is greater than a desired threshold risk value, candidate control variables within the BPP are modified to improvise candidate performance parameters for optimizing the BPP and generating an optimized batch production plan (OBPP). ### 📋 Abstract
> A system, method, and computer-readable medium enforce compliance, policy governance, and jurisdiction-aware control of digital artifacts generated by AI models. A deterministic digest of each artifact is stored in a registry, and a compliance token is generated encoding policy predicates, consent scope, jurisdictional lineage, monetization parameters, and a zero-knowledge proof component including a proof statement ID, cryptographic commitment, and verification key. A gateway verifier receives the artifact and token, verifies the signature, performs zero-knowledge proof validation without revealing regulated data, evaluates encoded policies, and renders a permit-or-deny decision. Verification results and compliance decisions are recorded via a dual-ledger atomic commit engine that updates both compliance and financial ledgers. A settlement engine calculates royalty values based on validated performance metrics and appends the results to the commit entry. Upon jurisdictional transitions, a transition engine detects boundary crossings and issues a forked compliance token with updated predicates. The system ensures verifiable, policy-aware, and jurisdictionally adaptive governance.

### 📋 Abstract
> [0000]    A secure data storage solution fragments encrypted data and distributes it across multiple cloud providers, increasing data protection by preventing any single cloud provider from accessing the complete data. Using cryptographic techniques such as Shamir's Secret Sharing or Reed-Solomon coding, the system divides the encrypted data into multiple independent fragments, each of which is stored separately. Each fragment alone is insufficient to reconstruct the original data, and only a minimum threshold of fragments is required for reassembly. By distributing fragments across diverse cloud providers, the invention mitigates risks associated with single-provider failures or breaches. The system employs secure communication protocols to protect fragments during transmission and monitors the integrity of each fragment in its respective storage location, ensuring both data confidentiality and availability. This fragmentation and multi-cloud distribution method offers enhanced security and reliability for sensitive data stored in distributed cloud environments.

By generating an authentication token that includes a timestamp and time-based one-time password (TOTP), synchronized with a Network Time Protocol (NTP) server, the system ensures that each access request is valid only within a specific time window. When a user requests data access, the token is verified by each participating cloud provider against the synchronized timestamp, allowing secure, time-sensitive validation across platforms. An identity provider (IdP) manages token issuance and synchronization, centralizing the authentication process while maintaining precise time alignment across clouds. This time-sync verification reduces the risk of replay attacks and ensures that only legitimate requests are processed, enabling secure, synchronized data access in multi-cloud environments. - **AI Relevancy Score**: N/A (UNAUDITED)

### 📋 Abstract
> Keyless key management systems that dynamically generates encryption keys on demand using a Deterministic Key Derivation Function (KDF) are disclosed and eliminate the need for stored encryption keys. The system derives unique, session-specific encryption keys based on a combination of biometric data, time-based one-time passwords (TOTP), and real-time environmental data including device location and IP address. By using this diverse set of inputs, the KDF creates a unique key each time access is requested, tightly linking the encryption key to the specific user and access context. This approach minimizes security risks associated with key storage or transmission, as no key is persistently stored or shared. The system's context-aware design and zero-trust model prevent unauthorized access, rendering the keys unusable outside their defined session parameters. This solution enhances security against brute-force and replay attacks, offering a scalable, efficient encryption method for distributed multi-cloud environments that requires no traditional key management infrastructure.

## 152. [202641086566] A Computer-Implemented Decision-Support System and Method for Quartile-Adjusted Skewness Intensity-Based Objective Criteria Weighting in Multi-Criteria Decision-Making
- **Patent ID / App No**: `202641086566`
- **Source**: Indian Patents
- **URL**: [https://iprsearch.ipindia.gov.in/PublicSearch/PublicationSearch/PatentDetails](https://iprsearch.ipindia.gov.in/PublicSearch/PublicationSearch/PatentDetails)
- **AI Relevancy Score**: N/A (UNAUDITED)

### 📋 Abstract
> ABSTRACT [0023] The present invention relates to a computer-implemented decision-support system and method for objective criteria weighting in multi-criteria decision-making using Quartile-Adjusted Skewness Intensity Weighting (QASI-W). The invention receives a decision matrix comprising multiple alternatives and criteria, identifies beneficial and non-beneficial criteria, normalizes the criterion values, and arranges the normalized values criterion-wise. The system computes the first quartile, median, and third quartile for each criterion and determines quartile- based skewness to identify distributional asymmetry. A Quartile-Adjusted Skewness Intensity score is then generated by combining baseline criterion importance with the absolute quartile-based skewness value. The generated scores are normalized to obtain final objective criteria weights. The invention reduces the excessive influence of extreme observations and improves the interpretability of criteria weighting in asymmetric and heterogeneous datasets. The system is applicable to healthcare evaluation, biotechnology, biomedical assessment, sustainability analysis, and other decision-support environments involving multi-criteria data.

Operationally, it employs a phenology-aware decision engine. A simple touch sensor allows farmers to request on-demand spoken status updates. Additionally, all sensor data and alerts are logged as plain-text files on a local SD card. This enables periodic offline data retrieval by agricultural technicians for expert analysis while preserving the farmer’s data ownership. An optimized deep-sleep power strategy ensures 25–35 days of maintenance-free operation per charge.

This tool aims to enhance patient safety by reducing the risks of harmful drug interactions and side effects. The integration of ADR and DDI prediction into healthcare practices can significantly reduce adverse events, improve the quality of care, and facilitate personalized medicine. Furthermore, the proposed system can be extended to incorporate new drug data and continually improve its predictive capabilities.

> Quantum-Chemical Matter Reconfiguration Engine with Adaptive Photonic Control for Autonomous Material Evolution and Sustainable Energy Applications Abstract The present invention introduces a Quantum-Chemical Matter Reconfiguration Engine (QCMRE) integrated with an Adaptive Photonic Control System (APCS) to enable autonomous material evolution through real time quantum-level chemical manipulation. Unlike conventional material synthesis methods that rely on fixed reaction pathways and energy-intensive processing, the proposed system employs quantum-state modeling, AI-driven molecular optimization, and dynamically tunable photonic energy sources to precisely control atomic bonding, crystal formation, and molecular rearrangement. The framework continuously monitors material behavior using nanoscale quantum sensors and applies adaptive photon frequencies to guide desired structural transformations while minimizing waste, emissions, and energy consumption. The invention incorporates a hybrid architecture consisting of quantum chemical simulation modules, machine learning-based reaction prediction engines, adaptive laser-photonic controllers, molecular feedback sensors, and sustainable energy optimization algorithms. Through closed-loop autonomous control, the system predicts optimal reaction pathways, adjusts photon intensity and wavelength in real time, and reconfigures material properties such as conductivity, strength, thermal stability, catalytic efficiency, and optical characteristics. This self-learning capability enables rapid discovery and fabrication of advanced functional materials without extensive manual experimentation. The proposed engine has broad applications in next-generation battery materials, hydrogen production, solar energy harvesting, semiconductor manufacturing, carbon capture materials, smart polymers, aerospace composites, biomedical nanomaterials, quantum electronics, and circular manufacturing systems. By combining quantum chemistry, artificial intelligence, adaptive photonics, and sustainable engineering principles, the invention significantly reduces production time, improves material performance, lowers environmental impact, and accelerates the development of intelligent, energy-efficient materials for future industrial and clean-energy ecosystems. It represents a transformative platform for autonomous material innovation, supporting sustainable manufacturing and next-generation energy technologies.

## 167. [202641085253] CLOUD-IOT INTEGRATED MACHINE LEARNING FRAMEWORK FOR REAL-TIME CREDIT CARD FRAUD DETECTION AND SECURE E-COMMERCE TRANSACTION AUTHENTICATION
- **Patent ID / App No**: `202641085253`
- **Source**: Indian Patents
- **URL**: [https://iprsearch.ipindia.gov.in/PublicSearch/PublicationSearch/PatentDetails](https://iprsearch.ipindia.gov.in/PublicSearch/PublicationSearch/PatentDetails)
- **AI Relevancy Score**: N/A (UNAUDITED)

### 📋 Abstract
> Credit card payments have become one of the most common ways to make financial transactions due to the rapid increase in digital banking, internet shopping, mobile payments and contactless transactions. The growth, however, comes at a cost as financial fraud is becoming more advanced and thus transaction security has become one of the primary concerns for banks, merchants and consumers. Current fraud detection services largely rely on pre-determined rules, static security policies or few transaction attributes to detect anomalies. While these methods can catch specific frauds, they often do not recognize novel orders that have recently arrived, leading to detection delays as well as the needless blocking of legitimate transactions—both creating customer annoyance. Current systems also tend to work in silos, not leveraging the massive amount of information that is generated via connected payment devices, cloud platforms and customer behaviour over time, handcuffing their ability to perform intelligent and adaptive fraud prevention. Accordingly, the present invention is concerned with a Cloud-IoT Integrated Machine Learning Framework for Real-Time Credit Card Fraud Detection and Secure E-Commerce Transaction Authentication which provides an all-in-one framework that integrates cloud computing, IoT-enabled payment infrastructure, behavioral feature engineering, machine learning and adaptive authentication. The system always collects data about transactions from banking systems, payment gateways, merchant platforms, customer devices, and terminals for contactless payments. The data collected is then distilled into useful behavioral parameters such as the Transaction Trust Score (TTS), User Behavioural Consistency Index (UBCI), Device Reliability Factor (DRF) Location Confidence Score (LCS) and Dynamic Fraud Risk Index (DFRI). Through a machine learning prediction engine, these indicators are then processed by the banks to determine fraud probability, detect unusual transaction behavior and aid in making intelligent authentication decisions. The framework also emphasizes the utilization of features such as monitor them in real time, receive fraud alerts, offer adaptive authentication solutions and continuously adapt to new patterns with machine learning algorithms that yields better detection performance when more information about the transactions becomes available. With this invention, businesses can expect improvements in transaction security, reduction in erroneous decline of legitimate transactions, improved fraud detection performance, and building stronger customer trust; as well as a scalable digital payment ecosystem to be merged into future eCommerce platforms. ### 📋 Abstract
> The present disclosure relates to a system and method for secure tensor layout scrambling in edge-cloud split inference. An edge-native security apparatus (102) receives input data from a raw sensor/data source (104) and uses neural execution hardware (106) with a split-layer execution unit (108) to generate an intermediate feature-map tensor (110), which is stored in a volatile tensor buffer (112). A cryptographic permutation controller (114), including a cryptographic secret storage unit (116), a nonce generation unit (118), a permutation seed derivation unit (120), and a pseudorandom permutation map generator (122), generates a nonce-dependent pseudorandom permutation map. An address-remapping memory-transfer controller (124), optionally including a DMA engine (124A) and a scatter-gather descriptor table (126), rearranges tensor index positions to generate a scrambled tensor stored in a scrambled tensor buffer (128) while leaving numerical activation values unchanged. A secure serialization unit (130) serializes the scrambled tensor, and a metadata authentication unit (132) generates protected reconstruction metadata with an authentication tag (166). A network interface (134) transmits the serialized scrambled tensor and protected reconstruction metadata through a communication network (136) to a cloud-side inference system (138). The cloud-side inference system (138) verifies the metadata using a metadata verification unit (140), accesses cryptographic material through a cloud-side cryptographic secret or session key unit (141), regenerates an inverse permutation using an inverse permutation controller (142), restores tensor ordering within a protected tensor reconstruction environment (144), and completes inference using a remaining neural network execution unit (146) to produce an inference output (148).

### 📋 Abstract
> SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR HUB-MANAGED ROTATION OF WEARABLE DEVICES TO PROVIDE CONTINUOUS GAP-FREE PERSONAL EMERGENCY RESPONSE SERVICE A rotation-based continuous monitoring system for providing gap-free fall detection and emergency response monitoring in personal emergency response systems. The system comprises a hub controller and at least two wearable sensing devices configured for sequential rotation between active monitoring and standby charging roles. The hub controller enforces a time-sliced rotation protocol with proactive validation of standby units and atomic role transition maintaining measured switchover gap of zero milliseconds through concurrent overlap periods during which both devices are simultaneously worn at spatially separated body locations. A spatial diversity analysis module analyzes motion data from devices positioned at separated body locations, computing inter-device correlation coefficients to distinguish isolated limb motion from coordinated whole-body motion, thereby suppressing false positive fall alerts while maintaining high fall detection sensitivity while reducing false positive alerts. A biometric continuity verification module extracts multi-modal biometric features comprising pulse-based identification characteristics, gait identification patterns, and contact pressure features to prevent wrong-user monitoring in multi-person households. Wearable devices implement passive optical sensor node architecture, transmitting raw sensor data to the hub for centralized processing. The system executes fall detection processing locally on edge computing processor with response time sufficiently low to provide real-time emergency indication without requiring internet connectivity or cloud services.

### 📋 Abstract
> ABSTRACT [0027] The present invention introduces an Explainable AI-Driven Hybrid Ensemble System for Early Cardiac Risk Prediction (EAI-HES) that intelligently combines multiple machine learning and deep learning paradigms to deliver highly accurate, transparent, and clinically actionable predictions of heart disease risk. The proposed system processes structured patient data through a comprehensive preprocessing pipeline and employs a novel stacked hybrid architecture wherein Random Forest and Artificial Neural Network base models generate intermediate predictions that are subsequently refined by an XGBoost meta-learner. This layered ensemble approach captures both interpretable decision boundaries and complex non-linear patterns inherent in medical datasets. To overcome the black-box limitations of conventional models, the invention integrates SHAP for global and local feature attribution alongside LIME for patient-specific explanations, enabling physicians to understand the contribution of individual risk factors such as age, cholesterol, blood pressure, and lifestyle indicators. Implemented as a full-stack web application with Flask backend and intuitive frontend, the system classifies patients into low, medium, or high risk categories while providing visual and textual rationales. Extensive preprocessing including imputation, encoding, scaling, and SMOTE balancing, coupled with rigorous evaluation, yields superior performance with XGBoost achieving approximately 95% accuracy. This invention advances cardiovascular diagnostics by merging ensemble robustness, deep representational learning, and explainability, thereby fostering trust and facilitating early intervention in clinical practice.

### 📜 Full Specification & Deep Scrape Text
Title
IT data asset update and maintenance methods, media and equipment based on smart tags

Abstract
Translated from Chinese
The present invention discloses an IT data asset update and maintenance method, medium and device based on smart tags, the method comprising: collecting historical data of each IT data asset corresponding to each group of second IT data asset information, inputting the historical data into the trained second neural network model, outputting the update adjustment factor of the relevant parameters of each IT data asset in each group of second IT data asset information, calculating the second update cycle based on the first update cycle and the update adjustment factor, and obtaining the update mapping table corresponding to each group of second IT data asset information; dynamically updating and maintaining the update mapping table corresponding to each group of second IT data asset information, and updating the relevant parameters of the IT data assets corresponding to each group of second IT data asset information based on the second update cycle recorded in the update mapping table. The above scheme can realize the automatic adjustment of the update cycle of the relevant parameters of IT data asset information, reduce the computing power while ensuring the accuracy of the update.

Description
Intelligent tag-based IT data asset updating and maintaining method, medium and equipment
Technical Field
The application relates to the technical field of computer network security, in particular to an IT data asset updating and maintaining method, medium and equipment based on intelligent labels.
Background
IT resource data covers a number of aspects and is an indispensable element in the information technology management and operation process. The current IT resource data updating mode usually adopts a mode of real-time monitoring and updating or a mode of updating according to a preset fixed sampling period, wherein the former needs to monitor each item of data of IT resources interacted with a user in real time and update the data in real time, the calculation is complex, and the latter does not consider the specificity of each IT resource, such as safety level, access quantity and the like, according to the fixed sampling period, and cannot provide personalized updating service. And the hardware resources and the software resources depend on the compliance of checking and updating by people after updating, so that the whole method is time-consuming and labor-consuming, and the IT data assets are inconvenient to update and maintain.
Disclosure of Invention
In view of the above problems, the application provides a technical scheme for updating and maintaining IT data assets based on intelligent tags, so as to solve the problems of complex operation and inconvenient updating and maintaining existing IT resource data updating and maintaining modes.
To achieve the above object, in a first aspect, the present application provides an IT data asset update maintenance method based on smart tags, the method comprising:
acquiring first IT data asset information, performing cluster analysis on the first IT data asset information to obtain a plurality of IT data asset information categories, classifying the first IT data asset information based on the IT data asset information categories to obtain a plurality of groups of second IT data asset information, wherein each group of second IT data asset information comprises related parameters of a plurality of IT data assets;
Inputting a plurality of groups of second IT data asset information into a trained first neural network model, outputting a first updating period corresponding to each group of second IT data asset information, and updating relevant parameters of IT data assets in each group of second IT data asset information based on the first updating period;
After a preset time period, collecting historical data of each IT data asset corresponding to each group of second IT data asset information, inputting the historical data into a trained second neural network model, outputting an update adjustment factor of relevant parameters of each IT data asset in each group of second IT data asset information, and calculating a second update period based on the first update period and the update adjustment factor to obtain an update mapping table corresponding to each group of second IT data asset information, wherein each group of update mapping table comprises a plurality of second update periods, each second update period corresponds to a next update sampling period of relevant parameters of one or more IT data assets, and the historical data comprises operation data, access data and security events of each IT data asset in the preset time period;
Dynamically updating and maintaining an updating mapping table corresponding to the second IT data asset information of each group, and updating relevant parameters of IT data assets corresponding to the second IT data asset information of each group based on a second updating period recorded by the updating mapping table;
the method further comprises the steps of:
Constructing a purchasing database of IT data assets, wherein a plurality of groups of first parameters are recorded in the purchasing database, and each first parameter comprises the type of the purchased IT data asset, the purchasing completion time and purchasing related parameters;
after updating the related parameters of a certain second IT data asset, recording the type of the currently updated IT data asset, and acquiring the related parameters of the updated second IT data asset, and recording the related parameters as second parameters;
If the currently updated IT data asset belongs to a hardware resource, judging whether a first parameter matched with the second parameter exists in the purchasing database, and if not, sending out first prompt information;
If the current updated IT data asset belongs to the software resource, searching whether a third parameter matched with the second parameter exists in a resource manufacturer website to which the current IT data asset belongs, and if not, sending out second prompt information.
Further, determining whether the first parameter adapted to the second parameter exists in the purchase database includes:
And acquiring a first update time stamp of the related parameter of the current second IT data asset after updating, determining a first time stamp range according to the first update time stamp and the corresponding security level of the IT data asset, and searching whether a first parameter matched with the second parameter exists in the first time stamp range.
Further, searching whether the third parameter matched with the second parameter exists in the website of the resource manufacturer to which the current IT data asset belongs comprises:
And acquiring a version number and a second update time stamp of the updated software resource, determining a second time stamp range according to the second update time stamp and the security level, and searching whether a resource manufacturer website to which the current IT data asset belongs in the second time stamp range has a version number matched with the version number of the updated software resource.
Further, inputting the historical data into the trained second neural network model includes:
Performing data cleaning on the historical data, and inputting the cleaned historical data into a second neural network model after training;
the data cleansing includes:
The historical data are arranged in groups according to the distance from the current timestamp to obtain a plurality of historical data segments, a score is calculated based on the historical data segments, historical data segments with scores lower than a preset score are removed, the score corresponding to the current historical data is calculated according to the scores and weights of the remaining historical data segments, and the weights of the historical data segments are larger as the historical data segments are closer to the current timestamp;
and the score corresponding to the historical data segment is calculated according to the security level, the access data amount and the security data amount of the IT data asset.
Further, the second neural network model calculates the update adjustment factor according to the following:
setting an initial value of an adjusting factor;
Allocating a weight for the operation data, the access data and the security event of each IT data asset in a preset time period, and calculating an adjustment score based on each weight and the data quantity;
Calculating the updated adjustment factor according to the adjustment score and the initial value of the adjustment factor;
the calculating a second update period based on the first update period and the update adjustment factor includes:
And multiplying the first updating period by the updating adjustment factor to obtain the second updating period, wherein the value range of the updating adjustment factor is [0.1,2].
Further, the method further comprises:
after each time of the relevant parameters of the IT data asset, adding an update mark for a second update period in the update mapping table;
When the duty ratio of the second update period with the update mark exceeds a preset duty ratio, counting the average value of all the second update periods recorded in the same update mapping table;
Traversing and searching whether a second updating period which is smaller than the average value and has a difference larger than a preset difference from the average value exists in the current updating mapping table, and if so, screening out the second updating period meeting the condition to obtain a second updating period set to be corrected;
correcting all second updating periods in the second updating period set according to a preset correction factor to obtain a corrected second updating period set;
replacing a corresponding second update period in the current update mapping table by adopting the corrected second update period set to obtain a corrected update mapping table;
and updating the relevant parameters of the IT data asset based on the corrected updating mapping table.
Further, the method further comprises:
After receiving the global updating instruction, updating the relevant parameters of the IT data assets corresponding to the second IT data asset information of each group, and resetting the starting time stamp information corresponding to the second updating period in the updating mapping table corresponding to the second IT data asset information of each group.
Further, when the IT data asset is a hardware resource, the relevant parameters of the second IT data asset comprise server configuration information, network equipment detail information, terminal equipment list information, printer and scanner information, and when the IT data asset is a software resource, the relevant parameters of the second IT data asset comprise operating system installation and permission information, application software list information and database management system detail information.
In a second aspect, the present application provides a computer readable storage medium having stored thereon a computer program which when executed by a processor implements the smart tag based IT data asset update maintenance method of the first aspect of the present application.
In a third aspect, the present application provides an electronic device having stored thereon a computer program comprising a processor and a storage medium having stored thereon a computer program which, when executed by the processor, implements the smart tag based IT data asset update maintenance method according to the first aspect of the present application.
The method comprises the steps of performing cluster analysis on first IT data asset information to obtain multiple groups of second IT data asset information, inputting the multiple groups of second IT data asset information into a trained first neural network model, outputting a first update period corresponding to the second IT data asset information of each group, updating relevant parameters of IT data assets in the second IT data asset information of each group based on the first update period, collecting historical data of the IT data assets corresponding to the second IT data asset information of each group after a preset time period, inputting the historical data into the trained second neural network model, outputting update adjustment factors of relevant parameters of the IT data assets in the second IT data asset information of each group, calculating the second update period based on the first update period and the update adjustment factors, obtaining an update mapping table corresponding to the second IT data asset information of each group, dynamically updating an update mapping table corresponding to the second IT data asset information of each group, and performing update on the relevant parameters of the IT data assets of each IT data asset corresponding to the second IT data asset information of each group based on the second update period recorded by the update mapping table. According to the scheme, the automatic adjustment of the update period of the IT data asset information related parameters can be realized, the calculation force is reduced, and the update accuracy is ensured.

As shown in fig. 1, in a first aspect, the present application provides an IT data asset update maintenance method based on smart tags, the method comprising:
Step S101, acquiring first IT data asset information, carrying out cluster analysis on the first IT data asset information to obtain a plurality of IT data asset information categories, classifying the first IT data asset information based on the IT data asset information categories to obtain a plurality of groups of second IT data asset information, wherein each group of second IT data asset information contains related parameters of a plurality of IT data assets;
step S102, inputting a plurality of groups of second IT data asset information into a trained first neural network model, outputting a first updating period corresponding to each group of second IT data asset information, and updating relevant parameters of IT data assets in each group of second IT data asset information based on the first updating period;
Step S103, after a preset time period, collecting historical data of each IT data asset corresponding to each group of second IT data asset information, inputting the historical data into a trained second neural network model, outputting an update adjustment factor of relevant parameters of each IT data asset in each group of second IT data asset information, and calculating a second update period based on the first update period and the update adjustment factor to obtain an update mapping table corresponding to each group of second IT data asset information;
each group of the update mapping tables comprises a plurality of second update periods, each second update period corresponds to the next update sampling period of one or more relevant parameters of IT data assets, and the historical data comprises operation data, access data and security events of each IT data asset in a preset time period;
Step S104, dynamically updating and maintaining an updating mapping table corresponding to the second IT data asset information of each group, and updating relevant parameters of IT data assets corresponding to the second IT data asset information of each group based on a second updating period recorded by the updating mapping table.
In step S101, the first IT data asset information refers to related parameters of original data asset information, belongs to data which is not classified and is disordered, and after classification, the obtained second IT data asset information mainly includes hardware resource data, software resource data, network resource data and data resources. The IT data asset refers to the resource itself, such as a server, a database, application software, a printer, etc., and the relevant parameters of the IT data asset refer to configuration information related to the resource, such as a model number, a use state, etc.
When the IT data asset is a hardware resource, the relevant parameters of the second IT data asset include server configuration information, network device detail information, terminal device list information, printer and scanner information, where the server configuration information includes a processor model, a memory size, a hard disk capacity, and the like, the network device detail includes a router, a model of a switch, a port number, a data transmission rate, and the like, and the terminal device list information includes a model, a configuration, and a use state of a device such as a desktop, a notebook, a tablet, and the like. The printer and scanner information includes device model, location, frequency of use, maintenance records, and the like.
When the IT data asset is a software resource, the relevant parameters of the second IT data asset include operating system installation and license information, application software inventory information, and database management system details information. The operating system installation and license information includes version, installation date, activation status, etc. The application software inventory information includes software names, versions, license numbers and use cases. The database management system detail information comprises database types, capacities, performance parameters and access authority settings.
When the IT data asset is a network resource, the relevant parameters of the second IT data asset include a network topology structure, IP addresses and domain name assignment records, and network traffic and bandwidth usage. The network topology structure diagram is used for displaying network equipment and connection relations, and is convenient for fault investigation and planning. The IP address and domain name assignment records are used to ensure reasonable allocation and efficient management of network resources. The network traffic and bandwidth usage are used to monitor network performance and optimize resource allocation.
When the IT data asset is a data resource, the relevant parameters of the second IT data asset include database structures and contents including table structures, field definitions, index settings, and stored data content, data warehouse information, log files, and data. The data warehouse is used for storing data types, capacities, access rights and backup strategies. The log file and the data are used for recording system operation, user behavior and the like and are used for safety analysis and fault detection.
In step S102, the first neural network model may acquire the class and the security level corresponding to each set of the second IT data asset information, and perform operation, so as to output the first update period corresponding to each set of the second IT data asset information. Generally, the higher the security level of the IT data asset, the shorter the first update period corresponding to the second IT data asset information output by the first neural network model, that is, the higher the update frequency needs to be used for updating the IT data asset with high security level. In this embodiment, the first update period refers to an initial update period of the information of each group of IT data assets, for example, the category is hardware resource data, and the result output by the first neural network model is usually about 1 day.
In step S103, each set of the update mapping tables includes a plurality of second update periods, each of the second update periods corresponds to a next update sampling period of one or more relevant parameters of the IT data assets, and the history data includes operation data, access data and security events of each of the IT data assets within a preset period of time. If the access quantity value is larger, the security event is larger, the abnormal times of the operation data are larger, or the occupancy of the operation resources is larger, the update adjustment factor can be adjusted to be smaller in the negative positive direction, so that the relevant parameters of the current IT data asset are updated more frequently, and otherwise, the update period of the relevant parameters of the IT data asset can be adjusted to be larger in the positive direction.
In step S104, each set of second IT data asset information includes a plurality of parameters related to IT data assets, for example, the hardware resource class includes a plurality of parameters related to servers, an initial update period may be set for each update period of the parameters related to the servers, then data of each server in a period of time is collected, a next update period of the parameters related to the servers is adjusted based on an operation result of the data, and the updated second update period is recorded in the update mapping table. The update map is dynamically refreshed after each update of at least one server-related parameter.
Because the updating of the relevant parameters of the IT data assets fully considers the factors such as the security level, access data, security event and the like of the current IT data assets, and the corresponding updating period along with the dynamic change of the historical data also changes correspondingly, compared with a mode of monitoring the relevant parameters of each group of IT data assets in real time, the method effectively saves the calculation force, and compared with a mode of updating the relevant parameters of each IT data asset by setting a fixed preset period, the method can update the relevant parameters of the IT data assets differentially, and improves the monitoring efficiency.
As shown in fig. 2, the method further includes:
Firstly, entering step S201 to construct a purchasing database of IT data assets, wherein a plurality of groups of first parameters are recorded in the purchasing database, and each first parameter comprises the type of the purchased IT data asset, the purchasing completion time and purchasing related parameters;
Step S202 is then carried out, after the relevant parameters of a certain second IT data asset are updated, recording the type of the currently updated IT data asset and acquiring the relevant parameters of the updated second IT data asset, and recording the relevant parameters as second parameters;
step S202 may be followed by step S203, wherein if the currently updated IT data asset belongs to a hardware resource, whether a first parameter adapted to the second parameter exists in the purchase database is judged, and if not, a first prompt message is sent;
Step S202 may be followed by step S204, wherein if the currently updated IT data asset belongs to the software resource, searching whether a third parameter adapted to the second parameter exists in the resource manufacturer website to which the current IT data asset belongs, and if not, sending out a second prompt message.
In short, if the IT data asset of the current updated relevant parameters belongs to a hardware resource, compliance of the IT data asset needs to be checked, and the current checking mode often depends on manual post-checking, so that the whole method is time-consuming and labor-consuming. When the related parameters of the hardware resources are monitored to change in a manner of constructing the purchase database, if a certain type of server is added or the memory of a certain server is replaced by 256G from 128G, the information in the purchase database before the current updating time point is traced back, whether the updated content is matched with the related parameters recorded in the purchase database or not is checked, so that the automatic verification of the updating compliance of the hardware resources is realized, and the efficiency is improved. Meanwhile, if the updated parameters are not matched with the information recorded in the purchasing database, a first prompt message is sent out so that the operation and maintenance personnel can check the information conveniently. Preferably, the first prompt message is also used for reporting the related parameters which are not matched currently, the position where the hardware resource is located, and the like.
If the IT data asset of the related parameters updated currently belongs to the software resource, the compliance of the IT data asset needs to be checked, if the version update of a certain application software is found, the application can automatically search whether the website of the resource manufacturer to which the application software belongs has an adaptive version number, if the version number exists, the current application software is updated based on an official channel, if the version number does not match, abnormal prompt information is sent out, the position of the electronic equipment provided with the application software and the unmatched content are reported, and the operation and maintenance personnel can check the position and unmatched content further conveniently.
Preferably, the first prompt information and the second prompt information can be an audio prompt, a luminous prompt, a vibration prompt or a text or graphic prompt on a display interface of the display device.
In some embodiments, determining whether the first parameter adapted to the second parameter exists in the purchase database includes obtaining a first updated timestamp of an associated parameter of a current second IT data asset, determining a first timestamp range according to the first updated timestamp and a security level of the corresponding IT data asset, and searching for whether the first parameter adapted to the second parameter exists in the first timestamp range.
In short, for the purchasing links of the hardware resources with different security levels, the corresponding flow time is different, so that in order to improve the searching efficiency, the purchasing information in a longer range can be traced forward by taking the current timestamp as the beginning for the hardware resource with higher security level, for example, after the first timestamp range can be set to be half a year, so as to determine whether the first parameter matched with the second parameter exists in half a year. For the parameter update of the hardware resource of the common security level, the search time range can be adaptively shortened to improve the search efficiency, for example, the first timestamp range can be set to be 1 month. By means of the scheme, when the first parameter and the second parameter are matched, the self-adaptive adjustment of the second parameter searching range can be achieved, and searching efficiency is improved.
In some embodiments, searching whether the third parameter adapted to the second parameter exists in the resource vendor website to which the current IT data asset belongs includes obtaining a version number of the updated software resource and a second update timestamp, determining a second timestamp range according to the second update timestamp and the security level, and searching whether the version number matched with the version number of the updated software resource exists in the resource vendor website to which the current IT data asset belongs in the second timestamp range.
In short, the same is true for updating the version number of the software resource, and different search time ranges are correspondingly determined at the website of the resource manufacturer according to different security levels of the software resource, so that the search efficiency is improved.
In some embodiments, as shown in FIG. 3, the second neural network model calculates the update adjustment factor according to the following:
step S301 is first entered to set an initial value of an adjustment factor;
Step S302 is carried out to allocate and configure a weight for the operation data, the access data and the security event of each IT data asset in a preset time period, and an adjustment score is calculated based on each weight and the data quantity;
step S303 is then carried out to calculate the updated adjustment factor according to the adjustment score and the initial value of the adjustment factor;
In this embodiment, the calculating the second update period based on the first update period and the update adjustment factor includes multiplying the first update period and the update adjustment factor to obtain the second update period, where a value range of the update adjustment factor is [0.1,2].
In this embodiment, more factors are considered for the calculation of the update adjustment factor, such as the same security event, which is weighted more heavily than the security event farther from the current timestamp when the weight ratio is assigned if the point in time of occurrence is closer to the current timestamp, thereby making the calculated update adjustment factor more accurate. For example, if device a had a 10 security events occurring in approximately 1 month and device B had a 15 security events occurring in approximately 6 months, then when the update adjustment factor was calculated using the algorithm described above, the adjustment amplitude of the update adjustment factor for device a would be greater than that for device B, and if both devices determined an initial update period of 1 day/1 time, then device a could be adjusted to 2 hours/time and device B could be adjusted to 6 hours/time.
In some embodiments, as shown in fig. 4, the method further comprises:
Firstly, step S401 is carried out, wherein after the relevant parameters of the IT data asset are each time, an update mark is added for a second update period in the update mapping table;
Step S402 is then entered to count the average value of all second update periods recorded in the same update mapping table when the duty ratio of the second update period with the update flag exceeds the preset duty ratio;
Step S403 is carried out, namely whether a second updating period which is smaller than the average value and has a difference larger than a preset difference with the average value exists in the current updating mapping table or not is searched in a traversing mode, if so, a second updating period meeting the condition is screened out, and a second updating period set to be corrected is obtained;
step S404 is carried out to correct all the second update periods in the second update period set according to a preset correction factor to obtain a corrected second update period set;
Step S405 is then entered into, replacing the corresponding second update period in the current update mapping table with the modified second update period set to obtain a modified update mapping table;
and then proceeds to step S406 where the relevant parameters of the IT data asset are updated based on the updated mapping table.
In this embodiment, the preset duty ratio may be set according to actual needs, for example, the preset duty ratio may be set to 50%, that is, after the update mapping table has been completed with more than 50% of the relevant parameters of the IT data asset, the average value of all the second update periods recorded in the same update mapping table is counted, if IT is detected that the IT data asset with a long update period exists, most of the relevant parameters of the IT data asset are updated many times and then the relevant parameters of the IT data asset are not updated yet, the relevant parameters of the part of the IT data asset are corrected according to the preset correction factor, so as to obtain a corrected second update period set, and then the relevant parameters of the IT data asset are updated based on the corrected update mapping table.
In this way, the relevant parameters of the IT data assets in the same group can be updated in a controllable time range, so that the situation that the relevant parameters of one IT data asset are not updated after other relevant parameters are updated is avoided, and the subsequent collection and arrangement of the information of the second IT data asset in the group are facilitated.
In some embodiments, the method further includes updating parameters of the IT data assets corresponding to the second IT data asset information of each group after receiving the global update instruction, and resetting start timestamp information corresponding to a second update period in the update mapping table corresponding to the second IT data asset information of each group.
In short, the global update instruction may be initiated by the upper layer system service, and through the global update instruction, IT is able to update the relevant parameters of the IT data assets corresponding to the second IT data asset information in each group, so as to facilitate collection and arrangement of subsequent relevant parameters.
As shown in fig. 5, in order to implement the system architecture of the intelligent tag-based IT data asset update maintenance method according to the present application, the system includes an acquisition layer, a data layer, a processing layer and an application layer. Specifically, the system may further include the following several functional modules to implement different functions:
And the intelligent label module is used for automatically classifying IT resource data and generating labels through a model and an algorithm, so that efficient organization and indexing of the data are realized. This process may be based on multiple dimensions of the content, format, source, etc. of the data. The tags can accurately reflect the characteristics and attributes of the resource asset, such as type, purpose, security risk level, resource type, configuration information, security status, etc.
And the security risk module is used for carrying out accurate security risk assessment based on the data attribute of the intelligent label and identifying potential security threats and vulnerabilities.
And the automatic operation and maintenance module is used for combining the intelligent label to realize automatic operation and response of IT resources and improve the operation efficiency.
And the decision support module is used for providing data support and insight for strategic decisions and business optimization of enterprises by utilizing the data with the intelligent labels.
And the continuous optimization and iteration module is used for continuously optimizing an algorithm and an intelligent label system according to the actual effect and feedback of the safe operation, so that the efficiency and the safety of data management are improved.
In some embodiments, the system further comprises a security risk module, an automated operation and maintenance module, and a decision support module.
The security risk module includes the following:
And the real-time monitoring and dynamic analysis module is used for realizing the real-time monitoring and dynamic analysis of IT resources based on the data labels and timely finding and solving the safety problem.
And the risk assessment module is used for carrying out key monitoring on the data with the sensitive label, carrying out risk assessment immediately and taking corresponding safety response measures once abnormal access or operation behaviors are found.
And the automatic vulnerability scanning module is used for periodically carrying out vulnerability scanning on IT resources and identifying potential safety risk points.
And the intelligent repair suggestion module is used for providing a targeted repair suggestion or an automatic repair scheme according to the scanning result and the attribute of the intelligent label, so that the risk of utilizing the security hole is reduced.
And the data access control module is used for setting different data access authorities according to the grade and the attribute of the intelligent label so as to ensure that sensitive data is not accessed by unauthorized personnel.
And the security policy making module is used for making a targeted security policy, such as encryption storage, periodic backup, access audit and the like, based on the data classification result of the intelligent tag, so that the security of the data is improved.
The automatic operation and maintenance module comprises the following contents:
and the data classifying and indexing module classifies and indexes the IT resource data according to the generated intelligent labels. By constructing an efficient data retrieval mechanism, quick positioning and inquiring of data are realized, and convenient data support is provided for automatic operation and maintenance.
And the intelligent operation and maintenance platform module is used for constructing an operation and maintenance platform based on intelligent labels and realizing the automatic management and monitoring of IT resources. And the potential problems are subjected to intervention treatment in advance through the resource tag, so that the fault occurrence rate and the operation and maintenance cost are reduced.
And the process optimization module optimizes and simplifies the operation and maintenance process by utilizing the intelligent label, and improves the operation and maintenance efficiency and response speed. For example, the problem resource is located quickly by the smart tag and the corresponding process flow is triggered.
The decision support module comprises the following contents:
And the data association analysis module is used for carrying out cross-domain and cross-system data association analysis based on the data classification result of the intelligent tag and mining potential association and value points between the data.
Optimizing resource scheduling, namely, optimizing a strategy based on the resource scheduling of the intelligent tag, and ensuring the stable operation and the data security of a key service system.
And the data-driven decision support is that IT resource data with intelligent labels is utilized to provide data support for strategic decisions and business optimization of enterprises. The enterprise is helped to find new business opportunities and growth points through means of data association analysis, trend prediction and the like.
Personalized security service, namely providing personalized security service for different user groups based on intelligent labels and user behavior analysis technology. For example, higher level security monitoring and protection services are provided for administrators of critical business systems, and convenient security training and instruction services are provided for general staff.
The system can realize multi-platform data pull-through and integrated operation, service modeling and association rule analysis, and automatic response and intelligent operation.
The multi-platform data pull-through and integrated operation realize data pull-through with a plurality of products such as a host CWPP, an asset management system, a leakage scanning device, a third-party threat information platform and the like in a customized development mode, an API interface docking mode and the like, so that a comprehensive and real-time security situation view is constructed. The multi-platform data fusion capability remarkably improves the efficiency and accuracy of safe operation.
The business modeling and the association rule analysis are based on the association rule analysis capability of a business scene, and the deep binding of business indexes and IT indexes is realized by deeply analyzing business safety requirements, so that a large number of association analysis and baseline analysis rules are formulated. The service modeling method enables the safety operation to be closer to the service reality, and improves the pertinence and the effectiveness of the safety response.
The automatic response and intelligent operation realize the rapid response and intelligent treatment of the security event by constructing key functional modules such as intelligent label generation, security risk assessment, automatic operation and maintenance and the like. The combination of automation and intellectualization not only improves the safety operation efficiency, but also reduces the cost and risk of manual intervention.

And the operation and maintenance cost is reduced, the manual operation is reduced by an automatic and intelligent means, and the labor cost is reduced. The multi-platform fusion and integration is realized, namely, the multi-platform fusion and integration is realized, data among a plurality of products are communicated, a comprehensive and real-time safety situation view is constructed, and the efficiency and the accuracy of safety operation are obviously improved.
Service closeness and pertinence, namely, through service modeling and association rule analysis, the safety operation is closer to service reality, and pertinence and effectiveness of safety response are improved.
The automatic response and intelligent operation capability is built, the cost and risk of manual intervention are reduced, and the safety operation efficiency is improved.
In some embodiments, the resource data needs to be subjected to a feature extraction process before being automatically classified, and the purpose of feature extraction is to extract meaningful and quantifiable features from the accessed resource data for intelligent label generation. These features can characterize the resources and provide critical information for subsequent analysis. And performing feature extraction on the preprocessed log data by using a transducer model, wherein the transducer can effectively capture long-term dependence in the sequence data.
Specifically, the feature extraction process includes the following steps:
a. Input embedding, namely converting input data into a numerical format which can be processed by a model, and converting words into word embedding vectors.
B. position coding because the transducer model does not contain any information about the order of the elements, position coding is used to inject position information for the elements in the sequence. The position coding may be fixed or learned and is typically added to the input embedding.
C. Self-attention mechanism-this is the core part of the transducer model. The self-attention mechanism enables the model to focus on different parts of the input sequence, providing the possibility to understand the global context information. The self-attention mechanism calculates a weight for each element in the sequence to decide which elements should be focused on during the encoding process. In this way, the model can better capture relationships and dependencies between elements.
In this embodiment, the multi-headed attention mechanism allows the model to focus on different aspects of the input sequence at the same time. The inputs are mapped to a number of different heads (heads) by linear transformation, each head independently calculating self-attention, and the results are stitched or averaged as the final output.
In the transfomer, residual connection and layer normalization are used to deepen the network and enhance the stability of training. The residual connection adds the input directly to the output, helping to alleviate the gradient vanishing problem. And the layer normalization normalizes the output of each layer, accelerates convergence and improves the generalization capability of the model.
D. and extracting characteristics, namely performing self-attention calculation and feedforward neural network calculation on each layer through a multi-layer structure of a transducer, so that the characteristics of different abstraction levels of input data can be extracted.
E. Output processing-depending on the task, it may be necessary to add some additional processing steps after feature extraction. For example, in a classification task, it may be necessary to add a fully connected layer and a softmax function over the features to generate the final predictions.
In some embodiments, the goal of generating the resource label is to automatically label the resource with relevant labels, and the labels can accurately reflect the information such as the use, the security level and the like of the resource, so that a key basis is provided for subsequent analysis. The intelligent label generating process comprises the following steps:
a. Tag encoding, namely providing a tag for each piece of log data. These tags are encoded using one-hot encoding to facilitate model training.
B. Training based on Mini-Batch SGD, training a label classifier by using a Mini-Batch SGD algorithm. The method comprises the following specific steps:
i. Randomly selecting a small batch of data from the training set as input for each iteration;
delivering the selected small batch of data to a tag classifier and calculating an output of the network;
calculating a loss function based on the network output and the actual label. Common loss functions include cross entropy loss, mean square error, etc.;
Updating parameters of the classifier by using Mini-Batch SGD algorithm. According to the gradient of the loss function, small-amplitude adjustment is carried out on parameters in the classifier;
And v, repeating the steps until the training set is completely traversed once, and completing one round of training (epoch).
C. Intelligent tag generation, in which the tag probability of each data instance is predicted by a tag classifier during training. Depending on the actual requirements, a probability threshold may be selected to determine the final tag. For each data instance, the tag with the highest probability is used as the result of intelligent tag generation.
In this embodiment, mini-Batch SGD (random gradient descent) algorithm is a common optimization algorithm in deep learning. In contrast to a standard SGD, it uses a small batch of data each time model parameters are updated, rather than one data point or the entire data set. The variance of gradient update can be reduced, and the training of the model is accelerated by utilizing the parallelism of matrix operation.
To generate the smart tag, a suitable loss function is defined that can measure the gap between the model-generated tag and the real tag. Depending on the specific task, different loss functions may be selected, such as cross entropy loss, mean square error loss, etc.
In this embodiment, the smart tag generation module is designed as follows, and specifically includes the following modules:
And the tag library construction module is used for designing characteristic tags of the resource data, constructing a vocabulary library with safety characteristics and improving the accuracy of subsequent analysis.
The tag coding module comprises the steps of tag preprocessing, selecting a proper coding mode, constructing a tag coding table, realizing a coding conversion function, introducing a coding cache mechanism and the like. Through the design and implementation of the module, the original label can be converted into a numerical form which can be processed by a model, and effective input characteristics are provided for subsequent intelligent label generation.
And the training and optimizing module is used for training and optimizing the model based on the Mini-Batch SGD algorithm. According to the algorithm principle, gradient calculation and parameter updating logic of the Mini-Batch SGD are realized. And calculating a loss value between the label generated by the model and the real label according to the selected loss function. The tissue training process comprises the operations of iteration number control, batch data extraction, gradient updating and the like. After each iteration or cycle is completed, the performance of the model on the validation set is evaluated and the optimal model parameters are saved.
And the label generation module is responsible for generating intelligent labels by using the trained model. The original data of the label to be generated is received. And carrying out preprocessing and feature extraction operations which are the same as those of training data on the data to be generated. And inputting the processed data into the trained model to generate corresponding intelligent labels. The generated tag is subjected to necessary post-processing operations such as tag mapping, format conversion, and the like.
In some embodiments, the present application further provides a search enhancement generation annotation, and the specific process includes the following steps:
Data collection and preprocessing-a large number of data elements are collected from IT resources including, but not limited to, log files, configuration files, network traffic data, and the like. Preprocessing the collected data, including data cleaning, format conversion, normalization and the like, to ensure the quality and consistency of the data.
Information retrieval and extraction, namely retrieving information related to the current safe operation scene from the preprocessed data by utilizing an information retrieval function of a retrieval enhancement generation technology. Through an efficient indexing mechanism, key data elements are quickly located and extracted. By an efficient indexing mechanism, rapid positioning and extraction of key data elements are ensured. And the rapid retrieval of a large-scale data set is supported, and the data processing efficiency is improved.
And marking the extracted data elements, including classification, named entity identification, relation extraction and the like. The labeling process is based on the generation capability of the search enhancement generation technology, and the accuracy and the integrity of labeling are improved by introducing related information in an external knowledge base.
And generating a labeling result, namely associating the labeled data elements with the original data to generate a structured data set containing rich labeling information. And the text generating capability of the retrieval enhancement generating technology is utilized to generate the annotation result report with strong readability and rich information, so that the security operator can understand and use the annotation result report conveniently.
In this embodiment, the generating the labeling result mainly includes the following steps:
And constructing a generating model based on the RAG technology, which can introduce related information in an external knowledge base and improve the accuracy and the integrity of the labeling. The method has strong text generation capability and can generate the labeling result report with strong readability and rich information.
And constructing and updating a knowledge base, namely constructing the knowledge base containing IT resource data elements and related knowledge, and providing rich background information for the labeling process. And the knowledge base is updated regularly, so that the accuracy and timeliness of the marked information are ensured.
And optimizing the labeling strategy according to different safe operation scenes and requirements, and improving the pertinence and the accuracy of labeling. And (3) performing iterative optimization on the labeling process by using a machine learning algorithm, so that the labeling efficiency and quality are improved.
In some embodiments, the application also introduces large model technology topology automation data annotation, which specifically comprises:
Large model selection and training, namely selecting a proper large model, such as a pre-training model based on a transducer structure, wherein the models have strong context semantic understanding capability and complex reasoning capability. The collected IT resource data is used to train the large model so that IT can identify and understand key elements and patterns in the data.
Topology automation construction, namely constructing a topology structure of IT resources by utilizing the output of the large model. This includes identifying nodes, connections, data flows, etc. in the network. The topology is optimized and tuned by an automated algorithm to ensure its accuracy and integrity.
And marking the key elements in the IT resource data by utilizing the semantic understanding capability of the large model on the basis of the topological structure. This includes sensitive data, unusual behavior, potential threats, etc. The labeling process may be semi-automated, i.e., the large model provides labeling advice, which is then manually validated and adjusted. The method can also be fully automatic, namely, the large model is directly marked, and the marking accuracy is ensured through subsequent verification.
The large model has strong context semantic understanding capability and complex reasoning capability, and can accurately identify and understand key elements and modes in IT resource data. Through training and optimization, the large model can adapt to different IT environments and business requirements, and accurate labeling and intelligent analysis are provided.
The topology automatic construction mainly utilizes the output of a large model to construct the topology structure of IT resources, and can automatically identify nodes, connection relations, data flows and the like in a network. The automatic algorithm can optimize and adjust the topological structure, ensure the accuracy and the integrity of the topological structure, and provide a solid foundation for data annotation.
The data labeling technology is to label data by utilizing the semantic understanding capability of the large model, and can accurately identify key elements such as sensitive data, abnormal behaviors, potential threats and the like. The labeling process can be semi-automatic or fully automatic, and is selected according to actual requirements.
In some embodiments, the method further performs annotation utilization through table enhancement generation, and specifically comprises the following steps:
The table enhancement generation model is constructed based on a deep learning technology, and the model can understand natural language query and generate SQL query consistent with the structure of the underlying database.
And training the table enhancement generation model by using a large amount of marked IT resource data, so that the table enhancement generation model can accurately identify data elements and generate effective SQL query.
Relevance identification-table enhancement generation model receives a natural language query of a user or system, and identifies data elements related to the query.
And generating labels, namely automatically generating labels according to the identified data elements by a table enhancement generation model, wherein the labels possibly comprise information such as the type, the source, the importance and the like of the data. Optimizing the generated label, ensuring that the label is consistent with the structure of the underlying database, and ensuring the accuracy of the label through a manual or automatic verification means.
And generating SQL query, namely generating optimized SQL query sentences by a table enhancement generation model according to the labeling result. And submitting the generated SQL query statement to a database for execution, and retrieving data related to the query.
The table enhancement generation technology combines natural language processing and database query technology, and realizes automatic conversion from natural language query to SQL query. The table enhancement generation model can accurately identify data elements and generate SQL queries consistent with the underlying database structure, thereby improving the accuracy and efficiency of data retrieval.
Deep learning techniques are the basis for constructing table enhancement generative models. By training the deep learning model, the deep learning model has strong natural language understanding and processing capability. The deep learning technology can also realize self-optimization and iteration of the model, and the accuracy and efficiency of labeling are continuously improved.
Database query optimization techniques are key to improving data retrieval efficiency. By optimizing SQL query statements, the query time and resource consumption of the database can be reduced. The database query optimization technology can also select a proper query index strategy according to the distribution and characteristics of the data, so that the query efficiency is further improved.
