acquiring first IT data asset information, performing cluster analysis on the first IT data asset information to obtain a plurality of IT data asset information categories, classifying the first IT data asset information based on the IT data asset information categories to obtain a plurality of groups of second IT data asset information, wherein each group of second IT data asset information comprises related parameters of a plurality of IT data assets;
Inputting a plurality of groups of second IT data asset information into a trained first neural network model, outputting a first updating period corresponding to each group of second IT data asset information, and updating relevant parameters of IT data assets in each group of second IT data asset information based on the first updating period;
After a preset time period, collecting historical data of each IT data asset corresponding to each group of second IT data asset information, inputting the historical data into a trained second neural network model, outputting an update adjustment factor of relevant parameters of each IT data asset in each group of second IT data asset information, and calculating a second update period based on the first update period and the update adjustment factor to obtain an update mapping table corresponding to each group of second IT data asset information, wherein each group of update mapping table comprises a plurality of second update periods, each second update period corresponds to a next update sampling period of relevant parameters of one or more IT data assets, and the historical data comprises operation data, access data and security events of each IT data asset in the preset time period;
Dynamically updating and maintaining an updating mapping table corresponding to the second IT data asset information of each group, and updating relevant parameters of IT data assets corresponding to the second IT data asset information of each group based on a second updating period recorded by the updating mapping table;
the method further comprises the steps of:

after updating the related parameters of a certain second IT data asset, recording the type of the currently updated IT data asset, and acquiring the related parameters of the updated second IT data asset, and recording the related parameters as second parameters;

If the current updated IT data asset belongs to the software resource, searching whether a third parameter matched with the second parameter exists in a resource manufacturer website to which the current IT data asset belongs, and if not, sending out second prompt information.

and acquiring a version number of the updated software resource and a second update time stamp, determining a second time stamp range according to the second update time stamp and a security level corresponding to the software resource, and searching whether a version number matched with the version number of the updated software resource exists in a resource manufacturer website to which the current IT data asset belongs in the second time stamp range.

and the score corresponding to the historical data segment is calculated according to the security level, the access data amount and the security data amount of the IT data asset.

setting an initial value of an adjusting factor;

Calculating the updated adjustment factor according to the adjustment score and the initial value of the adjustment factor;
the calculating a second update period based on the first update period and the update adjustment factor includes:

correcting all second updating periods in the second updating period set according to a preset correction factor to obtain a corrected second updating period set;
replacing a corresponding second update period in the current update mapping table by adopting the corrected second update period set to obtain a corrected update mapping table;
and updating the relevant parameters of the IT data asset based on the corrected updating mapping table.

## 181. [CN120710773A] Network security script arrangement method based on LLM enhanced RL
- **Patent ID / App No**: `CN120710773A`
- **Source**: Espacenet
- **URL**: [https://worldwide.espacenet.com/patent/search?q=pn%3DCN120710773A](https://worldwide.espacenet.com/patent/search?q=pn%3DCN120710773A)
- **AI Relevancy Score**: N/A (UNAUDITED)

### 📋 Abstract
> A network security script arrangement method based on LLM enhanced RL comprises the following steps: 1) LLM dynamically expands a to-be-selected strategy atom set based on a security threat scene: firstly, performing semantic similarity retrieval on input security threat intelligence by using a vector library, and matching an optimal defense strategy atom in a knowledge library; the context understanding capability of the LLM is then utilized to implement semantic understanding and reasoning on the candidate atom set, generating new policy atoms complementary to the defense. 2) RL refers to LLM atomic action preference to optimize a script generation strategy, and self-adaptive security arrangement of a complex network environment is realized: firstly, a security script graph model based on strategy atoms is adopted, and multiple constraints corresponding to nodes and edges in the graph model are abstracted on the basis of security arrangement definition; and then, a composite reward function is adopted to model a linear programming function for the multi-constrained security script arrangement problem, so that multi-dimensional optimization of defense efficiency and execution cost is realized.

### 📜 Full Specification & Deep Scrape Text
Title
A cybersecurity script orchestration method based on LLM-enhanced RL

Abstract
Translated from Chinese
A network security script orchestration method based on LLM-enhanced RL includes the following steps: 1) LLM dynamically expands the set of candidate policy atoms based on security threat scenarios: First, a vector library is used to perform semantic similarity retrieval on the input security threat intelligence to match the best defense policy atoms in the knowledge base; then, LLM's contextual understanding capability is utilized to perform semantic understanding and reasoning on the candidate atom set to generate new policy atoms that supplement the defense. 2) RL optimizes the script generation strategy based on the action preferences of LLM atoms to achieve adaptive security orchestration for complex network environments: First, a security script graph model based on policy atoms is adopted to abstract multiple constraints on nodes and edges in the corresponding graph model based on the security orchestration definition; then, a composite reward function is used to model the multi-constrained security script orchestration problem as a linear programming function to achieve multi-dimensional optimization of defense effectiveness and execution cost.

Description
Network security script arrangement method based on LLM enhanced RL
Technical Field
The invention relates to application of an artificial intelligence technology in the field of network security, in particular to a network security scenario editing method based on LLM enhanced RL.
Background
With the rapid development of network technology, the global network environment increasingly presents a highly interconnected and dynamically evolving complex characteristic. The continuous emergence of new network architecture and applications makes the boundaries of the network increasingly blurred, and the attack surface is also continuously expanded [1] . The variety of network terminal equipment is great, the variation of protocols is heterogeneous, and the like, so that more various network security threats and challenges are brought, and network attack means are more concealed and have stronger permeability [2][3] . Under the background, how to effectively defend and cope with novel security threats in complex network environments has become a key problem to be solved in the network security field. In this context, security orchestration automation and response (Security Orchestration, automation and Response, SOAR) technologies have evolved to become an important component of network security defense. The SOAR technology realizes cross-platform coordination and automatic execution of security policies by integrating threat information, situation awareness and automatic response mechanisms, and improves the overall security defense capacity [4] . In recent years, reinforcement learning (Reinforcement Learning, RL) is widely applied in security editing, and the dependence of the traditional method on manual configuration editing script is broken through. However, most of the existing researches depend on static script libraries, lack of dynamic regulation and control on script atom strange scenes, and limit effects of the script atom strange scenes in actual emergency response.
The large language model (Large Language Model, LLM) has developed great potential in the area of reasoning and decision support in the field of network security. Pternea et al [5] combine LLM with RL to analyze collaborative potential, and in environments lacking explicit reward signals, LLM can effectively assist RL agents in making decisions and accelerate learning processes. Zhang et al [6] propose that LLM can optimize RL proxy performance in many contexts, especially in dynamic environments, when the RL proxy needs to make decisions based on complex circumstances. The RLGF method uses the LLM as a base model for generating text, and the RL directs the LLM to generate content [7] that better conforms to the target task by providing rewards feedback.
LLM has wide knowledge migration and context learning capability, and can dynamically expand policy atom sets to make up the limitation of a predefined knowledge base in an unknown threat scene. Meanwhile, the RL is used as a data-driven optimization method, and strategy searching and strengthening adjustment can be performed in a complex environment so as to improve the effectiveness of scenario execution. The high-quality policy atoms are generated through LLM, and the optimizing capability of RL in dynamic environment is combined, so that a more adaptive and intelligent security arrangement frame can be constructed, and the security operation and maintenance has stronger decision making capability and generalization when dealing with novel attacks.
1.1 Challenging problem
While the introduction of LLM can provide a richer atomic extension to security scripts and a more strategic-oriented reference to RL decisions, it has the potential to promote security orchestration, but still faces the following challenges:
1) The accuracy and reliability of LLM generation policy atoms the text generation of LLM is essentially based on probability distribution, thus easily creating illusion problems [8] . In the security operation and maintenance scene, the LLM may generate logic errors or atomic operations against security policies due to illusion, and the reliability of security scenario generation is reduced. Friel et al [9] propose a method for detecting hallucinations in LLM generation by analyzing the internal state of a single response, striving to try and outputting predictive probabilities to efficiently identify hallucinations. Martino et al [10] propose reducing the illusion problem in LLM generated content by knowledge injection, enhancing LLM output accuracy by mapping context data of entities related to tasks to text space.
2) The LLM aided RL strategy has often a lack of transparency in terms of its interpretability and trustworthiness. In the field of network security, which requires high transparency and verifiability, the implementation of the RL algorithm is critical. Using hierarchical methods and symbolic representations, the interpretability of certain RL models may be significantly improved [11] . The inference generation of LLM relies on a large amount of training data, and its policy preference may be affected by the training data bias, resulting in unfair selection. Khediri et al [12] uses SHAP (SHAPLEY ADDITIVE exPlanations) values to interpret predictions of the model and generate easy-to-understand natural language descriptions via LLM, thereby helping security analysts understand the underlying cause of anomaly detection and improving transparency and confidence of intrusion detection systems. How to integrate the preference of LLM on atom selection into RL training, and improve the rationality and the interpretability of the finally generated security scenario, and needs to be further researched. Lin et al [13] propose a hybrid approach that combines RL and LLM, with RL being used to discover defects in the decision tree, and with LLM analysis failure scenarios, generates an improved decision tree. Ma et al [14] propose a framework that combines LLM with RL agents to support network security operations. The pre-trained RL agent acts as a mentor to help the LLM agent accelerate learning, from which the LLM can dynamically obtain guidance.
Disclosure of Invention
In order to cope with challenges brought by strange attacks and multidimensional complex network environments, the invention provides a security arrangement framework based on the cooperation of LLM and RL, and the generation of interpretable scene self-adaptive security scenario is realized. Under the framework, LLM knowledge reasoning is combined with RL decision making to realize a sustainable mutual energization closed loop.
The invention relates to a network security scenario arrangement method based on LLM enhanced RL, which comprises the following steps:
dynamically expanding a policy atom set to be selected based on a security threat scene by adopting a large language model LLM;
Secondly, adopting a reinforcement learning RL algorithm to refer to LLM atomic action preference to carry out decision optimization on a generation strategy of the script, and realizing self-adaptive security arrangement of the network security script of the complex network environment;
In the step (I), firstly, carrying out semantic similarity retrieval on input security threat information by using a vector library to match with the best defense strategy atoms in a knowledge base, and then, utilizing the context understanding capability of LLM to carry out semantic understanding and reasoning on the candidate original subset to generate new strategy atoms supplementing the defense;
In the second step, firstly, a security script graph model based on strategy atoms is adopted, and a plurality of constraints corresponding to nodes and edges in the graph model are abstracted on the basis of security arrangement definition;
In the network security scenario arrangement method, the security scenario consists of a plurality of defending actions, each action is an executable security measure, and the security scenario is split into a series of minimum executable units, and the minimum executable units are called defending strategy atoms or strategy atoms, and the minimum executable units are called as atoms for short.
The main contributions of the invention include:
1) LLM assisted strategy atom augmentation, namely analyzing the coverage defect and index short plate of the semantic matching preliminary screening atoms, and dynamically creating and expanding the security strategy atoms in the security scenario generation process by utilizing the natural language understanding and generating capability of LLM.
2) And a LLM-assisted strategy atom scoring mechanism is used for prompting engineering through a thinking tree (Tree of Thoughts, toT) so that the LLM imitates the knowledge base atom scoring standard, and quantitatively evaluating newly generated strategy atoms from four dimensions of processing time, resource occupation, manual participation and operation and maintenance effects to ensure feasibility and effectiveness.
3) LLM and RL tactics cooperate with optimize and align, under the decision-making frame of the cooperative optimization of LLM and RL that is offered, RL is responsible for tactics optimizing, LLM provides the priori probability that tactics are produced. The security policy trajectories generated by the multiple rounds of RL agent training are used to guide the fine-tuning of LLM. Through fine tuning and merging, LLM aligns to RL strategy, and ensures that the finally generated security scenario has strategy rationality and execution efficiency.
In experimental verification, the invention builds a real enterprise network experimental system based on 5G-IoT to test the performance of the scenario generated by the method under different security threat scenes. The experiment compares the safe script generated by the proposed method with the script generated by the method which is simply dependent on LLM and RL, proves that the script generated by the proposed method has better adaptability and effectiveness when facing to complex strange network scenes, and provides a new idea for intelligent safe operation and maintenance.

Detailed Description
Summary of the invention
With the continuous evolution of network attack technology, security orchestration and response systems have difficulty coping with heterogeneous devices, multi-source attacks, and rapidly changing network situations. However, most of the existing security arrangement methods rely on static script libraries and single reinforcement learning strategies, and lack dynamic regulation and control in a scene of strange script atoms. The invention fuses semantic retrieval and large language model reasoning into the state-action space construction and decision process of reinforcement learning, and constructs an arrangement framework of 'atomic knowledge base reinforcement-decision optimization' complementary closed loop so as to realize self-adaptive generation of the safety scenario under the complex network situation. Context learning and knowledge migration capabilities of the large language model LLM are utilized, dynamically expanding the set of strategy atoms to be selected based on the scenario. In combination with the thought tree prompt engineering, the large language model strategy reasoning process is split step by step, and the interpretability and the controllability of the reasoning process are improved. And the reinforcement learning RL algorithm refers to the large model atomic action preference to carry out decision optimization on the generation strategy of the script, so as to realize self-adaptive security arrangement of the complex network environment.
2 System model
In this section, a system model of a network security scenario layout method based on LLM enhanced RL is constructed, and the system model generates a security scenario by enhancing and RL decision based on LLM auxiliary retrieval. The invention realizes the generation of the security scenario under the multi-constraint condition through the synergistic effect of the LLM-driven strategy atom expansion mechanism and the RL optimization algorithm. The core module comprises two parts of strategy atom dynamic matching and augmentation and LLM enhanced RL decision optimization.
In the policy atom dynamic matching and augmentation part, a dual mechanism of atom semantic matching and LLM augmentation is provided for improving the coverage and scene adaptability of scenario policies. The invention uses FAISS [15] vector library to search semantic similarity of the input security threat information and match the best defense strategy atoms in the knowledge base. Then, semantic understanding and reasoning are performed on the candidate original subset by utilizing the context understanding capability of the LLM, and novel strategy atoms supplementing the defensive logic are generated.
In the LLM enhanced RL decision optimization part, a security script graph model based on strategy atoms is constructed, and a plurality of constraints of nodes and edges in a corresponding graph model are abstracted based on security arrangement definition. In addition, composite rewards functions are designed to model multiple constrained security scenario layout problems into a linear programming function with the goal of achieving multidimensional optimization of defensive efficacy and execution cost. 2.1 policy atom matching and augmentation

3LLM enhanced RL scheme design
As shown in fig. 3, this section proposes a LLM enhanced RL framework, which makes up for the deficiency of RL policy by utilizing the natural language understanding capability of LLM and its massive network security knowledge storage, so as to promote the capability of intelligent arrangement of security scenario in dynamic network environment. From a functional point of view, the proposed framework can be divided into four parts:
1) The security situation analysis, namely threat information analysis is injected as a context through prompt words, LLM is prompted to understand the state of a network security environment and identify potential threats in the environment, and specific situation analysis information quantization processing is generated to obtain For RL per-step decisions, LLM predicts real-time network situation based on current atomic combinations.
2) Policy orchestration and rewards settings in which a script policy map model is generated. The enhancement of the original subset by LLM and the auxiliary security situation analysis further enrich the action space and the state space of the RL.
3) LLM assists RL script decision-making LLM provides action preference prior probability, helps RL algorithm training and generates security scripts. By the guidance of LLM, the efficiency of the decision generation of the RL algorithm script is improved, and the safety script is more flexible and has strong adaptability.
4) Scenario track feedback and optimization, namely, the security policy track data of RL training is used for LLM fine adjustment so as to realize alignment of LLM action selection preference policy to RL policy, and security scenario generation flow is further adjusted and optimized.
3.1 Security Condition analysis
The goal of the security posture analysis section is to provide environmental state information for subsequent RL decisions. Threat information in the network environment is extracted and used as an input context, and is injected into the LLM in the form of a prompt word, so that a guiding model is used for identifying the security risk and the potential threat of the current environment. LLM calculates the total threat score of the environment by analyzing various information in threat information Reflecting the deviation degree of the current network environment from the ideal state and the influence degree of the potential threat on the environmental safety.
In the RL training decision process, LLM predicts network situation in real time based on selected scenario atomic combinations. The state data includes network situation, system configuration, load conditions, and operation and maintenance records, g 1 (v n )、g 2 (v n )、g 3 (v n ) and g 4 (v n ) scores for the current last selected atom n, quantized by LLM. And according to the data scoring result, the LLM evaluates the possible change of the network environment after the scenario is executed and predicts the security situation of the next time state. This process ensures that the network environment change predictions from the LLM are referenced in real time and corresponding pre-decisions made for future security threats each time the RL performs an action decision training process.
3.2 State and action space enhancement
With the support of natural language understanding capabilities and their massive network security knowledge storage, LLM is prompted to generate new scenario-compliant operation and maintenance policy atoms. In addition, LLM analyzes and predicts the network situation based on threat information report and selected scenario atomic combination, and the improvement of situation awareness capability further enhances the adaptability and flexibility of the RL framework. ● The state transition probability P represents the probability of transition from the current state s t to the next state s t+1 , i.e. the policy action has been selected

LLM converts network state elements such as g 1 (v n )、g 2 (v n )、g 3 (v n ) and g 4 (v n ) into high-dimensional vector representation, and enhances state space Helping RL agents to better understand the task environment. By combining policy atoms matched with a knowledge base, LLM generates new policy atoms fitting network scenes, and action space is enhanced So that the agent decision has more action choices. Based on the assistance of the two dimensions of LLM, the motion and state space of the RL is enhanced.

3.4 Fine-tuning alignment of LLM to RL policies
For the orchestration decisions of security scripts, LLM provides an atomic selection preference probability as a reference for RL policy updates. In order to improve the alignment degree of LLM to RL strategies, a LoRA [18] fine-tuning and parameter merging framework is designed in this section, so that the fine-tuned LLM can learn the strategies generated by RL and can maintain the stability and generalization capability of the original model.
As shown in fig. 4, the framework includes LoRA fine-tuning training, gradient-clipping-based LoRA adapter-to-LLM parameter merging two phases, specifically as follows:
(1) LoRA Fine training
The core idea is to freeze the weight W of the pre-training model and introduce low-rank matrices A and B for parameter updating:

After fusion and combination, LLM forms new parameter configuration, so that the LLM has better preference on security policy generated by RL, and meanwhile, generalization capability is considered. The final model can be directly applied to a security decision task, and the generated security policy is ensured to be efficient and reliable.
Preparation of experiment
4.1 Construction of an Experimental Environment
The combination of 5G and IoT has been a trend in the development of network technology. Compared with the prior communication network, the complexity and the openness of the 5G network are obviously improved, and the 5G network is more easily threatened and attacked by various network security.
As shown in fig. 5, a complex experimental network environment simulating a real enterprise network, 5G-IoT application is built for testing the effect of the generated security protection policies in an actual scenario. The boundary firewall and the internal firewall separate the environment from network areas with different security levels, specifically:
1) The C2 penetration area comprises an attacker host (Linux and Windows), simulates an external threat source and is connected to a network through the Internet.
2) And the DMZ zone comprises a database, web and an FTP server. The area forms a buffer zone for deploying the server and mainly plays roles of isolating risks, access control, server isolation and the like.
3) And the 5G core network area comprises 5GC network elements (AMF/SMF/UPF) and 5GC servers, is used for signal processing and data management of the 5G network and is connected with other areas through a plurality of gateways.
4) And the security management area comprises a fort machine and SOC security management equipment and provides overall network security management and policy implementation.
5) Internal applications and IoT zone-IoT devices and application server clusters comprising PCs, handsets, sensors, etc. The device is connected to the core network through a plurality of base stations, involving a plurality of wireless communication nodes.
Aiming at the 5G-IoT experimental network scenario, the section deploys targeted vulnerabilities for various regions by using an NVD universal vulnerability database [23] , and table 1 gives specific information of part of vulnerabilities.

4.2 Knowledge base construction
The relevant data of the defense relief measures in the ATT & CK [24] network security knowledge base are collected and used for building an experimental knowledge base. These measures include policies and techniques that reduce and prevent an attacker from performing malicious acts in a network environment. Table 2 summarizes the contents of the knowledge base, showing policy and technology class distributions and proportions in three security scenarios. Each policy may correspond to a number of different technology categories, e.g., a policy such as data backup corresponds to a plurality of technologies such as periodic backup planning, backup encryption, off-site backup storage, etc. These three scenarios are Enterprise environment (Enterprise), mobile environment (Mobile), industrial Control System (ICS) environment, respectively. ICS refers to networks and systems for controlling and monitoring industrial processes.
Table 2 experimental knowledge base categories and distributions
In the knowledge base, one strategy in each scene contains a plurality of corresponding specific technologies, and all technologies are classified and stored according to corresponding strategy numbers for facilitating searching. Many strategies are applicable in multiple scenarios, except for the differences in the techniques of the corresponding scenario. Therefore, all the technologies corresponding to the policy ID are stored with the policy ID as the file name. And the technology of different scenes is divided according to different dictionaries, so that the knowledge base is structurally stored. Fig. 6 shows knowledge base data samples after preprocessing with the assistance of GPT-4 scoring by scoring criteria. The GPT-4 scoring method has advantages in data evaluation and processing, and can comprehensively judge atom multidimensional indexes to improve the explanation of the scenario. Specific scoring criteria are shown in table 3. The scoring criteria are primarily referenced by the importance and applicability of policies or techniques in the environment, the complexity and potential system impact of implementation, impact on daily operation and system performance, and the expected effect in improving overall security.

4.3 Implementation of the method
Fig. 7 shows a security orchestration system flow constructed based on LANGCHAIN framework [25] and RAG [26] technology, aimed at enhancing the relevance and accuracy of LLM generated content in security orchestration by means of plug-in security knowledge base.
The system flow is divided into three stages of data processing, retrieval enhancement and scenario generation according to processing logic:
(1) Data processing stage
The system loads data from the preprocessed structured security operation and maintenance policy atom JSON file, uses LANGCHAIN JSON loader to load the policy file with nested structure in batches, and converts the policy file into Python dictionary format. Aiming at the nesting characteristic of strategy atoms, the research designs a dictionary item divider based on logic rules, recursively splits each strategy atom and generates independent item blocks according to scene classification. For policy items that contain multiple levels of classification (e.g., "system security/patch management"), the segmenter may retain its complete classification path as metadata while extracting the "Description" field as core semantic content.
To support semantic similarity retrieval, the descriptive text of the policy atom is embedded by sentence-transformers/all-mpnet-base-v2 [27] pre-trained language model vectors. All descriptive text is batch converted into 768-dimensional normalized vectors and injected into FAISS vector database in combination with metadata such as policy ID, priority, etc.
(2) Retrieval enhancement phase
Retrieval enhancement is mainly embodied in the methods of this section in two aspects, RAG and ToT [28] cues. The network attack threat information is mapped into vectors through an embedded model, the system fuses the structural filtering retrieval, and the most relevant strategy atom sets in the vector knowledge base are returned according to semantic similarity ordering. As shown in fig. 8, the retrieved policy atoms are combined with threat intelligence and embedded in the hint words that construct LLM.
And ①, analyzing the application scene by the LLM according to threat information, constructing a corresponding security arrangement script template, and defining basic structures such as triggering conditions, executing actions, verifying steps and the like.
And ②, selecting proper content from the retrieved security policy atom set by the model to fill the script template. If the atomic attack coverage rate is insufficient or a defense effect index short plate exists, the model imitates the existing atomic style to supplement and generate corresponding atomic actions.
And ③, scoring the complementary generated atomic blocks by LLM based on the scoring criteria of the existing atoms to ensure that the complementary generated atomic blocks meet the existing criteria.
And ④, setting a preference value (range 0-1) for each action in the script by LLM, marking the action exceeding 0.8 as a high recommended atom, and finally outputting the complete script.
FIG. 9 shows ToT multiple iterative hinting structures where complex security orchestration tasks are broken down into multiple thought rounds, each round with specific sub-questions and guidelines, ensuring that the model is able to systematically complete the task. The green thinking blocks correspond to atoms obtained by matching from a knowledge base, the pink thinking blocks correspond to complementary atoms generated by LLM through prompting, and the arrays correspond to four-term score representations of the atoms. Finally, in the fourth round of LLM, the combinations of web threat information and atom related attribute analysis scripts are prompted to be referred to, so that the preference probability of the atoms is provided, and the yellow label in the figure indicates the atoms with higher preference probability.
(3) Scenario generation stage
The script content generated by the LLM is split into action spaces of the RL, and the preference value of each action is used as a reference index of the RL rewarding training. And the RL obtains a stabilization strategy through multi-round training convergence, and finally generates a safety scenario with scene pertinence.
5 Experiment design and result analysis
To comprehensively and objectively evaluate the performance of the proposed solution, a solution that relies solely on LLM and RL generation scenario is chosen as a benchmark. And migrating to a security arrangement scene, wherein the CCPO [29] method realizes flexible control of the threshold value of the dynamic security scenario through a limited behavior strategy, and is set as Baseline-1. The SecCode [30] method adjusts the three-stage process (initial scenario generation, vulnerability restoration, cross-validation optimization scenario logic) to gradually generate a tree-like security scenario response process, which is set as Baseline-2.

5.1 Knowledge enhancement mechanism Performance analysis
The first set of experiments evaluates the influence of different knowledge enhancement mechanisms in the proposed method on the script generation performance, and specifically pays attention to the number of atoms generating the script, and indexes such as accuracy rate, recall rate and the like compared with a knowledge base.
TABLE 5 knowledge enhancement mechanism Performance comparison experiment results
As shown in Table 5, in the stage where no fine tuning was performed, proposed-1 exhibited the highest accuracy of 85.2% and recall of 78.5%, F1 value reached 81.7%, and the average number of atoms to generate the scenario was 14.7. In contrast, proposed-2 enhanced using only static knowledge base performed worst at this stage and the average number of atoms generating the scenario was the greatest. The combination of dynamic knowledge enhancement and ToT reasoning mechanisms effectively improves the generation quality of the safe scenario atomic actions. In the static knowledge base enhancement method, the high-quality atoms supplemented by LLM in the training generation scenario are not supplemented to the knowledge base, so that more atoms need to be arranged to achieve the scenario operation and maintenance target.
FIG. 10 (b) shows that after trimming, the performance of each method is improved, with the F1 value of Proposed-1 further improved to 86.7%, which is the best in balancing precision with recall. Proposed-3 and Proposed-4, although both of which are introduced into the dynamic knowledge base or ToT mechanism alone, have no outstanding synergistic effect. In addition, the fine tuning effectively reduces the average atom number generated by the script, reduces the redundancy of script atoms, and reflects a more refined and accurate structure. After fine tuning of Proposed-2, proposed-3 and Proposed-4, the F1 values were also significantly increased. These results indicate that introducing LLM fine tuning helps to promote knowledge recall of scenario atoms, etc., and that more atoms in the knowledge base support to stabilize scenario effects.
5.2 Security orchestration Performance analysis under different RL methods
The second set of experiments evaluates security orchestration performance analysis under different RL methods, focusing specifically on tie prize values and probability density distribution of prize values during RL training. In addition, failure rate and probability density of operation and maintenance of the generated script in the experiment environment attack and defense test are also used as reference indexes for safety arrangement performance analysis.
FIG. 11 shows the trend of the rewards over the training process and its final rewards distribution density for different RL methods. From the average total prize value of fig. 11 (a), the performance of all methods showed an increasing trend with increasing training rounds. From the training convergence curve, proposed-1 and Proposed-6 training was more stable, with a final prize convergence above 70 around 50 rounds. Proposed-7 training fluctuated more and the final reward was slightly lower than the former two. This results from the LLM strategy not having fine-tuning towards RL alignment, and the RL training is greatly affected by the LLM's own preference values and is difficult to converge. While Baseline-1 method performed the worst, the training process was oscillating vigorously, and the reward value stabilized between about 60-62 in the later stages of training.
From the case of the prize value probability density distribution of fig. 11 (b), the prize value density distribution of Proposed-1 and Proposed-6 is concentrated in the higher interval, with the peaks being significantly right and more concentrated. This means that a higher rewards return distribution can be obtained more stably, and the generated scenario is more stable in quality. Proposed-7 awards slightly shifted to around 65, while Baseline-1 awards had the lowest and more diffuse distribution of awards, indicating a weaker scenario optimization capability and a lack of stable performance. Overall, relying solely on RL algorithms does not perform as well as LLM logical reasoning and RL policy combination methods on scenario reward values and probability density distribution, and fine tuning can further enhance the coordination of LLM reasoning and RL policy.
FIG. 12 shows the trend of failure rate variation and probability distribution of an execution of an operation and a maintenance in an experimental environment under the guidance of scenario generated by several methods of training. From the average scenario operation and maintenance failure rate curve of fig. 12 (a), the failure rate of Proposed-1 drops fastest, and finally stabilizes below 4%, indicating that its optimization strategy can effectively reduce the probability of scenario execution failure. Proposed-6 failure rate was slightly higher than Proposed-1, and Proposed-7 failure rate was reduced to about 5% with a steady trend. The failure rate of Baseline-1 is always higher, and finally remains above 7%, which shows the defect of the scenario generated by relying on RL alone in the actual operation and maintenance environment. As can be seen from the probability density distribution of failure rate in FIG. 12 (b), the failure rate distribution of Proposed-1 and Proposed-6 is concentrated around 4%, and the peak density is high, indicating that the scenario operation and maintenance stability is the strongest. The failure rate distribution of Baseline-1 is the right, which shows that the scenario quality is unstable and the overall operation and maintenance stability is poor. From the analysis, the Proposed-1 method fuses more effective LLM reasoning and RL decision cooperative mechanism, and remarkably reduces the failure rate of scenario operation and maintenance. In addition, fine-tuning alignment of LLM to RL strategy effectively improves reliability and stability of scenario maintenance.
5.3 Scenario Performance analysis under different LLM settings
And a third group of experiments evaluate the performance analysis of the scenario under different LLM settings, and pay specific attention to the failure rate of the operation and maintenance of the scenario generated by the methods under different atomic number settings and the scenario generation time. In addition, the section adopts a commonly used LLM text generation quality evaluation index to evaluate the script quality, and the GPT-4 model is also used for scoring the script generation from three angles of completeness, interpretability and scene pertinence.
(1) Script performance analysis at different atomic numbers
In order to verify the influence of the number of atoms on the script operation and maintenance failure rate and the generation time, the experimental design of this section adjusts the number of the recall Top-K atoms matched with the semantic search. Fig. 13 shows the effect of different methods on failure rate and scenario generation time with a change in scenario atomic number. From the average scenario operation failure rate of fig. 13 (a), the failure rate of each method showed a gradual decrease trend as the atomic number increases. Wherein Proposed-5 shows the lowest failure rate under different atomic numbers, and particularly when the atomic number exceeds 25, the failure rate is stabilized to be about 3.5%. Baseline-2 has the highest overall failure rate, is maintained at more than 6%, and shows the defect of insufficient stability under the complex scenario generation environment.
From the average scenario generation time of fig. 13 (b), the generation time of all three methods increases significantly as the number of atoms increases. The Baseline-2 method has the shortest generation time of about 50 to 80 seconds, and the time for RL decision is omitted by simply relying on the LLM method, so that the method has advantages in the generation speed. The highest generation time of the Proposed-5 method reaches about 130 seconds, which shows that the scenario generation efficiency is greatly affected after the model scale is enlarged. From the analysis, the increase of the base model size reduces the script operation and maintenance failure rate to a certain extent, but correspondingly reduces the script generation efficiency, and the 7B model-based Proposed-1 method can better weigh the script generation performance and efficiency.
(2) Script quality assessment
Aiming at the set five attack types, the group of experiments selects corresponding strategy atoms from a knowledge base, and generates 5 standard reference scripts with the assistance of a GPT-4 model and a security expert to serve as the standard of subsequent evaluation. In order to comprehensively and objectively evaluate the quality of the safety scenario generated by each method, various subjective and objective evaluation indexes are introduced in this section, wherein the subjective and objective evaluation indexes comprise BLEU indexes for measuring the accurate matching degree of the generated scenario and the standard scenario and ROUGE indexes for evaluating the recall rate and the structural similarity of the standard scenario. And the manual scoring based on GPT-4 subjectively evaluates the script quality from three dimensions of script completeness, interpretability and scene pertinence, so that the omnibearing quality analysis of the generated script is realized.

Fig. 14 (a) shows that the profused-5 performs optimally at the BLEU score, and that the BLEU-1/2/4 reaches 56.82%, 42.37% and 29.81%, respectively, indicating that the generated transcript has higher accuracy in phrase and long sentence transcript content. Immediately following the Proposed-1 expression, the BLEU value was slightly lower than that of Proposed-5, but still higher than that of the Baseline-2 method. Baseline-2 performed the worst, with BLEU-4 reaching only 21.70%, indicating that the accuracy of the pure large model on script text expression was relatively low. From the ROUGE score shown in fig. 14 (b), the methods rank consistent with the BLEU performance. Proposed-5 overall leads other methods with ROUGE-1/2/L scores of 60.73%, 44.97% and 49.31%, respectively, meaning that the generated security scenario has the highest similarity to the reference scenario in overall logical structure. In summary, proposed-5 performs best in all evaluation dimensions of scenario generation quality based on the 13B model in combination with knowledge enhancement and RL mechanisms. The simple LLM method Baseline-2 has obviously lagged performance, and the LLM method combined with RL and knowledge enhancement is more advantageous in a security scenario generation scene.
Summary 6
Aiming at the defect of the adaptability of the static security knowledge base in a complex dynamic threat scene, a security scenario arrangement method with the cooperation of LLM and RL is provided. The method utilizes the context learning and knowledge migration capabilities of LLM to dynamically expand the policy atom set. In addition, toT reasoning method is used to prompt LLM to carry out multidimensional quantitative scoring on new atoms, so as to ensure feasibility and security of policy. The RL algorithm selects a preference optimization strategy based on the reference LLM actions. The model is subjected to policy track parameter fine adjustment and combination, so that alignment to the RL policy is realized, and the decision-making interpretability is enhanced. Experiments show that the method improves the adaptability to novel attacks in the environment of the simulated enterprise network, the 5G core network and the Internet of things, and proves the high efficiency and the superiority of the LLM and RL collaborative framework in the complex network environment safety arrangement.

7. The network security scenario arrangement method according to claim 1, wherein the network security scenario arrangement method is constructed based on LANGCHAIN frames and a retrieval enhancement generation RAG technique, wherein the vector library is a FAISS vector database;
the network security scenario arrangement method comprises the following steps:
(1) Data processing stage
Loading data from the preprocessed structured security operation and maintenance policy atom JSON file, using a LANGCHAIN JSON loader to load the policy file with the nested structure in batches, and converting the policy file into a Python dictionary format;
Adopting a dictionary item divider based on logic rules, recursively splitting each policy atom, and classifying according to scenes to generate independent item blocks;
for strategy items containing multi-level classification, the divider reserves the complete classification path as metadata, and simultaneously extracts a Description field as core semantic content;
The description texts of the strategy atoms are embedded by sentence-transformers/all-mpnet-base-v2 pre-training language model vectors, all the description texts are converted into 768-dimensional normalized vectors in batches, and are injected into a FAISS vector database by combining metadata such as strategy IDs, priorities and the like;
(2) Retrieval enhancement phase
Mapping the network attack threat information into vectors by an embedded model, merging, structuring, filtering and searching, and sequencing according to semantic similarity to return the most relevant strategy atom set in a vector knowledge base;
The retrieved policy atoms are combined with threat intelligence, embedded in the hint words that construct LLM,
Step ①, LLM analyzes the application scene according to threat information, constructs a corresponding security editing script template, and defines triggering conditions, executing actions and verifying steps;
Step ②, selecting proper content from the retrieved security policy atom set to fill the script template, and if the atom attack coverage rate is insufficient or a defense effect index short board exists, simulating the existing atom style to supplement and generate corresponding atom actions;
Step ③, LLM scoring the complementary generated atomic blocks based on the scoring criteria of the existing atoms to ensure that the complementary generated atomic blocks meet the existing criteria;
Step ④, LLM sets a preference value for each action in the script, wherein the range is 0-1, marks exceeding 0.8 are high recommended atoms, and the complete script is finally output;
(3) Scenario generation stage
The script content generated by the LLM is split into action spaces of the RL, the preference value of each action is used as a reference index of the RL rewarding training, the RL obtains a stable strategy through multi-round training convergence, and finally the safe script with scene pertinence is generated.

### 📜 Full Specification & Deep Scrape Text
Title
A method and system for an efficient privacy-preserving computing fusion engine for medical data

Abstract
Translated from Chinese
This invention provides a method and system for a high-efficiency privacy-preserving computation fusion engine for medical data. It includes: constructing a medical data encryption/decryption system as a foundation, standardizing and encapsulating technologies such as federated learning, homomorphic encryption, and secure multi-party computation, and defining a unified technical framework including data encryption interfaces, ciphertext computation interfaces, and result decryption interfaces; employing an intelligent task parsing mechanism to automatically decompose high-level medical analysis needs into a sequence of privacy-preserving computation sub-tasks, and achieving multi-technology collaboration through an execution engine; simultaneously, implementing resource monitoring and performance analysis functions, supporting runtime technology switching and parameter tuning, forming a self-optimizing execution environment. Finally, it provides a user-friendly application interface and visual display. This invention addresses the problems of single technical routes, low computational efficiency, poor resource utilization, and severe memory limitations in medical data privacy protection.

Description
Efficient privacy calculation fusion engine method and system for medical data
Technical Field
The invention relates to the field of medical big data processing and privacy protection, in particular to a medical data-oriented efficient privacy calculation fusion engine method and a medical data-oriented efficient privacy calculation fusion engine system, which are mainly applied to cross-mechanism safe sharing and analysis scenes of medical data.
Background
With the popularity of medical big data applications, privacy protection and efficient utilization of medical data is an important technical challenge. The medical data has the characteristics of high sensitivity, high dimensional isomerism, cross-institution dispersibility and the like, so that the traditional data analysis method is difficult to be directly applied to cross-institution sharing and analysis scenes of the medical data.
At present, the privacy computing technology has certain application in the field of medical data, and mainly comprises technical routes such as federal learning, homomorphic encryption, safe multiparty computing and the like. Federal learning allows organizations to collaboratively train models without sharing original data, homomorphic encryption supports direct computation on encrypted data, and secure multiparty computation allows multiparty computing of specific functions together while protecting the privacy of the respective data.
The prior art generally adopts a single privacy computing technology route to realize safe sharing and analysis of medical data, such as a medical data analysis system based on homomorphic encryption or a cross-institution collaborative model training framework based on federal learning. These systems typically use a fixed encryption scheme and computational protocol in implementation, the system architecture is relatively rigid, and the computational model is tightly coupled to the data processing flow.
However, the prior art has obvious defects that firstly, a single technical route is difficult to adapt to complex scenes and diversified calculation requirements of medical data, secondly, the existing encryption algorithm has low efficiency and high calculation cost when processing high-dimensional medical data, thirdly, the system performance and the resource utilization rate are poor due to the lack of an adaptive technology selection mechanism aiming at different types of medical data and calculation tasks, and finally, the existing system has serious memory limitation and calculation efficiency problems when processing large-scale high-concurrency medical data modeling.
Disclosure of Invention
The invention aims to provide a high-efficiency privacy calculation fusion engine method and system for medical data, and aims to solve the problems of single technical route, low calculation efficiency, poor resource utilization, serious memory limitation and the like in the privacy protection of the medical data.
In order to achieve the above purpose, the technical scheme provided by the invention is as follows:
the invention provides a medical data-oriented efficient privacy calculation fusion engine method, which comprises the following steps:
Based on the multi-source medical data characteristics, constructing a mapping relation from a state identifier to a prefix tree node through a prefix tree data structure, and realizing a read-write lock mechanism and a dynamic memory allocation strategy for supporting multi-thread concurrent access to obtain a state management module;
According to the state management module, analyzing performance characteristics of various privacy computing technologies under different medical data scenes, classifying computing tasks according to data scale, computing complexity and privacy requirements, modeling the computing tasks as optimization problems, designing an approximate algorithm to integrate data types, computing tasks and system resource states, and generating a self-adaptive privacy computing technology combination strategy;
According to the self-adaptive privacy computing technology combination strategy, the privacy computing protocol is decomposed into basic operation elements and a mathematical model is constructed, the computation cost, communication overhead and multidimensional weight of safety intensity of the protocol elements are defined, and a design solving algorithm selects the minimum cost protocol element combination meeting a preset safety threshold value to obtain an optimized privacy computing protocol frame;
Based on the optimized privacy computing protocol framework, carrying out privacy sensitivity analysis and grading on medical data, designing a hybrid encryption strategy and realizing a distributed key generation, distribution and management system to obtain a medical data encryption and decryption system;
Based on the medical data encryption and decryption system, standardized packaging is realized for various privacy computing technologies, a unified interface is defined, and an execution engine is constructed to realize multi-technology collaborative scheduling and execution, so that the medical data privacy computing fusion system is obtained.
Further, the constructing a mapping relationship from a state identifier to a prefix tree node through a prefix tree data structure, to implement a read-write lock mechanism and a dynamic memory allocation policy supporting multi-thread concurrent access, and obtain a state management module, including:
Analyzing the data types, the data scales and the access modes in the multi-source medical data characteristics, analyzing the state space generated in the privacy calculation process, determining the state characteristics and the distribution rules, and designing a prefix tree structure suitable for the medical data privacy calculation, wherein the prefix tree structure comprises node representation, path coding and a tree balancing strategy, so that a prefix tree structure design scheme is obtained;
Based on the prefix tree structure design scheme, a mapping relation from the state identifier to the prefix tree node is constructed, so that efficient storage and retrieval of state information are realized, and a state-prefix tree mapping system is obtained;
According to the state-prefix tree mapping system, aiming at federal learning training tasks and homomorphic encryption computing task scenes initiated by a plurality of medical institutions at the same time, a concurrent control mechanism based on read-write locks is realized to support simultaneous reading and mutually exclusive writing of prefix tree nodes by multiple threads, a dynamic memory allocation strategy is realized to adaptively adjust the capacity of a memory pool according to the size of a state space, and a concurrent optimized prefix tree state management module is obtained;
Based on the prefix tree state management module with concurrent optimization, the path compression technology of the prefix tree is realized to merge paths with single child nodes, an incremental persistence mechanism is realized to write only the prefix tree nodes which are changed into a storage medium, storage overhead is reduced, breakpoint recovery of a large-scale medical model is supported, and the state management module is obtained.
Further, the analyzing performance characteristics of various privacy computing technologies under different medical data scenes classifies computing tasks according to data scale, computing complexity and privacy requirements and models the computing tasks as optimization problems, designs an approximation algorithm to integrate data types, computing tasks and system resource states, and generates a self-adaptive privacy computing technology combination strategy, which comprises the following steps:
Based on the state management module, acquiring state data of each privacy computing technology in the history execution process, analyzing the characteristics of federal learning, homomorphic encryption, safe multiparty computation execution time, memory occupation and computation precision under different medical data types and computation scenes, and obtaining a technical characteristic evaluation matrix;
classifying medical data calculation tasks according to data scale, calculation complexity and privacy requirements based on the technical characteristic evaluation matrix, and establishing a task classification system to obtain a medical calculation task class model;
modeling a privacy computing technology selection problem as a non-uniform k center problem according to the medical computing task class model, and defining a cost function and resource constraint to obtain a mathematical optimization model;
According to the mathematical optimization model, designing and realizing an approximate algorithm of resource minimization, solving the problem of non-uniform k center, and obtaining a technical selection algorithm;
Based on the technology selection algorithm, the data type, the calculation task and the system resource state are comprehensively considered, and an optimal privacy calculation technology combination strategy is dynamically generated to obtain the self-adaptive privacy calculation technology combination strategy.

Based on federal learning, homomorphic encryption and secure multiparty computing technologies determined in the self-adaptive privacy computing technology combination strategy, decomposing privacy computing protocols corresponding to the technologies into basic operation elements of key exchange, data encryption, ciphertext calculation and result decryption, and establishing a protocol element library to obtain a protocol element set;
Based on the protocol element set, an uncertainty array-simulating model is built, protocol elements are used as elements in an array-simulating model, differential privacy protection intensity of data which is not leaked and calculation efficiency requirement of protocol execution are used as independent constraint of the array-simulating model, and an array-simulating mathematical model is obtained;
Defining a calculation cost comprising a CPU cycle number for each protocol element according to the pseudo-array mathematical model, wherein communication overhead comprises a transmission data quantity, security intensity comprises a differential privacy parameter epsilon value, and establishing a comprehensive evaluation system to obtain an element weight matrix;
According to the element weight matrix, a minimum weight base solving algorithm is designed and realized, and a protocol element combination with a differential privacy parameter epsilon value smaller than a preset safety threshold and minimum total calculation cost and communication expenditure is selected from protocol elements to obtain a protocol minimum weight base;
And constructing a protocol optimization framework based on the protocol minimum weight base, and realizing dynamic combination and formal verification of protocol elements to obtain the optimized privacy calculation protocol framework.
Further, privacy sensitivity analysis and classification are carried out on medical data, a mixed encryption strategy is designed, and a distributed key generation, distribution and management system is realized, so that a medical data encryption and decryption system is obtained, and the method comprises the following steps:
based on the optimized privacy computing protocol framework, carrying out privacy sensitivity quantitative analysis on patient identity information, diagnosis records and gene data in medical data, dividing the sensitivity into three stages of high sensitivity, medium sensitivity and low sensitivity from high to low, and establishing a multi-stage protection strategy to obtain a data sensitivity grading model;
Based on the data sensitivity grading model, designing a mixed encryption strategy combining symmetric encryption and asymmetric encryption, and selecting encryption schemes with different intensities aiming at data with different sensitivities to obtain the mixed encryption strategy;
according to the mixed encryption strategy, according to the calculation cost constraint in the optimized privacy calculation protocol framework, optimizing the key expansion round number and grouping mode parameters of an encryption algorithm to obtain an optimized encryption algorithm set;
based on the optimized encryption algorithm set, a distributed key generation, distribution and management system is designed and realized, so that key safety in a multi-mechanism cooperation environment is ensured, and a key management system is obtained;

According to the standardized privacy computing module set, an analysis system of medical data analysis and model training tasks is realized, disease prediction model training, multi-center clinical data statistical analysis and genome data association analysis requirements submitted by a user are received, the medical data encryption and decryption system is called to encrypt original medical data, and the disease prediction model training, the multi-center clinical data statistical analysis and the genome data association analysis requirements are decomposed into privacy computing subtask sequences, so that a task execution plan is obtained;
Constructing a privacy calculation execution engine core according to the task execution plan, integrating the key management function of the medical data encryption and decryption system, realizing multi-technology collaborative scheduling and execution, supporting data operation in a ciphertext state, and obtaining an execution engine core system;
based on the execution engine core system, a computing resource monitoring and performance analysis system is realized, encryption and decryption overhead and key management states of the medical data encryption and decryption system are monitored, and the runtime technology switching and parameter tuning are supported to obtain a self-optimizing execution environment;

Based on the data types, the data scales and the access modes in the multi-source medical data characteristics, analyzing the state characteristics and the distribution rules in the medical data state space, and determining the state quantity, the state transition frequency and the state dependency relationship to obtain a medical data state space characteristic model;
and designing a prefix tree node structure based on the medical data state space feature model, wherein the prefix tree node structure comprises a node data field, a child node pointer array and a compression mark, a design path coding scheme adopts variable length coding, and an AVL tree balance strategy is designed to maintain the query efficiency of the prefix tree, so that the prefix tree structure design scheme is obtained.
Further, modeling a privacy computing technology selection problem as a non-uniform k center problem according to the medical computing task category model, defining a cost function and a resource constraint, and obtaining a mathematical optimization model, including:
Based on the medical computing task category model, extracting all classified medical data computing tasks to form a medical data computing task set, defining each task in the medical data computing task set as a feature vector containing data scale, computing complexity and privacy requirements, and defining privacy computing technologies including federal learning, homomorphic encryption and safe multiparty computing as a technology set to obtain a task-technology mapping frame;
Defining a distance function to represent the cost when tasks in the medical data calculation task set are executed by adopting technologies in the technology set based on the task-technology mapping framework, defining capacity constraint to represent the maximum task number and radius constraint that can be processed simultaneously by each technology in the technology set to represent the maximum execution cost acceptable by each technology, and obtaining a constraint condition set;
and constructing an objective function to minimize the maximum task-technology distance in all tasks according to the constraint condition set, setting constraint conditions that the number of tasks allocated by each technology does not exceed the corresponding capacity constraint and the distance between each task and the corresponding allocation technology does not exceed the radius constraint of the corresponding technology, and obtaining the mathematical optimization model.
Further, according to the element weight matrix, a minimum weight base solving algorithm is designed and implemented, and a protocol element combination with a differential privacy parameter epsilon value smaller than a preset safety threshold and minimum total computation cost and communication overhead is selected from protocol elements to obtain a protocol minimum weight base, which comprises the following steps:
Based on the calculation cost, communication overhead and security intensity weight of each protocol element defined in the element weight matrix, extracting all protocol elements in the element weight matrix to create a protocol element selection set, and sequencing all protocol elements according to the order of security intensity from high to low to obtain a candidate element sequence;
according to the candidate element sequence, adopting a greedy strategy to sequentially select protocol elements meeting the condition that the epsilon value of the differential privacy parameter is smaller than a preset safety threshold, and calculating total calculation cost and communication overhead of the currently selected element combination to obtain an initial protocol element combination;
Based on the initial protocol element combination, element replacement and combination optimization are carried out in an iterative mode, the total calculation cost and communication cost are continuously reduced on the premise that the differential privacy parameter epsilon value meets the safety threshold value, and when the total calculation cost and the communication cost cannot be reduced through continuous multiple iterations, the iteration is stopped, so that the local optimal element combination is obtained;
And verifying the independence constraint and the array-simulating property of the selected protocol elements according to the locally optimal element combination, ensuring that the element combination meets the protocol integrity and safety requirements, and obtaining the protocol minimum weight base.

The state management module is used for constructing a mapping relation from the state identifier to the prefix tree node through the prefix tree data structure based on the multi-source medical data characteristics, realizing a read-write lock mechanism and a dynamic memory allocation strategy for supporting multi-thread concurrent access, and obtaining the state management module;

The invention has the advantages and positive effects that:

The prefix tree is adopted to replace hash mapping to store the state space of medical privacy calculation, so that the problem of memory limitation in medical big data modeling is solved, the method is particularly suitable for complex medical models such as Clinical Relational Network (CRN) and the like, and the memory occupancy rate is reduced;

5. And constructing a privacy computing execution engine with multi-technology integration, realizing unified scheduling and cooperative work of technologies such as federal learning, homomorphic encryption, safe multiparty computing and the like, and supporting 'available invisible' safe sharing and analysis of cross-institution medical data.
Drawings
In order to more clearly illustrate the technical solutions of the embodiments of the present application, the drawings that are needed in the description of the embodiments will be briefly described below, it being obvious that the drawings in the following description are only some embodiments of the present application, and that other drawings may be obtained according to these drawings without inventive effort for a person skilled in the art.
FIG. 1 is a flow chart of a method of the efficient privacy computing fusion engine for medical data of the present invention;
FIG. 2 is a flow chart of the operation of the adaptive technology selection module of the present invention;
fig. 3 is a schematic structural diagram of the efficient privacy computing fusion engine system for medical data.
Detailed Description
The preferred embodiments of the present invention will be described below with reference to the accompanying drawings, it being understood that the preferred embodiments described herein are for illustration and explanation of the present invention only, and are not intended to limit the present invention.
As shown in fig. 1, the present invention provides a method for an efficient privacy computation fusion engine for medical data, comprising:
step S1, based on the multi-source medical data characteristics, a mapping relation from a state identifier to a prefix tree node is constructed through a prefix tree data structure, a read-write lock mechanism supporting multi-thread concurrent access and a dynamic memory allocation strategy are realized, and a state management module is obtained.
S2, analyzing performance characteristics of various privacy computing technologies under different medical data scenes according to the state management module, classifying computing tasks according to data scale, computing complexity and privacy requirements, modeling the computing tasks as optimization problems, designing an approximate algorithm to integrate data types, computing tasks and system resource states, and generating a self-adaptive privacy computing technology combination strategy;
S3, according to the self-adaptive privacy computing technology combination strategy, decomposing a privacy computing protocol into basic operation elements and constructing a mathematical model, defining multi-dimensional weights of computing cost, communication overhead and safety intensity of protocol elements, and designing a solving algorithm to select a minimum cost protocol element combination meeting a preset safety threshold value to obtain an optimized privacy computing protocol frame;
s4, based on the optimized privacy computing protocol framework, carrying out privacy sensitivity analysis and classification on the medical data, designing a hybrid encryption strategy and realizing a distributed key generation, distribution and management system to obtain a medical data encryption and decryption system;
and S5, based on the medical data encryption and decryption system, realizing standardized packaging and defining a unified interface for various privacy computing technologies, and constructing an execution engine to realize multi-technology collaborative scheduling and execution to obtain the medical data privacy computing fusion system.
In one embodiment of the present invention, in step S1, further comprising:
S11, analyzing the data types, the data scales and the access modes in the multi-source medical data characteristics, analyzing the state space generated in the privacy calculation process, determining the state characteristics and the distribution rules, and designing a prefix tree structure suitable for the medical data privacy calculation, wherein the prefix tree structure comprises node representation, path coding and a tree balancing strategy, so that a prefix tree structure design scheme is obtained.
First, deep analysis is performed on the characteristics of the multi-source medical data. Multisource medical data typically includes multiple types of structured Electronic Health Records (EHRs), semi-structured medical image data, and unstructured medical text records. In terms of data size, clinical data typically has high dimensional characteristics, a single patient record may contain thousands of features, while genomic data has a higher dimension, with a single sample reaching millions of feature points. In terms of access patterns, the frequency of reading medical data is generally higher than the frequency of writing, for example, in disease prediction model training, the model parameter updating frequency is far lower than the data reading frequency, and the characteristic of more writing and less writing is typical.
Aiming at a state space generated in the privacy calculation process, the step establishes an analysis framework of the system. In medical data privacy computation, a state space refers to a set of all intermediate states that need to be maintained during the execution of an algorithm, including model parameters, gradient information, encrypted intermediate values, and the like. By analyzing typical privacy calculation scenes such as federal learning, homomorphic encryption, safe multiparty calculation and the like, the state space of the medical data privacy calculation is found to have three key characteristics, namely state space sparsity, access locality and hierarchical structure. State space sparsity refers to the fact that in a theoretically possible state set, the number of actually used states is small, usually lower than 1%, access locality is represented by the fact that relevant states are usually close to each other in an identifier space, and a hierarchical structure is represented by the fact that a clear hierarchical dependency relationship exists between the states, such as association between model parameters and corresponding gradients.
Based on the analysis, a feature model of the state quantity, state transition frequency, and state dependency is determined. In the medical data privacy calculation, the state quantity is in a direct proportion relation with the data dimension and the number of participants, the state transition frequency shows periodic change in the model training process and is related to the iteration times, and the state dependency relation can be formed into a Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) structure to describe the evolution paths among the states. These features together form a medical data state space feature model.
Then, based on the medical data state space feature model, a prefix tree node structure is designed, including a node data field, a child node pointer array and a compression flag. The prefix tree node structure comprises three parts, namely (1) a data field for storing state information associated with nodes and supporting state data with variable length, (2) a child node pointer array which is realized by adopting a dynamic array and automatically adjusts the size according to branch factors so as to avoid memory waste, (3) a compression mark for identifying whether the nodes participate in path compression and compressing the length information of paths.
In the path coding scheme design, a variable length coding technique is used to adaptively select a coding length according to the characteristics of the state identifier. Variable length coding is a technique of assigning different length codes according to the probability of occurrence of data, in which a high frequency access state is assigned a shorter code and a low frequency access state is assigned a longer code, which matches with the unevenly distributed characteristic of medical data state access. The encoding scheme uses prefix rules to ensure the uniqueness of decoding, i.e. that any encoding is not a prefix of another encoding.
In order to ensure the query efficiency of the prefix tree in a dynamic environment, the scheme adopts an AVL tree balancing strategy. The AVL tree is a self-balancing binary search tree with a difference in height of no more than 1 between the left and right subtrees of any node, ensuring that the time complexity of the lookup operation is O (log n) in the worst case.
