### 📋 Abstract
> The invention relates to the technical field of toughness improvement of an electric heating information physical system, and discloses a multi-stage toughness collaborative improvement method of an electric heating comprehensive energy information physical system. The method comprises the steps of constructing a defense resource allocation optimization model, performing defense resource allocation optimization based on attack schemes corresponding to attack scenes and load loss caused by the attack schemes, constructing an attack response simulation optimization model, performing attack response simulation optimization according to the attack scenes, and constructing a collaborative optimization model of attack response and toughness recovery. The PTCPS comprehensive toughness improvement under the cyber-physical collaborative attack is realized through a multi-stage collaborative strategy; according to the invention, the cognitive ability and response ability of the system to complex coupling disturbance are enhanced; global response and comprehensive toughness enhancement of the system in a complex attack mode are realized; and defense resource optimization configuration is carried out before attack, and system emergency recovery is realized by utilizing the internal performance characteristics of the system after attack, so that the recovery efficiency is improved, and the overall process-oriented system-level toughness improvement is realized.

### 📜 Full Specification & Deep Scrape Text
Title
A multi-stage resilience collaborative improvement method for an electrothermal integrated energy cyber-physical system

Abstract
Translated from Chinese
The present invention relates to the technical field of improving the resilience of electrothermal cyber-physical systems, and discloses a multi-stage collaborative resilience improvement method for electrothermal integrated energy cyber-physical systems. A defense resource allocation optimization model is constructed, and defense resource allocation optimization is performed based on the attack scheme corresponding to each attack scenario and the load loss caused by it. An attack response simulation optimization model is constructed, and attack response simulation optimization is performed according to the attack scenario. A collaborative optimization model of attack response and resilience recovery is constructed, and through a multi-stage collaborative strategy, the comprehensive resilience improvement of PTCPS under cyber-physical collaborative attacks is achieved; the present invention enhances the system's cognitive ability and response ability to complex coupled disturbances; achieves global response and comprehensive resilience enhancement of the system under complex attack modes; performs defense resource optimization configuration before the attack, and uses the system's internal performance characteristics after the attack to achieve system emergency recovery, improve recovery efficiency, and achieve system-level resilience improvement for the entire process.

Description
Multi-stage toughness cooperative lifting method for electric heating comprehensive energy information physical system
Technical Field
The invention relates to the technical field of toughness promotion of an electric heating information physical system, in particular to a multistage toughness cooperative promotion method of an electric heating comprehensive energy information physical system.
Background
Along with the development of the comprehensive energy system to the intelligent, multi-energy collaboration and depth informatization, a physical energy system (such as a power grid and a heat supply network) and an information sensing, communication and control system are gradually integrated, so that a highly-coupled information physical system is formed. In particular, in urban energy infrastructure, the electric heating comprehensive energy system effectively improves the energy utilization efficiency and the system flexibility through joint scheduling and resource cooperation. At the same time, however, this cross-domain fusion also significantly enhances the complexity and linkage vulnerability of the system. In this context, the electrothermal information physical system (PTCPS, power AND THERMAL Cyber-PHYSICAL SYSTEMS) is typically represented by a structure exhibiting a complex characteristic of "multi-coupling+cross-layer control", and especially when subjected to extreme disturbance or malicious attack, cross-domain cascade failure and multi-dimensional performance degradation may be formed. Therefore, how to construct a toughness improvement mechanism with overall process cooperative defense and recovery capability under PTCPS framework has become a key technical requirement for new energy systems.
The system-level security risk of the information physical fusion system in the multi-energy coupling and cross-layer propagation background can bring impact which can be compared with the natural disaster risk encountered by the traditional energy system. Therefore, it is needed to construct a toughness improving framework for a multi-energy coupling system, and particularly in the case of cross-layer collaborative attack, the coupling relationship between information and a physical layer significantly increases the complexity and the risk brought by high dependency of the system.
In recent years, the improvement of toughness of energy systems has become an important research direction for coping with extreme disturbance, natural disasters and compound network attacks. In the field of power systems, toughness research is mainly focused on the carrying capacity and recovery mechanism of a power distribution network under the condition of extreme natural disasters. The existing research results obviously enhance the operation recovery capability of the power system under the condition of natural disasters, but most of work is still limited to a physical layer, lacks systematic modeling of failure and linkage mechanisms of the information system, and mainly aims at a single energy type without covering complex propagation characteristics under a multi-energy coupling structure.
With the development of urban comprehensive energy systems, research is gradually extended from a single energy system to an electric-thermal-gas multi-energy coupling structure, and toughness modeling and optimization of the comprehensive energy systems become an emerging research hotspot. The existing research preliminarily realizes the toughness collaborative design of the multi-energy physical system, and provides reference for the post-disaster recovery and scheduling optimization of the comprehensive energy system. However, most of the achievements are still focused on the physical system, and the key roles of the information layer in fault propagation, cooperative defense and resource scheduling are not discussed deeply, and a cooperative lifting mechanism in the background of covering information physical fusion is not formed.
As the power system evolves toward the information physical fusion direction, some students begin to explore the impact of the information system on the system toughness. However, the existing research is still mainly focused on information physical fusion of the power system, and is not yet expanded to a multi-energy coupling information physical system. The literature proposes a model independent toughness scheduling method based on state antagonism deep reinforcement learning, which aims to improve the adaptability of an integrated energy system of integrated demand response in the face of uncertainty and network attack, but the disturbance range is still mainly limited to an information layer. Compared with a power system, the multi-energy coupling system is more complex in terms of coupling paths, feedback mechanisms and cross-layer scheduling, and has higher requirements on toughness modeling and strategy design. The existing research is concentrated on a single-stage strategy of an information layer or a physical layer, lacks a multi-stage collaborative lifting framework covering the whole process, and is difficult to support the efficient defense and quick recovery of a system under the condition of composite disturbance.
In summary, the current toughness improvement research still has the following three disadvantages:
1) The existing toughness improvement technology is mainly focused on physical layer disturbance response of a single energy system, lacks comprehensive modeling and consideration of a dynamic coupling and information physical cooperative mechanism of a multi-energy system, fails to fully consider deep coupling relations among electric, thermal and information systems, and is difficult to effectively describe propagation paths and linkage characteristics of cross-layer disturbance.
2) The current research mainly comprises physical attack, disturbance modeling is limited to a single physical layer, linkage impact caused by cross-layer cooperative attack is difficult to effectively cope with, and system modeling and coping strategies for information attack and a mechanism for cooperative action of the information attack and the physical attack are lacking, so that the system has insufficient defending capability under the situation of facing compound type and multi-source attack.
3) The existing toughness promotion strategies aiming at the multi-energy information physical system only consider the external resource support after attack occurs, neglect the mobilization and coordination utilization of the available resources in the system, focus on a single stage, have insufficient coordination and comprehensive utilization degree of the existing resources and lack a multi-stage strategy penetrating the whole process.
Disclosure of Invention
Aiming at the problems, the invention aims to provide a multistage toughness collaborative lifting method of an electric heating comprehensive energy information physical system, which is used for constructing a collaborative modeling method oriented to the electric heating information physical system (PTCPS), enhancing the cognition capability and response capability of the system to complex coupling disturbance, establishing a toughness lifting mechanism suitable for an information and physical collaborative attack scene, realizing global response and comprehensive toughness enhancement of the system in a complex attack mode, constructing a multistage toughness lifting framework, carrying out defensive resource optimization configuration before attack, utilizing the internal performance characteristics of the system to realize emergency recovery of the system, improving recovery efficiency and realizing system-level toughness lifting oriented to the whole process. The technical proposal is as follows:
A multi-stage toughness cooperative lifting method of an electric heating comprehensive energy information physical system comprises the following steps:
step 1, defending resource allocation optimization;
Constructing a defending resource allocation optimization model, firstly inputting parameters of an electrothermal comprehensive energy information physical system and the scale of information physical cooperative attack to generate N attack scenes under a corresponding scale, executing attack response simulation in the step 2 for each attack scene, and feeding back the attack scenes meeting the set load loss condition to the step;
Step 2, attack response simulation optimization;
By carrying out operation simulation on each attack scene, evaluating the load loss condition of the electric power system and the thermodynamic system under the disturbance condition, and returning the attack scene meeting the set load loss and the load loss result to the step 1;
step 3, cooperative optimization of attack response and toughness recovery;
And constructing a cooperative optimization model of attack response and toughness recovery, optimizing a recovery process after disturbance based on the provided defensive resource allocation result and attack scene, and optimizing the performance recovery of the system after disturbance with the aim of minimizing multidimensional performance degradation and recovery cost.
The beneficial effects of the invention are as follows:
1) The invention breaks through the modeling mode that the existing toughness improvement technology is limited to a single energy system, systematically considers the coupling relation among three systems of electricity, heat and information under PTCPS frames, can more accurately describe the propagation path of cross-layer disturbance and the linkage response behavior of the system, and improves the modeling and identification capability of complex collaborative attack.
2) Aiming at the actual situation that the existing toughness improvement model generally ignores information physical cooperative attack, the invention provides a PTCPS system-oriented overall process toughness improvement method, which comprehensively covers the system linkage failure problem caused by the information and physical layer composite attack from the defense configuration before attack and the system response in the attack process to the recovery regulation after attack, and improves the overall toughness of the system under the complex attack scene.
3) Compared with the traditional toughness improvement method which relies on external resources to carry out post-disaster recovery, the method mainly considers the existing resources in the system in the toughness recovery model, comprises an overall coordination mechanism of a thermal information wireless base station and an electric heating transient decoupling mechanism, combines with the defending resource optimization configuration before attack, realizes the overall process toughness collaborative improvement from prevention to recovery, and effectively improves the resource utilization efficiency and the recovery response speed.

Detailed Description
The invention will now be described in further detail with reference to the drawings and to specific examples.
The invention provides a multistage toughness cooperative lifting method of an electric heating comprehensive energy system considering information physical cooperative attack, and the innovation points are embodied in the following three aspects. Firstly, an interaction mechanism oriented to PTCPS is constructed, aiming at an information physical cooperative attack scene, a multi-level interaction system is established by comprehensively considering the coupling characteristic of an electric heating system and the control dependency relationship of an information layer, the information physical propagation mechanism and the vulnerability characteristic of cross-layer disturbance and attack are revealed, secondly, a multi-stage toughness improvement framework oriented to the whole attack process is provided, and a three-layer optimization model covering defense configuration, attack response simulation and recovery scheduling is constructed. The model carries out joint simulation by introducing a multi-attack combination, evaluates the influence of different disturbance paths on toughness performance, optimizes defensive resource allocation and recovery strategies on the basis, and realizes overall toughness improvement oriented to uncertain attack situations. Thirdly, a multi-stage collaborative lifting strategy is provided, the defensive resources of the information layer and the physical layer are allocated in a collaborative optimization mode before attack are integrated in the framework, the existing multi-dimensional emergency resources are fully utilized after attack, and the method comprises the steps of supporting emergency wireless communication, an electrothermal transient decoupling operation mechanism and cross-layer collaborative maintenance path scheduling by utilizing a nearby thermal information base station, and the resource coordination efficiency and the overall toughness of the system are improved.
The multi-stage toughness collaborative lifting method for the electric heating information physical system (PTCPS) provided by the invention constructs a toughness lifting flow for the whole process of information physical collaborative attack on the basis of comprehensively considering the physical coupling characteristic of the electric heating system and the control dependency relationship of the information system. The process comprises three steps of defending resource allocation optimization, attack response simulation optimization and cooperative optimization of attack response and toughness recovery. The flow chart is shown in figure 1.
And step 1, defending a resource allocation optimization model. Firstly, inputting the scale of the system parameter and information physical cooperative attack, and generating N typical attack scenes under the corresponding scale. And (3) executing attack response simulation in the step (2) on each attack scene, and feeding back the scenes meeting certain load loss conditions to the step. After all simulation of the N scenes is completed, defense resource allocation optimization is performed based on attack schemes corresponding to all attack scenes and load loss caused by the attack schemes. The model takes the expected load loss of the minimized system as an optimization target, and constraint conditions comprise fault occurrence probability constraint and total defensive resource limitation under various attack scenes. And solving the model by adopting a particle swarm optimization algorithm to obtain the optimal allocation scheme of the information and physical layer defense resources.
Specific examples are as follows:
The finite nature of defensive resources determines the rationality of resource allocation. In order to maximize the anti-attack capability of the system, the defensive resources need to be reasonably allocated between the information layer and the physical layer. Part of the critical information and physical devices have a greater impact on the security of the system as a whole, so the allocation of defensive resources should be biased towards critical elements to reduce their failure probability.

(1) Information layer constraints:
The information layer includes an electrical information system and a thermal information system. In PTCPS of the present embodiment, the electrical information network is typically wired by means of optical fibers, while the thermal information network uses wireless communication. (3) Information physical interaction constraint:
The information layer influences the operation state of the physical layer through the measuring and controlling functions, and the physical layer provides energy supply guarantee for the information layer.
The frequency modulation function in the power system reflects the control function of the information layer to the physical layer, and the automatic power generation control (automatic generation control, AGC) senses the frequency deviation in real time and adjusts the output of the unit to maintain the stability of the system. However, when the information node is attacked and fails, the frequency change cannot be accurately perceived, the AGC response fails, and the system frequency stability is reduced. In order to simplify modeling, when an information system fails, power unbalance realizes frequency recovery by cutting off an uncontrollable unit. And 3, collaborative optimization of attack response and toughness recovery. After the two steps are completed, the cooperative optimization of attack response and system recovery is further developed. The step is based on the provided defensive resource allocation result and the attack scene, and an optimization model oriented to the post-disturbance recovery process is carried out. The model aims at minimizing multi-dimensional performance degradation and recovery cost, and optimizes performance recovery of the system after disturbance. The specific recovery measures comprise communication recovery of an electric power information network by utilizing a nearby thermal information wireless base station, electric heating short decoupling operation to improve the flexibility of system adjustment in a recovery stage, and maintenance of a fault element for coordinating maintenance information and physics. And finally outputting a toughness curve from attack response to recovery end.
Through a multi-stage cooperative strategy, PTCPS comprehensive toughness improvement under information physical cooperative attack is realized.
Specific examples are as follows:
And 3, constructing a cooperative optimization model of attack response and toughness recovery, wherein the attack response model is constructed in the previous step, so that a multi-dimensional emergency resource coordination recovery model aiming at PTCPS is constructed on the basis of the previous step. The model comprehensively considers interaction and electric heating coupling characteristics of an information physical system, and realizes rapid collaborative recovery after attack occurrence so as to improve system toughness through an emergency communication recovery strategy of reestablishing a communication link of an electric power information node by means of a thermodynamic system wireless base station, a transient decoupling operation strategy of an electric heating coupling element and a synchronous maintenance scheduling mechanism of maintenance teams on the information and physical nodes.

In order to relieve supply and demand unbalance caused by attack, the CHP temporarily releases the coupling constraint of the electric heating efficiency during recovery, and only needs to meet the output safety range (65), the recovery model allows the CHP unit to independently adjust the electric/thermal output, and the key load recovery is preferentially ensured through the electric or thermal discarding operation (economic cost is required to be counted), so that the system flexibility is improved.

1. introducing an example;
The embodiment verification is performed by adopting an electrothermal information physical system comprising 71 physical nodes and 71 information nodes, so as to verify the effective effect of the multistage toughness collaborative lifting method of the electrothermal comprehensive energy information physical system. The physical layer of the system is formed by coupling an improved IEEE 39 node electric power system and a 32 node thermodynamic system, 7 power generation nodes, 3 CHP units and 1 Electric Boiler (EB) are covered, and the electric heating system coupling is realized at a plurality of key nodes. The corresponding information communication system is mapped with the physical system nodes one by one, the electric power communication network adopts optical fiber connection to construct a wired communication link, and the thermal communication network realizes information transmission through the deployed wireless base station. The overall structure of the system is shown in fig. 2 (a) and fig. 2 (b), wherein fig. 2 (a) is a physical layer structure, formulae (1) - (41) are power lines, and fig. 2 (b) is an information layer structure. 2. Analyzing results;
In order to verify the effectiveness of the multi-stage toughness improvement method provided by the invention, comparison analysis is carried out with a standard scheme which does not adopt the method. The attack scale of the information and the physical layer is set to be 5, the information and the physical defense resource budget are set to be 50, and the scale of the information and the physical maintenance team is set to be 2. The comparison scheme is set as follows:
case 1, the multi-stage toughness promotion strategy provided by the invention comprehensively considers the information physical defense resource optimization configuration before attack and the cooperative recovery of the existing multidimensional emergency resources after attack;
And Case 2, performing joint repair by information and a physical maintenance team only after attack occurs without performing defense resource optimization, and taking the joint repair as a reference scene.

Fig. 3, 4 and 5 show the performance curves of the power system, the thermodynamic system and the information network respectively under two schemes. As can be seen from the graph, under the scheme (Case 1) of the present invention, all three systems show smaller performance loss and faster recovery rate after attack, and are specifically shown as follows:
The minimum supply rate of the power system load is improved by 9.36% compared with Case2, and the recovery time is shortened by 5.5h;
The minimum supply rate of the thermodynamic system load is improved by 11.25% compared with Case2, and the recovery time is shortened by 4.75h;
The minimum effective rate of the information system nodes is improved by 8.53% compared with that of Case2, and the communication energy supply recovery time is shortened by 3.75h.

Compared with Case2, the toughness indexes of the electric, thermal and information systems of Case1 are respectively improved by 7.54%, 6.76% and 7.26%, the cumulative lifting rate reaches 21.92%, and the toughness performance is obviously better than that of Case 2. Under the same attack scale and resource constraint, case1 shows overall advantages over Case2 in terms of load loss, recovery time and comprehensive toughness indexes, and the superiority of the toughness improvement method is verified.

In summary, the invention constructs a PTCPS-oriented multistage toughness promotion flow framework, which covers three stages of defending resource allocation before attack, system response simulation in the attack process and toughness recovery optimization after attack, and forms a toughness promotion path covering a full life cycle.
Under the framework, the invention constructs a PTCPS-oriented system-level toughness promotion model aiming at the information physical cooperative attack. The defending resource allocation model simultaneously considers the defending requirements of the information layer and the physical layer, aims at minimizing the expected electric heating load loss of the system, and performs modeling and optimization by combining failure probability, resource constraint and the like. The toughness recovery model fully mobilizes the existing resources in the system, and comprises the steps of carrying out communication recovery by utilizing a geographically coupled thermal information wireless base station, improving the adjustment flexibility by adopting a thermoelectric transient decoupling mode, and systematically improving the overall toughness capability of PTCPS by carrying out cooperative repair on damaged information and physical equipment by combining with a scheduling maintenance team.

### 📜 Full Specification & Deep Scrape Text
Title
Cloud computing-based industrial Internet platform data security protection method and system

Abstract
Translated from Chinese
This invention relates to a data security protection method and system for a cloud-based industrial internet platform, belonging to the field of data processing technology. The method includes: performing a multi-dimensional risk assessment on collected industrial data at the edge layer to obtain a data security risk score; dynamically adjusting the strength parameters of the encryption algorithm based on the data security risk score to obtain encryption strength parameters; generating a cloud-edge collaborative protection strategy and its comprehensive protection strategy strength; automatically scheduling computing and storage resources based on the comprehensive protection strategy strength to obtain a resource scheduling coefficient; determining a protection effectiveness score based on the resource scheduling coefficient, data security risk score, encryption strength parameters, and comprehensive protection strategy strength; and optimizing the data security protection parameters and strategies using a closed-loop feedback mechanism based on the protection effectiveness score. This invention can improve the effectiveness of data security protection for industrial internet platforms.

Description
Cloud computing-based industrial Internet platform data security protection method and system
Technical Field
The invention relates to the technical field of data processing, in particular to an industrial internet platform data security protection method, system, electronic equipment and non-transitory computer readable storage medium based on cloud computing.
Background
Nowadays, with the rapid development of industrial Internet, more and more industrial equipment and systems are accessed to a cloud platform, so that remote acquisition, transmission, processing and analysis of data are realized. In order to ensure the safety of industrial data, the current common practice includes preprocessing and encrypting transmission of collected data by adopting edge computing equipment, realizing user identity authentication and authority classification by utilizing an access control mechanism of a cloud service provider, and constructing a multi-level security protection system by combining means of a firewall, an Intrusion Detection System (IDS), a data encryption algorithm (such as AES, RSA) and the like.
However, most of traditional security strategies depend on static configuration, are difficult to adapt to data flow characteristics and threat models which change in real time, and are easy to cause misjudgment or missed judgment, and on the other hand, the security collaboration mechanism between the edge and the cloud lacks unified standards, so that the problems of protection level splitting and strategy isolation exist, and the unified security strategy covering the whole life cycle of data is difficult to construct.
Disclosure of Invention
Aiming at the technical problems in the prior art, the invention provides the cloud computing-based industrial Internet platform data security protection method, system, electronic equipment and non-transitory computer readable storage medium, which can improve the effect of the industrial Internet platform data security protection.
The technical scheme for solving the technical problems is as follows:
the invention provides an industrial Internet platform data security protection method based on cloud computing, which comprises the following steps:
carrying out multidimensional risk assessment on the acquired industrial data at the edge layer to obtain a data security risk score;
dynamically adjusting the intensity parameters of an encryption algorithm according to the data security risk score to obtain encryption intensity parameters;
Generating a cloud edge cooperative protection strategy according to the data security risk score, the encryption strength parameter and cloud security situation data, and the comprehensive protection strategy strength of the cloud edge cooperative protection strategy;
according to the comprehensive protection strategy strength of the cloud edge cooperative protection strategy, automatically scheduling calculation and storage resources to obtain resource scheduling coefficients;
and determining a protection effect score according to the resource scheduling coefficient, the data security risk score, the encryption strength parameter and the comprehensive protection strategy strength, and optimizing the data security protection parameter and strategy by adopting a closed-loop feedback mechanism through the protection effect score.

normalizing each vulnerability threat level to obtain vulnerability threat level data;
And linearly combining the time sequence weighted result of the abnormal feature detection value, the protective measure effectiveness item and the vulnerability threat level data to generate the data security risk score.

The invention also provides an industrial Internet platform data security protection system based on cloud computing, which comprises:
the risk scoring module is used for carrying out multidimensional risk assessment on the collected industrial data at the edge layer to obtain a data security risk score;
the encryption parameter module is used for dynamically adjusting the intensity parameter of the encryption algorithm according to the data security risk score to obtain an encryption intensity parameter;
The protection policy module is used for generating a cloud edge cooperative protection policy according to the data security risk score, the encryption strength parameter and cloud security situation data, and the comprehensive protection policy strength of the cloud edge cooperative protection policy;
The resource scheduling module is used for automatically scheduling calculation and storage resources according to the comprehensive protection strategy strength of the cloud edge cooperative protection strategy to obtain resource scheduling coefficients;
And the safety protection module is used for determining a protection effect score according to the resource scheduling coefficient, the data safety risk score, the encryption strength parameter and the comprehensive protection strategy strength, and optimizing the data safety protection parameter and strategy by adopting a closed-loop feedback mechanism through the protection effect score.
In addition, in order to achieve the above purpose, the invention also provides an electronic device, which comprises a memory for storing a computer software program, and a processor for reading and executing the computer software program, so as to achieve the industrial Internet platform data security protection method based on cloud computing.
In addition, in order to achieve the above objective, the present invention further proposes a non-transitory computer readable storage medium, in which a computer software program is stored, the computer software program implementing, when executed by a processor, an industrial internet platform data security protection method based on cloud computing as described above.
The beneficial effects of the invention are as follows:
(1) According to the method, by introducing a security scoring mechanism integrating abnormal behavior detection, security measure effectiveness evaluation and vulnerability threat level, real-time risk identification and quantitative evaluation of industrial data on the edge side are realized, and timeliness and accuracy of security judgment are effectively improved.
(2) The invention dynamically adjusts the strength parameter of the encryption algorithm based on the security scoring result and the resource occupancy rate, so that the system can still maintain reasonable security protection level under the environment of limited resources, and the confidentiality of communication data is ensured while the performance bottleneck caused by excessive encryption is avoided.
(3) According to the method, risk scores, encryption strength parameters and threat rating information of the cloud are subjected to fusion analysis, a unified protection strategy is generated, so that safety response between the cloud and the edge is more consistent and coordinated, and the closed-loop linkage capacity of integral protection is enhanced.

The method is a time sequence weighted result of abnormal feature detection values, reflects the behavioral threat currently faced by the system, and focuses on detecting observable features facing attack behaviors. Is a second adjustment factor for adjusting the impact weight of the term in the overall score. Is vulnerability threat level data, reflects the structural vulnerability risk currently existing in the system, and emphasizes the evaluation of security from the perspective of system vulnerability. Is the threat level of the j-th identified system vulnerability, and the larger the value is, the more dangerous the vulnerability is, possibly from threat sources such as CVE. Is the threat level sum of all identified vulnerabilities. The total threat level is logarithmically compressed, avoiding extreme value dominant scoring. Is a third adjustment factor for adjusting the influence of the term in the score.

In a specific implementation, the formula is used for dynamically adjusting the strength of the encryption algorithm according to the real-time security score Rs and the resource usage condition so as to balance between 'security' and 'resource consumption'.
Rs is a data security risk score, reflecting the security risk level faced by the current system, and is a core variable driving encryption strength adjustment.
The self-adaptive encryption adjusting function is used for controlling the intensity parameters of the encryption algorithm, so that the encryption intensity is ensured to rise along with the nonlinear increase of the risk score, and the resource waste or the safety gap is avoided. Is the base encryption strength, representing the lowest encryption strength (e.g., AES-128) that the system defaults to use in the low risk state. Is an encryption strength adjustable range, representing the maximum variable range from the base strength to a higher security level (e.g., from AES-128 to AES-256). Is an adjustment factor that controls the sensitivity of the risk score Rs to intensity adjustments. Is the risk level of the normalization process, maps Rs to the [0,1] interval. Is hyperbolic tangent function, has output range between (-1, 1), and has the characteristics of rapid saturation. Small risk is slightly adjusted, medium risk is rapidly increased, and high risk is close to maximum encryption strength.
Is a weighted term of the availability of resources, Typically take values of [0,1], such as CPU, memory, GPU, etc. Indicating the contribution or importance of the resource to the encryption task. Is the weighted sum reflecting the current system's support capability for encryption strength in the resource dimension.
In summary, rs drives the encryption strength change, The rate of increase and the upper limit of the encryption level are controlled, The upper bound of the encryption strength rise is limited, and resource exhaustion is avoided.
The encryption strength formula represents:
risk perceptibility, namely, the higher the risk, the stronger the encryption;
Nonlinear response, namely avoiding extreme encryption strength variation through a tanh function;
resource adaptability, namely dynamically limiting encryption amplitude according to the current resource condition of the equipment;
The practicality and the robustness are combined, and excessive consumption of computing resources is avoided when the safety is improved.

In a specific implementation, a certain period (such as an hourly, daily or according to an event number threshold value) can be set to dynamically update the following key parameters so as to adapt to the changes of equipment states, data characteristics and attack behaviors in an industrial scene. The influence of various abnormal features in the risk score can be periodically adjusted according to the accuracy of abnormal detection, the false alarm rate and the threat level. The attenuation speed of the historical data can be dynamically adjusted, so that risk assessment is closer to the current situation, and the influence of outdated data is reduced. The time sensitivity of resource scheduling can be adjusted according to external environment changes such as system load, service period and the like (for example, the daytime strategy is stronger and the night strategy is more stable).
When the system detects that the protection effect score is continuously lower than the preset threshold value, the protection effect is not ideal, and the following dynamic updating operation is started immediately. The data security risk score is recalculated, the current data risk level is reevaluated based on the adjusted abnormal feature weight, the sensitivity to key threats is improved, and the risk detection accuracy is improved. The time attenuation coefficient in the cloud threat data can be reset or fine-tuned, so that the historical threat information is attenuated faster/slower in the strategy generation, and the responsiveness or stability of the strategy is enhanced. The method can adjust parameters such as resource weight, load function and the like according to the updated risk score and strategy strength, realize dynamic matching between the computing resource and the protection requirement, and avoid resource overload or idle.
Through the mechanism, the invention can realize linkage optimization of risk assessment, strategy generation and resource scheduling links, improve the strain capacity of the system to novel threats or sudden safety events, construct a dynamic safety closed loop system taking the protection effect as a core index, and improve the data safety protection precision and efficiency of an industrial Internet platform.

As shown in fig. 2, an industrial internet platform data security protection system based on cloud computing according to an embodiment of the present invention includes:
The risk scoring module 301 is configured to perform multidimensional risk assessment on the collected industrial data at an edge layer to obtain a data security risk score;
the encryption parameter module 302 is configured to dynamically adjust an intensity parameter of an encryption algorithm according to the data security risk score to obtain an encryption intensity parameter;

> The disclosed embodiments disclose techniques for seamlessly updating a cloud-based security service. A dispatcher virtual machine (VM) executing in a cloud data center receives network requests sent from clients located in a remote enterprise location to untrusted remote sites, and routes this network traffic through a chain of security service VMs that analyze the network traffic. During operation, the dispatcher VM determines that an existing security service VM in the chain needs to be upgraded to an updated version, and instantiates an updated chain of security service VMs that includes this updated version. The dispatcher VM then seamlessly transfers the flow of network traffic from the initial chain to the updated chain to seamlessly update the cloud-based security service without interruption. Upon determining that the updated version is operating correctly, the dispatcher VM halts and deallocates the previous version and any other unneeded portions of the initial chain.

- **Source**: Google Patents
- **URL**: [https://patents.google.com/patent/US20250350647A1/en](https://patents.google.com/patent/US20250350647A1/en)
- **AI Relevancy Score**: N/A (UNAUDITED)

### 📋 Abstract
> Disclosed is a method for implementing a Zero Trust Architecture (ZTA) to secure network resources by eliminating lateral threat movement and minimizing attack surfaces. A zero trust policy engine, positioned inline between user devices and network resources, receives and evaluates access requests by verifying user and device identities along with context information. Based on dynamic risk scores derived from these evaluations, the engine enforces least-privileged, identity-based access policies, selectively granting access exclusively to authorized resources. Connections are terminated and re-established through secure proxy techniques, with continuous inspection of traffic for threats and data loss. Adaptive security measures, including isolation through pixel-streaming and context-aware access adjustments, further enhance protection. This architecture integrates seamlessly with cloud-based security service platforms, supporting workload-to-workload security, external entity integration, and comprehensive compliance reporting through audit trails and dashboards.

### 📋 Abstract
> A cyber security restoration engine prioritizes nodes in a graph of nodes in a computer network or system that are involved in a cyber attack for remediation actions. The cyber security restoration engine performs this prioritization by, for each node, determining one or more edges linking the node to other nodes in the graph, the edges representing interactions between two nodes; obtaining metadata indicative of a type of interaction between two nodes connected by the edge and the roles of the two nodes in that interaction; determining how severe the interaction represented by that edge is within the context of the cyber attack, based on the metadata of that edge; and determining a severity score for the node by combining the severity score for each of the one or more edges connected to the node. The cyber security restoration engine prioritizes nodes for remediation action based on the severity scores for the nodes.

- **AI Relevancy Score**: N/A (UNAUDITED)

### 📋 Abstract
> A system and method for adaptive edge-cloud data processing dynamically distributes computational tasks between edge devices and cloud infrastructure in response to changing conditions. The system continuously monitors resource availability, network parameters, and workload characteristics while predicting future conditions using hierarchical forecasting models. A multi-objective optimization approach determines optimal task distribution, balancing processing latency, energy consumption, bandwidth utilization, and result quality. The system implements a partitionable processing pipeline that enables seamless task migration through state synchronization protocols and checkpoint mechanisms. During migration, the system preserves processing continuity by establishing dependencies, creating execution checkpoints, and verifying successful state transfer. Performance metrics may be continuously collected and analyzed to improve future decision-making. The system maintains operational resilience during connectivity disruptions through local decision-making capabilities and eventual consistency protocols, making it suitable for diverse applications including industrial IoT, connected vehicles, healthcare wearables, and smart city infrastructure.

## 439. [US11349854B1] Efficient threat context-aware packet filtering for network protection
- **Patent ID / App No**: `US11349854B1`
- **Source**: Google Patents
- **URL**: [https://patents.google.com/patent/US11349854B1/en](https://patents.google.com/patent/US11349854B1/en)
- **AI Relevancy Score**: N/A (UNAUDITED)

### 📋 Abstract
> A threat intelligence gateway (TIG) may protect TCP/IP networks from network (e.g., Internet) threats by enforcing certain policies on in-transit packets that are crossing network boundaries. The policies may be composed of packet filtering rules with packet-matching criteria derived from cyber threat intelligence (CTI) associated with Internet threats. These CTI-derived packet-filtering rules may be created offline by policy creation and management servers, which may distribute the policies to subscribing TIGs that subsequently enforce the policies on in-transit packets. Each packet filtering rule may specify a disposition that may be applied to a matching in-transit packet, such as deny/block/drop the in-transit packet or pass/allow/forward the in-transit packet, and also may specify directives that may be applied to a matching in-transit packet, such as log, capture, spoof-tcp-rst, etc. Often, however, the selection of a rule's disposition and directives that best protect the associated network may not be optimally determined before a matching in-transit packet is observed by the associated TIG. In such cases, threat context information that may only be available (e.g., computable) at in-transit packet observation and/or filtering time, such as current time-of-day, current TIG/network location, current TIG/network administrator, the in-transit packet being determined to be part of an active attack on the network, etc., may be helpful to determine the disposition and directives that may best protect the network from the threat associated with the in-transit packet. The present disclosure describes examples of methods, systems, and apparatuses that may be used for efficiently determining (e.g., accessing and/or computing), in response to the in-transit packet, threat context information associated with an in-transit packet. The threat context information may be used to efficiently determine the disposition and/or one or more directives to apply to the in-transit packet. This may result in dispositions and/or directives being applied to in-transit packets that better protect the network as compared with solely using dispositions and directives that were predetermined prior to receiving the in-transit packet.

> The architecture of process control plants and process control systems has been strongly influenced by limited controller and device memory, communication bandwidth, and controller and device processor capabilities. For example, the use of dynamic and static non-volatile memory in controllers is typically minimized or, at any rate, carefully managed. As a result, during system configuration (e. g. , a priori), the user typically determines what data should be archived or stored in the controller, the frequency at which it is stored, and the compression used. The controller must choose whether or not to allow it, and the controller is therefore configured with this limited set of data rules. As a result, data that may be useful for troubleshooting and process analysis is often not archived, and when it is collected useful information may be lost due to data compression. In addition to minimizing controller memory usage in currently known process control systems, data to be archived or saved can be stored in suitable historians or data silos, for example, workstations or computing devices. reported to Current techniques used to report data make poor use of communication resources and cause excessive controller load. In addition, due to time delays in communicating and sampling in historians or silos, data collection and time stamping are often out of sync with the actual process. Similarly, in batch process control systems, to minimize controller memory usage, batch recipes and snapshots of controller configurations are typically stored on a centralized computing device or in a specific location (e. g. , data silo or historian). It remains stored and is transmitted to the controller only when needed. Such a strategy introduces a large burst load on the controller and on the communication channel between the workstation or centralized computing device and the controller. Additionally, the power and performance limitations of relational databases in process control systems, combined with the high cost of disk storage, have a significant impact on structuring application data into independent entities or silos to meet specific application objectives. have For example, within the DeltaV™ system, process models, continuous historical data, and batch and event data are stored and/or archived in three different application databases or data silos. Each silo has a different interface for accessing the data stored therein. Structuring data in this way poses a barrier to accessing and using historicized data. For example, the root cause of product quality variability may relate to data in one or more of these data files. However, due to the different file structure, it is not possible to provide tools that allow quick and easy access to this data for analysis. Additionally, audit or synchronization functions must be performed to ensure that data across different silos is consistent. ### 📋 Abstract
> Operations events received from different monitoring systems are transformed into a common event format having standardized fields including a source origin identifier, a source component identifier, a creation time, and event data. Frequency-time analysis is performed on the transformed Operations events by segmenting time-domain data into time bins and determining source origin counts for each time bin. Event clusters are identified based on time-frequency-space envelopes determined from the frequency-time analysis. Each event cluster is associated with resolution metrics including a time-to-resolve value and a number of responders required for resolution. A predictive model is trained using the event clusters and their associated resolution metrics. New incoming Operations events are grouped into a new event cluster. The trained predictive model is applied to the new event cluster to predict resolution requirements, and a remediation action is initiated based on the predicted resolution requirements.

- **Source**: Google Patents
- **URL**: [https://patents.google.com/patent/US11736440B2/en](https://patents.google.com/patent/US11736440B2/en)
- **AI Relevancy Score**: N/A (UNAUDITED)

### 📋 Abstract
> A packet-filtering network appliance such as a threat intelligence gateway (TIG) protects TCP/IP networks from Internet threats by enforcing certain policies on in-transit packets that are crossing network boundaries. The policies are composed of packet filtering rules derived from cyber threat intelligence (CTI). Logs of rule-matching packets and their associated flows are sent to cyberanalysis applications located at security operations centers (SOCs) and operated by cyberanalysts. Some cyber threats/attacks, or incidents, are composed of many different flows occurring at a very high rate, which generates a flood of logs that may overwhelm computer, storage, network, and cyberanalysis resources, thereby compromising cyber defenses. The present disclosure describes incident logging, in which a single incident log efficiently incorporates the logs of the many flows that comprise the incident, thereby potentially reducing resource consumption while improving the informational/cyberanalytical value of the incident log for cyberanalysis when compared to the component flow logs. Incident logging vs. flow logging can be automatically and adaptively switched on or off depending on the combination of resource consumption and informational/cyberanalytical value.

The video decoding device determines the context for the entropy encoded data representing the split flag. Motor phase voltages are continuously acquired, sampled at the PWM rate and processed to compute sliding RMS values with IIR smoothing. Adaptive thresholds are formed from on-line statistical parameters (mean and standard deviation) of the filtered RMS during healthy operation. ### 📋 Abstract
> The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent manufacturing and computer-aided process planning, and discloses a mechanical CAD drawing recognition-based process flow arrangement system, which comprises CAD drawing analysis and feature recognition, manufacturing information structured storage, a process knowledge base, an intelligent process flow arrangement engine and a man-machine interaction module. The system adopts a vector analysis and visual inspection dual-channel parallel processing drawing, executes feature space alignment and consistency verification, calculates a feature identification risk factor and generates a reconstruction feature vector; and the intelligent arrangement engine dynamically adjusts the matching weight of the processing method according to the risk factor, constructs a process sorting optimization model containing the virtual risk cost, and adaptively supplements forced detection and margin compensation constraints according to the risk level. According to the method, the recognition uncertainty is converted into the quantitative risk index, and the quantitative risk index is fused into the process decision, so that the adaptive fault tolerance and dynamic optimization of the process scheme are realized.

- **AI Relevancy Score**: N/A (UNAUDITED)

### 📋 Abstract
> An artificial intelligence enhanced system for designing and optimizing environmentally resilient semiconductor devices integrates wave-based thermal modeling with multi-physics simulation and neuro-symbolic computing capabilities. The system enables comprehensive consideration of environmental effects throughout the semiconductor design process, incorporating traditional diffusive heat transfer models and wave-like heat transfer phenomena alongside other environmental stressors such as radiation exposure, mechanical strain, and chemical corrosion. A federated data-centric graph architecture manages and interconnects knowledge across multiple physics domains and environmental scenarios, while a physics model integration layer coordinates multi-scale simulations incorporating quantum-level effects and system-level behaviors. The system employs advanced uncertainty quantification and multi-objective optimization techniques to ensure robust designs for extreme environments. Real-time optimization capabilities enable dynamic adjustment of design and manufacturing parameters based on continuous monitoring and prediction of device behavior under various environmental conditions. The system's comprehensive approach bridges the gap between quantum-scale phenomena and macro-scale performance in extreme environment applications.

## 635. [US11829887B2] Progressive objective addition in multi-objective heuristic systems and methods
- **Patent ID / App No**: `US11829887B2`

- **URL**: [https://patents.google.com/patent/US11829887B2/en](https://patents.google.com/patent/US11829887B2/en)
