Title
Mapping region situation deduction method and system under multi-objective optimization

Abstract
Translated from Chinese
The present invention provides a method and system for deducing a surveying and mapping area situation under multi-objective optimization, which relates to the field of surveying and mapping technology, including obtaining multi-source heterogeneous geographic information data of a surveying and mapping area, using a deep learning algorithm to perform feature extraction and semantic segmentation on the multi-source heterogeneous geographic information data, and generating a three-dimensional geographic scene model of the surveying and mapping area; constructing a multi-objective optimization model for deducing a surveying and mapping area situation, and determining an optimal surveying and mapping equipment layout scheme set for the surveying and mapping area based on a simulation optimization algorithm; obtaining an optimal surveying and mapping equipment layout scheme based on each scheme in the optimal surveying and mapping equipment layout scheme set; simulating a surveying and mapping operation process under the optimal surveying and mapping equipment layout scheme in the three-dimensional geographic scene model to obtain current three-dimensional situation information of the surveying and mapping area; fusing multi-temporal remote sensing image data and geographic national conditions census data, and predicting three-dimensional situation evolution information of the surveying and mapping area in different time periods in the future based on the current three-dimensional situation information.

Description
Mapping region situation deduction method and system under multi-objective optimization
Technical Field
The invention relates to mapping technology, in particular to a mapping region situation deduction method and system under multi-objective optimization.
Background
The traditional situation analysis and deduction method of the mapping area depends on manual experience and subjective judgment, and is difficult to comprehensively consider various influencing factors, so that the situation deduction accuracy and efficiency are low, and the actual application requirements cannot be met.
At present, situation deduction of a mapping area mainly faces the following technical challenges that a mapping area relates to multi-source heterogeneous data such as geographic information, remote sensing images, socioeconomic and the like, and how to effectively fuse and process the data is a big problem.
Modeling of situation under a complex dynamic environment, namely, how to accurately establish a situation model under the complex dynamic environment is key, wherein a mapping area is influenced by various factors such as nature, man-made and the like.
Situation optimization under the condition of multiple targets, namely mapping area situation optimization needs to consider multiple targets such as economic benefit, ecological protection, disaster prevention and control and the like at the same time, and how to balance and optimize the targets is a difficult point.
The visualization and interpretation of situation deduction results are how to visually display the situation deduction results in an intuitive and easily understood manner, and provide clear deduction basis and interpretation, so that the situation deduction results are the problems to be solved urgently.
The prior art has a certain progress in deduction of situation of a mapping area, but has the defects of focusing on analysis of a single data source and lacking deep fusion and mining of multi-source data.
By adopting a simplified situation modeling method, it is difficult to describe a situation evolution rule in a complex dynamic environment.
The method mainly aims at a single optimization target, and can not realize the balance and optimization under the condition of multiple targets.
The deduction result has single presentation form, poor visual effect and lack of explanation on the deduction process.
Disclosure of Invention
The embodiment of the invention provides a mapping area situation deduction method and a mapping area situation deduction system under multi-objective optimization, which at least can solve part of problems in the prior art.
In a first aspect of the embodiment of the present invention, a mapping region situation deduction method under multi-objective optimization is provided, including:
Acquiring multi-source heterogeneous geographic information data of a mapping area, wherein the multi-source heterogeneous geographic information data comprises remote sensing image data, laser radar point cloud data and geographic national condition census data acquired by different types of sensors; the method comprises the steps of carrying out feature extraction and semantic segmentation on multi-source heterogeneous geographic information data by adopting a depth learning algorithm to generate a three-dimensional geographic scene model of a mapping area, constructing a multi-target optimization model deduced by a situation of the mapping area, wherein the multi-target optimization model comprises a plurality of sub-objective functions by taking mapping coverage rate, mapping efficiency, mapping cost and mapping precision as optimization targets, the weights of the sub-objective functions are determined by adopting a hierarchical analysis method, determining an optimal mapping equipment layout scheme set of the mapping area in the three-dimensional geographic scene model based on a simulation optimization algorithm, obtaining an optimal mapping equipment layout scheme based on each scheme in the optimal mapping equipment layout scheme set, simulating a mapping operation process under the optimal mapping equipment layout scheme in the three-dimensional geographic scene model, generating three-dimensional point cloud data consistent with the mapping operation process, obtaining current three-dimensional situation information of the mapping area, fusing multi-time-phase remote sensing image data and mapping general data, adopting a long-time-period time-lapse neural network algorithm to predict the evolution information of the mapping area in different time, inputting the three-dimensional situation information into the three-dimensional optimization model in future computing the three-dimensional model, and generating three-dimensional visual scenes of different future time periods of the mapping region by adopting a virtual reality technology based on the updated optimal mapping equipment layout scheme.

Detailed Description
For the purpose of making the objects, technical solutions and advantages of the embodiments of the present invention more apparent, the technical solutions of the embodiments of the present invention will be clearly and completely described below with reference to the accompanying drawings in the embodiments of the present invention, and it is apparent that the described embodiments are only some embodiments of the present invention, not all embodiments.

The following embodiments may be combined with each other, and some embodiments may not be repeated for the same or similar concepts or processes.
Fig. 1 is a flow chart of a mapping region situation deduction method under multi-objective optimization according to an embodiment of the present invention, as shown in fig. 1, the method includes:
S101, acquiring multi-source heterogeneous geographic information data of a mapping area, wherein the multi-source heterogeneous geographic information data comprises remote sensing image data, laser radar point cloud data and geographical national condition census data acquired by different types of sensors;
S102, constructing a multi-target optimization model deduced by situation of a mapping area, wherein the multi-target optimization model takes mapping coverage rate, mapping efficiency, mapping cost and mapping precision as optimization targets and comprises a plurality of sub-objective functions, and the weight of each sub-objective function is determined by adopting a hierarchical analysis method; the method comprises the steps of determining an optimal mapping equipment layout scheme set of a mapping area based on a simulation optimization algorithm in the three-dimensional geographic scene model, obtaining the optimal mapping equipment layout scheme based on each scheme in the optimal mapping equipment layout scheme set, simulating a mapping operation process under the optimal mapping equipment layout scheme in the three-dimensional geographic scene model, generating three-dimensional point cloud data consistent with the mapping operation process, and obtaining current three-dimensional situation information of the mapping area;
s103, fusing multi-temporal remote sensing image data and geographical national condition census data, adopting a long-short-term memory neural network algorithm, predicting three-dimensional situation evolution information of the mapping area in different future time periods based on current three-dimensional situation information, inputting the three-dimensional situation evolution information into the multi-objective optimization model, recalculating fitness values of each mapping equipment layout scheme, updating an optimal mapping equipment layout scheme, and generating three-dimensional visualization scenes of the mapping area in different future time periods by adopting a virtual reality technology based on the updated optimal mapping equipment layout scheme.

and constructing a geographic information semantic ontology base, and carrying out semantic mapping and knowledge association on the high-precision landform and landform model, the semantic building model, the multi-level road network model and the geographic information semantic ontology base to obtain a three-dimensional geographic scene model of the mapping area.
Illustratively, preprocessing is performed on multi-source heterogeneous remote sensing image data, laser radar point cloud data and geographical national census data. The remote sensing image data are processed in a mode of combining radiometric calibration, multi-view geometric correction and multi-scale image fusion to generate a multi-source remote sensing image data set with consistent spectral response and space geometric matching, the laser radar point cloud data are processed in a self-adaptive noise filtering mode, a multi-scale ground point extraction mode and a point cloud segmentation mode based on graph cutting to obtain point cloud subsets of different ground object types, and the geographical national condition census data are processed in a mode of space coordinate conversion, attribute data standardization and multi-level topological reconstruction to generate a geographical national condition element set consistent with the space reference of the remote sensing image data and the point cloud data.
Different deep learning algorithms are adopted to extract multi-level and multi-semantic characteristic information from remote sensing images, laser radar point clouds and geographic national condition data respectively.
The method comprises the steps of adopting a convolution neural network algorithm based on an attention mechanism to extract texture, spectrum and space characteristics to generate a multi-channel remote sensing image characteristic map, adopting a deep learning algorithm based on a map attention network to extract geometric characteristics, topological relation characteristics and semantic attribute characteristics to generate a multi-dimensional point cloud characteristic vector to a laser radar point cloud subset, adopting a deep learning algorithm based on a gating map convolution network to extract semantic characteristics, space relation characteristics and hierarchical structure characteristics to a geographic national condition element set, and generating a multi-resolution semantic characteristic map.
Aiming at the generated multi-channel remote sensing image feature map, multi-dimensional point cloud feature vector and multi-resolution semantic feature map, the deep nonlinear fusion is carried out by adopting a feature self-adaptive fusion strategy based on a self-attention mechanism.
The fusion strategy can adaptively perform weight distribution and optimization combination on geographic information features with different sources and different semantics, so that a multi-source heterogeneous geographic information fusion feature set with rich information and definite semantics is obtained.
The fused feature set covers various information such as terrain, ground objects, traffic and the like of the mapping area, and lays a solid data foundation for the subsequent three-dimensional geographic scene reconstruction.
And inputting the fused multi-source heterogeneous geographic information feature set into a multi-task deep learning model.
The model adopts an end-to-end joint optimization strategy, and realizes information interaction and complementation among different reconstruction tasks by sharing hidden layer parameters.
The model output comprises three branches, namely a high-precision topography model, a semantic building model and a multi-level road network model.
The method comprises the steps of generating a Digital Surface Model (DSM) which approximates to a real terrain elevation value by a landform model reconstruction branch through a regression loss function, reconstructing a three-dimensional geometric shape of a building through a multi-label classification loss function by a building model reconstruction branch, carrying out semantic annotation on attribute information such as category, function and the like of the building, and generating a multi-level three-dimensional road network with complete topological relation and clear function level by a road network model reconstruction branch through a graph structure embedding loss function.
Finally, the multitask deep learning model outputs three-dimensional geographic elements with high precision, multiple semantics and multiple layers in a mapping area.
The geographic information semantic ontology library oriented to the three-dimensional GIS is constructed, basic geographic element classes, spatial relation classes and thematic semantic classes are formally defined, and a concept hierarchy system and a logic reasoning rule of geographic information semantics in the mapping field are formed.
And then, carrying out semantic mapping on the generated three-dimensional geographic elements and classes and relations in the ontology library, and adding rich semantic attribute information into the three-dimensional model to enable the three-dimensional geographic scene model to have machine-understandable and reasoning semantic connotation.
And finally, carrying out space semantic consistency check and conflict resolution on the three-dimensional geographic scene model by utilizing an ontology reasoning engine, and ensuring the completeness and consistency of the model on logic semantics.
Through the steps, the method finally generates the three-dimensional geographic scene model of the mapping area with high precision, rich semantics and consistent logic.
The model is superior to the traditional method in geometric precision and visual effect, and the space reasoning and knowledge discovery capability driven by the semantic ontology is embedded, so that the model can support intelligent space analysis and decision.
The invention provides a brand new technical approach for reconstructing and applying three-dimensional geographic scenes in the fields of mapping, planning, emergency and the like.
In an alternative embodiment, the method for generating the three-dimensional geographic scene model of the mapping region by performing feature extraction and semantic segmentation on the multi-source heterogeneous geographic information data by adopting a deep learning algorithm comprises the following steps:
Processing the remote sensing image data in a combined radiometric calibration, multi-view geometric correction and multi-scale image fusion mode to generate a multi-source remote sensing image data
