multi-channel remote sensing image data and a multi-dimensional topological feature map, and a multi-dimensional feature map is generated into a multi-dimensional feature map-domain feature map-based on a multi-dimensional feature map-domain-fusion model, and a multi-dimensional feature map-domain fusion model is generated after the multi-dimensional feature map-domain fusion model is generated, and constructing a geographic information semantic ontology base, and carrying out semantic mapping and knowledge association on the high-precision landform and landform model, the semantic building model, the multi-level road network model and the geographic information semantic ontology base to obtain a three-dimensional geographic scene model of the mapping area.
Illustratively, multi-source remote sensing image data from different sensors and different time phases are subjected to radiation calibration, so that sensor response difference and atmospheric influence are eliminated, and the radiation brightness values of the image data are consistent.
The method comprises the steps of selecting an overlapping area of multi-source images, extracting radiation brightness values of stable and unchanged ground objects, establishing a radiation brightness conversion function, and carrying out radiation correction on each source image by utilizing the radiation brightness conversion function to unify the radiation brightness values to the same scale.
Due to the differences of imaging angles and sensor postures, the remote sensing images with different visual angles have geometric distortion and position deviation in space.
To achieve accurate image registration, multi-view geometric correction is required.
The method comprises the steps of selecting high-precision control points, establishing a geometric relation model of an image and the ground, and carrying out orthographic correction, resampling and registration on images of all view angles by utilizing the geometric relation model, so as to eliminate geometric distortion caused by view angle differences and realize accurate matching of the images in space.
In order to fully utilize the advantages of the spatial-temporal resolutions of different sensor images, multi-scale image fusion is required.
The method comprises the steps of decomposing a high-resolution panchromatic image and a low-resolution multispectral image into a plurality of scale levels by adopting a multi-scale decomposition method such as wavelet transformation or Laplacian pyramid, injecting space detail information of the panchromatic image into the multispectral image by utilizing strategies such as local mean value matching, edge enhancement and the like on each scale level, and reconstructing the fused high-resolution multispectral image by utilizing inverse transformation to realize synchronous promotion of the space information and the spectrum information.
The traditional convolutional neural network adopts a fixed convolutional kernel to extract the characteristics, and is difficult to adapt to the multi-scale and multi-directional characteristics of a ground object target.
Attention mechanisms are introduced, the weight of the convolution kernel can be adaptively adjusted, and the salient features of different areas and different scales are selectively focused.
The method comprises the steps of adaptively adjusting spatial distribution and channel weight of a convolution feature map through two sub-modules of spatial attention and channel attention in an encoder part of a convolution neural network, enabling the spatial attention to highlight salient features of a target area through generating a spatial weight map, enabling the channel attention to emphasize feature channels related to the target through generating a channel weight vector, and enabling the multi-scale attention feature map generated by the encoder to be subjected to up-sampling and cross-level feature fusion in a decoder part to obtain a multi-channel remote sensing image feature map.
And extracting multi-level and multi-scale characteristics of the multi-source remote sensing image dataset by using a convolutional neural network based on an attention mechanism, and generating a multi-channel remote sensing image characteristic map.
The method specifically comprises a texture feature map, a spectrum feature map, a space feature map, a geometric feature map, a space structure feature map and a space structure feature, wherein the texture feature map is used for extracting texture statistics such as gray level co-occurrence matrixes of images and Gabor filtering and describing surface texture modes of ground objects, the spectrum feature map is used for extracting spectrum indexes such as normalized vegetation indexes and normalized building indexes of the images and reflecting spectrum attribute differences of the ground objects, and the geometric feature map is used for extracting geometric features such as shapes, sizes and directions of the images and describing space structure features of ground object targets.
The multi-channel remote sensing image feature map comprehensively describes the texture, spectrum and spatial features of the ground object, and provides rich discrimination information for subsequent semantic segmentation.
The ground points are important ground feature types in the point cloud, and the ground points need to be accurately extracted from the point cloud so as to provide references for subsequent ground feature classification.
The method for extracting the ground points by using the multi-scale is adopted, and the smoothness and continuity characteristics of the ground are fully utilized.
The method comprises the steps of dividing a point cloud into a plurality of grids with different scales by adopting a meshing method, fitting a local plane equation in each grid by utilizing a random sample consensus (RANSAC) algorithm, extracting points conforming to plane characteristics as candidate ground points, and connecting the candidate ground points with consistent normal vector and gradual change elevation between adjacent grids by utilizing a region growing algorithm to form a sheet to obtain the complete ground point cloud.
In order to realize ground object level point cloud segmentation, the geometric and topological characteristics of the point cloud need to be fully utilized.
And adopting a point cloud segmentation method based on graph cut, regarding the point cloud as an undirected graph, and realizing global optimal segmentation of the point cloud through a minimum cut algorithm.
The method comprises the steps of constructing a point cloud undirected graph according to the spatial adjacent relation of point clouds, wherein each point serves as a node of the graph, edge connection exists between adjacent points, calculating the weight of an edge according to the geometric feature difference of two end points connected by the edge, finding minimum cuts on the weight graph by adopting a maximum flow minimum cutting algorithm, dividing the point cloud into different connected areas to achieve point cloud division, extracting geometric and topological features of each divided point cloud area, and giving a preliminary ground object category label.
The traditional point cloud feature extraction method, such as a point feature histogram, a rapid point feature histogram and the like, only considers the local geometric features of the points, and ignores the topological relation and semantic dependence among the points.
Introducing the graph attention network, the local and global characteristics of the point cloud can be simultaneously modeled, and the interaction between points can be learned. The method comprises the steps of converting point clouds into graph structure data, wherein each point serves as a node of a graph, node features comprise geometric information such as coordinates and normal vectors of the points, multi-layer graph convolution is applied to the graph, each layer of convolution updates the node features by aggregating neighborhood information of the nodes, attention mechanisms are introduced while the graph convolution is performed, contribution degrees of different neighborhoods to center node feature updating are adaptively adjusted according to similarity of the node features, and high-dimensional feature descriptors of each point are obtained through iterative optimization of multi-layer graph convolution and attention, wherein the high-dimensional feature descriptors comprise local geometric features of the points and global semantic features.
And extracting multi-dimensional point cloud features from the laser radar point cloud subsets by using a deep learning algorithm based on the graph attention network, and generating point cloud feature vectors.
The method specifically comprises the steps of extracting geometric attributes such as three-dimensional coordinates, normal vectors and curvatures of each point, describing the space shape features of the ground object where the point is located, extracting topological structure features such as connectivity, adjacent relations and the like between each point and adjacent points of each point, reflecting the space distribution mode of the ground object, extracting semantic attribute features such as probability distribution, mutual exclusion relations and the like of the ground object category to which each point belongs, and revealing the ground object composition of a point cloud scene.
The multidimensional point cloud feature vector comprehensively characterizes the geometric, topological and semantic features of the point cloud, and provides an important basis for subsequent point cloud segmentation and three-dimensional reconstruction.
The space coordinate system adopted by the geographical national condition census data is often different from the coordinate system of the remote sensing image and the laser radar point cloud, and space coordinate conversion is needed to be carried out, so that the unification of space positions is realized.
The method comprises the steps of selecting control points, establishing conversion relations among different coordinate systems, uniformly converting coordinates of points, lines and surface elements in geographical national condition data into a target coordinate system by utilizing the coordinate conversion relations, and checking and correcting the space topological relation of the converted elements to ensure the accuracy and consistency of the elements in space.
Attribute item names, types and formats in the geographical national condition census data are different, and attribute data standardization is needed to ensure standardization and interoperability of the attribute data.
The method comprises the steps of standardizing names and types of attribute items according to national relevant standards, unifying naming and type standards, carrying out format conversion and unit conversion on attribute values to enable the attribute values to meet standard standards, checking and correcting missing attribute and error attribute, removing abnormal values, supplementing default values and improving attribute data quality.
The ground object elements in the geographical national condition data have complex topological relations in space, and multilevel topological reconstruction is needed to form an element network with topological connection and reasonable structure.
The method comprises the steps of constructing adjacent topology between surface elements and communication topology between line elements based on space adjacent relations in element classes, constructing subordinate topology between upper and lower layers of elements according to semantic association rules between the element classes, constructing topology between different element classes of the same layer, checking correctness of the reconstructed topology relation by adopting a topology consistency checking method, carrying out necessary correction, and finally forming an element network with complete topology and correct relation.
The traditional element feature extraction method mainly focuses on the geometric and attribute features of elements, and ignores semantic links and spatial dependence among the elements.
The gating graph convolution network is introduced, so that the local characteristics and the global relation of the elements can be modeled at the same time, and the interaction influence among the elements is learned.
The method comprises the steps of converting a geographical national condition element network into graph structure data, wherein each element is used as a node of a graph, node characteristics comprise information such as geometry, attribute and topology of the element, multi-layer gating graph convolution is applied to the graph, each layer of convolution updates node representation through neighborhood information of aggregation nodes, a gating mechanism is used for controlling transmission intensity of the neighborhood information, an attention mechanism is introduced during graph convolution, contribution degrees of different neighborhood nodes to center node updating are dynamically adjusted according to similarity of the node representation, and high-dimensional characteristic representation of each element is obtained through iterative optimization of multi-layer graph convolution and attention, and local characteristics and global context information of the elements are fused.
And extracting multi-resolution semantic features from the geographical national condition element set by using a deep learning algorithm based on a gating chart convolution network, and generating a semantic feature chart.
The method comprises the steps of extracting spatial characteristics such as azimuth relation and distance relation between adjacent elements, revealing a spatial distribution mode of the feature elements, extracting semantic characteristics such as attribute statistics and association rules of each element category, describing semantic characteristics of element types, extracting structural characteristics such as inclusion and composition among elements of different levels, and reflecting the organization form of element networks. The multi-resolution semantic feature map comprehensively characterizes semantic connotation of geographical national conditions and provides a bridge for subsequent knowledge association.
It is important how to effectively fuse features of different sources, that the multi-source heterogeneous geographic information data has different feature representation forms and semantic granularity.
By adopting the characteristic self-adaptive fusion strategy based on the self-attention mechanism, the importance degree of different characteristics can be automatically adjusted according to task requirements, and the selective fusion of the characteristics is realized.
The method comprises the steps of cascading feature vectors of different sources such as multi-channel remote sensing image features, multi-dimensional point cloud features and multi-resolution semantic features to form an initial feature set, calculating correlation matrixes among different features through a multi-head self-attention mechanism, mining the inherent relation of the features, adaptively generating a weight coefficient of each feature according to the correlation matrixes, highlighting obvious features closely related to tasks, multiplying the initial feature set by the weight coefficient, achieving weighted fusion of the features, and obtaining a fused feature set with comprehensive information and low redundancy.
The fused feature set contains rich information of multi-source heterogeneous data, but complex nonlinear relations may exist between different features.
By adopting the nonlinear feature fusion method, deep semantic association among the features can be further mined.
The method comprises the steps of inputting the fused feature set into a multi-layer perceptron neural network, carrying out nonlinear transformation and combination on the features through nonlinear activation functions such as ReLU and the like, automatically learning high-order interaction among different features through a fully connected weight matrix in a hidden layer, and fusing the converted deep features again in an output layer to obtain fused features with rich semantics and strong expression capability.
The nonlinear feature fusion process automatically models complex mapping relations among multi-source heterogeneous features, so that the fused features are more compact and consistent in semantic space.
For a plurality of subtasks of three-dimensional geographic scene reconstruction, such as topographic modeling, building extraction, road network extraction and the like, the traditional method is to independently design and optimize each subtask, and neglect association constraint among the subtasks.
By adopting the end-to-end multi-task joint modeling method, a plurality of subtasks can be optimized simultaneously under a unified framework, complementary information among the subtasks is fully utilized, and the overall performance of scene understanding is improved.
The method comprises the steps of inputting a multisource heterogeneous geographic information feature set into a multi-task network in a sharing mode, learning basic feature representation of a scene by using a common feature extractor in a sharing coding layer, designing a specific decoder structure for each subtask in a task exclusive decoding layer to generate task specific output, introducing a correlation loss function between tasks to model a logic constraint relation between different task outputs, and simultaneously improving the prediction performance of each subtask through jointly optimizing the multi-task loss function.
And simultaneously generating a topography model, a building model and a road network model of the three-dimensional geographic scene by utilizing the multi-task deep learning model, and comprehensively describing the surface morphology and the ground feature distribution of the scene.
The specific output comprises a topography model, a building model, a road network vector diagram and a traffic network structure, wherein the topography model is used for extracting topography attributes such as elevation, gradient and slope direction, describing the surface relief form of a scene, generating a high-resolution digital surface model, the building model is used for extracting information such as spatial position, geometric shape and semantic category of a building, generating a vectorized three-dimensional building example and reflecting the distribution of manual facilities of the scene, and the road network model is used for extracting information such as spatial trend, width and type of a road, generating a topological connected road network vector diagram and describing the traffic network structure of the scene.
The three-dimensional model generated by multitasking comprehensively reflects the space structure and the ground object composition of the geographic scene, and lays a foundation for subsequent scene application.
To deepen the semantic meaning of the three-dimensional geographic scene model, a geographic information semantic ontology library needs to be constructed to form a hierarchical structure and a logical relationship between geographic concepts.
The method comprises the steps of defining a category system of geographic concepts according to geographic theory and industry specifications, organizing to form an ontology hierarchical structure, defining attribute characteristics and external relation constraint of each geographic concept to form semantic links among the ontology concepts, formalizing the ontology hierarchy, concept definition, relation constraint and the like by using ontology description languages such as OWL and the like to construct a computer-readable ontology knowledge base, and associating multi-source heterogeneous geographic data to the ontology concepts by using an ontology mapping method to realize semantic annotation and knowledge organization of the geographic data.
The geographic information semantic ontology library forms a semantic association network between geographic concepts and provides rich semantic support for the three-dimensional scene model.
And carrying out semantic mapping on the ground object examples and the ontology concepts in the three-dimensional geographic scene model by using the geographic information semantic ontology library, so as to realize the deep association of the scene model and the geographic knowledge.
The method comprises the steps of abstracting three-dimensional model elements such as a topography model, a building model and a road network model into instances of ontology concepts, mapping the building model into instances of concepts such as houses, schools and the like, extracting corresponding attribute values from the model elements based on attribute definitions of the concepts in the ontology to complete attribute association of the concept instances, establishing semantic association between the model instances based on relation constraint among the concepts in the ontology, such as establishing adjacent relation between the building instances and the road instances, and the like, and finding implicit geographical concept association by utilizing an ontology reasoning mechanism on the basis of the semantic association to further expand a semantic network of the three-dimensional scene model.
Finally, the three-dimensional geographic scene model with the pure geometric meaning is converted into geographic knowledge expression containing rich semantics, and the intelligence and usability of the model are enhanced.
By the technical scheme, multi-source heterogeneous geographic information data are comprehensively utilized, a three-dimensional geographic scene model integrating multi-level information of terrains, ground objects, roads and the like is constructed by means of a deep learning algorithm and a knowledge reasoning technology, and comprehensive and three-dimensional expression of geographic environments of a mapping area is achieved.
The scheme integrates the advantages of multi-source geographic data, combines various artificial intelligence technologies, can obviously improve the automation level and the refinement degree of the reconstruction of the geographic scene, and provides solid foundation support for intelligent application of geographic information in various industries.
In an alternative embodiment, constructing a multi-objective optimization model for situation deduction of a mapping region, comprising taking mapping objective data, mapping precision data, mapping time data and mapping cost data as inputs of the multi-objective optimization model, and constructing a mapping coverage sub-objective function, a mapping efficiency sub-objective function, a mapping cost sub-objective function and a mapping precision sub-objective function; the method comprises the steps of obtaining a mapping state of each grid, outputting the mapping state of each grid as a mapping coverage evaluation index, obtaining the parameter value of each mapping precision sub-objective function as the precision parameter of each mapping sensor and the parameter of a fusion algorithm, outputting the parameter value of each mapping precision sub-objective function as the mapping precision evaluation index, obtaining the input quantity of each cost element as the mapping cost evaluation index, obtaining the parameter value of each mapping efficiency sub-objective function as the type and the quantity of mapping equipment selected by each operation unit, outputting the parameter value as the mapping efficiency evaluation index, collecting the dynamic preference information required by a mapping task, constructing a pairwise comparison matrix between different optimization targets of the dynamic preference information to obtain a dynamic judgment matrix, calculating the maximum characteristic value of the dynamic judgment matrix and the characteristic vector corresponding to the maximum characteristic value by adopting a spectrum decomposition method, constructing a fuzzy consistency evaluation model of the dynamic judgment matrix, solving the maximum fuzzy characteristic value and the objective characteristic vector which are suitable for the dynamic preference information based on the consistency evaluation model, carrying out the initial fuzzy characteristic vector normalization obtained by solving, constructing a fuzzy characteristic vector weighting and a fuzzy characteristic vector combination, the method comprises the steps of optimizing and correcting an initial weight vector to obtain a combined weight vector, calculating the fuzzy consistency ratio of a dynamic judgment matrix, judging whether the matrix accords with logic consistency by setting a fuzzy consistency ratio threshold value, adjusting element values of the judgment matrix by adopting a feedback mechanism when the detection fails, recalculating the combined weight vector and carrying out consistency detection, and constructing an optimization target of a multi-target optimization model by taking the combined weight vector as a mapping coverage sub-objective function, a mapping efficiency sub-objective function, a mapping cost sub-objective function and a dynamic weighting coefficient of a mapping precision sub-objective function when the detection fails.
For example, mapping target data, mapping accuracy data, mapping time data, and mapping cost data are input to a multi-target optimization model.
The surveying and mapping target data comprise expected surveying and mapping states of grids in a measuring area, surveying and mapping precision data comprise precision parameters of various sensors and parameter settings of a data fusion algorithm, surveying and mapping time data comprise time arrangement and progress requirements of surveying and mapping operation, and surveying and mapping cost data comprise budget limits of various cost factors such as personnel, equipment and materials.
Based on model input, four sub-objective functions are established, namely a mapping coverage sub-objective function, a mapping efficiency sub-objective function, a mapping cost sub-objective function and a mapping precision sub-objective function.
The independent variable of the mapping coverage rate sub-objective function is the mapping state of each grid, and the value is 0 or 1, which indicates whether the grid is covered by mapping.
The output of the sub-objective function is a mapping coverage rate evaluation index of the whole area, and the coverage integrity and the balance of mapping operation on different areas are comprehensively reflected.
The independent variables of the mapping precision sub-objective function are precision parameters such as internal and external azimuth elements, resolution and the like of each mapping sensor, and parameters such as weight, threshold and the like of a multi-sensor fusion algorithm. The output of the sub-objective function is the mapping precision evaluation index of the whole measuring area, and the data precision level under different sensor combination schemes and fusion strategies is comprehensively evaluated.
The independent variables of the mapping cost sub-objective function are input amounts of various cost factors such as labor cost, equipment cost, material cost and the like.
The output of the sub-objective function is the total cost evaluation index of the mapping operation, and the economy under different resource allocation schemes is quantitatively described.
The independent variables of the mapping efficiency sub-objective function are the type and number of mapping devices selected for each unit of work.
A job element may be a certain sub-region of a zone or a staged task.
The output of the sub objective function is a mapping efficiency evaluation index, and the operation speed and timeliness under different equipment scheduling schemes are measured.
Dynamic preference information of a decision maker for mapping task requirements is collected, and the relative importance of different optimization targets is judged according to factors such as the urgency of the task, the precision requirement, the expense limitation and the like.
And constructing an optimization target pairwise comparison matrix to form a dynamic judgment matrix.
The element values in the matrix represent dynamic quantitative assessment values of the relative importance of the two optimization objectives of the line, typically taking 1-9 and its reciprocal.
And calculating the maximum eigenvalue of the dynamic judgment matrix by adopting a spectrum decomposition method and the eigenvector corresponding to the maximum eigenvalue.
And constructing a fuzzy consistency evaluation model of the dynamic judgment matrix, expressing the element values of the judgment matrix as fuzzy numbers, and considering the uncertainty of judgment.
And solving the dynamic judgment matrix based on the fuzzy consistency evaluation model to obtain a maximum fuzzy characteristic value and a fuzzy characteristic vector which are suitable for the current preference information.
And carrying out normalization processing on the fuzzy feature vector obtained by solving to obtain an initial weight vector, and quantitatively representing the importance degree of each sub-target.
However, the initial weights given by the subjective judgment alone may be biased and require further optimization and correction.
And constructing a subjective and objective combined weighting model, introducing constraint of objective data on the basis of initial weight, such as the value range of each sub objective function, sensitivity analysis and the like, and carrying out self-adaptive adjustment on the weight vector to obtain a combined weight vector.
Calculating the fuzzy consistency ratio of the dynamic judgment matrix, and measuring the logic consistency degree of the judgment matrix.
The fuzzy consistency ratio threshold is set, typically taking 0.1.
When the consistency ratio exceeds the threshold value, the judgment matrix has larger logic contradiction and cannot be directly used.
At this time, a feedback mechanism is adopted to require the decision maker to adjust some element values of the judgment matrix again until the element values pass the consistency check.
And taking the combined weight vector passing the consistency test as a dynamic weighting coefficient of four sub-objective functions of mapping coverage rate, mapping efficiency, mapping cost and mapping precision, and carrying out weighted summation on the plurality of sub-objective functions to obtain the overall optimization target of the multi-target optimization model.
The optimization targets comprehensively balance the importance of all sub-targets under different demand preferences, and are the trade-off and quantification of the overall performance of the mapping task.
And setting constraint conditions of the multi-objective optimization model according to the actual requirements and resource limitations of the mapping task.
Common constraint conditions include that the mapping coverage must reach a predetermined threshold, the mapping accuracy must meet the specification requirements, the mapping cost must not exceed the budget limit, the mapping efficiency must be completed within the specified time limit, the number of different types of mapping equipment is limited by available resources, certain critical areas or targets must be mapped preferentially, and the sensor working mode, the aviation route and the like must meet specific rules.
And constructing a mathematical form of the multi-objective optimization model according to the optimization objective and the constraint condition. The model can be solved by adopting a typical multi-objective optimization algorithm such as a weighted summation method, an epsilon-constraint method, a genetic algorithm and the like.
In the solving process, a solution set which meets constraint conditions and enables an optimization target to reach the optimal is searched by adjusting model parameters and searching a feasible domain of an optimization variable.
Each solution vector in the solution set represents an optimal configuration scheme of mapping operation, and comprises values of decision variables such as mapping state of each grid, type and number of selected sensors, input level of each cost element and the like.
According to the technical scheme, the multi-objective optimization model deduced by solving the situation of the mapping area can be dynamically adapted to the change of mapping requirement preference, a plurality of performance targets such as mapping coverage, precision, cost and efficiency are balanced, optimization and dynamic optimization of the mapping scheme are carried out by combining subjective and objective factors, theoretical basis and technical support are provided for scientific decision and accurate implementation of mapping tasks, and good practicability and popularization value are achieved.
In an alternative embodiment, building a mapping coverage sub-objective function, a mapping efficiency sub-objective function, a mapping cost sub-objective function, and a mapping accuracy sub-objective function, includes:
Dividing a region to be measured into grids with equal size by adopting a rasterization method, adaptively determining the side length of each grid according to the geometric characteristics of a mapping target and the required spatial resolution, counting the mapping state of each grid to form a mapping state matrix, extracting key ground object elements in the region to be measured from remote sensing images or laser point cloud data by utilizing a ground object element extraction technology, calculating the mapping integrity rate of each type of ground object elements, and constructing a mapping coverage sub-objective function by taking the ground object element mapping integrity rate larger than a given threshold value as a constraint condition; the method comprises the steps of decomposing a mapping task from top to bottom into a plurality of operation units by adopting a hierarchical decomposition method, determining standard working hours required for completion according to the operation quantity and the operation complexity for each operation unit, simultaneously calculating the completion efficiency of the unit operation quantity based on equipment performance parameters and operation experience for different mapping equipment, constructing a mapping efficiency sub-objective function by taking mapping time data as constraint conditions, carrying out systematic classification and collection on various cost elements related to the mapping task by adopting a cost accounting method, selecting a cost estimation model for different types of cost elements, constructing a total cost calculation model to obtain the budget cost for completing the whole mapping task, adopting a cost sensitivity analysis technology to identify key cost driving factors, constructing a cost sub-objective function by taking mapping cost data as constraint conditions, taking the precision parameters of different mapping sensors as optimization variables, establishing a functional relation between the mapping precision evaluation index and the precision parameters of the sensors, searching the optimal mapping sensor precision parameter combination by adopting a differential evolution algorithm, obtaining the optimal precision parameters of the mapping sensors, fusing the mapping data obtained by different sensors by adopting a multi-source data fusion technology, and constructing a mapping precision sub-objective function by taking the mapping precision data as constraint conditions.
Illustratively, the region to be measured is divided into grids of equal size by a rasterization method.
The side length of the grid is adaptively determined based on the geometric characteristics of the mapping target (e.g., size, shape, distribution density, etc. of the target) and the desired spatial resolution (i.e., the degree of detail of the mapping effort).
The selection of the grid side length needs to be compatible with the mapping efficiency and the mapping precision, the spatial resolution of mapping can be reduced by an oversized grid, and the workload of mapping can be increased by an undersized grid.
And counting the mapping state of each grid to form a mapping state matrix.
The number of rows and the number of columns of the matrix are the number of rows and the number of columns after rasterization respectively, and the value of a matrix element is 0 or 1, so that whether the corresponding grid is mapped and covered is indicated.
Initially, the elements of the mapping state matrix are all 0, indicating that all grids are not mapped. As the mapping operation proceeds, the matrix element of the grid covered by the mapping is set to 1.
And extracting key ground feature elements in the region to be detected, such as buildings, roads, water systems and the like, from the remote sensing images or the laser point cloud data by using a ground feature element extraction technology. And counting the number of grids appearing in each type of ground object element, and calculating the number of grids covered by actual mapping, thereby obtaining the mapping completeness of the ground object element, namely the proportion of the number of grids covered by mapping to the total number of grids.
And constructing a mapping coverage rate sub-objective function by taking the feature element mapping completeness rate larger than a given threshold value as a constraint condition.
The threshold value is determined according to the requirements of the mapping task, for example, the threshold value of the important feature elements can be set to be 100%, and the threshold value of the common feature elements can be properly relaxed.
The independent variable of the sub-objective function is the mapping state of each grid, the objective function value is the arithmetic average of the mapping states of all grids, and the mapping coverage level of the whole area is reflected.
And decomposing the whole mapping task into a plurality of operation units step by step from top to bottom by adopting a hierarchical decomposition method.
The unit of work may be a sub-region of the region or a periodic task of the mapping procedure such as data acquisition, data preprocessing, feature extraction, etc.
Each unit of work has explicit work content, completion criteria, and time limit requirements.
For each unit of work, the standard man-hours required to complete the unit are estimated based on its work load and work complexity.
The work volume reflects the number of works, such as the size of a mapping area, the number of target elements and the like, and the work complexity reflects the difficulty of works, such as the complexity of terrain conditions, the detail level of the target elements and the like.
The standard man-hour is the time required to complete a unit work volume under certain work conditions and resource investment.
Aiming at different mapping equipment such as unmanned aerial vehicle, total station, GPS and the like, the completion efficiency of unit workload is calculated based on performance parameters (such as navigational speed, measuring range, precision and the like) and operation experience.
The completion efficiency is the amount of work that the device completes per unit time, such as the area mapped per hour, the amount of data collected per day, etc.
And constructing a mapping efficiency sub-objective function by taking time data (such as total construction period, milestone nodes and the like) of the mapping task as constraint conditions.
The independent variable of the sub objective function is the type and the number of mapping equipment selected by each operation unit, the objective function value is the weighted sum of the completion time of all operation units, and the weight is determined according to the importance degree of the operation units.
The smaller the objective function value, the higher the overall mapping efficiency.
And (3) performing systematic classification and collection on each cost element related to the mapping task by adopting a cost accounting method.
Cost elements can be divided into direct costs and indirect costs.
The direct cost is the cost specially used for the mapping task, such as labor cost, equipment cost, material cost and the like, and the indirect cost is the public cost for serving a plurality of tasks, such as management cost, hydropower cost and the like, and the indirect cost is required to be distributed to the tasks according to a certain proportion.
An appropriate cost estimation model is selected for the different types of cost elements.
For example, the labor cost can be estimated according to the number of mapping personnel, the working time and the standard wage rate, the equipment cost can be estimated according to the type, the number, the using time and the lease price of the equipment, the material cost can be estimated according to the type, the number and the purchase price of the materials, and the management cost can be estimated according to a certain proportion of the total cost of the mapping task.
And on the basis of the cost element estimation, constructing a total cost calculation model to obtain the budget cost for completing the whole mapping task.
The total cost model dynamically estimates the total cost by summing up the estimates of the cost elements and taking into account the interactions between the cost elements and risk factors such as currency expansion, exchange rate variation, etc.
By adopting a cost sensitivity analysis technology, key cost driving factors with great influence on the total cost are identified, such as operation scale, technical difficulty, construction period limit and the like. And by sensitivity analysis, the optimization direction and the adjustment amplitude of the cost element are determined, and a basis is provided for cost control.
And constructing a mapping cost sub-objective function by taking cost data (such as total budget, single budget and the like) of the mapping task as constraint conditions.
The independent variable of the sub objective function is the input amount of each cost element, and the objective function value is the total cost estimated value. On the premise of meeting task requirements and standards, the smaller the objective function value is, the higher the cost optimization degree is.
And taking the precision parameters of different mapping sensors (such as cameras, laser radars, synthetic aperture radars and the like) as optimization variables, and establishing a functional relation between the mapping precision evaluation index and the sensor precision parameters.
The evaluation index of the mapping precision can be a medium error, a relative precision and the like, and reflects the precision degree of the mapping result.
The sensor precision parameters comprise measurement precision, positioning precision, stability and the like, and determine the mapping performance of the sensor.
And searching the optimal parameter combination in the range of the value of the sensor precision parameter by adopting a differential evolution algorithm.
The differential evolution algorithm continuously iterates the population of the updated solution through simulating the biological evolution process, and finally converges on the global optimal solution.
In the iterative process, the algorithm adjusts the variation, intersection and selection strategy of the solution according to the precision function value of the current solution, and balances the quality and diversity of the solution.
And after obtaining the optimal precision parameters of each mapping sensor, adopting a multi-source data fusion technology to fuse the mapping data obtained by different sensors.
The data fusion can be performed at a decision layer, a feature layer or a data layer, such as a weighted average method, a Kalman filtering method, a wavelet transformation method and the like.
The fused mapping data has the advantages of a plurality of sensors, and the precision level of the mapping data is higher than that of any single sensor.
And constructing a mapping precision sub-objective function by taking precision data (such as precision indexes, precision grades and the like) of the mapping task as constraint conditions.
The independent variables of the sub-objective function are the precision parameters of each mapping sensor and the parameters of a data fusion algorithm, and the objective function value is the fused mapping precision evaluation index.
On the premise of meeting the task requirements and specifications, the larger the objective function value is, the higher the mapping precision is.
According to the technical scheme, sub-objective functions related to situation deduction of the mapping area are constructed from four aspects of mapping coverage rate, mapping efficiency, mapping cost and mapping accuracy.
Each sub-objective function establishes a quantitative relation between an optimization target and an influence factor, and provides a corresponding solving method and an optimization strategy.
The four sub-objective functions are coordinated with each other, so that the establishment and the solution of the multi-objective optimization model are supported together, and a scientific basis is provided for the decision of the mapping task.
In an alternative embodiment, in the three-dimensional geographic scene model, determining an optimal mapping device layout scheme set for a mapping region based on a simulation optimization algorithm includes:
In the three-dimensional geographic scene model, according to geographic environment characteristics of a mapping area and mapping task requirements, initializing a plurality of mapping equipment layout schemes, wherein each mapping equipment layout scheme consists of different types and numbers of mapping equipment, each mapping equipment consists of an unmanned plane, a laser radar and a panoramic camera, each mapping equipment consists of three parts of sensor parameters, platform parameters and environment parameters, simulating the operation process of each mapping equipment layout scheme by using a constructed mapping equipment simulation model, acquiring mapping data acquisition quantity, resolution and measurement error indexes under different mapping equipment layout schemes through sensor data calculation, platform track planning and noise interference analysis, matching each index with a corresponding mapping coverage rate, mapping efficiency, mapping cost and mapping precision sub-objective function, calculating a sub-objective satisfaction value of each mapping equipment layout scheme in the form of fuzzy membership, expressing the position vector of each mapping equipment as a particle, consisting of the types, the numbers and the working parameters of each mapping equipment, expressing the adjustment direction and the amplitude of the scheme by using the constructed mapping equipment simulation model, constructing a weighted sum of sub-objective satisfaction value, calculating the optimal sub-objective satisfaction value in the form of the overall entropy according to the optimal value, optimizing the overall situation entropy, optimizing the overall situation of the particle satisfaction value according to the optimal entropy, optimizing the overall situation, using the optimal entropy, and optimizing the overall situation according to the objective entropy, optimizing the overall situation, and optimizing the overall situation according to the objective satisfaction value, the method comprises the steps of obtaining a particle with the smallest crowding degree distance, deleting the particle with the smallest crowding degree distance from an archive, searching according to the historical optimal position of the particle, the position of the global optimal particle and the crowding degree distance when the particle speed and the position are updated, and obtaining an optimal solution set consisting of non-dominant solutions as an optimal mapping equipment layout scheme set of a mapping area through iterative updating of the particle positions.
Illustratively, in the three-dimensional geographic scene model, a plurality of mapping device layout schemes to be evaluated are generated in an initialized mode according to geographic environment characteristics (such as topography, ground objects and the like) and mapping task requirements (such as mapping range, mapping precision, mapping time limit and the like) of a mapping area.
Each layout scheme consists of different types and numbers of mapping equipment so as to meet the requirements of mapping tasks.
The surveying and mapping equipment mainly comprises three main categories of unmanned aerial vehicle, laser radar and panoramic camera. The unmanned aerial vehicle is used for acquiring an aerial remote sensing image of a mapping area, the laser radar is used for acquiring three-dimensional point cloud data of the mapping area, and the panoramic camera is used for acquiring a panoramic live-action image of the mapping area.
Each mapping device consists of three parts, namely a sensor parameter, a platform parameter and an environment parameter.
The sensor parameters reflect performance indexes of the equipment, such as resolution, precision, field angle and the like, the platform parameters reflect the maneuverability of the equipment, such as navigational speed, range, load and the like, and the environment parameters reflect the adaptability of the equipment, such as wind speed, temperature, illumination and the like.
For each type of mapping equipment, a corresponding mathematical simulation model is constructed, the input of the model is equipment parameters and environment parameters, and the output is a quantization index of the equipment working process.
The simulation model comprehensively considers the physical characteristics, the working mechanism and the environmental influence of the equipment, and can simulate the operation process of the equipment more truly.
And simulating the operation process of each mapping equipment layout scheme by using the constructed mapping equipment simulation model.
The operation process mainly comprises three stages of acquisition, transmission and processing of mapping data. The data acquisition is realized through sensor data calculation, such as a geometric optical model imaged by a camera, a time-of-flight method of laser radar ranging and the like, the data transmission is realized through platform track planning, such as unmanned aerial vehicle route planning, a laser radar scanning mode and the like, and the data processing is realized through noise interference analysis, such as signal distortion correction, error compensation and the like.
And acquiring operation indexes such as acquisition quantity, resolution, measurement error and the like of mapping data under different mapping equipment layout schemes through simulation.
The acquisition quantity reflects the data acquisition capacity in unit time, the resolution reflects the space detail expression capacity of the data, and the measurement error reflects the accuracy degree of the data.
All indexes can be quantitatively calculated, and a basis is provided for subsequent scheme evaluation.
And matching the operation indexes of each layout scheme with four sub-objective functions of corresponding mapping coverage rate, mapping efficiency, mapping cost and mapping precision.
The sub-objective function reflects different requirements of the mapping task, wherein the coverage rate function characterizes the integrity of the mapping range, the efficiency function characterizes the speed of the mapping progress, the cost function characterizes the level of the mapping investment, and the precision function characterizes the quality of the mapping.
And calculating satisfaction degree of each mapping equipment layout scheme on four sub-targets by adopting a fuzzy membership degree form.
The fuzzy membership degree is the degree that the scheme belongs to a certain sub-target optimal solution set, and the value is between 0 and 1. The greater the membership, the more the representation scheme meets the requirements of the sub-objective.
The determination of the membership function needs to comprehensively consider factors such as the size of an index value, the change trend, an ideal interval and the like.
And constructing an adaptability function of the mapping equipment layout scheme based on the sub-target satisfaction.
The fitness function adopts a weighted summation form, satisfaction of four sub-targets is linearly combined, and the weight coefficient reflects the importance degree of different sub-targets.
The optimization target is that the fitness function value is the largest, namely, the layout scheme with the optimal comprehensive performance is found on the premise of considering a plurality of sub-targets.
And determining the weight coefficient of each sub-target by using an entropy weight method.
The entropy weighting method is an objective weighting method, and the importance of the index is measured according to the discrete degree of the index value.
The larger the degree of dispersion, the higher the degree of discrimination of the index, the larger the effect on the evaluation of the pattern, and the larger the weight coefficient.
First, the entropy value of each sub-target is calculated according to the satisfaction of the sub-targets of each scheme.
The entropy reflects the degree of disorder of the sub-objective satisfaction, and the larger the entropy is, the more uniform the satisfaction distribution is, and the lower the distinction degree is.
And then, carrying out normalization processing on the weights by utilizing the inverse of the entropy value to obtain initial weight coefficients.
In the optimization iteration process, the weight coefficient can be dynamically adjusted according to the solving requirement.
Each mapping device layout is represented as a particle.
The position vector of the particles consists of the type, the number and the working parameters of each mapping device, and reflects the configuration condition of the scheme.
The velocity vector of the particle represents the direction and magnitude of adjustment of the layout scheme, guiding the particle to search in the solution space.
And in the particle swarm optimization iteration process, updating the external archive according to the fitness value of the current particle.
External archiving is used to save the non-dominant solution found so far, i.e. the solution that is not dominant by any other solution.
The non-dominant solution is no worse on each sub-objective than the other solutions, and is the optimal compromise for multi-objective optimization.
At the same time, the crowding distance of the particles in the archive is calculated. The crowding degree distance represents the degree of density of one particle with other particles in the target space, and the larger the distance is, the more sparse the solution of the region where the particle is located is, and the greater the contribution to diversity of solution sets is.
And taking the particle with the largest crowding distance as the global optimal particle, and deleting the particle with the smallest crowding distance from the archive so as to maintain the archive size within a reasonable range.
When the particle speed and the position are updated, the historical optimal position of the particle, the position of the global optimal particle and the crowding degree distance are comprehensively considered.
The historical optimal position represents the optimal solution found by the particles in the past search, the position of the global optimal particle represents the optimal solution in the current archive, and the crowding degree distance represents the distribution condition of the solution.
All three provide beneficial reference information for particle movement.
And (3) continuously and iteratively searching particles in a solution space by setting a speed and position updated calculation formula, and gradually approaching to a global optimal solution set.
The updated formula contains parameters such as learning factors, inertia weights, constraint conditions and the like, and is used for balancing global exploration capacity and local development capacity of particles and improving convergence speed and accuracy of an algorithm.
The performance of the mapping device layout scheme is continuously improved through iterative updating of the particle positions of multiple rounds.
When the iteration number reaches a preset upper limit or the fitness value of the particles in the archive tends to be stable, the algorithm is terminated.
At this time, a set of non-dominant solutions stored in the external archive is the optimal mapping device layout scheme set for the mapping region.
The scheme set comprehensively balances a plurality of targets such as mapping coverage rate, mapping efficiency, mapping cost, mapping precision and the like, and can provide diversified decision references for actual mapping engineering.
The decision maker can select the most suitable layout scheme from the scheme set to implement according to the actual situation, thereby achieving the purposes of multi-objective optimization and comprehensive benefit maximization.
In an alternative embodiment, the multi-temporal remote sensing image data and the geographical national condition census data are fused, a long-short-term memory neural network algorithm is adopted, and three-dimensional situation evolution information of the mapping area in different future time periods is predicted based on current three-dimensional situation information, wherein the method comprises the steps of carrying out radiometric calibration and geometric correction on high-resolution visible light images and synthetic aperture radar image data acquired at a plurality of time points, carrying out registration between different-temporal remote sensing image data by utilizing a scale invariant feature transform algorithm, and fusing the multi-temporal remote sensing image data into a unified time sequence image sequence by a principal component analysis method or a wavelet transform method; the method comprises the steps of utilizing a semantic segmentation algorithm based on a convolutional neural network to extract ground use current situation map, a topographic map and a place name address map in geographical national condition census data and labeling attributes, extracting multi-level semantic features of images through a multi-scale convolution kernel, utilizing a conditional random field model to realize pixel-level ground feature classification, utilizing a topological relation and a spatial distribution rule among ground feature elements learned by a bidirectional recurrent neural network to carry out spatial correlation on ground feature semantic information obtained by interpretation and a time sequence to construct a multi-phase three-dimensional ground feature distribution model, constructing a three-dimensional situation evolution prediction model based on a bidirectional long-short-term memory neural network, expressing three-dimensional situation information of each time point as a multi-dimensional feature vector comprising object types, geometric shapes, spatial positions and semantic attributes, inputting a historical three-dimensional situation feature vector sequence into the three-dimensional situation evolution prediction model, and iteratively predicting three-dimensional situation evolution information of the mapping region in different time periods.
The invention provides a method for predicting three-dimensional situation evolution information of a mapping area in different future time periods based on current three-dimensional situation information by fusing multi-temporal remote sensing image data and geographical national condition census data and adopting a long-short-term memory neural network algorithm.
Image data of a mapping area are acquired at a plurality of time points through a high-resolution visible light remote sensing platform and a synthetic aperture radar system.
The visible light image can truly reflect the apparent information of colors, textures and the like of the ground object, and the synthetic aperture radar image can penetrate cloud, vegetation and the like to acquire the geometric structure information of the ground object. The two types of data complement each other and help to comprehensively describe the surface condition of the mapping area.
Meanwhile, geographical national condition census data related to the mapping area are collected, and the geographical condition census data mainly comprise a land utilization current situation map, a topography map and a place name address map.
The land utilization current map reflects the utilization type and range of land resources, the topography map reflects the relief form and elevation information of the earth surface, and the place name address map reflects the spatial distribution and attribute information of the aggregation.
The three types of data are associated with each other to form basic geographic information of the mapping area.
And performing radiometric calibration and geometric correction on the acquired multi-temporal remote sensing image data, and eliminating radiation distortion and geometric distortion in the imaging process.
The radiation calibration converts the image gray scale into physical reflectivity by establishing a quantitative relation between the sensor response and the ground object radiance, so that the radiation consistency of the image is improved.
Geometric correction is carried out by establishing a mapping relation between image coordinates and ground coordinates, correcting the image geometry to a uniform space reference system, and improving the position accuracy of the image.
And registering the different time-phase remote sensing image data by using a scale invariant feature transform algorithm.
The algorithm realizes the automatic matching of different time-phase images in space by extracting scale-invariant feature points, such as angular points, spots and the like, in the images and establishing the corresponding relation between the feature points.
The registered time sequence images are completely overlapped geometrically, and a foundation is laid for subsequent time sequence analysis.
And fusing the multi-temporal remote sensing image data into a unified time sequence image sequence by a principal component analysis method or a wavelet transformation method.
The principal component analysis method projects image data of a plurality of time phases to a new orthogonal feature space through linear transformation, and extracts the first several principal components with the largest contribution rate, thereby realizing dimension reduction compression and feature enhancement of the data.
The wavelet transformation method realizes scale isomorphism and edge preservation of the data by carrying out multi-scale and multi-directional wavelet decomposition on the image data and fusing high-frequency details and low-frequency contours on different scales.
The fused time sequence images realize integrated expression in spectrum, space and time, and are convenient for multi-dimensional information mining.
And extracting ground feature elements and labeling attributes of the geographical national condition census data by using a semantic segmentation algorithm based on a convolutional neural network.
The convolutional neural network is a deep learning model for simulating a human brain vision system, and multistage semantic features of images are automatically extracted through layer-by-layer convolution and pooling operation.
In the extraction process, the adaptability of the algorithm to complex ground features is enhanced by setting convolution kernels with different scales and directions.
On the basis of feature extraction, the pixel-level ground object classification is realized by using a conditional random field model.
The conditional random field is a probability graph model, and smooth and continuous ground feature classification results are finally obtained by establishing Markov attribute dependency relations among pixel points and considering the spatial correlation between the pixel points and surrounding areas.
The classification process fully utilizes the multidimensional characteristics of spectra, textures, shapes and the like of the ground features and the spatial context information, and greatly improves the accuracy of ground feature identification.
And at the same time of semantic segmentation, learning topological relation and space distribution rule between ground object elements by using a bidirectional recurrent neural network.
Recurrent neural networks are a deep learning model suitable for processing sequence data, capable of modeling long-term dependencies between data by recursively passing hidden layer states in the time dimension.
In the space dimension, adjacent and contained space relations among the feature elements are respectively modeled through a two-way transmission mechanism, and the combination modes of different features in space are depicted.
And carrying out spatial correlation on the ground object semantic information obtained by interpreting the geographical national conditions and the time sequence remote sensing image sequence, and constructing a multi-phase three-dimensional ground object distribution model.
The space association is realized through coordinate conversion and attribute linking between the images and the map data, the two-dimensional map elements are mapped to the three-dimensional image space, and the corresponding semantic attributes are inherited.
In the association process, a quick indexing method based on geometric hash is adopted, so that the calculation complexity of space searching is reduced.
The three-dimensional ground object distribution model is organized by adopting a space index structure such as a quadtree, an octree and the like, and each leaf node stores attribute information such as the type, the boundary, the elevation, the topology and the like of the ground object in the area.
On the basis of the attribute information, the geometric shape of the ground object is subjected to three-dimensional reconstruction in a triangular patch, voxel and other modes, and a multi-level and multi-scale ground object three-dimensional model is generated.
The multi-phase ground feature distribution model comprehensively records the distribution current situation of the ground features in different periods, reveals the time-space evolution rule of the ground features through time sequence analysis, and provides an important basis for predicting future situations.
And constructing a three-dimensional situation evolution prediction model based on the bidirectional long-short-term memory neural network.
The long-and-short-term memory neural network is an improved variant of the recurrent neural network, and by introducing the gating unit and the memory unit, the long-term dependency relationship in the time sequence can be better captured, and the problems of gradient disappearance, gradient explosion and the like can be relieved.
In the predictive model, three-dimensional situation information of each point in time is represented as a multidimensional feature vector including a feature type, a geometric shape, a spatial position, and a semantic attribute.
Wherein, the ground object type reflects the property and function of the ground object, the geometric shape reflects the size and appearance of the ground object, the spatial position reflects the longitude and latitude and elevation of the ground object, and the semantic attribute reflects the business meaning and application value of the ground object.
The feature vector quantifies a plurality of attribute dimensions of the ground feature in a normalized form, so that the feature vector is convenient to express and calculate in the model.
And sequentially inputting the historical three-dimensional situation characteristic vector sequence into the bidirectional long-short-time memory neural network in a sliding window mode.
The forward network and the backward network extract features from both directions of the time sequence, respectively, and obtain a coded representation of the history situation in the hidden layer state of the last time step.
Mapping the coded representation to a feature space of a future situation through a full connection layer, and obtaining probability distribution of three-dimensional situation evolution in each time period in the future by utilizing sustained softmax functions.
And training a prediction model by utilizing a large amount of historical three-dimensional situation data, and optimizing model parameters in a supervised learning mode.
The historical data is segmented into fixed-length samples according to a time sequence, and each sample comprises an input historical situation sequence and an output future situation sequence.
And measuring the difference between the predicted situation and the real situation by using a cross entropy loss function, and updating parameters by using a random gradient descent method.
In the training process, the generalization capability and the robustness of the model are improved by setting strategies such as dropout, L2 regularization and the like.
After model training is completed, the three-dimensional situation information acquired currently is input into a prediction model, and the three-dimensional situation evolution condition of a mapping area in different time periods in the future is predicted in an iterative mode.
The prediction result comprises the variation trend and probability distribution of the type, the geometric shape, the spatial position and the semantic attribute of each feature element in each time period.
Through three-dimensional visualization engines such as the trois. Js and the units 3D, prediction results are intuitively displayed in a dynamic scene mode, future ground feature distribution patterns, spatial topological relations, development trends and the like of a mapping area are revealed, and auxiliary decision support is provided for urban planning, resource management, disaster prevention and control and other applications.
The invention utilizes intelligent technical means such as multisource space-time big data, deep learning, three-dimensional reconstruction and the like to realize dynamic monitoring of complex geographic environments and accurate prejudgment of future situations.
The prediction result is visual and reliable, and the space-time analysis capability of basic mapping is greatly expanded.
In an optional implementation mode, a three-dimensional situation evolution prediction model based on a bidirectional long-short-time memory neural network is constructed, and the method comprises the steps of carrying out feature scaling on continuous variables in the multi-dimensional feature vector by adopting a normalization or standardization method, and carrying out feature conversion on
