The invention provides a method for constructing a three-dimensional situation evolution prediction model based on a bidirectional long-short-term memory neural network.
The method utilizes the advantages of the bidirectional long-short-term memory neural network in the aspect of processing time sequence data, combines an attention mechanism and a decoder structure, can effectively capture the evolution rule of the historical three-dimensional situation, and accurately predicts the three-dimensional situation states of different time periods in the future.
The specific technical scheme is as follows:
and carrying out feature scaling on continuous variables in the multidimensional feature vector by adopting a normalization or standardization method.
Normalization eliminates dimension influence by mapping the value range of continuous variables to the [0,1] interval, so that the features of different dimensions are comparable.
The normalization improves the convergence speed and stability of the model by subtracting the mean value from the continuous variable and dividing the continuous variable by the standard deviation, and converting the characteristic distribution into a standard normal distribution with the mean value of 0 and the variance of 1.
And performing feature conversion on discrete variables in the multidimensional feature vector by adopting a single-hot coding or embedding method.
The single-hot coding maps each value of the discrete variable into a binary vector, only one element in the vector is 1, the other elements are 0, and the class information of the discrete variable is coded.
Embedding maps discrete variables into a low-dimensional dense vector, converts the discrete variables into continuous vector representations through an embedding matrix obtained by learning, and reveals semantic relativity between different categories.
And carrying out normalization/standardization and single-heat coding/embedding treatment to obtain the preprocessed three-dimensional situation feature vector. The preprocessed feature vector has uniform scale and format, and is convenient for expression and calculation in the neural network.
And determining the number of nodes of an input layer of the two-way long-short-term memory neural network, the number of hidden units of the two-way long-short-term memory layer and the number of stacking layers according to the dimension of the preprocessed three-dimensional situation feature vector.
The number of nodes of the input layer is consistent with the dimension of the feature vector and is used for receiving input data.
The number of hidden units in the bidirectional long and short term memory layer determines the feature extraction capability of the network, and is usually set to be 2-4 times of the input dimension.
The number of stacked layers determines the depth and level of abstraction of the network, and more complex feature levels can be built by increasing the number of stacked layers.
And in the two-way long-short-term memory layer, outputting key characteristic information in the preprocessed three-dimensional situation characteristic vector by using an input gating unit, a forgetting gating unit and an output gating unit.
The input gating unit determines which information in the current input characteristics needs to be updated into the memory unit, the forgetting gating unit determines which information in the history memory unit needs to be forgotten, and the output gating unit determines which information in the memory unit needs to be output into the hidden state.
The gating unit realizes a soft switch between 0 and 1 through a sigmoid activation function and finely controls the flow of information.
The key characteristic information is stored in the memory unit, so that long-term memory and transmission of history information are realized.
The memory unit realizes the cyclic accumulation of information through a linear self-loop structure, and realizes the selective forgetting and updating of memory through the gate control unit.
The two-way long-short-term memory layer recursively transmits the hidden state in the forward direction and the reverse direction, and captures forward and backward dependency relations of the time sequence respectively.
And splicing the forward hiding state and the backward hiding state of the two-way long-short-period memory layer in each time step to form complete context characteristic representation.
In the attention layer, the importance weights of the context feature representations at different historical moments are calculated in parallel through a plurality of attention heads, and the historical context feature most relevant to the current prediction is determined.
The number of attention heads determines the parallelism and diversity of attention calculation, and is generally set to 4-8. Each attention head independently calculates an attention weight distribution, capturing correlation information for different aspects.
Similarity between the query vector and the key value vector is calculated by using dot product attention or additive attention mode, and attention weight distribution is generated.
The query vector represents the hidden state at the current moment, and the key value vector represents the hidden state at the historical moment.
Dot product attention is normalized by computing the inner product of the query vector and the key value vector and dividing by the key value vector dimension under the root number.
Additive attention by concatenating the query vector and the key value vector and activating the function through the full join layer and tanh, a nonlinear transformed attention weight is obtained.
And carrying out weighted summation on the attention weight distribution and the corresponding value vector to obtain an aggregated attention context feature vector.
The attention weight distribution reflects the contribution degree of different historical moments to the current prediction, and the value vector represents the hidden state of the historical moments.
The historical context features are aggregated by importance by weighted summation to obtain a context representation that is closely related to the current prediction.
And in the full connection layer, splicing the context characteristic representation output by the two-way long-short-term memory layer and the attention context characteristic vector output by the attention layer into a complete characteristic representation vector.
And the two parts of features are fused through the splicing operation, so that the feature representation which gives consideration to the global dependence and the local importance is obtained.
And carrying out nonlinear transformation and dimension conversion on the complete feature representation vector through one or more full-connection layers, and extracting high-level semantic feature information.
The fully connected layer maps the input features to a feature space with higher dimension through matrix multiplication and nonlinear activation functions, and exploits nonlinear interactions between features.
The number of layers and the number of nodes of the full-connection layer are set according to the complexity of tasks and the scale of data, and a pyramid structure is generally adopted, so that the number of nodes is reduced layer by layer.
And selecting a proper activation function to activate the high-level semantic feature information according to the type of the three-dimensional situation evolution prediction task.
For classification tasks, a softmax function is typically used to transform features into probability distributions.
For regression tasks, a linear function or sigmoid function is typically used to convert features to continuous values.
The choice of activation function determines the form and interpretation of the output layer.
In the output layer, according to the type of the three-dimensional situation evolution prediction task, the activated high-level semantic feature information output by the full-connection layer is utilized to generate an output feature vector representing the future three-dimensional situation state.
The dimension and meaning of the output feature vector correspond to the definition of the task, and the prediction result of the model on the future three-dimensional situation is represented.
Additional decoder structures are added at the output layer to further process and interpret the output feature vectors.
The decoder structure can be customized according to the task requirement, such as generating an output sequence by adopting a cyclic neural network, reconstructing an output image by adopting a convolutional neural network, and the like.
The introduction of the decoder structure enhances the expressive power of the model, so that the prediction result is more accurate and interpretable.
And applying the constructed three-dimensional situation evolution prediction model based on the bidirectional long-short-term memory neural network to an actual task.
And training the model by using the historical three-dimensional situation data, and optimizing model parameters in a supervised learning mode.
The training data includes a sequence of historical three-dimensional situational feature vectors and corresponding future three-dimensional situational state labels.
In the training process, the difference between the prediction result and the real label is measured by adopting a cross entropy loss function or a mean square error loss function, and the loss function is minimized by using a back propagation algorithm and a gradient descent optimization method, so that model parameters are updated.
Meanwhile, the complexity of the model is controlled by adopting strategies such as dropout regularization, early stopping and the like, and the generalization capability of the model is improved.
After model training is completed, the three-dimensional situation feature vector sequence obtained at present is input into a model, and a prediction result representing the future three-dimensional situation state is obtained at an output layer through a forward propagation process.
The prediction result can be three-dimensional situation classification probability distribution of different time periods in the future, and can also be three-dimensional situation regression values of different time periods in the future.

the system comprises a second unit for constructing a multi-objective optimization model deduced by situation of a mapping area, wherein the multi-objective optimization model takes mapping coverage rate, mapping efficiency, mapping cost and mapping precision as optimization targets, the multi-objective optimization model comprises a plurality of sub-objective functions, weights of the sub-objective functions are determined by adopting a hierarchical analysis method, an optimal mapping equipment layout scheme set of the mapping area is determined based on a simulation optimization algorithm in the three-dimensional geographic scene model, the optimal mapping equipment layout scheme is obtained based on each scheme in the optimal mapping equipment layout scheme set, a mapping operation process under the optimal mapping equipment layout scheme is simulated in the three-dimensional geographic scene model, three-dimensional point cloud data consistent with the mapping operation process is generated to obtain current three-dimensional situation information of the mapping area, a third unit for fusing multi-temporal remote sensing image data and geographical national situation census data, predicting three-dimensional situation evolution information of the mapping area in different time periods in the future based on the current three-dimensional situation information by adopting a long-time memory neural network algorithm, the three-dimensional situation evolution information is input into the multi-objective optimization model, and adaptive degree values of the mapping equipment layout schemes are recalculated, and generating three-dimensional visual scenes of different future time periods of the mapping region by adopting a virtual reality technology based on the updated optimal mapping equipment layout scheme.

Claims
Translated from Chinese
1. A method for deducing the situation of a surveying and mapping area under multi-objective optimization, characterized by comprising:
Acquire multi-source heterogeneous geographic information data of the surveying and mapping area, wherein the multi-source heterogeneous geographic information data includes remote sensing image data collected by different types of sensors, laser radar point cloud data, and geographic national conditions census data; use a deep learning algorithm to perform feature extraction and semantic segmentation on the multi-source heterogeneous geographic information data to generate a three-dimensional geographic scene model of the surveying and mapping area, wherein the three-dimensional geographic scene model includes a high-precision terrain model, a semantic building model, and a multi-level road network model;
A multi-objective optimization model for mapping area situation deduction is constructed, wherein the multi-objective optimization model takes mapping coverage, mapping efficiency, mapping cost and mapping accuracy as optimization objectives, and includes multiple sub-objective functions, and the weight of each sub-objective function is determined by using a hierarchical analysis method; in the three-dimensional geographic scene model, an optimal mapping equipment layout scheme set for the mapping area is determined based on a simulation optimization algorithm; based on each scheme in the optimal mapping equipment layout scheme set, an optimal mapping equipment layout scheme is obtained; in the three-dimensional geographic scene model, a mapping operation process under the optimal mapping equipment layout scheme is simulated, and three-dimensional point cloud data consistent with the mapping operation process is generated to obtain current three-dimensional situation information of the mapping area;
Integrate multi-temporal remote sensing image data and geographic national survey data, use long short-term memory neural network algorithm, and predict the three-dimensional situation evolution information of the surveying and mapping area in different time periods in the future based on the current three-dimensional situation information; input the three-dimensional situation evolution information into the multi-objective optimization model, recalculate the fitness value of each surveying and mapping equipment layout plan, and update the optimal surveying and mapping equipment layout plan; based on the updated optimal surveying and mapping equipment layout plan, use virtual reality technology to generate three-dimensional visualization scenes of the surveying and mapping area in different time periods in the future;
Construct a multi-objective optimization model for mapping area situation deduction, including:
The surveying and mapping target data, surveying and mapping accuracy data, surveying and mapping time data and surveying and mapping cost data are used as the input of the multi-objective optimization model to establish the surveying and mapping coverage rate sub-objective function, the surveying and mapping efficiency sub-objective function, the surveying and mapping cost sub-objective function and the surveying and mapping accuracy sub-objective function; among them, the independent variable of the surveying and mapping coverage rate sub-objective function is the surveying and mapping status of each grid, and the output is the surveying and mapping coverage rate evaluation index; the independent variable of the surveying and mapping accuracy sub-objective function is the accuracy parameters of each surveying and mapping sensor and the parameters of the fusion algorithm, and the output is the surveying and mapping accuracy evaluation index; the independent variable of the surveying and mapping cost sub-objective function is the input amount of each cost factor, and the output is the surveying and mapping cost evaluation index; the independent variable of the surveying and mapping efficiency sub-objective function is the type and quantity of surveying and mapping equipment selected for each work unit, and the output is the surveying and mapping efficiency evaluation index;
The dynamic preference information of surveying and mapping task requirements is collected, and a pairwise comparison matrix between different optimization objectives of the dynamic preference information is constructed to obtain a dynamic judgment matrix, wherein the element values of the dynamic judgment matrix represent the dynamic quantitative evaluation values of the relative importance of the two optimization objectives; the maximum eigenvalue of the dynamic judgment matrix and its corresponding eigenvector are calculated by the spectral decomposition method, and a fuzzy consistency evaluation model of the dynamic judgment matrix is constructed; the dynamic judgment matrix is solved based on the fuzzy consistency evaluation model to obtain the maximum fuzzy eigenvalue and fuzzy eigenvector that are compatible with the dynamic preference information; the solved fuzzy eigenvector is normalized to obtain an initial weight vector, and a subjective and objective combined weighting model is constructed to optimize and correct the initial weight vector to obtain a combined weight vector;
The fuzzy consistency ratio of the dynamic judgment matrix is calculated, and whether the matrix conforms to the logical consistency is judged by setting the fuzzy consistency ratio threshold; when the test fails, the feedback mechanism is used to adjust the element values of the judgment matrix, and the combined weight vector is recalculated and a consistency test is performed; when the test passes, the combined weight vector is used as the dynamic weighting coefficient of the surveying and mapping coverage sub-objective function, the surveying and mapping efficiency sub-objective function, the surveying and mapping cost sub-objective function and the surveying and mapping accuracy sub-objective function to construct the optimization target of the multi-objective optimization model.
2. The method according to claim 1 is characterized in that a deep learning algorithm is used to perform feature extraction and semantic segmentation on the multi-source heterogeneous geographic information data to generate a three-dimensional geographic scene model of the surveying area, comprising:
The remote sensing image data is processed by joint radiometric calibration, multi-view geometric correction and multi-scale image fusion to generate a multi-source remote sensing image dataset with consistent spectral response and spatial geometric matching; a convolutional neural network algorithm based on an attention mechanism is used to extract the texture, spectral and spatial features of the multi-source remote sensing image dataset to generate a multi-channel remote sensing image feature map; the lidar point cloud data is processed by adaptive noise filtering, multi-scale ground point extraction and point cloud segmentation based on graph cuts to obtain lidar point cloud subsets of different types of ground objects; a deep learning algorithm based on a graph attention network is used to extract the geometric features, topological relationship features and semantic attribute features of the lidar point cloud subset to generate a multi-dimensional point cloud feature vector;
The geographic national conditions census data is processed by spatial coordinate conversion, attribute data standardization and multi-level topological reconstruction to generate a geographic national conditions element set that is consistent with the spatial reference of the multi-source remote sensing image data set and the lidar point cloud subset; a deep learning algorithm based on a gated graph convolutional network is used to extract the semantic features, spatial relationship features and hierarchical structure features of the geographic national conditions element set to generate a multi-resolution semantic feature map; a feature adaptive fusion strategy based on a self-attention mechanism is used to nonlinearly fuse the multi-channel dynamic remote sensing image feature map, the multi-dimensional point cloud feature vector and the multi-resolution semantic feature map to generate a fused multi-source heterogeneous geographic information feature set;
The fused multi-source heterogeneous geographic information feature set is input into a multi-task deep learning model to generate a high-precision terrain model, a semantic building model and a multi-level road network model of the surveying area; a geographic information semantic ontology library is constructed, and the high-precision terrain model, the semantic building model and the multi-level road network model are semantically mapped and knowledge associated with the geographic information semantic ontology library to obtain a three-dimensional geographic scene model of the surveying area.
3. The method according to claim 1 is characterized in that establishing a surveying and mapping coverage sub-objective function, a surveying and mapping efficiency sub-objective function, a surveying and mapping cost sub-objective function and a surveying and mapping accuracy sub-objective function comprises:
The area to be measured is divided into grids of equal size by using a rasterization method. The side length of each grid is adaptively determined according to the geometric characteristics of the surveying and mapping target and the required spatial resolution. The surveying and mapping status of each grid is statistically analyzed to form a surveying and mapping status matrix. The key ground object elements in the area to be measured are extracted from remote sensing images or laser point cloud data using ground object element extraction technology. The surveying and mapping completeness rate of each type of ground object element is calculated. The sub-objective function of surveying and mapping coverage rate is constructed with the constraint condition that the surveying and mapping completeness rate of ground object elements is greater than a given threshold.
By adopting the hierarchical decomposition method, the surveying and mapping tasks are decomposed into multiple work units from top to bottom. The standard working hours required for each work unit are determined according to the workload and complexity of the work. At the same time, the completion efficiency of the unit workload is calculated based on the equipment performance parameters and work experience for different surveying and mapping equipment, and the surveying and mapping efficiency sub-objective function is constructed with the surveying and mapping time data as the constraint condition; by adopting the cost accounting method, various cost elements related to the surveying and mapping tasks are systematically classified and aggregated, and cost estimation models are selected for different types of cost elements. The total cost calculation model is constructed to obtain the budget cost for completing the entire surveying and mapping task, and the cost sensitivity analysis technology is used to identify the key cost driving factors, and the surveying and mapping cost sub-objective function is constructed with the surveying and mapping cost data as the constraint condition;
Taking the accuracy parameters of different surveying and mapping sensors as optimization variables, the functional relationship between surveying and mapping accuracy evaluation indicators and sensor accuracy parameters is established. The differential evolution algorithm is used to search for the optimal combination of surveying and mapping sensor accuracy parameters. After obtaining the optimal accuracy parameters of each surveying and mapping sensor, the multi-source data fusion technology is used to fuse the surveying and mapping data obtained by different sensors. The surveying and mapping accuracy sub-objective function is constructed with the surveying and mapping accuracy data as the constraint condition.
4. The method according to claim 1, characterized in that, in the three-dimensional geographic scene model, determining the optimal surveying and mapping equipment layout solution set of the surveying and mapping area based on the simulation optimization algorithm comprises:
In the three-dimensional geographic scene model, according to the geographic environment characteristics of the surveying and mapping area and the requirements of the surveying and mapping task, multiple surveying and mapping equipment layout plans are initialized, each surveying and mapping equipment layout plan is composed of different types and quantities of surveying and mapping equipment, wherein the surveying and mapping equipment includes drones, lidars, and panoramic cameras, and each device is composed of three parts: sensor parameters, platform parameters, and environmental parameters; the constructed surveying and mapping equipment simulation model is used to simulate the operation process of each surveying and mapping equipment layout plan, and the surveying and mapping data collection volume, resolution, and measurement error indicators under different surveying and mapping equipment layout plans are obtained through sensor data solution, platform trajectory planning, and noise interference analysis; each indicator is matched with the corresponding surveying and mapping coverage, surveying and mapping efficiency, surveying and mapping cost, and surveying and mapping accuracy sub-objective functions, and the sub-objective satisfaction value of each surveying and mapping equipment layout plan is calculated in the form of fuzzy membership;
Each surveying and mapping equipment layout plan is represented as a particle. The particle's position vector is composed of the type, quantity and working parameters of each surveying and mapping equipment. The particle's velocity vector represents the adjustment direction and amplitude of the layout plan. A fitness function in the form of weighted summation is constructed based on the sub-goal satisfaction values. The weight coefficient reflects the importance of different sub-goals. The optimization goal is to maximize the fitness function value. The entropy weight method is used to determine the initial weight of each sub-goal. The entropy value is calculated according to the discrete degree of the sub-goal satisfaction value, and the weight is normalized using the inverse of the entropy value.
In the iterative process of particle swarm optimization, the external archive is updated according to the fitness value of the current particle, and the crowding distance of the particles in the archive is calculated. The particle with the largest crowding distance is taken as the global optimal particle, and the particle with the smallest crowding distance is deleted from the archive; when the particle speed and position are updated, the search is performed based on the particle's own historical optimal position, the position of the global optimal particle and the crowding distance; through multiple rounds of iterative updates of particle positions, a set of optimal solutions composed of non-dominated solutions is obtained as the optimal surveying and mapping equipment layout plan set for the surveying and mapping area.
5. The method according to claim 1 is characterized by fusing multi-temporal remote sensing image data and geographic national survey data, using a long short-term memory neural network algorithm, and predicting the three-dimensional situation evolution information of the surveying and mapping area in different time periods in the future based on the current three-dimensional situation information, including:
Radiometric calibration and geometric correction are performed on high-resolution visible light images and synthetic aperture radar image data acquired at multiple time points. Scale-invariant feature transformation algorithm is used to align remote sensing image data of different temporal phases, and multi-temporal remote sensing image data are fused into a unified time series image sequence through principal component analysis or wavelet transform.
The semantic segmentation algorithm based on convolutional neural network is used to extract and annotate the land features of the land use status map, topographic map and place name address map in the national geographic survey data. The multi-level semantic features of the image are extracted through multi-scale convolution kernels, and the conditional random field model is used to achieve pixel-level classification of land features. At the same time, the topological relationship and spatial distribution law between land features are learned by using a bidirectional recurrent neural network, and the interpreted land feature semantic information is spatially associated with the time series image sequence to construct a multi-temporal three-dimensional land feature distribution model.
A three-dimensional situation evolution prediction model based on a bidirectional long short-term memory neural network is constructed, and the three-dimensional situation information at each time point is represented as a multidimensional feature vector including object type, geometric shape, spatial position and semantic attributes. The historical three-dimensional situation feature vector sequence is input into the three-dimensional situation evolution prediction model, and the three-dimensional situation evolution information of the surveying and mapping area in different time periods in the future is iteratively predicted.
6. The method according to claim 5, characterized in that constructing a three-dimensional situation evolution prediction model based on a bidirectional long short-term memory neural network comprises:
The continuous variables in the multidimensional feature vector are normalized or standardized to perform feature scaling, and the discrete variables in the multidimensional feature vector are converted by one-hot encoding or embedding methods to obtain a preprocessed three-dimensional situation feature vector; the number of input layer nodes, the number of hidden units in the bidirectional long short-term memory layer, and the number of stacked layers of the bidirectional long short-term memory neural network are determined according to the dimension of the preprocessed three-dimensional situation feature vector; in the bidirectional long short-term memory layer, the key feature information in the preprocessed three-dimensional situation feature vector is output by using an input gating unit, a forgetting gating unit, and an output gating unit;
The key feature information is stored in the memory unit, and the forward hidden state and the backward hidden state of the bidirectional long short-term memory layer at each time step are concatenated to form a context feature representation; in the attention layer, the importance weights of the context feature representations at different historical moments are calculated in parallel by multiple attention heads, the historical context features most relevant to the current prediction are determined, and the similarity between the query vector and the key value vector is calculated by using the dot product attention or additive attention method to generate an attention weight distribution, and the attention weight distribution is weighted and summed with the corresponding value vector to obtain an aggregated attention context feature vector;
In the fully connected layer, the context feature representation output by the bidirectional long short-term memory layer and the attention context feature vector output by the attention layer are spliced into a complete feature representation vector, and the complete feature representation vector is subjected to nonlinear transformation and dimensional conversion through one or more fully connected layers to extract high-level semantic feature information; according to the type of the three-dimensional situation evolution prediction task, an activation function is selected to activate the high-level semantic feature information; in the output layer, according to the type of the three-dimensional situation evolution prediction task, the activated high-level semantic feature information output by the fully connected layer is used to generate an output feature vector representing the future three-dimensional situation state, and an additional decoder structure is added to the output layer to construct a three-dimensional situation evolution prediction model based on the bidirectional long short-term memory neural network.
7. A surveying and mapping area situation deduction system under multi-objective optimization, used to implement the method described in any one of claims 1 to 6, characterized in that it comprises:
The first unit is used to obtain multi-source heterogeneous geographic information data of the surveying and mapping area, wherein the multi-source heterogeneous geographic information data includes remote sensing image data collected by different types of sensors, laser radar point cloud data and geographic national conditions census data; use a deep learning algorithm to perform feature extraction and semantic segmentation on the multi-source heterogeneous geographic information data to generate a three-dimensional geographic scene model of the surveying and mapping area, wherein the three-dimensional geographic scene model includes a high-precision terrain model, a semantic building model and a multi-level road network model;
The second unit is used to construct a multi-objective optimization model for mapping area situation deduction, wherein the multi-objective optimization model takes mapping coverage, mapping efficiency, mapping cost and mapping accuracy as optimization objectives, and includes multiple sub-objective functions, and the weight of each sub-objective function is determined by the hierarchical analysis method; in the three-dimensional geographic scene model, the optimal mapping equipment layout scheme set of the mapping area is determined based on the simulation optimization algorithm; based on each scheme in the optimal mapping equipment layout scheme set, the optimal mapping equipment layout scheme is obtained; in the three-dimensional geographic scene model, the mapping operation process under the optimal mapping equipment layout scheme is simulated, and three-dimensional point cloud data consistent with the mapping operation process is generated to obtain the current three-dimensional situation information of the mapping area;
The third unit is used to integrate multi-temporal remote sensing image data and geographic national conditions census data, and adopt a long short-term memory neural network algorithm to predict the three-dimensional situation evolution information of the surveying and mapping area in different time periods in the future based on the current three-dimensional situation information; input the three-dimensional situation evolution information into the multi-objective optimization model, recalculate the fitness value of each surveying and mapping equipment layout plan, and update the optimal surveying and mapping equipment layout plan; based on the updated optimal surveying and mapping equipment layout plan, use virtual reality technology to generate three-dimensional visualization scenes of the surveying and mapping area in different time periods in the future.

processor;

### 📜 Full Specification & Deep Scrape Text
Title
Multi-objective optimization control method and system for cooperative ramp merging of connected vehicles on highway

Abstract
State data of vehicles in a control area is collected, then time of starting control and selection of controlled vehicles are decided according to a position of a ramp merging vehicle, information is transmitted into a traffic control module by means of a data transmission module, and an artificial intelligence based ramp merging multi-objective control model ensures efficient, safe, and energy-saving operation of overall traffic of a road while completing ramp merging by means of a vehicle traveling track in the cooperative ramp control area. Compared with a traditional method, the present invention greatly promotes merging of the ramp vehicles, and different from other methods having the defect of transforming the problem of ramp merging into the problem of vehicle sequencing, the present invention greatly improves efficiency of ramp merging.

Description
CROSS REFERENCES
This application is the continuation application of International Application No. PCT/CN2022/102755 filed on 30 Jun. 2022 which designated the U.S. and claims priority to Chinese Application No. CN202210164445.8 filed on 23 Feb. 2022, the entire contents of each of which are hereby incorporated by reference.
TECHNICAL FIELD
The present invention belongs to the technical field of intelligent traffic vehicle-road cooperation, and in particular to a multi-objective optimization control method and system for cooperative ramp merging of connected vehicles on a highway.
BACKGROUND ART
With rapid growth of national economy and continuous promotion of urbanization, increased regional trades have prompted rapid growth in urban trips, thereby bringing challenges to efficient and safe operation of a highway. An on-ramp area, serving as a bottleneck affecting traffic efficiency of the highway, is a particularly eye-catching problem in traffic management. A common ramp control method is to control the rate of on-ramp inflow by adjusting macroscopic traffic flow state variables (such as density and flow). However, a ramp metering strategy aims to prioritize the efficiency of a trunk line and attempt to prevent congestion. With an incapability to control movement of a single vehicle to promote a merging process, the method fail to successfully merge in a case of a number of vehicles on a main line, resulting in congestion and safety problems.
In consideration of excellent dynamic control capabilities of intelligent connected vehicles, a cooperative ramp merging strategy was provided, to better control merging by adjusting tracks of the vehicles, so as to ensure traffic efficiency and safety. Common merging strategies can be divided into heuristic methods (rule-based methods or fuzzy methods) and optimal methods. However, heuristic algorithms usually require domain-specific expertise to finely design certain driving rules, lack of adaptability to other unknown situations, and have difficulty in achieving optimal control. Optimization algorithms such as a Pontryagin's maximum principle (PMP) and dynamic programming (DP) lack of self-learning capabilities, have difficulty in achieving global optimization in a complex on-ramp merging environment, and lack of adaptability to problems, and although reinforcement learning based optimization algorithms can improve adaptability of a system to unknown environments, existing strategies are too focused on reward shaping and model construction to fundamentally solve the problem of cooperative ramp merging. In essence, it is necessary for cooperative ramp merging to satisfy multi-objective long-term and short-term feedback at the same time. That is, it is necessary to consider the influence on long-term objectives during execution of short-term actions, but rewards for on-ramp merging evaluation are sparse and long-term for the merging problem. In this case, a traditional reinforcement learning method has difficulty in avoiding local optimality and instability when dealing with sparse reward problem, thereby influencing traffic efficiency and safety of vehicles in a ramp area.
Aiming at the above problem, the inventors have provided a related paper for a battery life oriented on-ramp reinforcement learning method, which initially solves the problem of on-ramp merging. However, the method is mainly oriented to battery health, is an implementation case in a specific application scenario of a new energy vehicle, but is not applicable to a real traditional mixed ramp merging scenario of a fuel vehicle and the new energy vehicle; and moreover, the paper does not involve ramp merging vehicle selection and main road merging gap selection, and lacks of key links in actual ramp merging application. Aiming at the above problem, the present patent, on the basis of specific cases provided by the paper, provided a multi-objective optimization control method and system for cooperative ramp merging of connected vehicles on a highway, which establish a comprehensive and complete framework and an advanced technology methodology for the problem of on-ramp vehicle merging.
SUMMARY
In order to solve the above technical problem, the present invention provides a multi-objective optimization control method and system for cooperative ramp merging of connected vehicles on a highway, which ensure efficient, safe, and energy-saving operation of overall traffic of a road while completing ramp merging by means of a vehicle traveling track in a cooperative ramp control area.
The present invention provides a multi-objective optimization control method for cooperative ramp merging of connected vehicles on a highway. The control method includes:
step 1, collecting state data of vehicles in a control area of the highway, and analyzing and processing the state data, the control area including an intersection of a main road and a ramp, a merging area, and partial road segments of the main road, the ramp and an acceleration lane of the highway, a range of the control area being a communication range of a road side unit, the road side unit being arranged at the intersection of the main road and the ramp of the highway, and the merging area being a preselected area including the partial road segments of the acceleration lane and road segments of the main road parallel to the partial road segments of the acceleration lane;
step 2, constructing a set of alternatives for a ramp merging vehicle, an auxiliary vehicle, and a guidance vehicle according to the state data of the vehicles in the control area;
step 3, inputting the set of alternatives into an artificial intelligence based ramp merging multi-objective control model separately, and further determining selection of the auxiliary vehicle and the guidance vehicle by means of an optimal value strategy;
step 4, according to the auxiliary vehicle, the guidance vehicle, and the merging vehicle that are selected, controlling and adjusting accelerations of the auxiliary vehicle and the guidance vehicle, to ensure safe merging of the ramp merging vehicle from the acceleration lane into the main road in the selected merging area; and
step 5, collecting state data of the ramp merging vehicle and the auxiliary vehicle, of which the accelerations are adjusted, and returning to step 4 to adjust accelerations at a next moment.
As a further improvement of the control method of the present invention, in step 1, the state data of the vehicles includes positions, speeds, power battery states, and corresponding moment information of the vehicles in the control area.
As a further improvement of the control method of the present invention, in step 1, the analyzing and processing the state data includes: analyzing the data, extracting features, and fusing information.
As a further improvement of the control method of the present invention, in steps 2 and 3, the optimal value strategy selected for the ramp merging vehicle, the guidance vehicle, and the auxiliary vehicle is as follows:
1) selecting the merging vehicle: setting a vehicle, of which a front bumper is closest to a ramp exit line, on the ramp as the merging vehicle, and obtaining state information of all the vehicles in the control area in first t time steps;
2) according to position information of all the vehicles, preliminary selecting each z main road vehicles in the rear of and in front of the merging vehicle as alternative vehicles of the auxiliary vehicle and the guidance vehicle on the basis of front and rear relations between main line vehicles and the merging vehicle;
3) in all the alternative vehicles, selecting two vehicles that are adjacent to each other as a group of guidance vehicle and auxiliary vehicle, to construct an alternative set AL of the guidance vehicle and the auxiliary vehicle of the merging vehicle; and
4) using a traversal method to substitute combinations in the alternative set AL into the artificial intelligence based ramp merging multi-objective control model separately, and determining the merging vehicle, the auxiliary vehicle, and the guidance vehicle that are finally selected on the basis of a value function Q of the model.
As a further improvement of the control method of the present invention, the state information of all the vehicles in the control area in the first time steps includes speeds, positions, and accelerations.
As a further improvement of the control method of the present invention, in step 4) of the optimal value strategy selected for the merging vehicle, the auxiliary vehicle, and the guidance vehicle, constructing an objective function and constraints of the artificial intelligence based ramp merging multi-objective control model successfully merged into a moment includes:
1) setting τ as a safe merging moment to construct a position and speed relation to be satisfied by the guidance vehicle, the auxiliary vehicle, and the ramp merging vehicle at the safe merging moment:

As a further improvement of the control method of the present invention, the multi-experience replay based virtual objective construction algorithm provided in construction of the rewards of the reinforcement learning actor-critic algorithm includes:
(1) constructing multi-experience virtual objectives and optimizing the objective space at at time step: on the basis of the objective g* and the data link (s t ∥g*, a, r, s t+1 ∥g*) at the t time step, constructing a fully connected neural network H, g=H φ (s, g*) taking 4 as a parameter, to obtain 1 virtual objectives in a current state: g 1 =H φ (s t , g*), g 2 =H φ (s t+1 , g*), . . . , g l =H φ (s t+1−1 , g*);
(2) optimizing data exploration on the basis of the optimized objective space: constructing 1 virtual objective data links on the basis of the obtained 1 virtual objectives: (s t ∥g 1 , a, r, S t+1 ∥g 1 ), (s t ∥g 2 , a, r, s t+1 ∥g 2 ), . . . , (s t ∥g l , a, r, s t+1 ∥g l ); and

(3) optimizing data exploration at a full time step: repeating (1) and (2) for each time step to complete data exploration and objective space optimization at all time steps;
(4) selecting virtual objective effectiveness on the basis of an artificial intelligence model: training the artificial intelligence model according to an optimized data set, and selecting, according to a training result, an optimal virtual objective data link at each time step; and
(5) verifying the fully connected neural network H for the virtual objectives: according to the optimal virtual objective data link at each time step, verifying the parameter φ of the fully connected neural network H for the virtual objectives, to constantly improve accuracy of generation of the virtual objectives, so as to ensure algorithm performance and a training speed.
The present invention provides a system based on a multi-objective optimization control method for cooperative ramp merging of connected vehicles on a highway. The system includes an information collection module, a data transmission module, a traffic control module, and an intelligent optimization module, where
the information collection module is used for collecting state data of vehicles in a control area of a highway, analyzing and processing the state data, and selecting a ramp merging vehicle, an auxiliary vehicle, and a guidance vehicle;
the information collection module includes an in-vehicle unit, and a road side unit, the road side unit being arranged at an intersection of a main road and a ramp of a highway, the road side unit being used for collecting positions, speeds and corresponding moment information of the vehicles in the control area, and being further used for collecting time of determining the ramp merging vehicle, and time when a front bumper reaches a ramp exit line, and the in-vehicle unit being used for collecting power battery states and corresponding moment information of the vehicles in the control area;
the data transmission module is used for using a mobile communication technology as a subject information transmission communication mode to assist one or two of wireless communication modes of wireless fidelity/bluetooth (WiFi/BT), and dedicated short range communications (DSRC) to transmit data between the information collection module and the traffic control module, the traffic control module and the intelligent optimization module;
the traffic control module is used for obtaining, according to the state data of the vehicles provided by the information collection module, a behavior strategy a, an objective g and a reward r that are optimal in real time, sending the behavior strategy to the in-vehicle unit for real-time control of the vehicles, and further sending the behavior strategy a, the objective g and the reward r that are optimal to the intelligent optimization module; and
the intelligent optimization module is used for storing data sent by the traffic control module, optimizing a ramp merging multi-objective control model on the basis of an alternative set AL of the vehicles selected in step 3) and an optimization algorithm provided in step 4), and transmitting the optimized model to the traffic control module.
Beneficial Effects
The present invention uses the above technical solution, and has the following technical effects compared with the prior art:
1. The present invention promotes, by controlling the vehicles on two lanes of the ramp merging area, a process of ramp merging, solves the problem of queuing caused by ramp vehicle merging delay caused by a traditional ramp control means only using flow rate control, and further actively promotes merging of the ramp vehicles on the premise of ensuring traffic capability of a main line, thereby greatly improving traffic efficiency in the ramp area; and a single-vehicle control method also ensures safe travel between the vehicles.
2. The present invention uses reinforcement learning for single-vehicle-controlled ramp merging, which is different from other single-vehicle-controlled ramp merging methods. Reinforcement learning may constantly explore and optimize the control strategy from historical data without constructing complex models, and moreover, the algorithm further has some robustness and adaptability due to diversity of exploration.
3. The present invention introduces a multi-experience virtual objective construction method, and the steps of objective space optimization and data exploration, thereby greatly improving data exploration efficiency, effectively solving the problems of long-term reward sparsity and a coupled relation between long rewards and short rewards in multi-objective ramp control, and ensuring safe and effective multi-objective ramp merging.
4. Compared with a paper published by the inventors, the present invention is mainly improved as follows:
1) Different from a battery health oriented merging method only for a new energy vehicle in the paper, the present invention provides a merging method for a mixed ramp scenario applicable to a variety of vehicles (including, but not limited to, traditional fuel vehicles, new energy vehicles, etc.), and the present invention provides a key technical link applied to a real merging scenario of the highway.
2) The present invention further optimizes vehicle constraints at the safe and successful merging moment, and further enriches a selection algorithm for the guidance vehicle, the auxiliary vehicle and the merging vehicle in the control area, and compared with a simple selection mode in the paper, the selection solution of the present invention may obtain the optimal vehicle selection solution, thereby further improving an optimal solution of the algorithm, and making running of the vehicles more energy-saving, efficient and stable.
3) The present invention further optimizes an importance level of the long-term rewards and the short-term rewards, and reserves an interface for objective introduction of the present invention for different practical situations, and the present invention determines a coefficient relation between the short-term rewards, thereby ensuring that the present invention may be adapted to situations having a variety of different objectives, and further improving the scope of application of the present invention.
4) The present invention further optimizes a data exploration algorithm provided by the article, introduces a multi-experience virtual objective construction method, which is different from simple selection of a next state by the paper, further improves efficiency of data utilization, improves a direction and correctness of data exploration, and greatly avoids occurrence of dangerous situations such as collision.
BRIEF DESCRIPTION OF THE DRAWINGS
FIG. 1 is a schematic diagram of a merging scenario of a highway provided in the present invention; and
FIG. 2 is an architecture diagram of a multi-objective optimization control method for cooperative ramp merging of connected vehicles on a highway of the present invention.
DETAILED DESCRIPTION OF THE EMBODIMENTS
The present invention will be further described in detail below in combination with the accompanying drawings and particular embodiments.
A method provided in the present invention is based on assumptions as follows: 1) network connected vehicles need to have necessary capabilities to transmitting information and implement instructions, that is, the network connected vehicles have the capability to interact information by means of an in-vehicle unit, and the vehicles fully execute control instructions; 2) a ramp control area includes an intersection of a main road and a ramp, a ramp merging area and partial road segments of a main line and the ramp, and a control range of the control area is a communication range of a road side unit; 3) the merging area has a fixed length, i.e., d m =d max −d min ; 4) delays in information transmission, data processing and computation, and instruction execution are ignored, that is, it is assumed that a running speed of each module is enough to support running of a system; and 5) influences of lateral movement and temperatures of the vehicles on the vehicles are ignored.
A multi-objective optimization control system for cooperative ramp merging of connected vehicles on a highway provided in the present invention includes an information collection module, a data transmission module, a traffic control module, and an intelligent optimization module.
1) The information collection module collects, by means of an in-vehicle unit and a road side unit, state information such as speeds, positions, and power battery states and corresponding moment information of vehicles in a control area and start moment information of merging of a ramp vehicle (a selected moment of a merging vehicle), and analyzing and processing the data, and the analyzing and processing the data include, but not limited to, analyze the data, extract features, fuse information, etc.; and
information collection cooperation of the in-vehicle unit and the road side unit included in the information collection module is as follows:
(1) the road side unit is responsible for collecting traffic state information, such as the speeds and positions of the vehicles in the area, and the start moment of merging of the ramp merging vehicle; and
(2) the in-vehicle unit is responsible for collecting vehicle related parameter information, such as engine state information, battery state information, and gear information. A power composition of a network connected vehicle designed in the present invention includes: a fuel vehicle, a pure electric vehicle, a hydrogen energy vehicle, and a hybrid electric vehicle.
2) The data transmission module uses a fifth generation mobile communication technology (5G) as a subject information transmission communication mode to assist one or two of wireless communication modes of wireless fidelity/bluetooth (WiFi/BT), dedicated short range communications (DSRC), etc. to transmit data between the in-vehicle unit, the road side unit, and each module;
3) the traffic control module obtains, according to traffic state information provided by the information collection module, a behavior strategy a, an objective g and a reward r that are optimal in real time, sends the strategy to the in-vehicle unit for real-time control of the vehicles, and further packages a traffic state information set to be sent to the intelligent optimization module; and
4) the intelligent optimization module includes a training sub-module and a data sub-module. The data sub-module stores data sent by the traffic control module, and applies an artificial intelligence data exploration method to obtain a number of data pairs for storage; and the training sub-module utilizes a reward function to optimize an artificial intelligence based ramp merging multi-objective control model according to the data provided by the data sub-module, and transmits an optimized model to the traffic control module.
The control area includes an intersection of a main road and a ramp, a ramp merging area, and partial road segments of a main line and the ramp. It is worth noting that a control range of the control area is a communication range of the road side unit, which sees FIG. 1 for details.
As shown in FIG. 2 , a multi-objective optimization control method for cooperative ramp merging of connected vehicles on a highway provided in the present invention includes:
S01 obtain, by an information collection module, state data of vehicles in a control area;
S02 perform, by the information collection module, data analysis, information fusion, etc. on the collected data by means of an intelligent data analysis model;
S03 according to the state data of the vehicles in the control area, construct a set AL of alternatives of a ramp merging vehicle, an auxiliary vehicle and a guidance vehicle;
S04 input the set of alternatives into an artificial intelligence based ramp merging multi-objective control model separately, and further determine selection of the auxiliary vehicle and the guidance vehicle by means of an optimal value strategy;
SOS transmit, by a transmission module, the vehicles selected in S04 and vehicle related collected data to a control module;
S06 confirm, by a traffic control module, the vehicles to which instructions are sent to implement a decision on the basis of the artificial intelligence based ramp merging multi-objective control model, a frame of the artificial intelligence based ramp merging multi-objective control model being a reinforcement learning actor-critic algorithm;
S07 transmit, by the transmission module, decision information to in-vehicle units of controlled vehicles to achieve a vehicle safe, efficient and energy-saving ramp merging objective, and the controlled vehicles are the ramp merging vehicle and the auxiliary vehicle; and
S08 collect state information data pairs of the controlled vehicles under a control strategy, and store the state information data pairs of the controlled vehicles into a data sub-module to form a closed loop control.
In S03 and S04, a selection method for the merging vehicle, the auxiliary vehicle and the guidance vehicle is based on a framework of the optimal value strategy algorithm framework, and includes:
1) select the merging vehicle: set a vehicle, of which a front bumper is closest to a ramp exit line, on the ramp as the merging vehicle, and obtain state information, such as speeds, positions, and accelerations, of all the vehicles in the control area in first t time steps;
2) according to position information of all the vehicles, preliminary select each z main road vehicles in the rear of and in front of the merging vehicle as alternative vehicles of the auxiliary vehicle and the guidance vehicle on the basis of front and rear relations between main line vehicles and the merging vehicle;
3) in all the alternative vehicles, select two vehicles that are adjacent to each other as a group of guidance vehicle and auxiliary vehicle, to construct an alternative set AL of the guidance vehicle and the auxiliary vehicle of the merging vehicle;
4) use a traversal method to substitute combinations in the alternative set AL into the artificial intelligence based ramp merging multi-objective control model separately, and determine the merging vehicle, the auxiliary vehicle, and the guidance vehicle that are finally selected on the basis of a value function 0% of the model; and
5) control and adjust, by the artificial intelligence based ramp merging multi-objective control model, accelerations of the merging vehicle and auxiliary vehicle according to the selected guidance vehicle, to solve multi-objective optimal control, so as to successfully merge the merging vehicle into a main line, and simultaneously ensuring energy consumption optimization of the merging vehicle and efficient and safe traffic of a road. Specifically, constructing a problem mathematical model and carrying out optimization solution on the basis of reinforcement learning are specifically included.

6) expand data exploration, and optimize the objective space: according to 4) and 5), it may be found that data satisfying g* is difficult to obtain, because g* is a fixed final objective and has extremely limited guidance significance for the real-time rewards. Therefore, a multi-experience replay based virtual objective construction algorithm is further provided, to introduce virtual objectives, to optimize the objective space, and simultaneously expand the data exploration. The provided multi-experience replay based virtual objective construction algorithm includes:
(1) construct multi-experience virtual objectives and optimize the objective space at a t time step: on the basis of the objective g* and the data link (s t ∥g*, a, r, s t+1 ∥g*) at the t time step, construct a fully connected neural network H, g=H φ (s, g*) taking φ as a parameter, to obtain/virtual objectives in a current state: g 1 =H φ (s t , g*), g 2 =H φ (s t+1 , g*), . . . , g l =H φ (s t+1−1 , g*);
(2) optimize data exploration on the basis of the optimized objective space: construct 1 virtual objective data links on the basis of the obtained 1 virtual objectives:
(s t ∥g 1 ), a, r, s t+1 ∥g 1 ), (s t ∥g 2 , a, r, s t+1 ∥g 2 ), . . . ,
(s t ∥g l ), a, r, s t+1 ∥g l ); and
store the virtual objective data links into the intelligent optimization module;
(3) optimize data exploration at a full time step: repeat (1) and (2) for each time step to complete data exploration and objective space optimization at all time steps;
(4) select virtual objective effectiveness on the basis of an artificial intelligence model: train the artificial intelligence model according to an optimized data set, and select, according to a training result, an optimal virtual objective data link at each time step; and
(5) verify the fully connected neural network H for the virtual objectives: according to the optimal virtual objective data link at each time step, verify the parameter φ of the fully connected neural network H for the virtual objectives, to constantly improve accuracy of generation of the virtual objectives, and improve a training speed of the algorithm.

Claims
What is claimed is:
1. A multi-objective optimization control method for cooperative ramp merging of connected vehicles on a highway, comprising:
step 1, collecting state data of vehicles in a control area of the highway, and analyzing and processing the state data, the control area comprising an intersection of a main road and a ramp, a merging area, and partial road segments of the main road, the ramp and an acceleration lane of the highway, a range of the control area being a communication range of a road side unit, the road side unit being arranged at the intersection of the main road and the ramp of the highway, and the merging area being a preselected area comprising the partial road segments of the acceleration lane and road segments of the main road parallel to the partial road segments of the acceleration lane;
step 2, constructing a set of alternatives for a ramp merging vehicle, an auxiliary vehicle, and a guidance vehicle according to the state data of the vehicles in the control area;
step 3, inputting the set of alternatives into an artificial intelligence based ramp merging multi-objective control model separately, and further determining selection of the auxiliary vehicle and the guidance vehicle by means of an optimal value strategy; wherein
the optimal value strategy selected for the ramp merging vehicle, the guidance vehicle, and the auxiliary vehicle is as follows:
i) selecting the merging vehicle: setting a vehicle, of which a front bumper is closest to a ramp exit line, on the ramp as the merging vehicle, and obtaining state information of all the vehicles in the control area in first t time steps;
ii) according to position information of all the vehicles, preliminary selecting each z main road vehicles in the rear of and in front of the merging vehicle as alternative vehicles of the auxiliary vehicle and the guidance vehicle on the basis of front and rear relations between main line vehicles and the merging vehicle;
iii) in all the alternative vehicles, selecting two vehicles that are adjacent to each other as a group of guidance vehicle and auxiliary vehicle, to construct an alternative set AL of the guidance vehicle and the auxiliary vehicle of the merging vehicle; and
iv) using a traversal method to substitute combinations in the alternative set AL into the artificial intelligence based ramp merging multi-objective control model separately, and determining the merging vehicle, the auxiliary vehicle, and the guidance vehicle that are finally selected on the basis of a value function Q π of the model;
step 4, according to the auxiliary vehicle, the guidance vehicle, and the merging vehicle that are selected, controlling and adjusting accelerations of the auxiliary vehicle and the guidance vehicle, to ensure safe merging of the ramp merging vehicle from the acceleration lane into the main road in the selected merging area; and
step 5, collecting state data of the ramp merging vehicle and the auxiliary vehicle, of which the accelerations are adjusted, and returning to step 4 to adjust accelerations at a next moment.

### 📋 Abstract
> Translated from Chinese The multi-objective optimal control method and system for the synergistic ramp of the expressway network-connected vehicle merges into the ramp. The information is transmitted to the traffic control module, and the multi-objective control model of the artificial intelligence-based on-ramp merge passes the vehicle trajectory in the control area of the ramp to complete the on-ramp merge while ensuring the efficient, safe, and energy-saving operation of the overall road traffic. And the traffic efficiency and traffic safety of the ramp, reduce the energy loss of control vehicles, and maximize the economic benefits of the high-speed system.

### 📜 Full Specification & Deep Scrape Text
Title
Multi-objective optimization control method and system for expressway internet of vehicles cooperating with ramp junction

Abstract
Translated from Chinese
The multi-objective optimal control method and system for the synergistic ramp of the expressway network-connected vehicle merges into the ramp. First, the state data of the vehicles in the control area are collected, and then the control start time and the selection of the controlled vehicle are determined according to the position of the vehicles merged into the ramp. The information is transmitted to the traffic control module, and the multi-objective control model of the artificial intelligence-based on-ramp merge passes the vehicle trajectory in the control area of the ramp to complete the on-ramp merge while ensuring the efficient, safe, and energy-saving operation of the overall road traffic. Compared with the traditional method, the present invention greatly promotes the entry of on-ramp vehicles, and is different from the defect of transforming the problem of on-ramp into a vehicle sequencing problem in other methods, greatly improves the efficiency of on-ramp entry, and ensures the main line. And the traffic efficiency and traffic safety of the ramp, reduce the energy loss of control vehicles, and maximize the economic benefits of the high-speed system.

Description
Translated from Chinese
Multi-objective optimal control method and system for collaborative ramp entry of expressway networked vehicles
technical field
The invention belongs to the technical field of intelligent traffic vehicle-road coordination, and in particular relates to a multi-objective optimization control method and system for the convergence of an expressway network-connected vehicle collaborative ramp.
Background technique
With the rapid growth of the national economy and the continuous promotion of the urbanization process, the increase in regional trade has led to the rapid growth of inter-city travel, which has brought challenges to the efficient and safe operation of expressways. Among them, the on-ramp area, as a bottleneck affecting the efficiency of expressway traffic, is a particularly concerned issue in traffic management. A common approach to ramp control is to control the rate of on-ramp inflow by adjusting macroscopic traffic flow state variables such as density or flow. However, the purpose of the ramp metering strategy is to prioritize the efficiency of the trunk and try to prevent congestion. Since the movement of individual vehicles cannot be controlled to facilitate the merging process, this method may fail to merging successfully when there are many vehicles on the main line, resulting in congestion and safety issues.
Considering the excellent dynamic control ability of ICVs, a coordinated ramp-in strategy is proposed to better control the inflow by adjusting the trajectory of vehicles to ensure traffic efficiency and safety. Common import strategies can be divided into heuristic methods (rule-based methods or fuzzy methods) and optimal methods. However, heuristic algorithms usually require domain-specific expertise for the fine design of certain driving rules, lack adaptability to other unknown situations and are difficult to achieve optimal control. Due to the lack of self-learning ability of optimization algorithms such as PMP, DP and other algorithms, it is difficult to achieve global optimization in the complex environment of on-ramp merging, and lack of adaptability to the problem; although the optimization algorithm based on reinforcement learning can improve the adaptability of the system to the unknown environment, However, existing strategies focus too much on reward shaping and model building, and cannot fundamentally solve the problem of collaborative on-ramp convergence. Essentially, collaborative on-ramp merging requires long-term and short-term feedback that simultaneously meets multiple objectives. That is, short-term actions need to be performed with consideration to long-term goals, but for the influx problem, the reward for on-ramp influx evaluations is sparse and long-term. In this case, it is difficult for traditional reinforcement learning methods to avoid local optima and instability when dealing with the sparse reward problem, which affects the passing efficiency and safety of vehicles in the ramp area.
In response to the above problems, the inventor has proposed a battery-life-oriented on-ramp reinforcement learning method in related papers to initially solve the problem of on-ramp convergence. However, it cannot be applied to the actual hybrid ramp entry scenario of traditional fuel vehicles and new energy vehicles; at the same time, the paper does not involve the selection of the main road entry gap selection for on-ramp vehicles, and there is a lack of key links in the actual application of on-ramp entry. In view of the above problems, this patent proposes a multi-objective optimization control method and system for the collaborative ramp entry of expressway networked vehicles on the basis of the specific cases proposed in the paper. technical method system.
SUMMARY OF THE INVENTION
In order to solve the above-mentioned technical problems, the present invention proposes a multi-objective optimization control method and system for expressway networked-vehicle cooperative on-ramp merging, which can ensure the overall traffic efficiency of the road while completing the on-ramp merging through the vehicle travel trajectory in the coordinated ramp control area. , Safe and energy-saving operation.
The present invention provides a multi-objective optimization control method for the synergistic ramp entry of expressway networked vehicles, including the following steps:
Step 1: Collect the state data of vehicles in the expressway control area, and analyze and process the state data; the control area includes the intersection of the main road and the ramp of the expressway, the merge area, the main road section, and the ramp section. And some sections of the acceleration lane, the range of the control area is the communication range of the roadside unit, the roadside unit is set at the intersection of the main road and the ramp of the expressway, and the merge area is a pre-selected area, including acceleration Parts of the lane and parts of the main road parallel to parts of the acceleration lane;
Step 2: Construct a set of options for the ramp-in vehicle, the auxiliary vehicle and the guiding vehicle according to the state data of the vehicle in the control area;
Step 3: Input the set of options into the artificial intelligence-based ramp and merge into the multi-objective control model, and further determine the selection of auxiliary vehicles and guiding vehicles through the optimal value strategy;
Step 4: Control and adjust the acceleration of the auxiliary vehicle and the guide vehicle according to the selected auxiliary vehicle, guide vehicle and merging vehicle to ensure that the merging vehicle on the ramp safely merges from the acceleration lane to the main road within the selected merging area. middle;
Step 5: Collect the state data of the ramp-incoming vehicle and the auxiliary vehicle after the acceleration adjustment is performed, and return to step 4 to perform the acceleration adjustment at the next moment.
As a further improvement of the control method of the present invention, in the step 1, the state data of the vehicle includes the position, speed, power battery state and corresponding time information of the vehicle in the control area.
As a further improvement of the control method of the present invention, in the step 1, the status data is analyzed and processed, including but not limited to data analysis, feature extraction and information fusion.
