### 📜 Full Specification & Deep Scrape Text
Title
Multi-objective optimal scheduling method and system for multi-AGV flexible job shop

Abstract
The invention relates to a multi-objective optimal scheduling method and system for a multi-AGV flexible job shop. The method comprises the steps of collecting layout data of a job shop, AGV operation parameters and production task data, constructing a scheduling system basic model, carrying out recursive neural network training and physical constraint model integration to obtain a mixed scheduling prediction model, carrying out subtask decomposition and path searching, obtaining a double-target optimization model through constraint linearization conversion, carrying out particle swarm optimization solution on the double-target optimization model, obtaining a non-dominant solution set through two-stage iterative computation of self-adaptive weight strategy and constraint conversion, carrying out multidimensional evaluation computation on the non-dominant solution set to obtain an optimal scheduling execution scheme, and carrying out model feedback update on the mixed scheduling prediction model to obtain a target scheduling prediction model. The invention realizes the multi-objective balance of task completion time and energy consumption, and improves the real-time response capability and operation stability of the system.

Description
Multi-objective optimal scheduling method and system for multi-AGV flexible job shop
Technical Field
The invention relates to the technical field of AGV scheduling, in particular to a multi-objective optimal scheduling method and system for a multi-AGV flexible job shop.
Background
With the rapid development of intelligent manufacturing, multi-AGV scheduling optimization in a flexible job shop becomes a key technology for improving production efficiency. The traditional AGV scheduling method mainly depends on static planning and manual experience, and is difficult to cope with a dynamic complex production environment, and particularly under a multi-AGV cooperative operation scene, the scheduling optimization problem is more complex due to the coupling relation between task allocation and path planning.
The existing AGV scheduling algorithm generally has the problem of insufficient adaptability to a real-time dynamic environment. The scheduling method based on the filter excessively depends on priori information, job workshops of different scales need to redesign parameters of the filter, and the method based on the heuristic algorithm is difficult to balance a plurality of optimization targets such as task completion time, energy consumption and the like, and is easy to sink into a local optimal solution.
Disclosure of Invention
The invention mainly aims to provide a multi-objective optimal scheduling method and system for a multi-AGV flexible job shop, which realize multi-objective balance of task completion time and energy consumption and improve real-time response capability and operation stability of the system.
In order to achieve the above purpose, the invention provides a multi-objective optimization scheduling method for a multi-AGV flexible job shop, which comprises the following steps:
collecting job shop layout data, AGV operation parameters and production task data, and constructing a scheduling system basic model;
performing recurrent neural network training and physical constraint model integration based on AGV historical operation data in the scheduling system basic model to obtain a hybrid scheduling prediction model;
Acquiring AGV state feature vectors and task demand features output by the mixed scheduling prediction model, performing subtask decomposition and path search processing, and obtaining a double-target optimization model through constraint linearization conversion;
Carrying out particle swarm optimization solution on the double-target optimization model, and obtaining a non-dominant solution set through two-stage iterative computation of self-adaptive weight strategy and constraint conversion;
Performing multidimensional evaluation calculation on the non-dominant solution set to obtain an optimal scheduling execution scheme;
And inputting the optimal scheduling execution scheme into an AGV control system, and carrying out model feedback update on the mixed scheduling prediction model to obtain a target scheduling prediction model.
The invention also provides a multi-objective optimal scheduling system of the multi-AGV flexible job shop, which comprises the following steps:
the acquisition module is used for acquiring job shop layout data, AGV operation parameters and production task data and constructing a scheduling system basic model;
the training module is used for carrying out recurrent neural network training and physical constraint model integration based on the AGV historical operation data in the scheduling system basic model to obtain a mixed scheduling prediction model;
The processing module is used for acquiring AGV state feature vectors and task demand features output by the mixed scheduling prediction model, carrying out subtask decomposition and path search processing, and obtaining a double-target optimization model through constraint linearization conversion;
The solving module is used for carrying out particle swarm optimization solving on the double-target optimization model, and obtaining a non-dominant solution set through two-stage iterative computation of self-adaptive weight strategy and constraint conversion;
The calculation module is used for carrying out multidimensional evaluation calculation on the non-dominant solution set to obtain an optimal scheduling execution scheme;
And the updating module is used for inputting the optimal scheduling execution scheme into an AGV control system, and carrying out model feedback updating on the hybrid scheduling prediction model to obtain a target scheduling prediction model.
The invention also provides a computer device comprising a memory and a processor, the memory having stored therein a computer program, the processor implementing the steps of any of the methods described above when the computer program is executed.
The invention also provides a computer readable storage medium having stored thereon a computer program which when executed by a processor performs the steps of the method of any of the preceding claims.
In summary, the technical scheme provided by the invention constructs a hybrid scheduling prediction model through deep integration of a recurrent neural network and a physical constraint model, improves the adaptability of a scheduling system to a dynamic environment, avoids the excessive dependence of a traditional method on prior parameters, reduces the coupling complexity of task allocation and path planning by adopting a task decomposition method based on similarity and a path planning strategy for improving an A-based algorithm, solves the deadlock problem in multi-AGV collaborative scheduling, introduces a two-stage optimization strategy of a self-adaptive particle swarm algorithm and an epsilon-constraint method, realizes multi-objective balance of task completion time and energy consumption, overcomes the defect that the traditional algorithm is easy to fall into local optimum, designs a multi-dimensional evaluation system based on time dimension, efficiency dimension and energy consumption dimension, comprehensively evaluates by combining a hierarchical analysis method, ensures the scientificity and reliability of the scheduling scheme, realizes continuous optimization and self-adaptive learning of the scheduling system through an online data acquisition and model dynamic updating mechanism, and remarkably improves the real-time response capability and running stability of the system.
Drawings
FIG. 1 is a schematic illustration of steps of a multi-objective optimal scheduling method for a multi-AGV flexible job shop in accordance with one embodiment of the present invention;
FIG. 2 is a block diagram of a multi-objective optimal scheduling system for a multi-AGV flexible job shop in accordance with one embodiment of the present invention;
fig. 3 is a block diagram schematically illustrating a structure of a computer device according to an embodiment of the present invention.
The achievement of the objects, functional features and advantages of the present invention will be further described with reference to the accompanying drawings, in conjunction with the embodiments.
Detailed Description
The present invention will be described in further detail with reference to the drawings and examples, in order to make the objects, technical solutions and advantages of the present invention more apparent. It should be understood that the specific embodiments described herein are for purposes of illustration only and are not intended to limit the scope of the invention.
Referring to fig. 1, the embodiment provides a multi-objective optimization scheduling method for a multi-AGV flexible job shop, which includes the following steps:
s1, collecting layout data of a job shop, AGV operation parameters and production task data, and constructing a scheduling system basic model;
The workshop layout data comprises machining equipment coordinate data and position data of an AGV charging station. And carrying out topology modeling on the traveling channel of the AGV, and carrying out topology analysis on the layout of the channel in the workshop to obtain the layout topology data of the workshop. And carrying out coordinate mapping on the motion trail of the AGV according to the workshop layout topology data. The coordinate information of all important positions, equipment and channels in the workshop is converted into a unified workshop layout matrix, so that a matrix model representing the workshop space distribution is obtained. And collecting the operation parameters of the AGV. The method comprises the steps of collecting data such as the running speed, turning radius, carrying capacity, battery capacity and the like of AGV equipment. The parameters are monitored in real time through a vehicle-mounted sensor, and a dynamics parameter model of the AGV is built by combining data fitting technologies such as a least square method and the like. The model can accurately describe the motion performance and constraint of the AGV under different working conditions. And scheduling production tasks according to the process flow data in the workshops. Workpiece processing process data in the workshop, transfer time data between processes and task priority data are input into a task scheduler. And the task scheduler calculates an optimal production task sequence through a linear programming model. The task sequence will determine the execution order and priority of different tasks to ensure the smoothness and high efficiency of the production process. In the process, the linear programming model not only considers time constraint among tasks, but also combines the priority information of the tasks so as to maximize the overall benefit of workshop production. And establishing a kinematic model of the AGV based on the workshop layout matrix, the dynamic parameter model of the AGV and the production task sequence. In the kinematic model, a speed vector and a position vector of the AGV are substituted into Euler equations as core variables, and motion constraint conditions of the AGV in the running process are obtained by solving the equations. The motion constraints refer to physical constraints that the AGV must meet in performing a task, such as maximum speed, minimum turning radius, etc. These constraints ensure the safety and efficiency of the AGV in performing the tasks. And performing constraint modeling on the AGV motion constraint condition and the task time window to obtain a scheduling constraint model. The time window means that each task needs to be completed within a certain time range, and the AGV must be ensured to complete the task within a specified time in the scheduling process. Meanwhile, considering the energy consumption of the AGV, the battery capacity of the AGV may become a limiting factor in the case of long-time operation. And performing integral operation on the speed data and the battery capacity data in the AGV dynamic parameter model to obtain a corresponding energy consumption function, and quantifying the energy requirements of the AGV when executing different tasks. And integrating the motion constraint model, the task time window constraint model and the energy consumption function of the AGV to obtain a scheduling system basic model.
S2, performing recurrent neural network training and physical constraint model integration based on AGV historical operation data in a scheduling system basic model to obtain a hybrid scheduling prediction model;
Specifically, the AGV running track data, task execution time data and energy consumption data in the basic model of the scheduling system are subjected to data set division, and the data are converted into a training sample set suitable for time sequence analysis through time sequence segmentation. And (5) carrying out standardization treatment on the training samples. In order to improve the quality of data and the training efficiency of the neural network, a training sample set is input to a batch normalization layer for data standardization, so that the mean value and variance of input features are relatively balanced, the training is accelerated, and the gradient disappearance or explosion problem is avoided. In order to enhance the diversity of the training data, the track data is randomly rotated and translated by adopting a data enhancement technology, so as to generate an enhanced training data matrix. In this way, the scale of the training set is effectively expanded, and the adaptability and generalization capability of the model to different scenes are enhanced. Time sequence feature extraction is performed by a long short time memory network element (LSTM). The LSTM can effectively capture the long-short-period dependency relationship in the time sequence data, and is suitable for processing the history track data of the AGV. By batching the enhanced training data matrix, the LSTM can extract therefrom the state feature vectors of the AGV, which will be used as inputs for constructing the recurrent neural network model. The AGV state characteristics comprise dynamic change characteristics such as position, speed, acceleration and the like, and can reflect the running states of the AGV in different time periods. AGV status feature vectors are input into a recurrent neural network containing 3 hidden layers. The recurrent neural network performs deep learning and processing on input data through a plurality of layers of neurons, and extracts more complex rules. In order to optimize the training effect of the network, an Adam optimizer is used to optimize parameters of the neural network. The Adam optimizer is a self-adaptive optimization algorithm, can effectively adjust the learning rate, accelerates convergence in the training process, and avoids the defects of the traditional gradient descent method. The obtained first neural network model can be used for preliminarily predicting the state of the AGV after training. And carrying out dropout processing on the hidden layer of the first neural network model. Dropout is a regularization technique that avoids overfitting of the model to the training data by randomly discarding some neurons during the training process. When the validation loss does not drop a number of times in succession (e.g., N times), an early-stop mechanism is triggered, thereby preventing the model from over-tuning during training, resulting in performance degradation. After the optimization treatment, the obtained second neural network model has better generalization capability and higher stability. These physical constraints are constructed as Lagrangian constraints based on the AGV kinematics equations, time window constraints and energy consumption functions in the scheduling system base model. The Lagrangian constraints effectively introduce physical constraints into the optimization problem, thereby ensuring that the scheduling decisions not only meet the actual physical constraints, but also balance the needs of multiple objectives. For example, the kinematic equations of the AGV can ensure that the AGV does not exceed physical limits during travel, time window constraints can ensure that tasks are completed on time, and energy consumption functions limit the energy consumption of the AGV, thereby ensuring that the AGV can efficiently complete tasks. And carrying out weighted combination on the physical constraint loss function and the predicted loss of the neural network to obtain the hybrid optimization objective function. Under the guidance of the objective function, iterative computation is performed by using a back propagation algorithm, and parameters of the neural network are adjusted step by step, so that the hybrid scheduling prediction model can realize the maximization of prediction accuracy on the basis of meeting physical constraints. After multiple iterations, the finally obtained mixed scheduling prediction model can accurately predict the running state and scheduling scheme of the AGV according to the state characteristics and task requirements of the AGV.
S3, acquiring AGV state feature vectors and task demand features output by the mixed scheduling prediction model, performing subtask decomposition and path search processing, and obtaining a double-target optimization model through constraint linearization conversion;
The output of the mixed scheduling prediction model is processed, and the similarity between the state feature vector of the AGV and the task demand feature is calculated. And measuring the similarity between tasks through a weighted combination of the cosine distance and the Euclidean distance to obtain a task similarity matrix, wherein the similarity matrix reflects the similarity degree between different tasks. And clustering the tasks according to the set similarity threshold value to obtain a decomposition sequence of the tasks. And mapping and matching each subtask in the task decomposition sequence with AGV equipment. In order to ensure reasonable pairing of tasks and AGVs, an M X N-dimensional task allocation matrix is constructed by adopting a 0-1 integer programming method, wherein M is the total number of tasks, and N is the total number of AGVs. The matrix clearly shows the distribution relation between each task and each AGV, and a task distribution scheme is primarily obtained. On the basis of the preliminary allocation scheme, the execution task sequence of each AGV is encoded for optimization. A new task optimization sequence is generated by using single-point crossover and double-point mutation operation through an optimization method based on a genetic algorithm. Single-point cross operations can explore more task scheduling by exchanging some of the tasks in the task sequence, while double-point mutation operations increase the diversity of the solution space by randomly changing the order of the tasks. These operations help to increase the diversity of task scheduling, and thus improve the optimization effect of the scheduling scheme. And (5) path planning is carried out. And constructing a path planning space of an A-algorithm according to the workshop layout matrix. The a algorithm is a graph search algorithm that can find the shortest path in a given trellis environment. When constructing the path planning space, the layout space of the workshop is subjected to rasterization, and the distance between each two nodes is set to be the length of an AGV body so as to ensure the accuracy and the practical feasibility of path calculation. And (5) obtaining the path search network through rasterization processing of a grid method. Setting heuristic function to path searching network to optimize path searching process. The design of the heuristic function is crucial to the performance of the a-algorithm, and the evaluation function of the path is constructed by combining the weighted sum of the manhattan distance and the dynamic obstacle avoidance factor. The Manhattan distance can provide an estimate of the linear distance, and the dynamic obstacle avoidance factor considers the influence of real-time obstacles, so that the collision risk of the AGV in the path planning process is effectively avoided. And obtaining a cost matrix of the path by using the path evaluation function, wherein the cost matrix reflects the cost of different paths and helps to optimize path selection. Meanwhile, linearization processing is carried out on the motion constraint condition of the AGV. The kinematic equations, turn constraints, and speed constraints of an AGV are typically nonlinear, and the nonlinear constraints are converted into a set of linear inequalities using a first order Taylor expansion. The original complex motion constraint condition can be expressed in a linear constraint mode, and subsequent optimization calculation is facilitated. and calculating a task completion time function based on the task optimization sequence. The function can reflect the time requirement of task completion and provide a timeliness basis for scheduling optimization. Meanwhile, the energy consumption function of each AGV is calculated according to the dynamic parameter model of the AGVs, and the function reflects the energy consumption of the AGVs in the task executing process. In order to ensure that the objective functions can be reasonably compared under different scales, the task completion time function and the energy consumption function are normalized, and are converted into standardized objective functions. And combining the standardized objective function, the linearization constraint equation and the path cost matrix to obtain a double-objective optimization model.
S4, carrying out particle swarm optimization solution on the double-target optimization model, and obtaining a non-dominant solution set through two-stage iterative computation of self-adaptive weight strategy and constraint conversion;
Specifically, a first stage initialization is performed on the dual-objective optimization model. And generating an initial solution of the particle swarm in M multiplied by N dimension according to the total number of tasks M and the total number of AGVs N. The initial solution space represents a preliminary match between the task and the AGV, covering all possible task allocation approaches. In the framework of particle swarm optimization, each particle represents a task allocation scheme, and the solution space is the scope of particle swarm search. The initial solution space is input into an adaptive particle swarm algorithm for optimization. The self-adaptive particle swarm algorithm controls the exploratory and development performance of the searching process by adjusting the inertia weight of the particle swarm, and in the process, a linear decreasing method is used for calculating the inertia weight value. The adjustment of the inertial weight value helps to balance the local search and the global search of the particles in the search space, so that the particles can keep a larger search range in an early stage, and the precision of the solution can be finely adjusted in a later stage, thereby accelerating the convergence process. The position and the speed of the particle swarm are updated through the self-adaptive particle swarm algorithm, so that the particles are effectively guided to move towards the direction of the optimal solution. In this process, the movement of the particles is not only influenced by self experience, but also the search process is optimized by guidance of a globally optimal solution. In order to improve the efficiency of the particle swarm algorithm, a tournament selection strategy is adopted to screen a global optimal solution. The strategy selects the particle with the highest current quality through a competition mechanism, gives higher selection probability to the particle, and improves the searching quality of the particle swarm. After the first stage search computation, a set of first stage search solutions are obtained, which represent possible solutions found in the preliminary optimization process. And applying an epsilon-constraint method to the first-stage search solution set, performing constraint conversion on the objective function by applying the epsilon-constraint method, and converting the energy consumption target into inequality constraint conditions to obtain a constraint conversion model. The original multi-objective optimization problem is converted into a single-objective optimization problem, the energy consumption objective is regarded as a constraint condition, and the task completion time is used as a main objective for optimization. By taking the energy consumption as constraint, the energy consumption limit is not exceeded while the task completion time is optimized, and the reasonable utilization of resources is realized. Based on the constrained transformation model, the population is evolved by using binary crossover operators and Gaussian mutation operators, and a second-stage initial population is obtained. The binary crossover operator can exchange part of genes of the particles so as to generate a new solution, and the Gaussian mutation operator increases the diversity of the search space by slightly perturbing the positions of the particles so as to avoid the risk of being trapped in a locally optimal solution. And (5) carrying out local search optimization on the initial population in the second stage. And fine tuning the particle position through a variable neighborhood search strategy, wherein the strategy ensures that a better solution can be found in a local solution space through dynamically adjusting the search range and the neighborhood structure. The introduction of the variable neighborhood search can effectively improve the local search capability of the particle swarm algorithm, and improve the precision and the optimization effect of the solution. After the optimization of the local search, a group of local optimal solution sets are obtained, and the solution sets represent the optimal solution in the current stage search process. Non-dominant ranking is performed in order to select the most representative solution set from the locally optimal solution set. Non-dominant ranking is a ranking method based on the Pareto optimization idea, which solutions are optimal is decided by comparing dominant relations between the solutions. In non-dominant ordering, a solution is considered to dominate another solution if it is not worse than the other solution on all targets and better than the other solution on at least one target. The local optimal solution set is divided into a plurality of levels by non-dominant ranking, forming a priority ranking. The solution set is screened based on an elite retention strategy, which ensures that the most excellent solution can persist in the evolution process by retaining the current optimal solution, and is further optimized in subsequent iterations. The method is characterized in that the method is selected according to the crowding degree distance of the solution, the crowding degree distance is used for measuring the crowding degree of the solution in a solution space, and the solution with smaller crowding degree represents that the solution is relatively sparse in a target space and has more potential and should be reserved preferentially. And obtaining a candidate non-dominant solution set after non-dominant sorting, crowding degree distance calculation and elite retention strategy screening. And (3) selecting a comprehensive optimal solution of task completion time and energy consumption by judging the pareto dominant relationship of the candidate solutions. these final non-dominant solution sets represent solutions that can achieve the best balance between multiple objectives in task scheduling and path planning, i.e., non-dominant solution sets.
S5, carrying out multidimensional evaluation calculation on the non-dominant solution set to obtain an optimal scheduling execution scheme;
Wherein for each solution in the non-dominant set of solutions, a time-dependent index is extracted. The time index includes the total time of task completion and the waiting time of the AGV. The scheduling efficiency of the whole production task is evaluated by calculating the total time of task completion, and the waiting time of the AGV reflects the idle degree of the vehicle or the irrational task arrangement. And (3) carrying out standardization processing on all the time indexes so as to carry out fair comparison among different solutions and obtain the standardized time indexes. And (5) performing efficiency index calculation on the non-dominant solution set. The efficiency index includes the utilization rate of the AGV equipment and the completion rate of the production task. The device utilization rate of the AGVs is obtained by measuring the ratio of the active time of each AGV in the production process to the total working time, and the use efficiency of the resources of the AGVs in the workshop is reflected. The completion rate of the production tasks is measured by comparing the ratio of the actually completed tasks to the planned tasks. And inputting the two efficiency indexes into a linear programming model, and performing standardized calculation to obtain corresponding standardized efficiency indexes. And carrying out accumulation calculation on the running energy consumption data of the AGV equipment in each non-dominant solution set. And obtaining a standardized energy consumption index of each AGV by calculating the total energy consumption of each AGV and dividing the total energy consumption by the number of tasks completed by the AGV, and reflecting the energy use efficiency of the AGV under the specific task allocation and scheduling. And inputting the standardized time index, the standardized efficiency index and the standardized energy consumption index into an evaluation system of the analytic hierarchy process. The analytic hierarchy process is a comprehensive evaluation method for multi-criterion decision making, and can sort a plurality of alternatives according to the weights of various indexes. In order to build the analytic hierarchy process network, a three-layer evaluation structure is built. The three-layer structure includes a target layer, a criteria layer, and a scheme layer. The target layer is the final scheduling execution scheme evaluation target, the criterion layer is the evaluation index of time, efficiency, energy consumption and the like, and the scheme layer is each solution in the non-dominant solution set. By substituting the normalized index into this structure, comprehensive evaluation is performed. And carrying out consistency calculation on the judgment matrix in the three-layer evaluation structure. The construction of the judgment matrix is a key step in the analytic hierarchy process and is used for expressing the relative importance among all evaluation indexes. through consistency calculation, the weight distribution in the judgment matrix is reasonable, and the consistency among different evaluation indexes is higher. The consistency calculation is completed by calculating a Consistency Ratio (CR), and if the consistency ratio is lower than a set threshold value, the judgment matrix has better logic consistency, and the weight distribution is reasonable. And comprehensively calculating the standardized time index, the standardized efficiency index and the standardized energy consumption index based on the weight matrix obtained through the consistency calculation to obtain the evaluation score of each non-dominant solution set. The score reflects the overall merits of each solution for multi-dimensional objectives such as time, efficiency, and energy consumption. Based on the comprehensive evaluation score sequence, multi-AGV simulation is performed to verify the execution effect of the selected solution in the actual scheduling process. The simulation can simulate the scheduling process of a plurality of AGVs in an actual job shop and evaluate the execution effects of different solutions. Through simulation, the feasibility and the effectiveness of the optimization scheme are verified, and the selected optimal scheduling execution scheme can provide expected performance in an actual environment.
And S6, inputting the optimal scheduling execution scheme into an AGV control system, and carrying out model feedback update on the hybrid scheduling prediction model to obtain the target scheduling prediction model.
Specifically, the optimal scheduling execution scheme is subjected to time sequence decomposition. The task sequence is converted into speed control instructions that the AGV can understand and execute. The corresponding speed instruction is calculated according to the time node of each task and the interval between the tasks by inputting the task sequence into the kinematic equation of the AGV, and a real-time control instruction is provided for the AGV. And performing state monitoring and data filtering on the real-time control sequence of the AGV. And acquiring position information and task completion state data generated in the real-time operation process of the AGV to obtain an operation state matrix of the AGV. To ensure accuracy and reliability of the data, a third order kalman filter is used to filter the data. By setting the noise coefficient to be 0.1, the Kalman filter can effectively reduce the influence of external interference and sensor errors, and calculate the actual position and state change of the AGV. And inputting the AGV running state matrix into a recurrent neural network model for analysis and prediction. The model can capture the time dependence of the AGV in the motion process by using a long-short time memory (LSTM) unit, and predict the future motion trail of the AGV. By collision risk detection of the state prediction sequence, the model can identify potential collision risks. Based on the workshop layout matrix, the minimum safety distance between AGVs is calculated, and a safety threshold value is set to be 2 times of the length of the vehicle body and used for judging whether collision occurs. If the predicted track crosses the motion tracks of other AGVs and the requirements of the safety distance are not met, the system triggers the obstacle avoidance mechanism and adjusts the path or speed to ensure that the safety distance between the AGVs is maintained. In order to improve the running safety of the AGV, the local path of the AGV is re-planned according to the obstacle avoidance constraint condition. In the process, the path cost is calculated by adopting a Belman equation, and the path points are updated through continuous iteration so as to find the optimal path sequence. The Belman equation helps the AGV to calculate the path with the minimum cost according to the current state and the environmental information, so that the AGV can complete the task in the optimal path on the premise of avoiding collision. After the path planning is completed, the running state matrix of the AGV and the optimized path sequence are combined according to the time sequence to form a new real-time execution data set. These data include important information such as the real-time position of the AGV, the status of the task completion, the energy consumption, etc. And obtaining the task completion rate and the energy consumption rate of the AGV through the statistical calculation of the real-time data. And online updating the hybrid scheduling prediction model. The updating process is performed based on real-time data, and every 32 samples are input into the mixed dispatch prediction model as one batch by means of batch processing. Through the operation, the system can perform optimization updating on model parameters according to the latest operation data, so that the scheduling prediction model can be always adapted to the production environment of dynamic changes of workshops. The updated model parameters and the physical constraint loss function are weighted and integrated, so that the model can accurately predict the motion track and the task completion condition of the AGV, and can fully consider physical constraint conditions, such as energy consumption, task time window and the like, in the process of optimizing scheduling, and a target scheduling prediction model is obtained.

establishing an AGV kinematic model based on a workshop layout matrix, an AGV dynamic parameter model and a production task sequence, and substituting an AGV speed vector and a position vector into an Euler equation to obtain an AGV motion constraint condition;

batching the reinforced training data matrix, and extracting time sequence characteristics through a long-short-time memory network unit to obtain an AGV state characteristic vector;
the AGV state feature vector is input into a recurrent neural network comprising 3 hidden layers, and parameter optimization is carried out through an Adam optimizer, so that a first neural network model is obtained;
Carrying out dropout processing on a hidden layer of the first neural network model, and triggering an early-stopping mechanism when the verification loss is not reduced continuously N times to obtain a second neural network model;
Based on a scheduling system basic model, constructing an AGV kinematic equation, time window constraint and an energy consumption function as Lagrangian constraint terms to obtain a physical constraint loss function;
And carrying out weighted combination on the physical constraint loss function and the neural network prediction loss to obtain a mixed optimization objective function, inputting the mixed optimization objective function into a second neural network model, and carrying out iterative computation through a back propagation algorithm to obtain a mixed scheduling prediction model.

In one example, particle swarm optimization solution is performed on a dual-objective optimization model, and a non-dominant solution set is obtained through two-stage iterative computation of an adaptive weight strategy and constraint conversion, including:
Initializing a double-target optimization model in a first stage, and generating an initial solution of the particle swarm in M multiplied by N dimension according to the total number M of tasks and the total number N of AGVs to obtain an initial solution space;
Inputting the initial solution space into an adaptive particle swarm algorithm, and calculating an inertia weight value by a linear decreasing method to obtain an adaptive weight parameter;
updating the position and the speed of the particle swarm based on the self-adaptive weight parameters, and screening a global optimal solution by adopting a tournament selection strategy to obtain a first-stage search solution set;
An epsilon-constraint method is applied to the first-stage search solution set, and an energy consumption target is converted into inequality constraint conditions to obtain a constraint conversion model;
Based on the constraint transformation model, carrying out population evolution through a binary crossover operator and a Gaussian mutation operator to obtain a second-stage initial population;
Performing local search optimization on the initial population in the second stage, and performing fine adjustment on the particle positions by adopting a variable neighborhood search strategy to obtain a local optimal solution set;
Layering the local optimal solution sets according to a non-dominant ordering method, calculating a crowding distance, screening the solution sets by combining an elite retention strategy to obtain candidate non-dominant solution sets, judging the pareto dominant relation of the candidate non-dominant solution sets, and selecting a solution with comprehensively optimal task completion time and energy consumption to obtain the non-dominant solution sets.

The initial solution space is input into a self-adaptive particle swarm algorithm, and the particle swarm algorithm is an optimization method for simulating the foraging behavior of the bird swarm in nature. In this process, the particles adjust their position based on their personal experience and global experience and approach toward an optimal solution. By constantly updating the speed and position of the particles, the particle swarm algorithm can bring the particles closer to the globally optimal solution. In the process, a tournament selection strategy is adopted to screen out a global optimal solution in a particle swarm, and a search solution set in the first stage is obtained. The tournament selection strategy refers to randomly selecting a number of particles in a population of particles, and then selecting the optimal particles among them as representative of the next generation. By means of the strategy, the particle swarm can intensively search the optimal solution area and avoid sinking into local optimal. Application of a first-stage search solution set -Constraint method, converting the energy consumption goal into an inequality constraint. The constraint method is an effective way to deal with the multi-objective optimization problem, taking one objective function as the optimization objective and the other objective functions as the constraint conditions, ensuring that the other constraints are satisfied under the optimization objective. And carrying out population evolution through binary crossover operators and Gaussian mutation operators based on the constraint transformation model. Binary crossover operators generate new solutions by swapping partial solutions of two particles, while gaussian mutation operators fine-tune the solutions of particles by adding gaussian noise. In the second stage, a local search optimization is performed on the initial population. The local search optimization adopts a variable neighborhood search strategy to improve the quality of the solution by finding the optimal solution near the current solution. The variable neighborhood search enables the algorithm to avoid local optima and find globally optimal solutions by adjusting the neighborhood structure step by step. The solution of the particles is fine-tuned within a certain range for each local search. Specific constraints on task scheduling, such as task completion time and energy consumption per AGV, are considered in this process. Through local search optimization, the solution of the particle gradually approaches the optimal solution of the problem. And after the optimization of the local search is completed, non-dominant sorting is performed on the particle swarm. The non-dominant ranking method is a method of layering solution sets, and the merits of the solutions are determined by comparing dominant relations between the solutions. Let solution a dominate over solution B, i.e. if solution a is not inferior to solution B on all targets and is superior to solution B on at least one target, then solution a dominates over solution B. The result of the non-dominant ordering is to divide the solution set into multiple levels, with the top-ranked solutions being closer to the optimal solution. After the non-dominant ranking is completed, the crowdedness distance for each solution is calculated, and the degree of each decryption set in the solution is measured. Solutions with smaller crowding distances tend to be in the edge region of the solution space, representing globally optimal solutions. And screening out the solution with the highest potential through the combination of the crowding degree distance and the elite retention strategy, and obtaining a candidate non-dominant solution set. And judging the pareto dominant relationship of the candidate non-dominant solution set, and selecting a solution with comprehensively optimal task completion time and energy consumption as a final solution. These final solutions represent optimal scheduling schemes that can effectively balance task completion time and energy consumption in a multi-AGV job shop. And obtaining a non-dominant solution set through a particle swarm optimization algorithm process.
In one example, performing multidimensional evaluation calculation on the non-dominant solution set to obtain an optimal scheduling execution scheme includes:
Extracting time indexes of each solution in the non-dominant solution set, wherein the time indexes comprise total task completion time and AGV waiting time, and standardized time indexes are obtained;
performing efficiency index calculation on the non-dominant solution set, substituting the AGV equipment utilization rate and the production task completion rate into a linear programming model to obtain a standardized efficiency index;
performing accumulated calculation on the operation energy consumption data of each AGV in the non-dominant solution set, dividing the total energy consumption by the number of completed tasks to obtain a standardized energy consumption index;
inputting the standardized time index, the standardized efficiency index and the standardized energy consumption index into a hierarchical analysis network, establishing a three-layer evaluation structure, and carrying out consistency calculation on a judgment matrix in the three-layer evaluation structure to obtain an index weight matrix;
based on the index weight matrix, comprehensively calculating a standardized time index, a standardized efficiency index and a standardized energy consumption index to obtain an evaluation score sequence, performing multi-AGV simulation based on the evaluation score sequence, and selecting an optimal scheduling execution scheme.

the acquisition module 1 is used for acquiring job shop layout data, AGV operation parameters and production task data and constructing a scheduling system basic model;
the training module 2 is used for carrying out recurrent neural network training and physical constraint model integration based on AGV historical operation data in the scheduling system basic model to obtain a mixed scheduling prediction model;
the processing module 3 is used for acquiring AGV state feature vectors and task demand features output by the mixed scheduling prediction model, carrying out subtask decomposition and path search processing, and obtaining a double-target optimization model through constraint linearization conversion;
the solving module 4 is used for carrying out particle swarm optimization solving on the double-target optimization model, and obtaining a non-dominant solution set through two-stage iterative computation of the self-adaptive weight strategy and constraint conversion;
The calculation module 5 is used for carrying out multidimensional evaluation calculation on the non-dominant solution set to obtain an optimal scheduling execution scheme;
And the updating module 6 is used for inputting the optimal scheduling execution scheme into the AGV control system, and carrying out model feedback updating on the hybrid scheduling prediction model to obtain the target scheduling prediction model.

Claims
Translated from Chinese
1. A multi-objective optimization scheduling method for a multi-AGV flexible workshop, characterized by comprising the following steps:
Collect the layout data of the job shop, AGV operation parameters and production task data, and build the basic model of the scheduling system;
Based on the AGV historical operation data in the basic model of the scheduling system, recursive neural network training and physical constraint model integration are performed to obtain a hybrid scheduling prediction model; specifically, the following steps are performed: the AGV operation trajectory data, task execution time data and energy consumption data in the basic model of the scheduling system are divided into data sets, and time series segmentation is performed to obtain a training sample set; the training sample set is input into a batch normalization layer for data standardization processing, and the trajectory data is enhanced by random rotation and translation to obtain an enhanced training data matrix; the enhanced training data matrix is divided into batches, and time series features are extracted through long short-term memory network units to obtain AGV state feature vectors; the AGV state feature vectors are input into a batch normalization layer for data standardization processing, and the trajectory data is enhanced by random rotation and translation to obtain an enhanced training data matrix. A recursive neural network with three hidden layers is parameterized by an Adam optimizer to obtain a first neural network model; the hidden layer of the first neural network model is dropout processed, and an early stopping mechanism is triggered when the verification loss has not decreased for N consecutive times to obtain a second neural network model; based on the basic model of the scheduling system, the AGV kinematic equation, time window constraint and energy consumption function are constructed as Lagrangian constraint terms to obtain a physical constraint loss function; a weighted combination of the physical constraint loss function and the neural network prediction loss is performed to obtain a hybrid optimization objective function, and the hybrid optimization objective function is input into the second neural network model, and a hybrid scheduling prediction model is obtained by iterative calculation using a back propagation algorithm;
Obtaining the AGV state feature vector and task requirement feature output by the hybrid scheduling prediction model, performing subtask decomposition and path search processing, and obtaining a dual-objective optimization model through constraint linearization transformation;
The dual-objective optimization model is solved by particle swarm optimization, and a non-dominated solution set is obtained through two-stage iterative calculation of adaptive weight strategy and constraint conversion;
Performing multi-dimensional evaluation calculation on the non-dominated solution set to obtain an optimal scheduling execution plan;
The optimal scheduling execution plan is input into the AGV control system, and the hybrid scheduling prediction model is updated through model feedback to obtain a target scheduling prediction model.
2. The multi-objective optimization scheduling method for a multi-AGV flexible job shop according to claim 1 is characterized in that the job shop layout data, AGV operation parameters and production task data are collected, and a basic model of the scheduling system is constructed, including:
Collect the coordinate data of processing equipment and the location data of AGV charging stations in the workshop, and perform topological structure modeling on the AGV driving channel to obtain the workshop layout topology data;
Coordinate mapping of the AGV motion trajectory is performed according to the workshop layout topology data to obtain a workshop layout matrix;
The driving speed, turning radius, load capacity and battery capacity of the AGV equipment are collected by sensors and fitted by the least square method to obtain the AGV dynamic parameter model. The workpiece processing process data, process transfer time data and task priority data are input into the task scheduler for linear programming modeling to obtain the production task sequence.
An AGV kinematic model is established based on the workshop layout matrix, the AGV dynamic parameter model and the production task sequence, and the AGV velocity vector and position vector are substituted into the Euler equation to obtain the AGV motion constraint conditions;
The AGV motion constraint conditions and task time windows are constrained and modeled to obtain a scheduling constraint model. The speed data and battery capacity data in the AGV dynamic parameter model are subjected to energy consumption integration operations to obtain an energy consumption function. The energy consumption function is integrated with the scheduling constraint model to obtain a scheduling system basic model.
3. The multi-objective optimization scheduling method for a multi-AGV flexible workshop according to claim 1 is characterized in that the AGV state feature vector and task requirement feature output by the hybrid scheduling prediction model are obtained, and subtask decomposition and path search processing are performed, and a dual-objective optimization model is obtained by constraint linearization conversion, including:
The similarity between the AGV state feature vector and the task requirement feature output by the hybrid scheduling prediction model is calculated, and the task similarity matrix is obtained by weighted combination of cosine distance and Euclidean distance. Tasks are clustered according to the similarity threshold to obtain a task decomposition sequence.
Map and match each subtask in the task decomposition sequence with the AGV device, construct an M×N dimensional task allocation matrix through 0-1 integer programming, where M is the total number of tasks and N is the total number of AGVs, and obtain an initial allocation plan;
Encoding the execution task sequence of each AGV in the initial allocation scheme, and obtaining the task optimization sequence through single-point crossover and double-point mutation operations;
Constructing the A* algorithm path planning space according to the workshop layout matrix, setting the distance between nodes to the length of one AGV body, and rasterizing the space by the grid method to obtain a path search network;
A heuristic function is set for the path search network, and a weighted sum of the Manhattan distance and the dynamic obstacle avoidance factor is used as a path evaluation function to obtain a path cost matrix;
Performing a first-order Taylor expansion on the AGV motion constraint condition, converting the AGV kinematic equation, turning constraint and speed constraint into a set of linear inequalities, and obtaining a linearized constraint equation;
The task completion time function is calculated based on the task optimization sequence, the energy consumption function is calculated for the AGV dynamic parameter model, and a standardized objective function is obtained through normalization processing. The standardized objective function, the linearized constraint equation and the path cost matrix are combined to obtain a dual-objective optimization model.
4. The multi-objective optimization scheduling method for a multi-AGV flexible workshop according to claim 3 is characterized in that the dual-objective optimization model is solved by particle swarm optimization, and a non-dominated solution set is obtained through two-stage iterative calculation of adaptive weight strategy and constraint conversion, including:
Initialize the dual-objective optimization model in the first stage, generate an M×N-dimensional particle swarm initial solution according to the total number of tasks M and the total number of AGVs N, and obtain an initial solution space;
The initial solution space is input into the adaptive particle swarm algorithm, and the inertia weight value is calculated by a linear decreasing method to obtain an adaptive weight parameter;
Based on the adaptive weight parameters, the position and speed of the particle swarm are updated, and the global optimal solution is screened using the tournament selection strategy to obtain the first-stage search solution set;
Applying the ε-constraint method to the solution set searched in the first stage, the energy consumption target is converted into inequality constraints, and a constraint conversion model is obtained;
Based on the constraint transformation model, the population is evolved by using a binary crossover operator and a Gaussian mutation operator to obtain an initial population for the second stage;
The initial population of the second stage is optimized by local search, and the particle position is fine-tuned by using the variable neighborhood search strategy to obtain the local optimal solution set;
The local optimal solution set is stratified according to the non-dominated sorting method, the congestion distance is calculated and the solution set is screened in combination with the elite retention strategy to obtain a candidate non-dominated solution set, and the Pareto dominance relationship of the candidate non-dominated solution set is determined, and the optimal solution in terms of task completion time and energy consumption is selected to obtain a non-dominated solution set.
5. The multi-objective optimization scheduling method for a multi-AGV flexible workshop according to claim 4 is characterized in that the multi-dimensional evaluation calculation of the non-dominated solution set to obtain the optimal scheduling execution plan includes:
Extracting time indicators from each solution in the non-dominated solution set, including the total task completion time and the AGV waiting time, to obtain a standardized time indicator;
Calculate the efficiency index of the non-dominated solution set, substitute the AGV equipment utilization rate and the production task completion rate into the linear programming model, and obtain the standardized efficiency index;
The operation energy consumption data of each AGV in the non-dominated solution set is accumulated and calculated, and the total energy consumption is divided by the number of completed tasks to obtain a standardized energy consumption index;
Input the standardized time index, the standardized efficiency index, and the standardized energy consumption index into a hierarchical analysis network to establish a three-layer evaluation structure, and perform consistency calculation on the judgment matrix in the three-layer evaluation structure to obtain an index weight matrix;
Based on the indicator weight matrix, the standardized time indicator, the standardized efficiency indicator, and the standardized energy consumption indicator are comprehensively calculated to obtain an evaluation score sequence, and multi-AGV simulation is performed based on the evaluation score sequence to select the optimal scheduling execution plan.
6. The multi-objective optimization scheduling method for a multi-AGV flexible workshop according to claim 5 is characterized in that the optimal scheduling execution plan is input into the AGV control system, the hybrid scheduling prediction model is updated by model feedback, and the target scheduling prediction model is obtained, including:
Decomposing the optimal scheduling execution plan into a time series, converting the task sequence into a speed control instruction through the AGV kinematic equation, and obtaining the AGV real-time control sequence;
The position coordinate data and task completion status data in the AGV real-time control sequence are sampled, and the data is filtered by a third-order Kalman filter with a noise coefficient of 0.1 to obtain an AGV operation state matrix;
The AGV operation state matrix is input into the recursive neural network model, the motion trajectory of the AGV is calculated through the long short-term memory unit, and a state prediction sequence is obtained. The state prediction sequence is subjected to collision risk detection, and the minimum safe distance between AGVs is calculated based on the workshop layout matrix. The safety threshold is set to 2 times the vehicle body length to obtain the obstacle avoidance constraint condition.
Replanning the AGV local path according to the obstacle avoidance constraint condition, calculating the optimal path cost by Bellman equation, and iteratively updating the path points to obtain an optimized path sequence;
The AGV operation state matrix and the optimized path sequence are combined in time sequence, and the task completion rate and energy consumption rate are statistically calculated to obtain a real-time execution data set;
The hybrid scheduling prediction model is updated online, and the real-time execution data set is input into the hybrid scheduling prediction model in batches of 32 samples to update the parameters to obtain updated model parameters, and the updated model parameters are weightedly integrated with the physical constraint loss function to obtain the target scheduling prediction model.
7. A multi-objective optimization scheduling system for a multi-AGV flexible operation workshop, characterized in that the steps for implementing the multi-objective optimization scheduling method for a multi-AGV flexible operation workshop according to any one of claims 1 to 6, the multi-objective optimization scheduling system for a multi-AGV flexible operation workshop comprising:
The acquisition module is used to collect the layout data of the job shop, AGV operation parameters and production task data, and build the basic model of the scheduling system;
A training module, used to perform recursive neural network training and physical constraint model integration based on the AGV historical operation data in the basic model of the scheduling system to obtain a hybrid scheduling prediction model;
A processing module, used to obtain the AGV state feature vector and task requirement features output by the hybrid scheduling prediction model, and perform subtask decomposition and path search processing, and obtain a dual-objective optimization model through constraint linearization conversion;
A solution module, used for performing particle swarm optimization on the dual-objective optimization model, and obtaining a non-dominated solution set through two-stage iterative calculation of an adaptive weight strategy and constraint conversion;
A calculation module, used for performing multi-dimensional evaluation calculation on the non-dominated solution set to obtain an optimal scheduling execution plan;
The updating module is used to input the optimal scheduling execution plan into the AGV control system, perform model feedback update on the hybrid scheduling prediction model, and obtain a target scheduling prediction model.
8. A computer device, comprising a memory and a processor, wherein the memory stores a computer program, and wherein the processor implements the steps of the multi-objective optimization scheduling method for a multi-AGV flexible workshop as described in any one of claims 1 to 6 when executing the computer program.
