The database reinforcement includes: checking the current configuration of the database, strengthening the account, authorization, password, log, strategy, patch, assigning different accounts to different administrators, deleting or locking invalid accounts, restricting super administrator remote login, minimizing permissions, limiting the length and complexity of the default password, limiting the default password generation cycle, limiting the password reuse, enabling the logging function, recording user operations on the device, recording system security events, and database audit strategies; The establishment and improvement of the information security management system includes: according to standard specifications Requirements: Establish and implement a security management system that meets the requirements of the corresponding level. The establishment and improvement of the information security management system also includes: implementing information security responsibilities, establishing an information security work leading group, an information security management department or an information security responsibility department, clarifying information security work, determining security positions, implementing personnel, and clarifying the information security responsibilities of the leading organization, responsible department, and personnel; implementing the personnel security management system, formulating a management system for personnel recruitment, leaving the post, assessment, and education and training, implementing specific measures of the management system, and conducting security reviews, training, assessment, and security and confidentiality education for security personnel; implementing the system construction management system, establishing information system classification filing, program design, product procurement and use, password use, software development, project implementation, acceptance and delivery, grade assessment, and security service management systems, and clarifying work content, work methods, work processes, and work requirements; implementing the system operation and maintenance management system, establishing computer room environment safety, storage media safety, equipment and facility safety, security monitoring, network security, system security, malicious code prevention, password protection, backup and recovery, and incident handling management systems, formulating emergency plans, and conducting regular drills.
A unit-based network security protection system, comprising:
Vulnerability scanning module: determine the plan, configure the strategy, back up the system, implement the scan, analyze the results, scan again, fix the vulnerability, conduct a second review, and scan again. According to the security vulnerability knowledge base, detect the security risks and vulnerabilities of any one or more information assets in the network protocol, network service, and network equipment, analyze and identify the vulnerabilities that may be used by intruders to illegally enter the network or illegally obtain information assets, and remind that when receiving the host scanning instruction or performing the host scanning, the host data is backed up first. If the server is a dual-machine hot standby system, one of them is scanned in one scanning session. The scanning object strategy is adjusted for hosts or network devices with special requirements. A single host scanning method for a certain system is adopted, and one IP is scanned each time. The next IP is scanned after the scan is completed. The scanning time of the equipment scanning the production network segment is adjusted to a time period that does not affect the business.
Baseline inspection module: collects login information of network devices, security devices, operating systems, databases, and middleware in the target information system, logs in to the target device to check the device configuration, records the configuration information, conducts configuration security analysis, logs in to the network devices, security devices, operating systems, databases, and middleware one by one based on the collected login information, tests the accuracy of the login information collection and the permissions of the provided accounts, analyzes whether all security configuration inspection contents can be covered, and forms a baseline inspection report;
Check the network and security equipment modules: check equipment management, account management, authentication and authorization, login methods, log auditing, service port optimization, security protection, and rationality of security policies, including checking the operating system unit, database unit, Web server, and middleware unit;
Full-flow threat analysis module: Utilizes threat data intelligence and the collected full-network traffic to analyze internal compromised hosts, external attacks, internal violations, and internal risks, analyzes, determines, and traces incidents, and analyzes asset information and related statistical data within the current network;
Intranet asset discovery module: sort out the host assets and WEB servers of the intranet information system, and dynamically manage the intranet asset ledger throughout its life cycle, including: host asset service discovery unit, Web service discovery unit, and asset visualization display unit;
Emergency response module: monitors security issues in business systems, traces attacks at the Internet level through big data analysis, analyzes the causes of security incidents, traces the sources of incidents, classifies security incidents, defends against attacks through big data analysis and security threat intelligence, discovers unknown and dangerous network behaviors, and locates the source of attacks;
Emergency drill module: analysis and judgment. If it is judged to be a suspected computer virus outbreak, determine whether it is a system problem. If it is a system problem, start the system emergency plan. If it is not a system problem, determine whether it is a virus outbreak. If it is a virus outbreak, execute the notification process. If it is not a virus outbreak, determine whether it has network transmission. If it is judged to have network transmission, determine whether it is necessary to isolate the infected host. If it is judged to be isolated, disconnect the host network connection and start the system emergency plan. Determine whether it is necessary to execute anti-virus measures. If it is judged that it is not necessary to isolate, directly determine whether it is necessary to execute anti-virus measures. If it is judged that it is necessary to execute anti-virus measures, determine whether it will cause damage to system data. If it is judged that it will cause damage to the system, perform anti-virus measures after backing up the system. If it is judged that it will not cause damage to the system, directly execute anti-virus measures. After execution, determine whether the virus has been cleared. If it is judged that no anti-virus measures are needed, directly determine whether the virus has been cleared. If it is judged that the virus has been cleared, restore the network connection of the isolated host and execute the notification process. If the virus still exists after the anti-virus measures are executed, continue to execute new virus detection and killing measures until the virus is cleared.
The penetration test module includes: Web penetration test unit and advanced penetration test unit; the Web penetration test unit simulates real security attacks to find potential ways for hackers to invade information systems, including information collection, remote overflow, password guessing, local overflow, enterprise user-side attacks, man-in-the-middle attacks, Web scripts and application testing; the advanced penetration test unit includes: combining information security best practices, simulating targeted attacks, using Internet-side assets or internal untrusted/semi-trusted areas as penetration entrances, simulating hacker intranet attacks to obtain the highest authority or sensitive data in the intranet for further penetration testing, including evaluating the status of external assets, finding intranet access points and using available intranet access points in Internet assets, and deploying jump servers to penetrate the internal network;
The security operation and maintenance module includes: daily security operation and maintenance unit, important moment security assurance unit, and periodic security inspection unit; the daily security operation and maintenance unit includes: security policy optimization, security product operation and maintenance, and security assessment; the security policy optimization: whether the security control strategy is effective and reasonable is checked and improved, including: research, plan formulation, policy optimization, and output report; the security product operation and maintenance includes: equipment operation safety monitoring, equipment operation safety audit, equipment and policy backup and update; the security assessment includes: timely discovery of security vulnerabilities in the information system through security scanning assessment, vulnerability rectification of Windows, Linux servers and security equipment, security scanning of information assets during non-business peak hours based on application and combined with security vulnerability knowledge base, and no scanning method containing denial of service type is used. If the scanning system does not respond during the scanning process, the scanning is stopped immediately, and after analyzing the situation to determine the cause, the system is restored and the scanning strategy is adjusted before scanning; the important moment security assurance unit includes: proactive detection of users' assets exposed on the external network before major holidays to form an asset inventory Single, conduct precise vulnerability scanning according to the asset discovery results, conduct comprehensive investigation for specific vulnerabilities, notify major security incidents including one or more of high-risk system vulnerabilities, high-risk worm viruses, malicious intrusions and attacks, provide one or more information of event type, impact scope, solution, and prevention plan, conduct comprehensive security inspection and security reinforcement for important systems, and retest the security reinforcement results to confirm that security issues are repaired in a timely and effective manner; during holidays, conduct real-time alarm monitoring and log analysis for firewalls, Web application firewalls, IDS/IPS, load balancing, web page anti-tampering systems, and network security audit systems, monitor antivirus software and detection and killing records, monitor and log analysis of the status of application systems and database systems and business platforms, and conduct timely investigation and analysis if attacked or one or more accidents in intrusion are found, trace and analyze the source and cause of the accident, propose solutions based on the investigation cause and accident situation, and record accidents, accident analysis, solutions, and tracing plans; the periodic security inspection unit includes: periodic security product inspections and periodic security policy optimization suggestions;
The risk assessment module includes: network security assessment unit, host security assessment unit, application security assessment unit, terminal security assessment unit, data security assessment unit, physical security assessment unit, middleware security assessment unit, and management security assessment unit; the network security assessment unit includes: analyzing the organization's network topology architecture, security domain planning, VLAN division, network device configuration, security device configuration, and security protection measures, conducting security assessments on the physical network structure, logical network structure, and network devices, discovering security and network load problems in the network structure, security and anti-attack problems in the network devices, evaluating the security status of the network, and discovering existing security, rationality, and usage efficiency problems; the host security assessment unit includes: conducting security assessments on the operating system, account, authentication, authorization, network service, and system log. The application security assessment unit includes: conducting security assessment on the application system according to the account, authentication, authorization, audit, performance resources, backup and recovery, and penetration test of the application system, detecting and analyzing input verification, identity authentication, authorization, configuration management, sensitive data, session management, encryption technology, exception management, audit and log records, and habitual problems, and finding security vulnerabilities and potential safety hazards in the application system; the terminal security assessment unit includes: checking patches, account passwords, network services, virus protection, and local security policies, The terminal's security status is evaluated based on patch upgrades, virus protection, account passwords, network services, and local security policies to find security vulnerabilities and potential safety hazards in the terminal; the data security evaluation unit includes: detecting and analyzing database username and password management, database access control, login authentication methods, data security, security vulnerability checks, patch management, and database security audits; the data security status is evaluated based on the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the data to find possible security vulnerabilities and potential safety hazards at the data level; the physical security evaluation unit includes: detecting and analyzing physical security boundaries, physical entrance control, detecting and analyzing the security protection of offices, rooms, and facilities, detecting and analyzing the security protection of external and environmental threats, secure area work control, delivery and handover areas, equipment placement and protection, supporting equipment, and cabling. Security, equipment maintenance, movement of assets, off-site equipment and asset security, safe disposal or reuse of equipment, unattended user equipment, clear desktop and screen strategies, assess the security of the network computer room based on the physical environment of the computer room, access control, power supply, cable layout, equipment placement, label specifications, and computer room systems; the middleware security assessment unit includes: detecting and analyzing middleware username and password management, middleware security auditing, login authentication methods, communication confidentiality, resource control, and middleware intrusion prevention strategies, assessing whether the installation and deployment of the middleware and the implementation of configuration parameters meet the application operation safety requirements; the management security assessment unit includes: assessing the current status of information security management based on security organization, security system, security personnel, security operation and maintenance, security emergency, and security training, and finding possible security risks and missing points.
The information system level protection assessment module includes: level protection gap assessment unit, security assurance system design unit, level protection assessment unit, information system software rectification unit. The level protection gap assessment unit includes the following processes: information collection and analysis, preparation of tools and forms, determination of assessment objects, determination of assessment indicators, determination of assessment tool access points, determination of assessment content, development of assessment guidelines, preparation of assessment plans, preparation of assessment implementation, on-site assessment and result recording, result confirmation and data return, determination of single assessment results, summary and analysis of single assessment results, overall assessment, formation of security assessment conclusions, and preparation of assessment reports; the security assurance system design unit includes: through information system level protection gap assessment Analyze the weaknesses and risks of the current network and information system, carry out security rectification, complete the topology design of the corresponding products, implement security technical measures, and improve the security management system; combine the information system level protection gap assessment results, follow the information security level protection requirements, and formulate an information security system framework based on actual conditions. The information security system framework includes: security strategy, security technology system, operation guarantee system, security organization and management system. The security strategy interacts with the three systems of security technology system, operation guarantee system, and security organization and management system. The three systems of security technology system, operation guarantee system, and security organization and management system are constructed under the guidance of the security strategy, and the security strategy formulated in the security strategy is The various elements of the information system are transformed into technical implementation methods and management and operation guarantee means to achieve the goals set in the security strategy; the level protection evaluation unit includes: testing and evaluation of the information system security level protection status, including security control evaluation and evaluation analysis of the implementation and configuration of the basic security controls required by the information security level protection in the information system; the overall information system evaluation of the overall security of the information system; the description of the security control evaluation is organized in the form of work units, and the work units include security technology evaluation and security management evaluation. The security technology evaluation includes: physical security evaluation, network security evaluation, host system security evaluation, application security evaluation, data security evaluation on multiple levels Security control assessment, the security management assessment includes security management organization assessment, security management system assessment, personnel security system assessment, system construction management assessment, system operation and maintenance management assessment and other aspects of security control assessment; the information system software rectification unit includes: analyzing the weaknesses and risks of the current network and information system through the gap assessment report of the level protection gap assessment, including the weaknesses and risks of the operating system, database, and network security equipment, checking and reinforcing the operating system, database, and network security equipment one by one according to the security configuration reinforcement specifications of the equipment, and formulating relevant risk avoidance measures, including operating system reinforcement, network/security equipment reinforcement, database reinforcement, and establishment and improvement of information security management system;
The Internet threat detection and active response module includes: providing risk assessment, real-time monitoring, tampering disposal, and emergency confrontation for Internet services to regain safer protection; the risk assessment includes: assessing exposure, vulnerability, and content security as a baseline, regular and continuous review, regular monitoring of asset changes, and continuous analysis of the risks introduced by new assets; the real-time monitoring includes: real-time monitoring of page tampering, 0day, web trojans, black links, DNS, and availability security incidents and generating reports to notify users in a timely manner; the tampering disposal includes: quickly replacing tampered sites through DNS technology; the emergency confrontation includes: cloud-based emergency confrontation to protect sensitive data.
The above-mentioned unit-based network security protection method and system use cloud computing technology to integrate assessment, protection, monitoring, and response modules to create an adaptive security protection platform driven by multi-engine intelligence, focusing on the business life cycle and deeply understanding the hacker attack process, helping users to fully manage business security issues and deliver fully visible security services. By actively assessing risks and taking precautions, the distributed scanning system will conduct a comprehensive assessment of the business when the business goes online, and monitor business changes every day, analyze new risk issues introduced, and achieve rapid perception of risk changes. Restore attack behavior, link protection, and complete WEB system security protection based on the hacker attack process. Through the threat intelligence sharing mechanism, the attack source is blocked globally to effectively avoid the emergence of a second victim. Online business risk analysis and attack trend analysis, continuous anti-attack optimization and protection strategy, online real-time response and timely disposal of security incidents, comprehensively help users manage business security issues and protect business. Using intelligent technologies such as machine learning and security big data, continuously mining threat intelligence and hidden attacks, running the three engines of assessment, protection, and monitoring in an integrated and linked manner, combined with a distributed architecture, it can quickly respond to various attack threats and continuously improve protection functions.
During the vulnerability scanning process, data backup should be done before host scanning. For systems with hot standby, only one of them should be selected for scanning in one scanning session. For important hosts or network devices with special requirements, the scanning object strategy should be adjusted. Instead of scanning the network segment of the production system, a single host scanning method for a certain system should be used. Only one IP should be scanned each time. After the scan is completed, the next IP should be scanned to minimize the risk rate. The time for scanning the production network segment should be adjusted to a time period that does not affect the business. Maximize the vulnerability scanning strategy to effectively check the latest security vulnerabilities on the target system. Minimize the impact of vulnerability scanning, remove the DDOS option in the scanning strategy, and select the port scanning strategy in a targeted manner based on the information analysis provided by the customer to ensure the normal operation of the target system. For hosts with hot standby in the scanning target, the two hosts should be scanned for vulnerabilities in different sessions. The scanning order is to scan the backup machine first and then the host machine to ensure business continuity.
Vulnerability scanning, especially when checking vulnerabilities in a wide range of IPs, can provide a wide range of security vulnerability searches for the targets being evaluated, and the evaluation environment is completely consistent with the online operating environment of the evaluated object, which can more realistically reflect the network security issues and network security threats faced by the host system and network equipment. Through security scanning and evaluation, the core servers and important network equipment in the network, including servers, switches, firewalls, etc., are scanned to detect and analyze security vulnerabilities in network equipment, and the identified vulnerabilities that may be used by intruders to illegally enter the network or illegally obtain information assets are alerted to security administrators, so that security policies can be improved in a timely manner to reduce security risks.
Through security baseline inspections, we discovered security holes and weak links in various servers, network equipment, security equipment and other IT equipment, and identified, analyzed, patched and inspected the discovered vulnerabilities to eliminate and reduce high and medium risk hazards of IT equipment, prevent security incidents, avoid illegal exploitation of information system vulnerabilities, enhance information system security prevention capabilities, and ensure business sustainability.
Full-flow threat detection and analysis mainly uses threat data intelligence, the collected full-network traffic and the analysis model to provide periodic detection, discovery and response services for key information security issues such as internal compromised hosts, external attacks, internal violations and internal risks. It improves the ability to proactively respond to security threats and builds the last "firewall" in information security. Full-flow threat detection and analysis can also help understand internal business process access, and provide the necessary foundation for the subsequent use of big data analysis technology to carry out security analysis, security data baselines, deep mining of security data and security data audits.
Emergency response to security incidents refers to the measures and actions taken quickly after a security threat incident occurs to restore the confidentiality, integrity and availability of the system as quickly as possible, and to prevent and reduce the severity of the impact of security threat incidents. It also relies on big data analysis technology to provide Internet-level attack tracing services to ensure the smooth operation of the system and maintain the security of the business system. The security incident level classification and response methods are pre-planned to ensure that the response service is in place quickly and accurately. Timely monitor and discover security issues in the business system in order to respond to security incidents in a timely manner, and accurately locate the problem in the security incident response, troubleshoot in a timely manner, and restore business. Make full use of security big data resources and security threat intelligence information to improve the perception and defense capabilities of unknown threats, effectively defend against new attacks such as APT, and realize the early rapid discovery of unknown threat network behaviors and accurately locate the source of attacks.
Penetration testing uses various means to simulate real security attacks, thereby discovering potential ways for hackers to invade information systems. Advanced penetration testing combines international and domestic information security to establish best security practices, simulates targeted attacks by advanced hackers, uses Internet-side assets or internal untrusted/semi-trusted areas as penetration entrances, and simulates hackers' intranet attacks to obtain the highest management authority or sensitive data of the internal network. Further penetration testing is conducted to comprehensively evaluate the effectiveness of the company's current overall security status and security analysis capabilities, and proposes corresponding rectification and reinforcement suggestions based on the test results, assisting users in completing rectification and reinforcement implementation, and improving the security level of users' Internet-side business systems and internal overall networks.
System online security assessment is an important part of the application system life cycle. Based on a full investigation of the application system construction plan and current status, a security testing plan is formulated before the system goes online. According to the construction of the information system platform, the testing work is carried out in accordance with the system pre-online security testing plan, and a thorough and comprehensive security vulnerability assessment is carried out to discover potential security loopholes. Through the pre-online testing work, all assets covered by the application system are re-confirmed and identified, and the compliance analysis of the implementation of the application system level protection construction measures is completed. A comprehensive risk assessment is conducted on the various security measures and management systems implemented by the application system level protection, and residual risks are clarified; based on the risk assessment results, pre-online testing results, and compliance analysis results, gap analysis is conducted, and security improvement suggestions are put forward to ensure the safety of the new system before it goes online.
Security policy optimization analyzes and adjusts on-site security equipment, network environment, operation and maintenance permissions and existing policies to ensure efficient use of security policies. Security product operation and maintenance services monitor security product status, monitor security event alarms, upgrade security products to update versions and rule bases, and perform policy backup to ensure safe and efficient operation of equipment. Security assessment services conduct regular assessments of basic equipment through analysis to identify existing problems and vulnerabilities and propose solutions for optimization and improvement.
In order to ensure the safety of customers during major holidays, we have designed a security guarantee that covers monitoring and early warning, security testing, and event discovery in three important links: before, during, and after the event, and runs through the entire process of early warning, protection, monitoring, and response. We ensure the continuous security of customer information systems, reduce risks before impacts occur, and promptly discover and solve problems after an event occurs.
Risk is the possibility of something that has destructive power. Risk management is the process of identifying and assessing risks, reducing them to an acceptable level, and implementing the correct mechanism to maintain this level of risk. Risk analysis is a method of identifying risks and the losses they may cause, thereby adjusting security measures. With the continuous development of any enterprise's network and information systems, the role of network and information systems is increasing. The weaknesses, threats and potential risks they face will have a great impact on the entire business. Therefore, enterprises can use the scientific method of "risk management" to manage the security of network and information systems, take security measures to prevent problems before they occur, and improve the security level and capabilities of customers.
Based on the needs of network security operation and business security protection, we establish scientific network operation protection, deeply explore security issues in related network business, comprehensively guarantee network security operation and incident response speed through security monitoring and security operation and maintenance, and find out the shortcomings of the current technical level of the network through security services, promote the security technology protection system, and truly maximize the effectiveness of security technology protection measures, ultimately ensuring network compliance and safe operation and achieving data security.
Internet threat detection and active response provide continuous risk assessment + real-time monitoring + tampering disposal + emergency response services, allowing users to regain greater security.

DETAILED DESCRIPTION
A unit-based network security protection method according to an embodiment of the present invention includes:
Vulnerability scanning; determine the plan, configure the strategy, back up the system, implement the scan, analyze the results, scan again, fix the vulnerability, conduct a second review, and scan again. According to the security vulnerability knowledge base, detect the security risks and vulnerabilities of any one or more information assets in the network protocol, network service, and network equipment. Analyze and identify the vulnerabilities that may be used by intruders to illegally enter the network or illegally obtain information assets, and remind that when receiving the host scanning instruction or performing the host scanning, first back up the host data. If the server is a dual-machine hot standby system, scan one of them in one scanning session. Adjust the scanning object strategy for hosts or network devices with special requirements, adopt a single host scanning method for a certain system, scan one IP each time, and scan the next IP after the scan is completed. Adjust the scanning time of the equipment scanning the production network segment to a time period that does not affect the business;
Baseline inspection: collect login information of network devices, security devices, operating systems, databases, and middleware in the target information system, log in to the target device to check the device configuration, record the configuration information, conduct configuration security analysis, log in to the network devices, security devices, operating systems, databases, and middleware one by one based on the collected login information, test the accuracy of the login information collection and the permissions of the provided account, analyze whether all security configuration inspection contents can be covered, and form a baseline inspection report;
Check the network and security equipment: Check equipment management (such as console, ssh (Secure Shell), management IP, AAA (Authentication, Authorization, Accounting), account management, authentication and authorization, login method, log audit, service port optimization, security protection (such as SNMP (Simple Network Management Protocol), protocol encryption, address spoofing, etc.), and the rationality of security policies, including checking the operating system, database, Web (World Wide Web) server, and middleware;
Full-flow threat analysis: Utilize threat data intelligence and the collected full-network traffic to analyze internal compromised hosts, external attacks, internal violations, and internal risks, analyze, assess, and trace incidents, and analyze asset information and related statistical data within the current network;
Intranet asset discovery: sort out the host assets and WEB servers of the intranet information system, and dynamically manage the intranet asset ledger throughout its life cycle, including host asset service discovery, Web service discovery, and asset visualization;
Emergency response: Monitor security issues in business systems, trace the source of attacks at the Internet level through big data analysis, analyze the causes of security incidents, trace the source of incidents, classify security incidents, defend against attacks through big data analysis and security threat intelligence, discover unknown and dangerous network behaviors, and locate the source of attacks;
Emergency drill: Analyze and judge. If it is a suspected computer virus outbreak, determine whether it is a system problem. If it is a system problem, start the system emergency plan. If it is not a system problem, determine whether it is a virus outbreak. If it is a virus outbreak, execute the notification process. If it is not a virus outbreak, determine whether it has network transmission. If it is determined to have network transmission, determine whether it is necessary to isolate the infected host. If it is determined to be isolated, disconnect the host network connection and start the system emergency plan. Determine whether it is necessary to execute anti-virus measures. If it is determined that it does not need to be isolated, directly determine whether it is necessary to execute anti-virus measures. If it is determined that it is necessary to execute anti-virus measures, determine whether it will cause damage to system data. If it is determined that it will cause damage to the system, perform anti-virus measures after backing up the system. If it is determined that it will not cause damage to the system, directly execute anti-virus measures. After execution, determine whether the virus has been cleared. If it is determined that no anti-virus measures are needed, directly determine whether the virus has been cleared. If it is determined that the virus has been cleared, restore the network connection of the isolated host and execute the notification process. If the virus still exists after the anti-virus measures are executed, continue to execute new virus detection and killing measures until the virus is cleared.

Information system level protection assessment includes: level protection gap assessment, security system design, level protection assessment, and information system soft rectification;
The level protection gap assessment includes the following processes: information collection and analysis, preparation of tools and forms, determination of assessment objects, determination of assessment indicators, determination of assessment tool access points, determination of assessment content, development of assessment guidelines, preparation of assessment plans, preparation of assessment implementation, on-site assessment and result recording, result confirmation and data return, determination of single assessment results, summary and analysis of single assessment results, overall assessment, formation of security assessment conclusions, and preparation of assessment reports;
The design of the security assurance system includes: analyzing the weaknesses and risks of the current network and information system through information system level protection gap assessment, making security rectifications, completing the topology design of corresponding products, implementing security technical measures, and improving the security management system; formulating the information security system framework based on the actual situation in accordance with the information security level protection requirements and the information system level protection gap assessment results;
As shown in FIG1 , the information security system framework of this embodiment includes: security strategy, security technology system, operation guarantee system, security organization and management system;
The three systems of security strategy and security technology system, operation guarantee system, and security organization and management system interact with each other.
The three major systems of security technology system, operation guarantee system, and security organization and management system are constructed under the guidance of security strategy, transforming various elements formulated in the security strategy into technical implementation methods and management and operation guarantee means to achieve the goals formulated in the security strategy;
As shown in FIG2 , the level protection assessment of this embodiment includes: testing and evaluating the level protection status of the information system, including the security control assessment of the implementation and configuration of the basic security controls required by the information security level protection in the information system and the overall assessment of the information system that evaluates and analyzes the overall security of the information system. The description of the security control assessment is organized in the form of work units. The work units include security technology assessment and security management assessment. The security technology assessment includes: physical security assessment, network security assessment, host system security assessment, application security assessment, data security assessment and multi-level security control assessment; the security management assessment includes: security management organization assessment, security management system assessment, personnel safety system assessment, system construction management assessment, system operation and maintenance management assessment and multi-level security control assessment;
Information system soft rectification includes: analyzing the weaknesses and risks of the current network and information system through the gap assessment report of the level protection gap assessment, including the weaknesses and risks of the operating system, database, and network security equipment; checking and reinforcing the operating system, database, and network security equipment one by one according to the security configuration reinforcement specifications of the equipment; formulating relevant risk avoidance measures, including operating system reinforcement, network/security equipment reinforcement, database reinforcement, and establishment and improvement of information security management system;
Internet threat detection and active response include: providing risk assessment, real-time monitoring, tampering disposal, and emergency confrontation for Internet services to regain greater security;
Risk assessment includes: assessing exposure, vulnerability, and content security as a baseline, conducting regular and continuous reviews, regularly monitoring asset changes, and continuously analyzing the risks introduced by new assets;
Real-time monitoring includes: real-time monitoring of page tampering, 0day (vulnerability information that is known or disclosed before the system vendor knows and releases relevant patches), web trojans, black links, DNS (Domain Name System), and availability security events, and generating reports to notify users in a timely manner;
Tampering disposal includes: quickly replacing the tampered site through DNS technology;
Emergency response includes: cloud-based emergency response to protect sensitive data.
The vulnerability scanning assessment of this embodiment mainly detects the security risks and vulnerabilities of various information assets such as network protocols, network services, and network devices based on the security vulnerability knowledge base. The scanning method can use a tool to perform network scanning. Use the security scanning assessment tool to scan the core servers and important network devices in the network, including servers, switches, firewalls, etc., to detect and analyze security vulnerabilities of network devices, and alert security administrators to the identified vulnerabilities that may be used by intruders to illegally enter the network or illegally obtain information assets, so as to improve security policies in a timely manner and reduce security risks.
The strategy selection before vulnerability scanning implementation in this embodiment follows the following principles: First, the vulnerability scanning strategy is maximized to effectively check the latest security vulnerabilities on the target system. The impact of vulnerability scanning is minimized, and the DDOS (Distributed denial of service attack) option is removed from the scanning strategy. Based on the information analysis provided by the customer, the port scanning strategy is selected in a targeted manner to ensure the normal operation of the target system. For any hosts with hot standby dual machines among the scan targets, the two hosts should be scanned for vulnerabilities in different sessions. The scanning order is to scan the standby machine first and then the host machine to ensure business continuity.
Furthermore, the login information of this embodiment includes: login method, login account/password, and management host information.
Furthermore, the baseline check of this embodiment also includes: based on the best practices of the baseline check at each level of network equipment, security equipment, operating system, database, and middleware, a configuration check is performed on the target information system, the configuration status of the current equipment is recorded, the current security configuration status is analyzed, and the gaps in security configuration are identified and recorded with reference to the security baseline. Based on the overall gap analysis of the baseline check and combined with the current situation of the information system, a baseline check report is formed.
Furthermore, the operating system inspection of this embodiment includes: basic information inspection, patch management, user account, password security, permission management, log and audit, system service port inspection, security protection, and network protocol security.
Furthermore, the database check of this embodiment includes: checking account security, checking database connection security, checking database security component configuration, checking log configuration, and checking communication protocol.
Furthermore, the present embodiment checks the Web server and middleware: management application restriction check, directory listing check, prohibition of access to files outside the Web directory, message body size of http requests, default port check, error level redirection, prohibition of list display files, prevention of denial of service attacks, default installation of useless files, hiding of version numbers and sensitive information, account management, authentication and authorization, log configuration, communication protocols, equipment and security requirements.
The unit unit in this embodiment can be a company, an institution, a school, a public welfare organization, or an organization associated with a school such as a school-enterprise, a joint school-running unit, a group company, an affiliated company such as a system-shared affiliated company, an upstream and downstream affiliated company, etc., which are used as a unit for network security protection.
Furthermore, the asset information and related statistical data in the current network of this embodiment include: asset statistical information, attack surface statistical information, new asset information, asset change information, new attack surface information, attack surface change information, and a detailed list of new assets.
Furthermore, the asset statistical information of this embodiment includes: statistically analyzing the server type ratio according to the server type of the asset.
Furthermore, the attack surface statistics information of this embodiment includes: statistics information of various open ports.
Furthermore, the detailed list of newly added assets in this embodiment includes: one or more of the IP address, server type, server version, status, and detected time of the asset.
Furthermore, the detection of external attacks in this embodiment includes: reverse sequence attack detection, Web attack situation analysis, and password brute force attack detection.
Furthermore, the anti-sequence attack detection of this embodiment includes: analyzing and discovering the number of anti-sequence attack behaviors of internal services and the situation of each anti-sequence attack behavior.
Furthermore, the reverse sequence attack situation of this embodiment includes: attack time, source IP, and destination IP/port.
Furthermore, the Web attack situation analysis of this embodiment analyzes the situation of the internal server being attacked through traffic analysis, and analyzes the situation distribution of the overall Web attack types, detailed information of each attack method and the results of the attack.
Furthermore, the attack results of this embodiment include: attack warning, attack capture, and prompt.
Furthermore, the attack methods of this embodiment include: Webshell (a code execution environment in the form of web page files such as asp, php, jsp or cgi, used for website and server management), black market knife scanning, Web vulnerability scanning, Struts2 (Web application framework based on MVC design pattern) attack, upload attack, sql (Structured Query Language) injection attack, information leakage, and one or more of the newly added files of the application system.
Furthermore, the password blasting attack detection of this embodiment detects the number of password blasting attacks suffered by different servers every day, the type of service, the email exposure attack situation, the remote management service blasting attack situation and the database service blasting attack situation.
Furthermore, the attack situation of this embodiment includes: attack source IP, destination IP, protocol, number of attacks within 60 seconds, and blasting results.
Furthermore, the detection of internal violations in this embodiment includes: exposure surface detection, illegal external connection detection, malicious DNS (Domain Name System) analysis, ACL (Access Control Lists) combing, weak password detection, abnormal login detection, and unconventional service analysis.
Furthermore, the exposure surface detection of this embodiment analyzes the illegal attack surface information in the current network through big data analysis.
Furthermore, the illegal attack surface information of this embodiment includes: attack surface statistics information, newly added attack surface information, attack surface change information, and attack surface information.
Further, the attack surface statistics of this embodiment include: statistics of various open ports. Further, the attack surface information of this embodiment include: server IP, port, service type. Further, the illegal external connection detection and analysis environment of this embodiment includes: the physical address of the destination IP of the illegal external connection, the historical trend of the illegal external connection event, the detailed time of the illegal external connection event, the source IP, the destination IP, any one or more of the ports. Further, the malicious DNS analysis of this embodiment monitors and analyzes the DNS requested by the internal network through traffic analysis, and analyzes the reputation of the internal DNS in combination with threat intelligence to find the requests and detailed information of the malicious DNS existing inside. Further, the detailed information of the malicious DNS of this embodiment includes: any one or more of the request time, source IP, the requested malicious domain name, and the physical address where the domain name is located. Further, the ACL of this embodiment combs and analyzes the access relationship of all existing IPs in the current network, including the access relationship of different ports from the source IP to the destination IP, analyzes the ACL control within the network, and handles the unreasonable ACL inside.
Furthermore, the weak password detection and analysis of this embodiment discovers the status of weak passwords of internal servers, reports the total number of weak passwords, the number of passive statistical discoveries, the number of dictionary matching discoveries and the number of active discoveries, and detects and analyzes information on weak passwords for mail services, remote management services, and database services.
Furthermore, the information of weak passwords of the mail service, remote management service, and database service of this embodiment includes: affected accounts, weak passwords, affected servers, protocols, and detection time.
Furthermore, the abnormal login detection of this embodiment includes: detecting abnormal behavior of the internal server, including: abnormal details of external login to the internal server, abnormal login details, and non-working hours login details.
Furthermore, the details of the abnormality of external login to the internal server in this embodiment include: the IP of the external login, the IP location, the internal server IP, the protocol, and the access time.
Furthermore, the abnormal login details of this embodiment include: user, common login location, remote login location, and discovery time.
Furthermore, the off-work hours login details of this embodiment include: source IP, IP location, destination IP, protocol, and access time.
Furthermore, the unconventional service analysis of this embodiment includes: remote control service, proxy service, RegeoryTunnel (intranet penetration tunnel) service detection and discovery, HTTP (Hyper Text Transfer Protocol) proxy detection and discovery, SOCKS (Protocol for sessions traversal across firewallsecurely) proxy detection and discovery, Teamview/IRC (professional remote connection tool/(Internet Relay Chat)) detection and discovery, analysis of the time of connection service, source IP of connection service, destination IP of connection service and service type.
Furthermore, the event analysis of this embodiment includes: by discovering compromise events, WEB attack events, internal abnormal information, using network penetration information, and combining cloud threat situations, determining whether the nature of the event is a true malicious attack behavior and analyzing the cause of the event.
Furthermore, the event tracing of this embodiment tracks and traces the malicious attack events, analyzes the physical location of the attacker, the evidence of the attacker's behavior, and the methods commonly used by the attacker.
Furthermore, the host asset service discovery of this embodiment includes: scanning and discovering new assets, asset changes, new ports, port changes, identifying operating systems, IP addresses, domain names, and outputting asset information reports.
Furthermore, the Web service discovery of this embodiment includes: analyzing and discovering ports, Web servers, development languages, some front-end WAF information, and Web service conditions. The asset visualization display of this embodiment visualizes asset information, supports rapid retrieval of asset information, report export, and can output web service information reports.
Furthermore, the emergency drill of this embodiment also includes: emergency drill for network attack incidents.
Further, the network attack incident emergency drill of this embodiment includes: analysis and judgment. If it is judged to be a malicious attack incident on an external website, the attack source IP address is located according to the system log, firewall log, network log, network traffic analysis, and web page anti-tampering system analysis, and it is judged whether the attack source can be determined. If the attack source cannot be determined, it is judged whether the attack source type can be determined. At the same time, according to the system security status, it is judged whether it is tampering, SQL (Structured Query Language) injection, XSS (Cross Site Scripting) cross-site scripting attack, Trojan horse, illegal intrusion or one or more malicious attacks. If it is judged that there is a malicious attack, whether the web page anti-self-tampering system has been tampered with is detected. If it has been tampered with, the cause of the vulnerability is detected. If it has not been tampered with, the IDS (intrusion detection system intrusion detection system) Whether the system detects intrusion, if intrusion is detected, verification is performed; if no intrusion is detected, whether the type of attack source can be determined; if the type of attack can be determined, whether the vulnerability can be restored and repaired; if the type of attack source cannot be determined, the emergency plan is initiated; if it is determined that the vulnerability can be restored and repaired, the vulnerability is restored and repaired; if it is determined that the vulnerability cannot be restored and repaired, the emergency plan is initiated; after restoring and repairing the vulnerability, it is determined whether the attack continues; if it is determined that the attack continues, the source of the attack is determined and the emergency plan is initiated at the same time; if it is determined that the attack does not continue, the notification process is executed; if the attack source IP address or attack path cannot be located, or the attack network path cannot be closed after analysis, the emergency plan (in the case of system unavailability) is initiated and notified.
Furthermore, the information collection of the Web penetration test of this embodiment includes: collecting operating system types, analyzing network topology, port scanning, operation type determination, application determination, account scanning, and configuration determination in one or more ways; the password guessing utilizes brute force attacks and dictionaries to guess passwords.
Further, the Web script and application test of this embodiment includes: injection, cross-site scripting attack, invalid authentication and session management, insecure direct object reference, cross-site request forgery, check security configuration errors, detect insecure encrypted storage, unrestricted URL access, detect insufficient transport layer protection, and detect unverified redirection and forwarding. The injection of this embodiment includes: injection attack vulnerability, sending untrusted data as part of a command or query statement to the interpreter, deceiving the interpreter to execute unplanned commands or access unauthorized data. The cross-site scripting attack of this embodiment includes: when the application receives untrusted data, it sends it to a web browser without verification and escape, executes scripts on the browser, hijacks user sessions, harms websites, or redirects users to malicious websites. The invalid authentication and session management of this embodiment includes: making the application functions related to authentication and session management unable to be correctly implemented, destroying passwords, keys, session tokens, or attacking other vulnerabilities to impersonate other users. The insecure direct object reference of this embodiment includes: exposing references to internal implementation objects, generating insecure direct object references, and manipulating the references to access unauthorized data. The cross-site request forgery of this embodiment includes: using cross-site request forgery attacks to force the browser of the logged-in user to send a forged HTTP request to a web application with a vulnerability, forcing the user's browser to send a request to the application with a vulnerability. The security configuration error check of this embodiment includes: detecting whether the application, framework, application server, web server, database server and platform are defined, implemented, and maintained, and whether the software is updated in a timely manner. The detection of unsafe encrypted storage of this embodiment includes: detecting whether the web application uses encryption measures or hash algorithms to protect sensitive data, and using weakly protected data to commit identity theft and credit card fraud crimes. The unrestricted URL access of this embodiment includes: forging URLs to access hidden web pages. The detection of insufficient transport layer protection of this embodiment includes: detecting whether the application does not perform identity authentication, whether encryption measures are taken, whether there are measures to protect the confidentiality and integrity of sensitive network data, whether the application uses a weak algorithm, whether an expired or invalid certificate is used, or whether identity authentication or encryption measures or protection measures are used correctly. The detection of unverified redirection and forwarding of this embodiment includes: detecting that the web application redirects or forwards users to other web pages or websites and uses untrustworthy data to determine whether the destination page is verified, redirecting users to phishing websites or forwarding to unauthorized pages.
Further, the present embodiment evaluates the external asset status and searches for intranet access points, including: determining whether there is a remote control vulnerability through information collection and analysis, and if so, obtaining system permissions, and generating a report after information collection and analysis; if there is no remote control vulnerability, determining whether there is a remote common vulnerability, and if so, determining whether local common permissions can be obtained after information collection and analysis, and generating a report if there is no remote common vulnerability, and if local common permissions can be obtained, determining whether local extraction can be performed after information collection and analysis, and generating a report if local common permissions cannot be obtained; if entity extraction can be performed, generating a report after information collection and analysis, and directly generating a report if entity extraction cannot be performed. The present embodiment utilizes the intranet access points that can be used in Internet assets and deploys a jump server to perform intranet penetration, including: collecting basic intranet information after confirming the scope of intranet penetration assets, performing port scanning and known CVE vulnerability scanning at the system layer, and then verifying and utilizing system vulnerabilities for penetration, collecting application platform information, version fingerprint data, and conventional vulnerability scanning information at the application layer, and then verifying and mining application vulnerabilities for penetration, and then organizing vulnerability data for comprehensive utilization, improving control authority, intercepting information, remotely controlling, and expanding resources, and submitting a penetration test report for review.
The information collection and analysis of this embodiment includes: baseline check and vulnerability scanning. The baseline check of this embodiment includes: performing a baseline check on the system to discover security vulnerabilities and weak links in servers, network devices, and security devices, and identifying, analyzing, repairing, and inspecting the discovered vulnerabilities; the vulnerability scanning includes performing a vulnerability scan on the system, checking the security risks and vulnerabilities in various information assets in network protocols, network services, and network devices, performing security vulnerability detection and analysis on network devices, and assisting in the rectification of vulnerabilities.
Further, the survey of this embodiment includes: collecting information on security equipment, network environment, operation and maintenance authority and existing security policies. The security equipment information of this embodiment includes: equipment name, equipment person in charge, equipment manufacturer and model, management address and method, physical address, equipment administrator information, user name and password, and equipment white paper. The network environment information of this embodiment includes: network topology diagram, server asset information, network equipment asset information, and business system information. The operation and maintenance authority information of this embodiment includes: operation and maintenance personnel authority and maintenance management address. The existing security policies of this embodiment include: access control policy, security protection policy, and behavior audit policy. The formulation of the scheme of this embodiment includes: based on the information collected from the survey and combined with the actual security needs of the user, the gap analysis of the existing security policy is carried out, and the problem of policy missing, policy redundancy, and policy not abolished is found, and the scheme is formulated. The gap analysis of the existing security policy of this embodiment includes: analyzing the user's business security needs, analyzing the gap of the existing security policy, and the overall situation of the security policy gap analysis. The analysis of the user's business security needs of this embodiment includes: summarizing the business system, asset information and formulating security protection policy requirements. The analysis of the existing security policy gap of this embodiment includes: access control policy gap analysis, security protection policy gap analysis, and behavior audit policy gap analysis. The policy optimization of this embodiment includes: access control policy optimization, security protection policy optimization, and behavior audit policy optimization. The access control policy optimization of this embodiment includes: boundary access control equipment and operation and maintenance management equipment. The boundary access control equipment of this embodiment includes: sorting out the access requirements of the business system, customizing the access control policy according to the business, clarifying the original address, destination address, and service, indicating the policy activation work order number, date, and applicant, adding missing policies, modifying rough policies, and deleting redundant policies. The operation and maintenance management equipment of this embodiment includes: sorting out the operation and maintenance personnel and maintenance demand information, building or adjusting the operation and maintenance personnel according to the unit organizational structure, clarifying the personnel names and contact information, creating or adjusting asset information according to the business responsible unit, requiring the clear asset IP address, bearer business, and physical location, and creating corresponding policies according to different operation and maintenance personnel. The security protection policy optimization of this embodiment includes: intrusion detection equipment and Web application firewall. The intrusion detection device of this embodiment includes: combing the basic information of the business system, creating an intrusion detection protection object according to the business system, clarifying the assets and responsible personnel contained, formulating intrusion protection strategies, including intrusion attack strategies, Trojan virus strategies, and audit strategies, creating intrusion protection strategies for each business system, and optimizing the strategies according to the asset types, operating system types, and software business types contained in the business system. The Web application firewall of this embodiment includes: combing the basic information of the business system, creating a Web application protection object according to the business system, clarifying the assets and responsible personnel contained, and formulating protection strategies, including Web malicious scanning protection strategies, SQL injection protection strategies, XSS attack protection strategies, website hanging horse protection strategies, hotlink protection strategies, and webpage tampering protection strategies. The behavior audit strategy optimization of this embodiment includes: network security audit, database audit, and Internet behavior management. The network security audit of this embodiment includes: combing the basic information of the business system, creating a business access audit strategy and a management and maintenance audit strategy according to the business system, the business access audit strategy audits all accessed network behaviors of the business system, and the management and maintenance audit strategy designs all management and maintenance network behaviors of the business system. The database audit of this embodiment includes: combing business system information and database information, creating audit strategies for each database, including risk pointer audit, abnormal login design, abnormal maintenance audit, abnormal tool audit, creating business system objects according to business system information, creating report strategies according to different business systems, and generating audit reports for each business system. The Internet behavior management of this embodiment includes: combing terminal information, creating or adjusting terminal users according to the organizational structure of the unit, and creating Internet behavior audit strategies for users, including email audit strategies, website access audit strategies, communication chat audit strategies, posting audit strategies, and keyword audit strategies.
The equipment operation safety monitoring of this embodiment includes: monitoring network equipment, security equipment, and host, setting alarm thresholds and alarm rules for various functional indicators, timely discovering abnormal equipment operation status, and issuing different alarms for monitored security events according to different levels and types. If it is determined to be a device failure, the fault handling process is started, and the alarm threshold is adjusted according to the actual situation. The monitoring network equipment of this embodiment includes: equipment hardware status inspection, equipment software status inspection, equipment performance status inspection, security policy inspection and optimization, and log inspection. The equipment hardware status inspection of this embodiment includes: inspection of the operation status of the equipment hardware, including inspection of the operation status of the power supply, fan, chassis, board, flash card, and status light, inspection of the stability of the physical port, inspection of the connection status, label, and identification status, and inspection of the equipment hardware alarm information. The equipment software status inspection of this embodiment includes: inspection of the system kernel operation status and inspection of whether there is a new kernel upgrade program that can be used. The equipment performance status inspection of this embodiment includes: checking CPU utilization, memory utilization, network interface utilization, and buffer usage. The security policy inspection and optimization of this embodiment includes: reviewing the correctness and effectiveness of the security policy. The log check of this embodiment includes: checking whether the log reception is normal, whether the log needs full log processing, log collection and analysis. The monitoring security equipment of this embodiment includes: security equipment hardware status inspection, security equipment software status inspection, security equipment performance status inspection, security equipment security policy optimization, security equipment log inspection, and security equipment rule base inspection. The security equipment hardware status inspection of this embodiment includes: checking the operation of the security equipment hardware, including the operation status of the power supply, fan, chassis, board, flash card, and status light, checking the stability of the physical port, and checking the connection status, label, and identification status. The security equipment software status inspection of this embodiment includes: checking the system kernel operation status, whether there is a new kernel upgrade program that can be used, and the software system version upgrade status. The security equipment performance status inspection of this embodiment includes: checking the CPU utilization, memory utilization, network interface utilization, and buffer usage. The security policy optimization of the security equipment of this embodiment includes: reviewing the correctness and effectiveness of the security policy. The security equipment log inspection of this embodiment includes: checking whether the log is normal, whether the log needs full log processing, and log collection and analysis. The rule base check of the security device implemented in this embodiment includes: checking the virus definition upgrade, including checking the antivirus definition upgrade, and checking the IDS/IPS rule base upgrade. The monitoring host of this embodiment includes: host hardware status inspection, host operating system security inspection, host performance inspection, suspicious service process inspection, and virus inspection. The host hardware status inspection of this embodiment includes: checking the operation of the host device hardware, including the operation status of the power supply, fan, chassis, board, and status light, checking the status of the network card, IP address, routing table, disk array operation status, system fault light display, and system hardware error report. The host operating system security check of this embodiment includes: checking the operating system software version, checking the installation of one or more system patches in the Windows series patch, Linux system patch, and Unix series patch, checking and optimizing the operating system security configuration, including account, security policy, service inspection and optimization, analyzing system logs, and checking patch installation. The host performance check of this embodiment includes: checking CPU utilization, memory utilization, swap area utilization, disk space usage, and I/O working conditions. The suspicious service process check of this embodiment includes: checking the name of the service to be enabled, the necessity of the service to be enabled, and the resource usage of the service. The virus check of this embodiment includes: checking the installation of client virus software, the upgrade of virus definition library, the distribution of policies, and the processing of viruses. The equipment operation security audit of this embodiment includes: using the security management platform, combined with asset information, to find the correlation relationship in the data of network access logs, management behavior records, operation behavior records, product operation records, network traffic, and information generated by security monitoring, setting correlation analysis rules and filtering conditions, and mining network attacks and operation failure information. The equipment and policy backup and update of this embodiment include: security protection through daily policy configuration and equipment upgrade, optimizing policies, and maintaining the policy and configuration backup of security products, including policy configuration, policy combing, equipment upgrade, and backup recovery. The policy configuration of this embodiment includes: analyzing the actual security requirements of the business system and the functions of security products according to the overall security policy, and configuring the security policy of the security product according to the policy configuration process. The policy combing of this embodiment includes: regularly combing the policy configuration of security products, combing redundant policies and abandoned policies, and deleting them after confirmation. The equipment upgrade of this embodiment includes: regularly upgrading the software version, rule base, and feature base of the security product, backing up the original system before upgrading, testing the upgrade package, regularly checking the manufacturer's version update, and filing the update operation record. The backup and recovery of this embodiment includes: regularly backing up the configuration and policy of the product, storing the backup content on a dedicated server, and filing the backup operation record. The vulnerability rectification of this embodiment includes: repairing the vulnerabilities of the server and security equipment within the scanning range, and reinforcing the application and database vulnerabilities.
The periodic security product inspection of this embodiment includes: periodically checking the security status of security products during the operation of information security products, including equipment operation security monitoring, equipment operation security auditing, equipment and policy backup and update, setting alarm thresholds and alarm rules for CPU utilization, memory utilization, disk utilization, and network interface connectivity of security products, and monitoring in real time. If the operation status of the security product is abnormal, it is confirmed, and if it is confirmed to be a product failure, the fault handling process is started. During the monitoring process, the alarm threshold is adjusted according to the actual situation to obtain the baseline of the operation status of the security product, and different alarms are issued according to different levels and types for the monitored security events according to the alarm rules, and the alarm information is sent to the security management platform, and the operation and maintenance personnel or inspection personnel are notified through the security management platform to take processing measures according to the situation of the security event; the security management platform is used to find the correlation between one or more data in the network access log, management behavior record, operation behavior record, product operation record, and network traffic in combination with asset information, and the correlation analysis rules and filtering conditions are set to mine network attacks and operation failure information; security protection is carried out through policy configuration and equipment upgrade, and the policy is optimized, and daily inspections are carried out on the policy and configuration backup of the security product. The periodic security policy optimization suggestions of this embodiment include: collecting information on security equipment, network environment, operation and maintenance permissions and existing security policies, implementing security product inspections, conducting gap assessments and rectification suggestions on existing security policies in combination with actual business security needs of users, and performing policy optimization; the rectification suggestions include: security policy optimization suggestions, and the security policy optimization suggestions include: access control policy optimization implementation methods, security protection policy optimization implementation methods, and behavior audit policy optimization implementation methods.
Further, the security assessment of the network equipment of this embodiment includes: checking the security of network equipment access control, checking the security protection configuration of network equipment, and checking the policy of network equipment. The security check of network equipment access control in this embodiment includes: checking software versions, equipment vulnerabilities, and security issues. The security protection configuration assessment of network equipment in this embodiment includes: checking user security, system password security, log inspection, evaluating equipment access control security, equipment management security, and network equipment service security, and evaluating through business application and security baseline configuration. The policy check of network equipment in this embodiment includes: evaluating the policy configuration and use of existing network equipment and security equipment, and evaluating whether the policy configuration meets business needs and ensures the security of the system.
