If tampering of the network kernel table is detected, the agent (or network kernel table enforcer at the agent) can automatically and immediately undertake remediation actions to reinforce the original network settings using the previously stored copy of the network kernel table (e.g., copy of network kernel table stored at endpoint). If any discrepancies are discovered during the comparison such as a change in network configurations or settings, addition of new network settings, a change in the number of network configurations, and so forth, the endpoint agent can replace the tampered network kernel with the previously stored copy of the network kernel table. In other words, the original network settings can be recovered using the copy of the network kernel table. The agent can also alert the controller (step 5045 ) so that further investigations can be made.
The frequency of the comparison can be a user-configurable value. For example, the administrator may configure the comparison to be every two, three, four, five, or ten seconds or at any other frequency as desired.
Periodically checking the integrity of the network kernel table can help to prevent the table from being reprogrammed with unauthorized routing information and other networking rules that may identify an unauthorized destination. This helps to prevent a hacker from transferring data out of the compromised endpoint to the unauthorized destination. Further, because the integrity the entire network kernel table is checked, the agent can detect discrepancies to any portion of the table (i.e., both the portion provided by the controller and other portions not provided by the controller, but still authorized by the enterprise).
In a specific embodiment, the network kernel table may be programmed to allow only connections using the virtual overlay network platform and block all other connections at the local network. In this specific embodiment, the blocking may be accomplished by identifying or programming a specific port, e.g., port 9797, in the routing table for the building of the secure tunnel and configuring the local physical network to support only that specific port, e.g., port 9797.
FIG. 51 shows a flow for tracking health or status of an endpoint. In a step 5110 a connection between the controller and the endpoint agent is continuously monitored. For example, the controller may periodically poll or ping the controller over the connection for updates. Instead or additionally, the endpoint agent may be configured to periodically check-in with the controller. For example, the controller may check in with the endpoint agent (or vice-versa) every one, two, three, four, or five seconds or at any other frequency as desired. The frequency can be a user-configurable value.
In a step 5115 , a determination is made as to whether there was an interruption in the connection. For example, there can be a predetermined or preconfigured threshold time period or timeout period within which the endpoint agent must respond to the controller with a status update (e.g., five, ten, or fifteen seconds or any other time period as desired). If, for example, the controller issues a status update request to the endpoint agent and does not receive a status update from the controller within the threshold time period to respond, the controller may determine that there is a potential problem at the endpoint.
When an interruption in the connection is detected, the controller may add the endpoint to a listing of quarantined endpoints (step 5120 ) and alert the administrator (step 5125 ).
For example, referring back now to FIG. 42 , in some cases the malicious program may attempt to kill 4295 the endpoint agent. If the endpoint agent is killed, the controller will be able to detect that there may be a potential problem with the endpoint based on the interruption in the connection between the controller and endpoint agent. The controller can then undertake remediation actions to isolate the potentially compromised endpoint.
In another specific embodiment, the endpoint agent reports back to the controller with information including CPU usage, running processes, storage usage, or combinations of these. The controller examines the information for anomalies. For example, the controller may compare the reported CPU usage against a model of expected CPU usage. If the reported CPU usage exceeds the expected CPU usage by a threshold amount, the controller can generate an alert and place the endpoint into quarantine. An unexpected level of CPU usage, running processes, or both may indicate a potentially compromised endpoint.
FIG. 52 shows a flow for handling an endpoint that may have been compromised. In a step 5210 , the controller receives from an endpoint an alert. For example, the alert may have been triggered based on the endpoint agent discovering a tampering of the network kernel table. In response, in a step 5215 , the controller adds an IP address of the endpoint to a listing of quarantined endpoints. Thus, other endpoints when requesting permission from the controller to connect to the endpoint will be denied permission to connect to the endpoint because the endpoint will be listed in the listing of quarantined endpoints.
In a step 5220 , the controller instructs the endpoint to empty or delete its network kernel table in the OS. This provides another layer of security because without the network kernel table, the malicious program will not be able to make connections. In a step 5225 , an alert notification (e.g., email or text) is generated and sent to the administrator.
In a specific embodiment, a method for securing, through a virtual network, a public cloud provided by a cloud services provider for an enterprise includes: providing a plurality of agents for a plurality of endpoints, the plurality of endpoints to be hosted by a plurality of server machines in the public cloud provided by the cloud services provider for the enterprise; providing a controller that connects to the plurality of agents; storing, at the controller, a whitelist identifying components of a multi-tiered application authorized by the enterprise to use the virtual network; defining an application profile for the multi-tiered application, the application profile specifying valid computing flows between components of a tier of the multi-tiered application and components of another tier of the multi-tiered application, the components of the tier to be executed at an endpoint, and the other components of the other tier to be executed at another different endpoint; provisioning the plurality of endpoints according to the application profile, the provisioning comprising generating a plurality of static routing tables for the plurality of endpoints, a static routing table for an endpoint comprising at least one Internet Protocol (IP) subnet; distributing a first static routing table, and a first agent to a first endpoint, wherein when a request is received at the first endpoint to connect to a second endpoint, the first agent determines whether an IP address of the second endpoint falls within the at least one IP subnet; if the IP address of the second endpoint falls within the at least one IP subnet, receiving, at the controller from the first agent, a request to perform a security check; and in response to the security check request, checking the whitelist to determine whether a requestor of the request to connect to the second endpoint is listed as a component of the multi-tiered application authorized to use the virtual network.
The method may include determining that the requestor of the request to connect to the second endpoint is not listed in the whitelist as a component of the multi-tiered application authorized to use the virtual network; and upon the determination, not allowing the connection to the second endpoint.
The method may include programming the first static routing table into a network kernel table of an operating system (OS) executing at the first endpoint, the network kernel table comprising other routing information that is separate from the first static routing table; generating a copy of the network kernel table, the copy of the network kernel table thereby comprising the first static routing table distributed by the controller, and the other routing information that is separate from the first static routing table; maintaining, at the first endpoint, the copy of the network kernel table; sending another copy of the network kernel table to the controller for storage at the controller; periodically comparing the network kernel table in the OS against the copy of the network kernel table maintained at the first endpoint to detect tampering of the network kernel table in the OS; and upon detecting tampering, reinforcing the tampered network kernel table in the OS with the copy of the network kernel table maintained at the first endpoint, and issuing an alert to the controller.
The method may include maintaining continuous connections between the controller and the plurality of agents; detecting that a first continuous connection between the controller and the first agent at the first endpoint has been interrupted; and based on the interruption, placing the first endpoint into quarantine.
The method may include placing, by the controller, a third endpoint into quarantine; after the placing the third endpoint into quarantine, receiving, at the controller from the first agent at the first endpoint, a request to connect to the third endpoint, the request to connect to the third endpoint being received at the controller because the first agent has determined that an IP address of the third endpoint falls within the at least one IP subnet; and denying the request to connect to the third endpoint because the third endpoint is in quarantine.
In an embodiment, the components of the multi-tiered application identified in the whitelist are arranged as a tree, the tree comprises authorized parent and child processes associated with the component of the multi-tiered application authorized to use the virtual network, and signatures corresponding to the authorized processes, wherein the request to perform the security check comprises signatures of processes spawned from the requestor, and wherein the checking the whitelist comprises comparing a signature of a process spawned from the requestor with a signature of an authorized process listed in the whitelist.
The method may include in response to the security check request, checking the application profile to determine whether a computing flow from the first endpoint to the second endpoint is a valid computing flow according to the application profile. The method may include in response to the security check request, checking a listing of endpoints that have been quarantined to determine whether an IP address of the second endpoint is in the listing. An endpoint may include a container. An endpoint may include a virtual machine.

## 721. [CN112291232B] Safety capability and safety service chain management platform based on tenants

### 📋 Abstract
> The invention discloses a safety capability and safety service chain management platform based on tenants, which relates to the field of network safety and comprises the following steps: the system comprises a security situation perception system, a portal management system and a cloud security resource pool; the security situation perception system is used for acquiring security element information of tenants in the platform, analyzing the acquired security element information to generate a corresponding security situation prediction result, and generating and executing a corresponding security disposal strategy based on the security situation prediction result; the portal management system is used for managing tenants in the platform by logging in the portal management system by managers and managing self resources of the tenants by logging in the portal management system by the tenants; the cloud security resource pool comprises: the system comprises a detection probe system, a service auditing system, a web application protection system and a vulnerability scanning system; the platform is used for carrying out the same management on the tenants and the network, the information safety and the network safety of the tenants are guaranteed, and the safety of the use of the private network in the private network platform is improved.

### 📜 Full Specification & Deep Scrape Text
Title
Safety capability and safety service chain management platform based on tenants

Abstract
The invention discloses a safety capability and safety service chain management platform based on tenants, which relates to the field of network safety and comprises the following steps: the system comprises a security situation perception system, a portal management system and a cloud security resource pool; the security situation perception system is used for acquiring security element information of tenants in the platform, analyzing the acquired security element information to generate a corresponding security situation prediction result, and generating and executing a corresponding security disposal strategy based on the security situation prediction result; the portal management system is used for managing tenants in the platform by logging in the portal management system by managers and managing self resources of the tenants by logging in the portal management system by the tenants; the cloud security resource pool comprises: the system comprises a detection probe system, a service auditing system, a web application protection system and a vulnerability scanning system; the platform is used for carrying out the same management on the tenants and the network, the information safety and the network safety of the tenants are guaranteed, and the safety of the use of the private network in the private network platform is improved.

Description
Safety capability and safety service chain management platform based on tenants
Technical Field
The invention relates to the field of network security, in particular to a safety capability and safety service chain management platform based on tenants.
Background
With the advancement and development of science and technology, networks become important tools, especially for enterprises, the networks are indispensable tools, and many enterprises select private networks as the networks of the enterprises at present.
The enterprise needs to rent the internet special line, and the internet network in China does not really complete interconnection with the internet network in Europe and America and the like. This phenomenon is commonly referred to as a "network bottleneck". The problems caused by the network bottleneck problem of the network are as follows: important mails sent to abroad are lost, file transmission is slow, English searching cannot be applied, English websites cannot be accessed, SKYPE conferences cannot be carried out with the abroad, foreign systems such as ERP, OA, CRM and the like cannot be realized, and the problems seriously influence various business trips of enterprises and cause great enterprise loss.
At present, computer network application in China has some distance from the world, the speed is slow and access constraint is the first reason, namely the international export bandwidth of the Internet in China is not large enough, so that many foreign users cannot access the domestic websites in a reflected mode, and the foreign networks are difficult to access in China, so that enterprises miss many potential business opportunities. Enterprise leasing internet acceleration leases address these network problems: the internet acceleration special line can enable domestic access to foreign networks, the foreign access to the domestic networks is smooth, and therefore enterprises can receive more business orders.
The private line supports all communication application programs and connection requirements due to the characteristics of exclusive bandwidth, continuous safety, predictable performance, wide use and the like, and is the first choice for connecting the client with all the global nodes at present.
However, the existing private network platform only provides a corresponding private network for an enterprise in the platform, i.e. a tenant, but the security of the private network is not sufficient, and corresponding data and networks of the enterprise cannot obtain corresponding security guarantees, so that some enterprises cannot use the private network due to security problems.
Disclosure of Invention
The invention aims to solve the problem of network security of the existing special network platform, and provides a tenant-based security capability and security service chain management platform.
In order to achieve the above object, the present invention provides a tenant-based security capability and security service chain management platform, which includes: the system comprises a security situation perception system, a portal management system and a cloud security resource pool;
the security situation awareness system is used for acquiring security element information of tenants in the platform, analyzing the acquired security element information to obtain an analysis result, generating a corresponding security situation prediction result based on the analysis result, presenting the security situation prediction result to the tenants through the portal management system, and generating and executing a corresponding security disposal strategy based on the security situation prediction result;
the portal management system is used for managing tenants in the platform by logging in the portal management system by a manager, and managing self resources of the tenants by logging in the portal management system by the tenants, wherein the tenants are isolated from each other;
the cloud security resource pool comprises: the system comprises a detection probe system, a service auditing system, a web application protection system and a vulnerability scanning system;
the detection probe system is used for monitoring threats of a network of tenants in the platform and displaying the monitored threats to corresponding tenants through the portal management system;
the service auditing system is used for accessing a tenant service network, capturing network access flow, analyzing a network data packet according to a distributed auditing strategy, extracting an auditing event and responding;
the Web application protection system is used for performing Web attack protection, Web malicious scanning protection, Web malicious code protection and information leakage protection on tenants in the platform;
the vulnerability scanning system is used for scanning the network of the tenant to discover the host, scanning the host to discover vulnerabilities and vulnerabilities of different application objects on the host, evaluating the vulnerabilities, vulnerability risks of the host and the network, and generating a vulnerability repair guidance scheme based on an evaluation result; the vulnerability scanning system is also used for auditing the security policy of the tenant; the vulnerability scanning system is also used for constructing a management system for the tenants and displaying the corresponding results of the vulnerability scanning system to the tenants through the portal management system.
The invention provides all-around service guarantee for private line users, builds a matched security situation sensing system and a portal management system by combining the service characteristics of private line tenants, builds a cloud security resource pool, drains tenant data packets and flow to a security cloud, and provides network security guarantee through security technical means such as intrusion detection, website protection, database audit, security situation sensing and the like. Meanwhile, a portal management system is provided for providing security service arrangement, hierarchical and decentralized management, security scanning, security monitoring, security auditing and security situation awareness type security services for private line users. The platform ensures the network security of platform users by fusing a plurality of systems and adopting a plurality of security technical means, the security is higher and more comprehensive, and the security protection is more stable.
Preferably, the security situational awareness system includes:
the information acquisition unit is used for acquiring safety element information of tenants;
the information analysis unit is used for carrying out corresponding analysis based on the safety factor information to obtain an analysis result;
a safe disposal unit: for performing routine treatment and exception treatment based on the analysis result, the routine treatment being embodied in the form of a planned task work order; exception handling is embodied in the form of response management and alarm work order processing; the safety disposal unit is also used for managing safety early warning and notification;
and the view presenting unit is used for presenting a security situation prediction result view for the user.
Preferably, the security situation prediction result generated by the security situation awareness system includes: asset situation, attack situation, operational situation, vulnerability situation, risk situation, threat situation, website situation and traffic situation; the security situation awareness system is also used for analyzing and counting attack chains.
The security situation awareness system supports a user to log in and enter a situation comprehensive display interface. Through the interface, the whole multi-dimensional monitoring can be carried out on the safety situation of the whole network of the user. And the comprehensive security situation is presented based on the acquired security information, so that the user is helped to control the security state of the whole network from the global perspective. The method comprises the steps of attacking situation maps, presenting the security situation of protected objects around assets in the network, the security threat trend, the whole network alarm distribution, the whole network vulnerability and configuration vulnerability distribution, the health situation of a service system and the like.
The security situation awareness system has the functions of security operation and situation analysis: the security situation awareness system has the function of asset management, and can perform grouping and domain-division unified maintenance on managed IT assets. The system supports displaying relationships between different asset regions in the form of an asset tree; the system supports displaying all of the inventory in a management area in the form of a list. The security situation awareness system supports the built-in common equipment and system types of the system, and users can customize asset types and define the asset extension attributes for each asset type. The security situation awareness system supports editing of asset topology, including adding nodes, adding/editing links. The security situation awareness system can automatically identify new assets according to the equipment addresses of the received events and the missed scanning results, and supports automatic addition to an asset list.
The security situation awareness system has a risk assessment function: the security situation awareness system comprehensively considers the value, the vulnerability and the threat of the assets, and calculates the possibility of the risk and the influence of the risk through a built-in risk calculation model. The security situation perception system supports the automatic calculation of the risk values of the assets, the security domains and the business systems at regular intervals, and the plotting of the risk change curves of the assets, the security domains and the business systems along with the change of time, and supports risk drilling and analysis. The security situation awareness system supports the system to vividly display the risk matrix of the security domain, marks the distribution situation of asset risks in the security domain from two angles of possibility and influence, guides an administrator to carry out risk analysis, and takes corresponding risk disposal countermeasures.
The security situation perception system has the functions of early warning management: the security situation awareness system supports the analysis of possibly affected assets by issuing internal and external early warning information and knows the attacks and potential security risks possibly suffered by the service system in advance. The early warning of the safety situation perception system is divided into internal early warning and external early warning. The internal early warning is automatically generated through a preset rule, and the external early warning is manually input; the security situation awareness system can be associated with the affected assets when the early warning information is input; the early warning types in the security situation awareness system comprise security announcement, attack early warning, vulnerability early warning and virus early warning.
The security situation awareness system integrates a big data technology, and combines SQL, NewSQL and NoSQL technologies to realize efficient and reliable storage and high-speed retrieval of multi-element, heterogeneous and mass security data. Providing intelligent correlation analysis, behavior analysis based on machine learning, a stream security analysis technology, building an active security management mechanism, timely discovering hidden dangers of a service system through active vulnerability scanning and security configuration checking, and performing early warning in advance; and by combining internal and external information, more accurate and timely security analysis is provided. Meanwhile, an attack chain model is introduced to analyze a whole set of attack processes including detection, penetration, attack trapping, control and damage, and a perception model and a visualization technology are utilized to perform multi-dimensional, multi-view and fine-grained centralized situation presentation on an analysis result. The system helps users to master real-time security situation and dynamically sense hidden dangers and threats, and provides powerful support for security analysts and decision layers of tenants.
The security situation perception system adopts a distributed computing technology architecture based on Hadoop/Spark and a non-relational database (NoSQL/NewSQL) technology-CupidDB, has the characteristics of distribution, full-text indexing, horizontal elastic expansion, real-time formatted data search, full-text search of original data keywords, intelligence, machine learning, integrated threat information, high reliability and the like, adopts an open platform architecture design, follows a universal application interface and a management interface, realizes modular assembly of functional components, can be freely selected by tenants, and can realize good butt joint and integration with the application and management environment of customers.
The security situation awareness system is connected with security equipment or security subsystems in a user network in a butt joint mode to realize integration of various types of multi-manufacturer security monitoring protection resources, can cover all-network assets and service operation information, vulnerability information, attack behavior information, risk information and abnormal flow information through the butt joint of the existing security subsystems and the to-be-built security subsystems, combines threat information and performs comprehensive analysis presentation on the basis, and forms a multi-view-angle omnibearing situation awareness system comprising attacked object and attack source identification, vulnerability identification, attack process and influence analysis, security risk situations and the like through description of an attack chain.
Preferably, the portal management system includes: the system comprises a cloud security management platform and a security self-service portal; the cloud security management platform is used for providing services required by a business scene and providing operation entrances of an administrator and tenants; the portal interface of the security self-service portal is divided into an operation and maintenance manager interface and a tenant interface; the portal management system supports the creation of a plurality of tenants, can create a required security virtual machine for each tenant in a security resource pool, and simultaneously arranges a service chain corresponding to the tenant, and the tenant can log in a tenant portal inlet to manage the security virtual machine to which the tenant belongs.
Preferably, in the cloud security management platform, the tenant can select the required security service content and create the corresponding security virtual machine in a security service package manner, wherein the security service package is composed of a basic service package, and the basic service package is composed of a security network element and a resource template.
The portal management system provides security service management services for the platform, flexibly allocates security capability services for tenants according to network security requirements of the platform, each tenant has an independent security capability portal, and each user is safely isolated.
The portal management system has a security service chain function: the portal management system can divide security domains, arrange service chains by taking the service security domains as units, and issue a boundary access control strategy, wherein the service chains are service chains defined by the system or users, namely, the users select some security service options and then form the service chains according to a certain sequence. The portal management system can flexibly arrange the security service business and provide customized security service chains for different security domains. The portal management system supports multiple tenants, supports service chain isolation of different tenants, and ensures service security.
The portal management system has a multi-tenant function and supports a multi-tenant architecture. Each tenant is supported to have an independent portal, and the portal of the tenant can only check the security assets of the tenant, check the security market and submit the security service package order, so that data of different tenants are isolated.
Preferably, the detection probe system comprises:
an acquisition layer: the system is used for acquiring data and acquiring data packets and flow according to needs; detection layer: detecting the collected data packets and the flow by adopting a plurality of detection modes; a storage layer: the data packets and the flow can be stored according to the requirement; analysis layer: the system is used for carrying out threat clue analysis based on the detection result to generate a threat situation; a display layer: the method is used for displaying threat situation, alarming and inquiring events; configuring a management layer: for related policy configuration and device management operations.
Wherein, the detection probe system has attack monitoring function:
the detection probe supports IP fragment recombination, TCP stream state tracking, protocol analysis of 2-7 layers, and identification and analysis of an application protocol (such as HTTP Tunnel) of a super-7 layer, and the system supports the protocol identification and protocol analysis capability of a known service (such as a Web Server running under 8000 ports) working under a non-default port. The detection probe has an anti-escape detection mechanism, and can effectively prevent fragment escape attack, overlapping escape attack, and redundant or useless byte escape attack. The detection probe can detect various attack behaviors such as buffer overflow, network worms, network database attacks, trojan horse software, spyware and the like. The detection probe system needs to have the capability of detecting the attack to the Web system (including a browser and a server): SQL injection (including various variants), XSS (including stored XSS and reflected XSS) and various grammatical variants thereof, Webshell, webpage horse hanging, semantic variant, encoding and the like. The detection probe system supports abnormal behavior detection/alarm: the method is to detect and alarm network abnormal behaviors such as scanning, worm virus, Trojan horse, abnormal access frequency, abnormal access flow and the like. The detection probe system supports abnormal data packet detection: and detecting the network abnormal data packet according to four attack types of Christmas tree attack, scanning attack, denial of service attack and option attack. The detection probe system supports Trojan C & C covert channel detection: the method is independent of the Trojan horse feature library, detects the session behavior initiated by the Trojan horse software through a detection means of the session behavior, gives an alarm, simultaneously informs the initiated source IP and the accessed destination IP, and provides the reason for doubting the Trojan horse channel and related session information. The detection probe system supports blacklist warning: when the user confirms the access relation of the network, the blacklist can be configured to prevent illegal access, and when the blacklist strategy is configured, if a session hits the blacklist strategy, an alarm can be generated.
The detection probe system supports high-risk IP discovery: the method has the function of discovering the high-risk IP in the assets by detecting abnormal behaviors such as scanning, worm virus, Trojan horse, abnormal access frequency, abnormal access flow and the like. And simultaneously informing the reason for high risk and the like.
The detection probe system has a threat presentation function: the detection probe system can show the threat that the engine detected in real time at threat show interface, and the reality content needs to be comprehensive abundant, include: chinese name of the threat, level of the threat, prevalence of the threat, source ip of the threat, destination ip of the threat, and time of occurrence of the threat.
Preferably, the service auditing system comprises a system data center and a system auditing engine; the system data center comprises a management system and a report system, wherein the management system is used for managing and configuring the service audit system, and comprises system state monitoring and maintenance, audit object definition, audit rule definition and audit strategy configuration; the report system is used for recording and maintaining the audit log, retrieving, counting and analyzing the log, and can generate the audit report according to the requirements of the user;
the system audit engine is provided with a packet capturing module, an analysis module and a response module; the packet capturing module is used for capturing and recombining the network data packet and primarily filtering the network data packet according to a preset audit range; the analysis module is used for classifying, filtering and analyzing the network data packet, auditing important events and sessions according to auditing rules and detecting whether the network data packet carries key attack characteristics; the audit event, the session and the attack are submitted to a response module, and the response module is used for responding according to an audit strategy;
the service auditing system can automatically extract commands and fields according to the type of auditing service, and a user can select the extracted commands or fields as key objects to analyze.
The service auditing system supports a plurality of auditing engines which can be managed in a distributed mode at the same time, and auditing logs can be uniformly stored, inquired and analyzed. The service auditing system supports auditing various access behaviors aiming at the web service system, and comprises two access modes of HTTP and HTTPS. The business auditing system supports an automatic mode to establish the corresponding relation between web access and SQL access and generate an access behavior model base. The service auditing system supports the function of providing a data dictionary, the auditing record can be translated into key information, and the network language is converted into the service language, so that the service auditing system is popular and easy to understand. The service auditing system supports the playback of the audited operation information, and plays back the operation and return information of the service user on the webpage in a page mode. The service auditing system can expand and support accurate correlation auditing of human-application-database access in an application and database separation environment, and realizes the whole process recording and tracing of each service operation in the service environment. The content of the service auditing system correlation audit log needs to comprise information such as operation time, a service user name, a client IP, service operation, a service system IP, a database account number, a database IP, SQL statements and the like. The service auditing system supports scene-based service exception analysis; the information of access of abnormal account numbers, multi-IP login of the same account number, abnormal comparison of work load and work load, overtime of page response time and the like can be visually displayed. The service auditing system supports flow monitoring and access monitoring of the service system; it can provide the variation trend chart of the audited system service operation, the longitudinal comparison chart of the event quantity and the flow in different periods of the same system, etc. The service auditing system supports multi-level deployment, and the superior can check the running state, auditing reports and the like of the subordinate auditing system. The service auditing system supports the linkage with a Web Application Firewall (WAF), and can realize scene reduction display on the attack of the application system reported by the WAF. The service auditing system supports the extension of the auditing system, and can adopt a large data platform to store and analyze auditing logs, thereby greatly extending the storage space and the analysis capability.
The service auditing system audits aiming at the application system based on the http/https protocol. The method has the advantages that the traffic of the web application system is collected and analyzed in a bypass mode (mirror image mode), the operation of the application system is recorded, the operation in the web application system can be fully audited, the operation of key accounts can be monitored, and the access of key business modules can be monitored. The business auditing system mainly analyzes the operation compliance of the application system, finds abnormal operation and unauthorized behavior, provides a page simulation playback function, and tracks and positions responsible persons for restoring an operation scene; meanwhile, the product can analyze the safety of the service system and find out the risks of library collision attack, plaintext password transmission, non-fuzzified transmission of sensitive data, performance bottleneck of key service modules and the like.
Preferably, the Web application protection system performs Web attack protection in the following manner, including:
analyzing and extracting behavior characteristic data of the Web attack, and establishing a Web attack behavior characteristic library; analyzing network data in real time, constructing a virtual machine in a Web application protection system, generating a simulated attack behavior by using the virtual machine and the real-time network data, extracting simulated behavior characteristic data of the simulated attack behavior, matching the simulated behavior characteristic data with behavior characteristic data in a Web attack behavior characteristic library, and judging the attack behavior if the matching is successful;
the Web application protection system adopts the following modes to carry out Web malicious scanning protection, including: web vulnerability scanning protection: detecting all request messages of the HTTP, and enabling a web application protection system to discover scanning attack variables and take measures to carry out protection after scanning actions are detected; and (3) crawler protection: the web application protection system can detect and protect against malicious crawlers; CGI scan protection: the web application protection system can detect the access of the CGI type file, discover an attack behavior and take measures to protect; the Web application protection system adopts the following modes to protect Web malicious codes: the Web application protection system is internally provided with a WebShell library on one hand and intercepts malicious WebShell uploading, and on the other hand, a user can define and prohibit ASP or PHP page files from uploading based on a Web file uploading control function.
The Web application protection system performs HTTP/HTTPS flow analysis on the Web server, protects attacks targeting Web application program bugs, and optimizes Web application access aspects to improve usability, performance and safety of Web or network protocol applications and ensure that Web service applications can be delivered quickly, safely and reliably. The Web application defense system applies an HTTP session rule set that covers common Web attacks such as SQL injection, and XSS. Meanwhile, more attacks can be identified and prevented through self-defining rules. The method solves the security problem of Web systems which are not possessed by traditional equipment, such as a firewall, UTM and the like.
Preferably, the vulnerability scanning system discovers hosts in the scanned network and identifies attributes thereof, including: host name, device type, port condition, operating system, and open services;
the vulnerability scanning system adopts a preset standard to carry out unified rating on all vulnerabilities, the vulnerability scanning system utilizes the scores of the vulnerabilities to synthesize the protection level and the asset value of the scanned assets, adopts a preset risk assessment algorithm to evaluate the vulnerability risks of the host and the network, generates the vulnerability risk levels of the host and the network and makes a vulnerability risk management strategy;
the vulnerability scanning system has corresponding description for each vulnerability, including: the vulnerability specification, the system of influence, the platform of influence, the risk level and the involved standards and corresponding links, and provides vulnerability fix guidance schemes.
Preferably, the vulnerability scanning system is used for constructing a management system for tenants, and specifically includes: the vulnerability scanning system comprises a plurality of vulnerability scanning units and a management unit, wherein each vulnerability scanning unit corresponds to one area network, and the vulnerability scanning unit is used for being responsible for vulnerability scanning of the corresponding area network; the management unit is used for uniformly managing and monitoring the plurality of scanning units.
The vulnerability scanning system can provide vulnerability management service, periodically (monthly, quarterly and yearly) scans vulnerability security of host assets of tenants, and accurately discovers the surviving hosts in the scanned network. And after the security vulnerability information is found, the security vulnerability information is quickly displayed on a self-service portal and is communicated with an administrator through mails, short messages and the like. Various safety risks and hidden dangers can be effectively eliminated through the vulnerability scanning system, and the occurrence probability of safety events is reduced to the maximum extent.
Preferably, the security situation awareness system, the portal management system, the detection probe system, the service auditing system, the web application protection system and the vulnerability scanning system in the platform respectively correspond to one or more servers, the platform further comprises a server storage device, which is used for storing and transferring the servers, and the server storage device comprises:
the system comprises a machine room, a safety room, a transfer channel, a first upper guide rail, a second upper guide rail, a third upper guide rail, a first lower guide rail, a second lower guide rail, a third lower guide rail, a first butt joint guide rail, a second butt joint guide rail, a third butt joint guide rail and a fourth butt joint guide rail; the first upper guide rail is fixed at the top in the machine room, the preset end of the first upper guide rail extends to the top of the first transfer passage, the first lower guide rail is fixed on the ground in the machine room, and the preset end of the first lower guide rail extends to the bottom of the first transfer passage; the second upper guide rail is fixed at the inner top of the transfer channel, the left end of the second upper guide rail extends to the top of the left end of the transfer channel, and the right end of the second upper guide rail extends to the top of the right end of the transfer channel; the second lower guide rail is fixed at the bottom in the transfer channel, the left end of the second lower guide rail extends to the bottom of the left end of the transfer channel, and the right end of the second lower guide rail extends to the bottom of the right end of the transfer channel; the third upper guide rail is fixed on the top in the safety house, the preset end of the third upper guide rail extends to the top of the second transfer passage port, the third lower guide rail is fixed on the ground in the safety house, and the preset end of the third lower guide rail extends to the bottom of the second transfer passage port; the first butt joint guide rail is used for butt joint of the preset end of the first upper guide rail and the left end of the second upper guide rail; the second butt joint guide rail is used for butt joint the preset end of the first lower guide rail with the left end of the second lower guide rail; the third butt-joint guide rail is used for butt-joint the preset end of the third upper guide rail with the right end of the second upper guide rail; the fourth butt joint guide rail is used for butt joint of the preset end of the third lower guide rail and the right end of the second lower guide rail;
the machine room is provided with a machine room entrance and an exit and a first transfer passage port, the safety room is a closed room, the safety room is provided with a second transfer passage port, a sealing door is arranged at the second transfer passage port, one end of the transfer passage is communicated with the first transfer passage port, and the other end of the transfer passage is communicated with the second transfer passage port; be equipped with a plurality of cabinets in the computer lab, install a plurality ofly in every cabinet the server, cabinet top fixedly connected with rings, the rack bottom is equipped with the installation base, and installation base bottom is equipped with a plurality of butt joint holes and is used for the recess that the guide rail passed, still be equipped with a plurality of transfer structures in the computer lab, it includes to shift the structure:
the device comprises a sliding block, a first electric trolley, a traction rope, an electric hoist and a second electric trolley; the slider is used for sliding on first to third upper guideway, and electric block fixes on the slider, and first electronic dolly is used for moving on first to third upper guideway, haulage rope one end and first electronic dolly fixed connection, and the haulage rope other end is used for pulling the rack, and the electronic dolly of second is used for moving on first to third lower guideway, and the electronic dolly upper surface of second is equipped with a plurality of butt joint posts that are used for inserting the butt joint hole.
The invention also provides a disaster rescue method based on the server storage device, which is used for safely transferring the server when a flood or fire disaster happens in the machine room, and the method comprises the following steps:
opening a sealing door of the safety house, and butting the preset end of the first upper guide rail with the left end of the second upper guide rail; butting the preset end of the first lower guide rail with the left end of the second lower guide rail; butting the preset end of the third upper guide rail with the right end of the second upper guide rail; butting the preset end of the third lower guide rail with the right end of the second lower guide rail;
embedding a sliding block and a first electric trolley into a first upper guide rail, then sliding the sliding block to the upper part of the cabinet, and then fixing the sliding block, wherein the sliding block is positioned behind the sliding direction of the first electric trolley;
then, opening the electric hoist, butting a lifting hook of the electric hoist with a lifting ring on the cabinet, and then lifting the cabinet by using the electric hoist to a preset height;
then, a second electric trolley is arranged on the first lower guide rail, the second electric trolley is moved to the position below the hoisted cabinet, then the cabinet is put down, and the butt joint column is inserted into the corresponding butt joint hole of the installation base;
then separating the lifting hook from the lifting ring, simultaneously starting the first electric trolley and the second electric trolley, and moving the cabinet into a safety room;
and after all the cabinets are moved into the safety room, the third butt joint guide rail and the fourth butt joint guide rail are detached, and the sealing door is closed.
One or more technical schemes provided by the invention at least have the following technical effects or advantages:
the platform can carry out uniform safety management on resources and networks of the private network tenants, guarantees the information safety and the network safety of the tenants, improves the safety of the private network in the private network platform, adopts various safety technical means, and has higher safety and more comprehensive safety protection.
