Example one
Referring to fig. 1, an embodiment of the present invention provides a tenant-based security capability and security service chain management platform, where the platform includes: the system comprises a security situation perception system, a portal management system and a cloud security resource pool;
the security situation awareness system is used for acquiring security element information of tenants in the platform, analyzing the acquired security element information to obtain an analysis result, generating a corresponding security situation prediction result based on the analysis result, presenting the security situation prediction result to the tenants through the portal management system, and generating and executing a corresponding security disposal strategy based on the security situation prediction result;
the portal management system is used for managing tenants in the platform by logging in the portal management system by a manager, and managing self resources of the tenants by logging in the portal management system by the tenants, wherein the tenants are isolated from each other;
the cloud security resource pool comprises: the system comprises a detection probe system, a service auditing system, a web application protection system and a vulnerability scanning system;
the detection probe system is used for monitoring threats of a network of tenants in the platform and displaying the monitored threats to corresponding tenants through the portal management system;
the service auditing system is used for accessing a tenant service network, capturing network access flow, analyzing a network data packet according to a distributed auditing strategy, extracting an auditing event and responding;
the Web application protection system is used for performing Web attack protection, Web malicious scanning protection, Web malicious code protection and information leakage protection on tenants in the platform;
the vulnerability scanning system is used for scanning the network of the tenant to discover the host, scanning the host to discover vulnerabilities and vulnerabilities of different application objects on the host, evaluating the vulnerabilities, vulnerability risks of the host and the network, and generating a vulnerability repair guidance scheme based on an evaluation result; the vulnerability scanning system is also used for auditing the security policy of the tenant; the vulnerability scanning system is also used for constructing a management system for the tenants and displaying the corresponding results of the vulnerability scanning system to the tenants through the portal management system.
Example two
In the second embodiment, a general implementation schematic diagram of the security situation awareness system in the second embodiment is shown in fig. 2:
as shown in fig. 2, the security situation awareness system is a platform built on the existing security protection facility, and can compatibly integrate various existing or to-be-built security devices, security subsystems, or any security data information sources in the user network, such as firewalls, IDS, antivirus, WAF, APT, honeypot systems, threat information, and the like. Based on the butt joint of any safety equipment and data source, the situation awareness platform realizes the situation awareness capacity through the fusion analysis and presentation of safety data, and comprises the centralized acquisition and acquisition of situation information, the big data storage of massive safety situation information, the situation awareness-oriented big data centralized analysis and the situation awareness visual presentation.
The security situation perception system combs and summarizes various security elements and monitoring angles related to the security situation according to business requirements, and forms a situation perception system formed by combining eight dimensions. The eight dimensions are respectively asset situation, attack situation, operation perception, vulnerability situation, risk situation, threat situation, website situation and stream situation, and the eight perception systems are fused to form a situation overview facing comprehensive situation monitoring, as shown in fig. 3.
Through the perception of the eight dimensions, the security situation perception system can present a relatively universal and complete panoramic image of the network security situation for the tenant. In the special analysis presentation and extension of the eight dimensions, tenants can focus on integration and match according to needs to form a security situation sensing system suitable for self business needs and security situation monitoring needs.
The security situation perception system obtains necessary data through situation elements, and then situation observation understanding is carried out through data analysis, so that situation prediction in a short time in the future is achieved. The security situation perception system is a perception system for collecting, analyzing and presenting security information established under a big data information processing architecture. The security situation awareness system is composed of four layers of frameworks, namely a security element acquisition layer, a security big data storage layer, a security situation analysis layer and a situation awareness and display layer, and the four layers of frameworks actually correspond to a classical three-level model of situation awareness, as shown in fig. 4.
As can be seen from fig. 4, the secure element collection and secure big data storage implement a first level: situation elements are obtained, and the security situation analysis realizes the second level: situation understanding, situation perception and display embody the third level: and (5) situation prediction. The security situation awareness system has a good architecture foundation, covers all main links for realizing situation awareness, and provides powerful system platform support for enterprises to realize situation awareness.
The safety situation awareness system function is divided into five parts on the whole, and the five parts are respectively: information acquisition, information analysis, security disposition, user presentation view and system support.
Information acquisition: the method and the device realize the collection of the security element information such as the asset information, the performance information, the log and security event information, the stream information, the configuration security information, the vulnerability information and the like of the IT resources of the client.
Information analysis: aiming at various collected safety factor information, the system realizes performance and availability analysis, configuration conformance analysis, safety event analysis, flow behavior analysis, safety and compliance analysis, vulnerability analysis, risk analysis and macroscopic situation analysis. Wherein, the risk analysis comprises asset value analysis, vulnerability analysis, threat analysis, risk assessment, influence analysis and the like; the macro situation analysis comprises address entropy analysis, hotspot analysis, key safety index analysis, business health degree analysis and key management index analysis.
Safe disposal: including routine handling and exception handling. Routine treatment is mainly embodied in the form of a planning task work order; exception handling is primarily embodied in the form of response management and alarm work order processing. In addition, the system also comprises the functions of safety early warning management and notification management.
And (3) supporting a system: the method comprises asset management, service management, report management, system self management, authority management, cascade management, knowledge management and a global security information base.
The security situation perception system is a massive information acquisition and processing system based on a big data architecture. The security situation perception system provides a collection function, a storage function, a centralized analysis function and a comprehensive situation display function of massive security information in a layering manner. The security situation awareness system provides an open security element information acquisition architecture, is not separately deployed in a user network, but is used for accessing various security devices, protection engines, data traffic and external threat information in an existing network in a rich interface mode, and also comprises a security device system which is possibly expanded in the future. On the basis of uniformly acquiring massive security information, the security situation perception system focuses on comprehensively utilizing the monitoring data to perform centralized analysis processing, recognizes security situations, senses threats and risks through data fusion processing means such as sorting, simplifying and filtering, contrast statistics, key identification, trend induction, correlation analysis, mining prediction and the like, and performs situation perception visual presentation according to user service characteristics and security requirements.
The process of implementing the omnibearing situation awareness by the security situation awareness system roughly comprises 4 steps, namely acquisition of various security element information, situation awareness-oriented centralized data analysis, presentation of multidimensional situation awareness, early warning notification and disposal, and the process is shown in fig. 5.
(1) Obtaining various types of safety factor information: the security situation awareness system acquires various security element information influencing the security situation of the network environment by butting various security devices, subsystems and security data sources in the network, wherein the security element information comprises attack information, object weakness information, system operation information and external threat information.
(2) Situation awareness-oriented centralized data analysis: on the basis of gathering massive multi-directional safety factor information, the safety situation sensing system integrates the data, and performs data fusion, association analysis and mining analysis for cognition and monitoring of the overall safety situation. The method comprises the steps of analyzing the degree of attack threat received by assets and business objects and the risk degree of the assets and the business objects, analyzing the attack process and the attack target of complex attack, analyzing the damage and the influence range of the attack, analyzing the source tracing of the attack threat, comparing external threat information with internal safety information, and the like. These analytical processing tasks will provide support for data and computational tasks for the upper-level posture presentation.
(3) Presentation of multidimensional situation awareness: through comprehensive security element acquisition and centralized processing and analysis of data information, the security situation perception system can present all-around situation perception for users. The method is characterized in that eight main dimensions of asset situation, attack situation, operation situation, vulnerability situation, risk situation, threat situation, website situation and flow situation and a security situation summary are used as a situation perception implementation framework, the understanding and construction of slicing of a large and complex situation perception information processing system are facilitated through the eight dimensions, and all security element information can be collected and processed around the dimensions.
Some of the main contents corresponding to the perception of 8 dimensions include the following:
asset situation: and combing the assets, the service system and the security domain of the whole network by taking the assets as a center, and examining the safety of the assets from the perspective of the protected object. By the dimension, the safety condition of the assets in the whole network, the asset discovery, completion and correction conditions, the asset source, the value distribution, the system version, the network segment distribution, the application port type, the exposure surface of the assets, the asset type and other factors can be known in real time, and the current situation of the assets in the whole network is analyzed and presented.
Attack situation: the source, target, scale, impact and outcome of all attack behaviors are perceived. And displaying dynamic attack conditions on a map, classifying and describing attack type trends, displaying distribution of attack ports, and ranking attack sources top 10. And performing list analysis by using factors such as the name, attack times, event quantity, duration, event increment and the like of the attack event, and evaluating and analyzing the current attack situation from the view angles of the service system and the security domain.
The operation situation is as follows: and (4) sensing related security situations from the system operation angle of supporting production services, and monitoring the number of equipment in the whole network, the equipment availability and the performance condition. The method comprises the following steps of performing association analysis by combining network topology and fault diagnosis topology, sensing service operation situation, and performing advanced prevention treatment on risks and threats affecting system operation.
Vulnerability posture: and sensing the vulnerability and vulnerability situation exposed by each layer in the network and possibly utilized. The method mainly comprises vulnerability detection and verification, such as vulnerability updating time, distance from maximum scanning time, asset vulnerability quantity, type distribution, influence range, hazard degree, change trend, grade distribution, detection rate, processing condition and the like in the system; and the check compliance rate, the weak password detection rate and the asset type distribution, the check items influencing the assets most, the open ports and other dimensions are analyzed, and the vulnerability situation of the current service is mastered, so that the reinforcement and the pre-defense strategy are formulated in advance.
Risk situation: and (4) sensing the risk situation affecting the normal operation of the service by taking the safety condition of the whole network as a center. The risk situation of the whole network can be clearly observed and understood by mainly analyzing and presenting dimensions such as security domain risk level and level distribution, vulnerability of assets, attacked risk index, facing threat and threat distribution and the like in combination with the description of an attack relation diagram, so that the risk situation of the whole network is perceived, and guiding guidance is provided for the safety construction of the whole network.
Threat situation: the method is mainly based on internal and external information and supported by depending on information source access, thereby not only supporting Venus eye of the user, but also supporting other information manufacturers and the access of open source information and internal information. The threat situation formed by the service system is sensed by analyzing and presenting factors such as information sources, information types, information contents, information updating conditions, information geographical distribution and the like and comparing the factors with the information of the service system per se.
Website situation: the method is mainly perceived through risks faced by the website, vulnerability of the website, usability and the like. The method comprises the steps of carrying out situation analysis and presentation on dimensions such as Trojan hanging, tampering, loopholes, sensitive word statistics, attacked conditions of websites, loophole conditions, vulnerability ranking, usability detection and the like. Therefore, the system can be used for reinforcing and blocking in time and ensuring the continuous and safe operation of the service website.
The flow situation is as follows: network attacks including real-time access topology, session conditions, asset and port activity conditions are depicted through dimensionalities of current flow distribution conditions, access relations, flow trends, protocol ports, alarm conditions and the like, and current network flow situations are intuitively mastered by combining an intelligent analysis model, so that decision support is provided for network security construction.
The security situation perception system can also perform attack chain analysis statistics: the attack chain divides the attack into five stages of investigation, penetration, attack and trap, control, damage and the like according to the event type, and provides analysis data for reference for a user through information of a source IP, a target IP, the event type, the event number and the like of events in each stage. Carrying out whole-process monitoring presentation on the attacked condition of the whole network service assets; the real-time attack process trend is mastered, and timely and effective response treatment is carried out; and (4) recording attack context information, storing evidence, and simultaneously knowing the attack rule, attack technique and attack intention of an attacker, thereby providing theoretical support for subsequent defense, trapping and countermeasures.
EXAMPLE III
The portal management system includes: the system comprises a cloud security management platform and a security self-service portal; the cloud security management platform performs unified management, provides services required by various service scenes, and provides operation entrances of administrators and tenants. The cloud security management platform adopts a Kubernetes (K8S) container cloud framework, and can be deployed on a hardware server or in a virtualization and cloud environment.
The secure self-service portal enables multi-tenant management, which simply means that a single instance can serve multiple organizations. The multi-tenant technology is how to provide services, which are the same as or even customizable to a plurality of clients, in a single system architecture and service in a shared data center, and can still guarantee data isolation of customers. A system supporting multi-tenant technology needs to perform virtual partitioning on its data and configuration in design, so that each tenant or organization of the system can use a separate system instance, and each tenant can perform personalized configuration on the leased system instance according to its own needs.
The security self-service portal supports the creation of a plurality of tenants, a required security virtual machine can be created in a security resource pool for each tenant, a service chain is arranged, and the tenant can log in a portal entrance of the tenant through an account to manage the security virtual machine to which the tenant belongs.
In the cloud security management platform, the required security capability can be selected in a security service package mode, and a corresponding security virtual machine is created. The security service package is composed of basic service packages, the basic service packages are composed of security network elements and resource templates, and the hierarchical structure of the whole service package is shown in fig. 6.
Example four
The detection probe system adopts a technical route combining a characteristic detection technology and abnormal behavior detection. The feature detection technology is specifically realized through a built-in feature library, a virus library, a malicious sample library, a malicious URL library and a custom feature. The abnormal behavior detection technology is specifically realized by built-in C & C, network scanning, worm and other behavior models.
The system architecture is shown in fig. 7, and includes:
an acquisition layer: the system is responsible for data acquisition on a network, and can acquire data packets and flow as required; detection layer: packet detection, flow detection, file detection and threat information collision are carried out on data and flow by adopting the modes of feature detection, algorithm detection, file detection, association detection, knowledge base detection and the like; a storage layer: the data packets and the flow can be stored according to the requirement; analysis layer: according to the detection result, a threat cue analysis function is provided, and various types of collected log data are analyzed and displayed from a sample view angle, a C & C view angle, a malicious URL view angle and an event view angle respectively; a display layer: threat situation display, event alarm and query, and the like; configuring a management layer: related policy configuration and device management operations.
The detection probe system has full-flow acquisition capability: through the flexible and powerful function of automatically acquiring the data, a user can acquire the network data in a user-defined mode and store the acquired network data in a user-defined format file mode.
The detection probe system has the intrusion detection capability: the detection probe system adopts a method of combining a characteristic detection technology, an abnormal behavior detection technology, a threat intelligence technology, a black and white list technology, a baseline technology and a static APT detection technology, and realizes comprehensive and effective detection of various threats such as viruses, trojans, worms, botnets, buffer overflow attacks, denial of service attacks, scanning detection, cheating hijacking, SQL injection, XSS attacks, website Trojan hanging, hidden channels, AET escape, C & C behaviors and the like through deep packet analysis and flow analysis of network flow.
The detection probe system realizes the automatic detection of known threats and unknown threats by a built-in characteristic library, a virus library, an abnormal behavior model library, a threat intelligence library such as malicious URLs (uniform resource locators), malicious samples and the like.
The static APT detection of the system detection probe system is a detection method for matching or calculating the binary content of the detected file through a certain characteristic comparison or algorithm, and the detected file is not actually operated through static detection. The detection probe system performs static detection on the file content of the detected file in various modes such as virtual Shellcode execution, brute force search hidden PE and the like, so as to determine whether the file is a malicious file.
The detection probe system supports the functions of restoring files from network disk protocols such as hectometre, 360 and new wave, WebMail protocols such as 126 and 163 and new wave, and standard protocols such as http, ftp, pop3, smtp and imap based on a built-in malicious sample library, detecting malicious files in real time, and manually uploading a file sample by a user to detect the malicious files.
The detection probe system supports detection based on a black and white list, and a user can detect violation services and unknown services by defining the black and white list. The detection probe system supports a baseline-based flow alarm function, and a user can alarm by setting alarm thresholds for different types of flows or automatically comparing the system with historical and contemporaneous flows. The detection probe system has virus detection capability, supports virus detection and file detection, and detects the file content of the detected file through a feature matching or detection algorithm so as to determine whether the file is a malicious file, wherein the file type identification is based on file features rather than extensions, and the file extension can still be effectively identified after being changed.
The detection probe system has unknown threat behavior detection capability: the system has the capability of detecting unknown threats, and supports the detection of unknown Trojan C & C behaviors, network scanning behaviors and worm behaviors through typical behavior analysis and research on Trojan C & C activities, network scanning activities and worm activities. For example, the characteristics of C & C behavior include: and establishing network connection between the attacker and the attack target, so that the attack target is under the control of the attacker and can receive the command of the attacker and return an execution result. This determines that the behavior of the network connection is different from the normal network connection behavior, for example, the network connection has the typical characteristics of reverse connection behavior, heartbeat behavior, data encryption behavior and the like.
The detection probe system has the detection capability of self-defined rules: the system is based on a flexible rule description language technology, provides an open user interface for customizing the detection rule, can meet the abnormal detection requirement of more fitting user service, and can realize abnormal logging behaviors such as abnormal time, abnormal IP (Internet protocol) and multi-IP (Internet protocol) logging, and abnormal service behaviors such as malicious service subscription, high-frequency service access and service detour.
The detection probe system has stiff wood creep detection capability: the quality of the feature library of the original intrusion detection system is continuously updated and optimized, thousands of selected events representing mainstream dead wood crawling attacks exist, and by issuing an accurate dead wood crawling event library, when a data packet in a network is matched with a rule, a terminal or equipment which is planted with a Trojan horse or is controlled by an external hacker is immediately found in the network, and a danger source is positioned. Meanwhile, in order to emphasize the timeliness of the event, the special Trojan horse is discovered by sensing abnormal behavior detection such as C & C channels, network scanning and worm activities of unknown Trojan horses.
The detection probe system has intrusion response capability: for the detected intrusion event, the system supports a plurality of response modes, including event log recording, alarm, original message recording and the like. The system supports various alarm modes such as syslog, SNMP Trap, mail, short message, page prompt and the like. Seamless connection with a third-party system can be realized through a syslog and SNMP Trap mode. The system supports policy-based primitive message logging and event-based primitive message logging. The user can make the system record the concerned flow by configuring the strategy, or record the characteristic message of the trigger event when the system detects that the specific event is generated.
The detection probe system has query statistics capability: the system has rich inquiry and statistic functions, including event classification statistics, event source distribution statistics and map display, sample classification statistics, virus event and source statistics, attack type statistics, domain name analysis, intra-environment interconnection relationship statistics and map display, and extra-environment interconnection relationship statistics and map display. In order to meet the personalized analysis requirements of users, the system provides a flexible access relation analysis engine and a user operation interface, and users can utilize abundant query conditions, query result merging conditions, statistical result sorting conditions and the like to realize the analysis requirements of different dimensions such as external connection analysis, unknown interconnection analysis, port analysis, active IP analysis and the like.
The detection probe system has threat analysis capability: the system provides a threat cue analysis function, and can analyze and display various types of collected log data from a sample view angle, a C & C view angle, a malicious URL view angle and an event view angle respectively. In addition, the system also analyzes and displays various events from the perspective of an attacker and an attacker based on the mailbox address of the IP address. The display mode is mainly performed by combining a chart and a list, statistics and summarization can be performed according to different dimensions such as event types and levels, and the charts such as pie charts and trend charts are used for visual display. Aiming at the list data, the system adopts a downward step-by-step tracing mode to track and analyze the clues, so that the user can better track the events and respond and process in time, and the visual management of the events is effectively improved. The correlation analysis is to perform correlation analysis on internal and external data stored in the system, and mainly comprises sample and threat information correlation, sample and feature detection information correlation analysis, behavior correlation information analysis, and multidimensional correlation drilling of sample fingerprints, hidden channels (IP + ports, URLs and domain names), geographic information and feature events. According to the sample log reported by the acquisition engine, the correlation analysis can be carried out with the host which has received the attack and has generated the C & C channel in the current system according to the behaviors of the host and the sample log, the matching can be carried out according to the corresponding attack path in the attack chain process, and the stage to which the host belongs can be found so as to trap the attack or be scanned.
The detection probe system has threat management capabilities: the system focuses on the design concept of simple configuration, and mainly aims at the simplicity of threat management. Threat management involves: the method comprises four parts of threat discovery, threat presentation, threat analysis and threat processing, wherein the four parts form closed-loop threat management. The system adopts a comprehensive detection technology to ensure the accuracy of threat discovery; the method of combining the multidimensional graph, the table and the data is adopted to ensure the simplicity and the sufficiency of threat display; meanwhile, events which do not need to be concerned are filtered out through an intelligent analysis filtering method, and the quality of threat exhibition is guaranteed; the application of a de-technologized wizard helps the user to analyze and process the threat, and in addition, an automatic processing mechanism also reduces the maintenance workload of the user to the maximum extent.
The detection probe system has flow statistics capability: the system has multi-dimensional traffic statistics and monitoring capability, and comprises traffic statistics of applications such as total traffic, Web traffic, mail traffic, database traffic and P2P traffic, microscopic traffic statistics such as P2P, DNS, IP/ports, key protocols, key operation and maintenance, key Web behaviors and the like, IP-to-traffic statistics, port traffic statistics, IP traffic statistics and the like.
EXAMPLE five
The service auditing system is a BS framework and supports a user to access and manage by utilizing an IE browser. The system mainly comprises a data center and an auditing engine. The data center provides a management interface for the outside, and is mainly responsible for managing the auditing system, configuring the auditing strategy and storing the auditing logs for the user to inquire and analyze. The auditing engine can access to a user service network by a bypass, captures network access flow, deeply analyzes a network data packet according to an auditing strategy distributed by a user, extracts an auditing event and responds.
The main architecture of the business auditing system is shown in fig. 8.
The data center is composed of a management system and a report system, the management system is responsible for managing and configuring the whole service audit system, including system state monitoring and maintenance, audit object definition, rule definition, audit strategy configuration and the like, and the report system is responsible for recording and maintaining audit logs, retrieving logs, counting and analyzing and can generate audit reports in various formats according to user requirements.
The work basis of the audit engine is an audit strategy, a packet capturing, analyzing and responding module is arranged in the equipment, and the packet capturing module is responsible for capturing and recombining network data packets, performing preliminary filtering according to a preset audit range and preparing for subsequent analysis; the analysis module classifies, filters and analyzes the network database by using technologies such as state detection, protocol analysis and the like, audits important events and sessions according to audit rules, and simultaneously detects whether the data packet carries key attack characteristics. The audit event, the session and the attack are submitted to a response module, the response module is responsible for responding according to an audit strategy, and the audit event, the session and the attack are uploaded to a data center for storage, an event is sent to a real-time alarm interface for alarm, key threat operation is blocked, and the audit log can also be sent to other external systems in a mail, Syslog and SNMP information mode.
The main functions of the service auditing system comprise:
web application access auditing: in a common service system, most services are accessed based on a Web mode. The client accesses the application system through the modes of HTTP, HTTPS and the like. The service auditing system can monitor the network data flow accessed by the application system and analyze the data flow so as to achieve the comprehensive auditing of the service system access.
In order to clarify the auditing scope and enable the auditing log to be presented in a business language, the business system and operation to be audited need to be defined.
And (3) defining a service system: the service auditing system can define various service systems by using network language, including IP of service system, service type and port provided, entry characteristics, etc. After the definition of the service system is completed, the auditing system can classify and analyze various services according to different service systems.
Self-learning of business operation rules:
the service auditing system can automatically learn various service operation rules to form an operation rule list, and an administrator only needs to select and correspond each operation rule in the list to a specific service operation to form a service operation definition. The heavy workload of defining business operation one by an administrator is saved, and the management cost is saved.
Self-defining the business rules:
the business audit system supports automatic learning of business rules and self-definition of the rules, and allows a user to set and adjust triggering conditions and response strategies of various safety audit events. For example, the login operation characteristics of different service users are similar, but the internal parts of Post are slightly different, and the login operation template obtained through self-learning can be adjusted to the template characteristics by the administrator in the Post content part, i.e. the Post template with commonality can be used for matching various login contents.
The business auditing system can realize a fine-grained auditing strategy: in order to make the auditing system complete auditing work, a user needs to determine an auditing target and an auditing range in advance, namely an auditing strategy, which comprises an audited business system, a business user, a business operation type (a business rule set) and the like. In many cases, a user only concerns about key service access behaviors of part of users, so that an auditing system is required to provide operation-level policy definition, and fine-grained auditing policy definition is guarantee for accurate auditing.
The service auditing system can automatically extract commands and fields according to the type of auditing service, and a user can select the extracted commands or fields as key objects to analyze. Aiming at database services, a database name, a table name, a command and other lists can be analyzed and formed; for web services, a list of URLs, access patterns, etc. can be analyzed and formed. Through the intelligent analysis function, the analysis process of the user on the audit data can be simplified, and the analysis efficiency is greatly improved.
The service auditing system can audit the sensitive data assets: application systems often store critical data assets, and sensitive data is part of the data assets. Such data, if violated or obtained illegally by internal and external customers, can pose a very high risk to organizations, including loss of property and reputation. The service auditing system can audit various access behaviors of sensitive data assets in a targeted manner, and the purposes of real-time alarming and source tracing are achieved.
The service auditing system can discover violation of service: based on the auditing strategy, the business auditing system can find various violations and unauthorized behaviors of the business system visitors. The business personnel executes the operation beyond the business range, such as issuing excessive orders, charging excessive for certain account number and the like, which are often illegal operations. Strictly speaking, each application system has its own right control rule, but not all application systems can be strictly limited, and when the security of the system is not enough, an unauthorized operation will occur. The operation can be audited by the service auditing system, and the warning can be timely initiated.
The service auditing system can analyze the service exception: the service auditing system can analyze the abnormity in service access, and can provide an alarm when access abnormity occurs in a certain key service, such as the operation frequency exceeds a limit value in a certain time period. The method can effectively early warn scenes such as database collision attack, high-frequency client information query and the like. In addition, the user can customize the business process, and mining analysis can be performed on the operation which does not conform to the business process.
EXAMPLE six
The web application protection system has the following functions:
web attack protection: the Web application protection system has the detection and defense capabilities of SQL injection attack and XSS attack, the detection and defense capabilities of Web malicious scanning protection, the virtual patch function, the import of the scanning result of the IBM AppScan scanner and the automatic generation of the protection strategy according to the scanning result. The HTTPS encryption and decryption algorithm supports an international algorithm and a national encryption algorithm and has the functions of detecting and protecting HTTPS encryption and decryption attack flow. The web application protection system has a violence scanning protection function and prevents a website from being cracked violently. The XML DoS detection and defense capability is provided. The system has the capabilities of SYN Flood/UDP Flood/ICMP Flood attack detection and defense. The system has a website lock function, locks the website and can set the locking time according to the date and the period. The method has a Web environment sensing function, and automatically identifies the operating system, the server type, the language and the middleware of the protected server. The method has a Slow attack protection function, and effectively protects Slow attacks such as a Slow heads mode, a Slow body mode, a Slow read mode and the like. The password protection device has the weak password protection function, and can detect the functions of logging in by a user through a weak password, detecting the intensity of a user registration password and the like. The system has HTTP Flood (CC attack) detection and defense capability. The system has the capability of detecting and defending CSRF attacks, and the CSRF supports the self-learning function. And the function of preventing Cookie information from being tampered is supported, and the function at least comprises attribute settings such as Cookie signature, Cookie self-learning and Cookie encryption.
web application compliance and delivery:
the web application defense system is provided with a URL-based application layer access control function. The web application protection system supports compliance checking for HTTP request header information. The method and the parameter length in the HTTP request information are detected aiming at the specified URL page. And information return protection of fingerprints, HTTP error pages, bank cards, identity cards and the like of the Web server operating system is supported. The method supports a file uploading and downloading control function, a real file identification function and a Web form keyword filtering function. The webpage tamper-proofing function aiming at the hotspot URL is supported, and meanwhile, no additional influence is caused on the Web server and the Web application system.
And (3) Web attack protection:
the SQL injection attack utilizes the defects that the Web application program does not check and filter input data, and injects a malicious SQL command into a background database engine for execution, thereby achieving the purposes of stealing data and even controlling a database server. XSS attack means that a malicious attacker inserts a malicious HTML code into a Web page, and when a victim browses the Web page, the HTML code embedded in the Web page can be executed by the Web client of the victim, so that the malicious purpose is achieved.
Just because the attacks such as SQL injection and XSS utilize defects of each page instead of general vulnerabilities, the number of variant and variant attacks is very large, and if the detection is carried out by a common method, the false alarm rate and the false alarm rate are extremely high. The Web application protection system adopts an attack method analysis method instead of an attack code characteristic analysis method, and can accurately and comprehensively detect and defend the Web attack behaviors.
Specifically, a Web service threat detection algorithm is adopted, and the algorithm is divided into two stages: the first stage is a behavior extraction stage, which analyzes and extracts the behavior characteristics of the Web attack instead of the data characteristics and establishes a Web attack behavior characteristic library; and the second stage is to analyze the network data in real time, construct a light virtual machine in the web application protection system, simulate the attack behavior to observe the behavior characteristics of the attack behavior, and correctly judge the occurrence of the attack behavior. The detection mode based on the principle avoids high false alarm rate caused by matching of the solidification characteristics and also avoids false alarm caused by too strict detection rules.
Web malicious code protection:
briefly, WebShell is an ASP or PHP Trojan backdoor, and after an attacker invades a website, the Trojan backdoor files are often placed in a website directory of a Web server and mixed with normal page files. Then, an attacker can control the Web server through the ASP or PHP trojan backdoor based on a Web mode, upload and download files, check a database, execute any program command and the like. Since the data exchanged with the controlled Web server is transferred through the 80 port, the WebShell is not intercepted by other network security devices. Meanwhile, the WebShell is used, generally, records cannot be left in the system log, only some data submission records can be left in the website log, and an inexperienced administrator is difficult to see the intrusion traces.
On one hand, the Web application protection system is internally provided with a mainstream WebShell library to intercept malicious WebShell uploading, and on the other hand, based on a Web file uploading control function, a user can define to prohibit ASP or PHP page files from uploading, so that malicious attacks based on WebShell are effectively prevented.
Web application compliance:
the HTTP protocol compliance is to make compliance check on the HTTP request, if the request not conforming to the set regulation is discarded, the request conforming to the regulation is processed as a normal request.
Aiming at the HTTP request, the web application protection system can limit the length of a request head, the number of Cookies, the number of HTTP protocol parameters, the length of protocol parameter values, the length of protocol parameter names and the like in request information. And for the detected out-of-compliance request, allowing the discarding or returning error page processing to be carried out, and recording a corresponding log. The web application protection system supports the self-learning function of the request information, can automatically count a series of data of the request header information within the learning time, and provides reference for the user to set parameters. The method can actively defend various hacker attacks, avoid the hacker attacks or prevent malicious damage to the computing resources of the server.
Aiming at a specified URL, the web application protection system can define a method (such as POST, OPTION, TRACE, DELETE and the like) allowed by the HTTP page, the URL length and the query character string length, check reasonable values of parameters of various applications, allow discarding or returning error page processing for detected out-of-compliance requests, and record corresponding logs. The method can prevent illegal detection or overflow attack aiming at the Web server, and avoid hacker attack or stop maliciously damaging the computing resources of the server to the maximum extent.
EXAMPLE six
The sixth embodiment of the invention specifically introduces a vulnerability scanning system.
The vulnerability scanning system can provide vulnerability management service, periodically (monthly, quarterly and yearly) scans vulnerability security of host assets of a user, and accurately discovers the surviving host in the scanned network. And after the security vulnerability information is found, the security vulnerability information is quickly displayed on a self-service portal and is communicated with an administrator through mails, short messages and the like. Through the service pack, various safety risks and hidden dangers can be effectively eliminated, and the occurrence probability of safety events is reduced to the maximum extent.
Asset discovery and management: the vulnerability scanning system comprehensively, quickly and accurately discovers the survived host in the scanned network by comprehensively using various means (host survival detection, intelligent port detection, operating system fingerprint identification and the like), accurately identifies the attributes of the survived host, including the host name, the equipment type, the port condition, the operating system, open services and the like, and prepares for further vulnerability scanning. Meanwhile, the asset management function of the vulnerability scanning system can provide convenience for IT assets of users, and meanwhile, the vulnerability scanning system is used as a basic part for vulnerability risk assessment and provides a basis for assessing vulnerability risks of a host and a network.
A system vulnerability scanning module: the progressive scanning method can enable the vulnerability scanning system to carry out targeted scanning by utilizing the discovered asset information, discover the vulnerabilities and vulnerabilities of different application objects (operating systems and application software) on the host computer, and simultaneously ensure the rapidness of the scanning process and the accuracy of the results. The scanning object comprises various common network hosts, operating systems, database systems, network equipment, application systems, common software, cloud computing platforms, Apple platforms and the like.
And (3) vulnerability risk assessment: vulnerability scanning systems can assess and qualify vulnerabilities, risks of vulnerabilities of hosts and networks. The vulnerability scanning system adopts the latest CVSS v2 standard to carry out unified rating on all vulnerabilities and objectively display the risk levels of the vulnerabilities. On the basis, the vulnerability scanning system utilizes the CVSS score of the vulnerability to synthesize the protection level and the asset value of the scanned asset, adopts a risk assessment algorithm formulated by reference national standards, can make quantitative and qualitative comprehensive evaluation on the vulnerability risk of the host and the network, helps a user to determine the vulnerability risk level of the host and the network, and prepares a reasonable vulnerability risk management strategy. The description of the vulnerability information comprises CVSS scores, vulnerability risk assessment conclusions of the host and the network can be directly reflected in vulnerability assessment reports, and suggestions are made on risk control measures.
Guidance for vulnerability repair: through CVSS scoring, the vulnerability scanning system can directly provide priority guidance for repair work to ensure that the most dangerous vulnerability is repaired first. Each vulnerability of the vulnerability scanning system is described in detail, and comprises the description of the vulnerability, the system, the platform, the risk level, the corresponding relation of standard CNCVE, CVE, CNNVD, BUGTRAQ and the like, and link information, and a repairing scheme is provided, such as system reinforcing suggestion, a security configuration step, patch downloading link and the like, and the information can help a user to establish comprehensive knowledge of the vulnerability and correctly complete vulnerability repairing work.
And (4) safety strategy auditing: a user can perform trend comparative analysis based on a host, a network and weaknesses through the regular execution of a planning task, and audit a risk control strategy and the conventional repair work so as to evaluate the effectiveness of the risk control strategy and the vulnerability management work and provide decision support for the adjustment of a security strategy.
Constructing a unified management system:
the vulnerability scanning system can assist large-scale information system users to construct a complete unified vulnerability management system. The user can deploy independent scanning units in different network domains, and the independent scanning units are respectively responsible for vulnerability scanning in the respective network domains, so that scanning loss caused by the fact that a single scanning unit is difficult to overcome access control obstacles between network domains is avoided. Meanwhile, through a management control center of the vulnerability scanning system, a user can realize unified management and monitoring of a plurality of independent scanning units, and when the number of the scanning units is large, the management pressure can be shared in a hierarchical management mode to form a unified hierarchical management system.

In the prior art, waterproof and fireproof protection is mainly needed in protection of a machine room, flood and fire disasters of the machine room in the prior art are monitored and alarmed through a monitoring system, and then workers are informed to conduct emergency treatment, but when the machine room is faced with stronger flood and fire disasters and cannot be blocked or splashed, if the water or fire can not be controlled, the monitoring and alarming on a server are extremely small, and the server in the machine room is still damaged.
In order to solve the problems, the invention provides a server storage device which is used for storing and transferring servers, when a large fire or flood cannot be controlled, rescued or rescued, the server can be quickly transferred by using the device, and a cabinet provided with the servers is transferred into a waterproof and fireproof safety room from a common machine room, so that the safety of the servers is guaranteed.
In order to solve the problems, the server storage device is designed and comprises a machine room, a safety room, a transfer channel and corresponding guide rails, the basic principle is that a cabinet is located in the machine room under normal conditions, when an uncontrollable fire or flood occurs, the cabinet is quickly transferred into the safety room, the server in the cabinet can be protected by utilizing the water resistance and the fire resistance of the safety room, the safety of the server is guaranteed, and the server is taken out of the safety room after the flood and the fire pass.
When flood or fire disaster occurs and the cabinet needs to be transferred, the transfer structure in the device can be used for transferring, and the cabinet transfer process using the transfer structure is as follows:
opening a sealing door of the safety house, and respectively butting the preset end of the first upper guide rail with the left end of the second upper guide rail by utilizing the first butting guide rail, the second butting guide rail, the third butting guide rail and the fourth butting guide rail; butting the preset end of the first lower guide rail with the left end of the second lower guide rail; butting the preset end of the third upper guide rail with the right end of the second upper guide rail; butting the preset end of the third lower guide rail with the right end of the second lower guide rail;
embedding a sliding block and a first electric trolley in the transfer structure into a first upper guide rail, then sliding the sliding block to the upper part of the cabinet, and then fixing the sliding block, wherein the sliding block is positioned behind the sliding direction of the first electric trolley;
then, opening the electric hoist, butting a lifting hook of the electric hoist with a lifting ring on the cabinet, and then lifting the cabinet by using the electric hoist to a preset height;
then, a second electric trolley is arranged on the first lower guide rail, the second electric trolley is moved to the position below the hoisted cabinet, then the cabinet is put down, and the butt joint column is inserted into the corresponding butt joint hole of the installation base;
then separating the lifting hook from the lifting ring, simultaneously starting the first electric trolley and the second electric trolley, and moving the cabinet into a safety room;
and after all the cabinets are moved into the safety room, the third butt joint guide rail and the fourth butt joint guide rail are detached, and the sealing door is closed.
Can realize the quick transfer of rack through above-mentioned mode, avoid the rack to be damaged by flood or conflagration, the computer lab is for fan heat and control temperature and humidity, be equipped with corresponding temperature control system and ventilation system, and these systems are equipped with corresponding passageway and can intake, and corresponding electrical apparatus and circuit produce the conflagration easily, therefore, when uncontrollable conflagration and flood take place, can shift the rack to in the safety house, and the safety house is sealed room, the server can not install in the safety house for a long time, the safety house is ventilative also not dispelled the heat, be not convenient for long-term the depositing of server, but can deposit the server for a short time when taking place great flood and conflagration, guarantee the safety of server, it removes the server from the safety house to treat after flood and conflagration.
Wherein, this device utilizes corresponding guide rail laborsaving mode of slip to be convenient for pull and shift the great rack of weight, and on the other hand utilizes the electronic dolly of second to share the weight of rack, avoids causing too big pressure to make it drop or damage or slip labouring to the first electronic dolly of top at the in-process that removes, and this device utilizes the electronic dolly drive and the effect that the cabinet was shifted fast to laborsaving mode of pulling can be realized.
Wherein, slider among this device can be fixed when needs are fixed, slides when needs slide, if first fixed mode is: the side surfaces of the first upper guide rail, the second upper guide rail and the third upper guide rail are provided with a plurality of first fixing screw holes, the sliding block is provided with a plurality of second fixing screw holes, and the fixing screws are used for being inserted into the first fixing screw holes and the second fixing screw holes to fix the sliding block. The second fixing mode is as follows: first to the third guide rail that goes up the guide rail that the guide rail adoption magnetic conduction metal made, the slider surface is equipped with the electromagnet layer with the contact surface of first to third upper guide rail, when the purpose of design is the electro-magnet outage like this, do not have magnetic force to adsorb and can normally slide between the electromagnet layer of slider and first to the third upper guide rail, when the electro-magnet circular telegram, it can fix the slider to have the adsorption affinity between the electromagnet layer of slider and first to the third upper guide rail, and fixed slider can avoid the slider to take place to slide at the in-process of handling rack, lead to the rack to bump damage.
The bottom of the mounting base is provided with a groove for the guide rail to pass through, the groove is arranged to facilitate the guide rail to pass through the mounting base like the first lower guide rail to the third lower guide rail, the second electric trolley is convenient to mount, and the sliding block, the wheels of the first electric trolley and the wheels of the second electric trolley are all embedded in the guide rail to avoid derailment.
The first electric trolley, the electric hoist and the second electric trolley in the device can be powered by a conventional power supply of a machine room, and can also be powered by a standby power supply in the machine room, wherein the standby power supply can be a standby storage battery pack and is provided with corresponding waterproof and fireproof protection measures.
The wall of the safety house is sequentially provided with an outer cement layer, a heat insulation layer and an inner cement layer from outside to inside, the heat insulation layer is designed to prevent excessive heat from being transmitted into the safety house to cause overhigh temperature in the safety house when a fire disaster happens, and the heat insulation material is a material capable of retarding heat flow transmission and is also called as a heat insulation material. Conventional thermal insulation materials such as glass fiber, asbestos, rock wool, silicate, etc., and novel thermal insulation materials such as aerogel blankets, vacuum panels, etc.
Wherein, the height of safe room is greater than the height of computer lab, and such purpose can ensure that safe room does not intake water or the water level is lower when intaking to report to the police in the computer lab. The device also comprises a corresponding controller which is used for controlling the first electric trolley, the electric hoist and the second electric trolley.
The applicant researches and discovers that although the cabinet is moved into the safe room, the cabinets are on the same guide rail, the second electric trolley easily slides on the guide rail, after a disaster, although the cabinets are not flooded or burnt out, the cabinets are easily damaged due to sliding collision of the cabinets, and the cabinets are quickly fixed and butted within a time required for emergency when the fire and the flood happen, if the butting is slow, the fire or the flood can be spread to the safe room and the aim of emergency rescue is lost, so that the efficiency of safe transfer is improved for quick butting of the cabinets in the safe room, the cabinets are fixed in the safe room to avoid sliding collision, and the cabinet damage caused by moving collision of the second electric trolley is avoided. The first fixing structure and the second fixing structure are designed correspondingly, the effects of quick butt joint and fixing are achieved, and meanwhile, the air bag is used for buffering to guarantee buffer protection of the cabinet during quick butt joint.
To solve the above problem, please refer to fig. 12, in which fig. 12 is a schematic structural diagram of a first fixing structure and a second fixing structure; in the embodiment of the invention, a fixed base 20 is fixed in a safety house, a first fixed structure is fixed on the fixed base, one end of a third lower guide rail extends to the bottom of a second transfer passage port, the other end of the third lower guide rail extends to the bottom of the fixed base, a second fixed structure is installed at the head of a second electric trolley, and a first fixed structure is installed at the tail of the second electric trolley;
wherein the first fixing structure comprises: the device comprises a first cylinder 21, an upper clamping mechanism, a lower clamping mechanism, a first air pipe 22, a second air pipe 23 and an air valve;
the pneumatic valve is installed on first trachea or second trachea, and first drum left end is the open end, and first drum right-hand member is sealed end, and the installation of right-hand member inner wall is fixed with the gasbag in the first drum, goes up screens mechanism and includes: a second cylinder 24, a first extension spring 25, a first piston 26, and a first detent lever 27; the lower end of the second cylinder is fixedly connected with the upper surface of the first cylinder, the first piston and the first telescopic spring are both positioned in the second cylinder, the first piston can slide up and down in the second cylinder, the lower end of the first telescopic spring is fixedly connected with the upper surface of the first piston, the upper end of the first telescopic spring is fixedly connected with the inner wall of the upper end of the second cylinder, the upper end of the first clamping rod is fixedly connected with the lower surface of the first piston, the lower end of the first clamping rod sequentially penetrates through the lower end of the second cylinder and the upper surface of the first cylinder and then extends into the first cylinder, one end of the first air pipe extends into the air bag and is communicated with the air bag, and the other end of the first air pipe extends into a first cavity formed by the inner walls of the first piston and the second cylinder and is communicated with the first cavity; lower screens mechanism includes: a third cylinder 28, a second extension spring 29, a second piston 30 and a second detent lever 31; the upper end of the third cylinder is fixedly connected with the lower surface of the first cylinder, the second piston and the second telescopic spring are both positioned in the third cylinder, the second piston can slide up and down in the third cylinder, the upper end of the second telescopic spring is fixedly connected with the lower surface of the second piston, the lower end of the second telescopic spring is fixedly connected with the inner wall of the lower end of the third cylinder, the lower end of the second clamping rod is fixedly connected with the upper surface of the second piston, the upper end of the second clamping rod sequentially penetrates through the upper end of the third cylinder and the lower surface of the first cylinder and then extends into the first cylinder, one end of the second air pipe extends into the air bag and is communicated with the air bag 32, and the other end of the second air pipe extends into a second cavity formed by the second piston and the inner wall of the third cylinder and is communicated with the second cavity.
The upper clamping mechanism and the lower clamping mechanism are identical in structure, and vertical center lines of the upper clamping mechanism and the lower clamping mechanism are superposed.
The right end of the first cylinder in the first fixing structure arranged at the tail part of the second electric trolley is fixedly connected with the tail part of the second electric trolley.
Wherein, the second fixed knot constructs including: the device comprises an insertion rod 33, a plurality of electric telescopic rods 34, a first cylinder 35, a first controller, a first touch switch 36 and a plurality of second touch switches 37;
the center of the first cylinder is provided with a through hole, the right end of the insertion rod is inserted into the through hole, the right end face of the insertion rod is aligned with the right end face of the first cylinder, the insertion rod is provided with external threads, the inner wall of the through hole is provided with internal threads, the insertion rod is in threaded connection with the first cylinder, the left end of the insertion rod is fixedly connected with the head of the electric trolley, a plurality of electric telescopic rods are uniformly and horizontally distributed on the left end face of the first cylinder, the right end of each electric telescopic rod is fixedly connected with the left end face of the first cylinder, and the left end; the first touch switch is arranged on the surface of the right end of the insertion rod and used for detecting whether the insertion rod is contacted with the air bag or not; the second touch switches correspond to the electric telescopic rods one by one and are used for detecting whether the electric telescopic rods are in contact with the first clamping rods or the second clamping rods; the first touch switch and the second touch switch are both connected with a controller, and the controller is used for controlling the length of the electric telescopic rod;
when the air bag is not compressed by the inserting rod, the distance between the lower end of the first clamping rod and the upper end of the second clamping rod is larger than the outer diameter of the first cylinder; when the air bag is compressed by the inserting rod, the first touch switch detects that the inserting rod is in contact with the air bag, namely the first touch switch is triggered, the controller controls the electric telescopic rod to extend, and when the second touch switch detects that the electric telescopic rod is in contact with the first clamping rod or the second clamping rod, namely the second touch switch is triggered, the controller controls the corresponding electric telescopic rod to stop extending and keep the corresponding length.
The fixing and butt joint process of moving the cabinet into the safety house comprises the following steps:
after the first and second electric trolleys move into the safety house, the second fixing structure of the first and second electric trolleys is butted with the first fixing structure on the fixing base, and the first and second electric trolleys are limited and protected;
after the second electric trolley moves into the safety house, the second fixing structure of the second electric trolley is butted with the first fixing structure on the first electric trolley, and the second electric trolley is limited and protected;
...
after the Nth second electric trolley moves into the safety house, the second fixing structure of the Nth second electric trolley is butted with the first fixing structure on the (N-1) th electric trolley, and the Nth second electric trolley is subjected to limiting protection; n is an integer greater than 2;
and all the second electric trolleys are limited and protected according to the mode, so that the second electric trolleys are prevented from sliding and colliding.
Wherein, the butt joint mode of second fixed knot structure and first fixed knot structure is:
an inserting rod in the second fixing structure is inserted into the first cylinder from the left end of the first cylinder, then is gradually inserted into the first cylinder rightwards, passes through the space between the lower end of the first clamping rod and the upper end of the second clamping rod, then is contacted with the air bag to start extruding the air bag, when the inserting rod is contacted with the air bag, the first touch switch is triggered, the controller controls the electric telescopic rod to extend, when the second touch switch detects that the electric telescopic rod is contacted with the first clamping rod or the second clamping rod, namely the second touch switch is triggered, the controller controls the corresponding electric telescopic rod to stop extending, corresponding length is kept, when the air bag is compressed, air is respectively transmitted into the first cavity and the second cavity from the first air pipe and the second air pipe, air pressure in the first cavity and the second cavity is increased to enable the corresponding first piston and the second piston to move, the first piston and the second piston move to drive the corresponding first clamping rod and the second clamping rod to move, the first clamping rod and the second clamping rod are designed to enable the insertion rod to be inserted into the extrusion air bag and then move towards the center of the first cylinder, the distance between the first clamping rod and the second clamping rod is shortened, the electric telescopic rod is enabled to be in contact with the first clamping rod and the second clamping rod, the insertion rod does not have space retraction, the electric telescopic rod is already in contact with the first clamping rod and the second clamping rod, the air bag cannot restore to the original shape, the limitation on the insertion rod is further realized, and the butt joint of the second fixing structure and the first fixing structure is further realized; when the second fixing structure and the first fixing structure need to be disassembled, only the corresponding air valve needs to be opened, so that air pressure is reduced, the first telescopic spring and the second telescopic spring are utilized to drive the first piston and the second piston to return respectively, and then the first clamping rod and the second clamping rod are driven to return, so that the distance between the first clamping rod and the second clamping rod is larger than the outer diameter of the first cylinder, then the inserting rod is taken out from the first cylinder, and the electric telescopic rod is retracted to the initial length. When in butt joint, the butt joint speed is high due to the need of quick butt joint, the air bag can be used for buffering, and the butt joint is convenient, quick and safe. The electric telescopic rod and the corresponding controller can be powered by an external power supply or a self-contained power supply.
The invention also provides a disaster rescue method based on the server storage device, which is used for safely transferring the server when a flood or fire disaster happens in the machine room, and the method comprises the following steps:
pulling out external lines of the cabinet, such as a data line power line and the like, opening a sealing door of the safety house, and butting the preset end of the first upper guide rail with the left end of the second upper guide rail; butting the preset end of the first lower guide rail with the left end of the second lower guide rail; butting the preset end of the third upper guide rail with the right end of the second upper guide rail; butting the preset end of the third lower guide rail with the right end of the second lower guide rail;
embedding a sliding block and a first electric trolley into a first upper guide rail, then sliding the sliding block to the upper part of the cabinet, and then fixing the sliding block, wherein the sliding block is positioned behind the sliding direction of the first electric trolley;
then, opening the electric hoist, butting a lifting hook of the electric hoist with a lifting ring on the cabinet, and then lifting the cabinet by using the electric hoist to a preset height;
then, a second electric trolley is arranged on the first lower guide rail, the second electric trolley is moved to the position below the hoisted cabinet, then the cabinet is put down, and the butt joint column is inserted into the corresponding butt joint hole of the installation base;
then separating the lifting hook from the lifting ring, simultaneously starting the first electric trolley and the second electric trolley, and moving the cabinet into a safety room;
and after all the cabinets are moved into the safety room, the third butt joint guide rail and the fourth butt joint guide rail are detached, and the sealing door is closed.

### 📜 Full Specification & Deep Scrape Text
Title
Media data processing method, computing device and storage medium

Abstract
The present disclosure provides a media data processing method. The method includes obtaining, after determining that a user client performs a service operation with a first service client, first video data from the user client and second video data from the first service client; and synthesizing the first video data with the second video data to generate service operation video data. The method also includes transmitting the service operation video data to the user client and the first service client; obtaining a processing result of the service operation from the first service client; storing the service operation video data and generating storage information; receiving an access request that is transmitted by a second service client and that carries the storage information; and obtaining the service operation video data according to the storage information and returning the service operation video data to the second service client.

Description
RELATED APPLICATIONS
This application is a continuation application of PCT Patent Application No. PCT/CN2018/116853, filed on Nov. 22, 2018, which claims priority to China Patent Application No. 201711258239.9, filed with the Chinese Patent Office on Dec. 4, 2017 and entitled “MEDIA DATA PROCESSING METHOD AND APPARATUS, AND RELATED DEVICE”, content of all of which is incorporated herein by reference in its entirety.
FIELD OF THE TECHNOLOGY
This application relates to the field of information technologies and, in particular, to a media data processing method, a computing device, and a storage medium.
BACKGROUND OF THE DISCLOSURE
With the development of information technologies and the arrival of the information era, information brings great convenience to people's life as a major productivity factor, so that people can carry out various activities through the Internet without going out, for example, online shopping, online entertainment, online payment, or even online authentication. However, people may suffer from malicious attacks from the Internet during online activities. As a result, private information of people is leaked and stolen, causing threats to property safety of people. Especially, in online authentication activities and services having online authentication activities, security of private data often cannot be maintained comprehensively. Moreover, authentication modes of current online authentication activities often cannot meet high requirements of authentication activities yet.
The disclosed methods and systems are directed to solve one or more problems set forth above and other problems.
SUMMARY
One aspect of the present disclosure provides a media data processing method. The method includes: obtaining, after determining that a user client performs a service operation with a first service client, first video data from the user client and second video data from the first service client; and synthesizing the first video data with the second video data to generate service operation video data. The method also includes transmitting the service operation video data to the user client and the first service client, so that the first service client completes the service operation with the user client according to the service operation video data; obtaining a processing result of the service operation from the first service client; storing the service operation video data and generating storage information, in response to the processing result indicating that the operation takes effect; and receiving an access request that is transmitted by a second service client and that carries the storage information. The method further includes obtaining, in response to the access request, the service operation video data according to the storage information and returning the service operation video data to the second service client, so that the second service client completes processing for the service operation according to the service operation video data.
Another aspect of the present disclosure provides a computing device. The computing device includes a memory storing computer readable instructions; and a processor coupled to the memory. The processor executes the computer readable instructions in the memory to perform: obtaining, after determining that a user client performs a service operation with a first service client, first video data from the user client and second video data from the first service client; and synthesizing the first video data with the second video data to generate service operation video data; transmitting the service operation video data to the user client and the first service client, so that the first service client completes the service operation with the user client according to the service operation video data; obtaining a processing result of the service operation from the first service client; storing the service operation video data and generate storage information in response to the processing result indicating that the operation takes effect; receiving an access request that is transmitted by a second service client and that carries the storage information; and obtaining, in response to the access request, the service operation video data according to the storage information and return the service operation video data to the second service client, so that the second service client completes processing for the service operation according to the service operation video data.
Other aspects of the present disclosure can be understood by those skilled in the art in light of the description, the claims, and the drawings of the present disclosure.
