Detailed Description
As shown in fig. 1, the application provides an underwater detector cluster self-adaptive detection method based on distributed reinforcement learning, which comprises the following steps:
S1, obtaining feature data of a detector, obtaining a standardized state matrix through self-adaptive standardized processing, constructing a spatial relationship quantization matrix based on the standardized state matrix, generating a group topology feature matrix based on the spatial relationship quantization matrix, converting the group topology feature matrix into a probability distribution matrix and calculating entropy feature vectors, and carrying out feature fusion on the standardized state matrix, the group topology feature matrix and the entropy feature vectors to obtain final feature representation, wherein the detector feature data comprise detector basic state data, environment parameter data and detector group position data;
S2, constructing an action prototype matrix and an action coupling tensor based on the final feature representation, generating a constraint condition set based on the action prototype matrix and the action coupling tensor, optimizing the action coupling tensor based on the constraint condition set to obtain an optimized action space, constructing an action evaluation matrix based on the optimized action space to obtain an movable action set through a screening algorithm, and performing multi-level coding on the movable action set to generate a coded action space;
S3, constructing a basic rewarding tensor comprising efficiency rewards, safety rewards, cooperative rewards and information acquisition rewards based on the final characteristic representation, a group topology characteristic matrix and the coded action space, constructing a dynamic weight adjustment matrix based on the basic rewarding tensor to generate a comprehensive rewarding function, performing strategy optimization based on the comprehensive rewarding function to obtain optimized strategy parameters;
S4, constructing a decision evaluation tensor comprising an immediate decision layer, a tactical decision layer and a strategic decision layer based on a final optimization strategy, obtaining a fusion decision matrix through multi-level fusion, constructing a real-time monitoring matrix based on the fusion decision matrix, performing anomaly detection and processing to obtain adjusted execution parameters, constructing a multi-dimensional evaluation index system based on the adjusted execution parameters, obtaining evaluation weights and performance indexes through a self-adaptive weight algorithm, obtaining execution data based on the adjusted execution parameters, the evaluation weights and the performance indexes, constructing an experience knowledge base, and obtaining an optimized knowledge base and updating rules through a knowledge refining algorithm.
As shown in fig. 2, according to an aspect of the present application, step S1 is further:
S11, acquiring detector basic state data and environment parameter data, and carrying out standardized processing by calculating a dynamic mean value and a dynamic standard deviation and combining a preset exponential decay smoothing factor to obtain a standardized state matrix, wherein the detector basic state data comprises three-dimensional space coordinates, a speed scalar, a horizontal plane deflection angle, a vertical plane deflection angle and a residual energy level of the detector;
S12, acquiring position data of a detector group, constructing a position matrix and a spatial distance measurement matrix, carrying out weighted combination on the spatial distance measurement matrix, a pre-configured angle correlation matrix and an energy potential difference matrix to obtain a spatial relationship quantization matrix, and generating a group topology feature matrix based on the spatial relationship quantization matrix and the position matrix through matrix operation regulated by dynamic coefficients, wherein the spatial distance measurement matrix is obtained by calculating spatial distance, speed difference and energy difference among the detectors;
s13, inputting the group topology feature matrix into a probability distribution conversion unit, and obtaining a probability distribution matrix through exponential normalization operation; performing weighted calculation on the probability distribution matrix and a pre-configured local environment weight matrix to generate a conditional information entropy matrix;
S14, generating a multi-dimensional feature tensor through tensor stacking operation based on the standardized state matrix, the group topology feature matrix and the entropy feature vector, applying a compression algorithm to the multi-dimensional feature tensor to obtain a compressed feature tensor, and performing matrix multiplication operation on the compressed feature tensor and a preconfigured self-adaptive feature selection matrix to obtain a final feature representation.
In example 1 of the present application, each detector i (i=1, 2., n) raw state vector r_i= (x_i, y_i, z_i, v_i, θ_i, Φ_i, e_i); where x_i, y_i, z_i are three-dimensional space coordinates, v_i is a velocity scalar, θ_i is a horizontal plane offset angle, φ_i is a vertical plane offset angle, and e_i is a residual energy level. Local environment parameter vector e_i= (p_i, t_i, c_i, f_i) is obtained, where p_i is water pressure, t_i is temperature, c_i is conductivity, and f_i is water flow velocity vector. An adaptive extremum standardization method X' _i= (X_i mu_d)/(sigma_d+epsilon) is adopted, wherein X_i is original data, mu_d is a dynamic mean value and calculated through exponential sliding, sigma_d is a dynamic standard deviation, epsilon is an adaptive smoothing factor, epsilon=k is exp (- |sigma_d|), k is an adjustment coefficient and defaults to 0.01, and a standardization state matrix S= [ S_1, S_2 ] is output.
Constructing a spatial relationship quantization matrix （Spatial Relationship Quantification Matrix,SRQM）,SRQM_{ij}=w_d*D_{ij} + w_a * A_{ij} + w_e * E_{ij};, wherein D_ { ij } is a spatial distance measure ,D_{ij} = [(x_i x_j) 2 + (y_i y_j) 2 + (z_i z_j) 2 ] 1/3 * exp(-λ|v_i v_j|);A_{ij} and is an angle correlation, A_ { ij } = cos (theta_itheta_j) & co (phi_iphi_j) & 1|v_ i v _j|/v_max) & E_ { ij } is an energy potential difference, E_ { ij } = (e_i+e_j)/(2e_max) & exp (- |e_ i E _j|/e_max) & w_d, w_a, w_e are adaptive weight coefficients. A group topology feature matrix (Group Topology Feature Matrix, GTFM) is constructed, GTFM=alpha, SRQM, P+beta, SRQM, P and 2 , wherein P is a position matrix, alpha and beta are dynamic adjustment coefficients, alpha=1/(1+exp (- | SRQM | F ));β=1·α;||·|| F is a Frobenius norm), and the group topology feature matrix GTFM is output.
The method comprises the steps of converting a group topology feature matrix GTFM into a probability distribution matrix P (GTFM) _ij=exp (GTFM_ij)/Σexp (GTFM_kl), calculating condition information entropy H (i|j) = -sigma P (GTFM) _ij × log (P (GTFM) _ij) { ij }, wherein W_ij is a local environment weight, W_ij = exp (- |E_ i E _j| 2 /tau) and tau is a temperature parameter, and controlling the weight attenuation speed. The entropy feature vector h_vec= [ H (1|·), H (2|·), H (n|·) ], is constructed, and the entropy feature vector h_vec is output.
Constructing a multidimensional feature tensor, f=stack (S, GTFM, h_vec), applying a tensor compression algorithm F '=tcp (F), wherein TCP is a tensor compression projection defined as F' = Σ (λ_k×u_k v_k i w_k), k=1, r, wherein λ_k is a feature value, u_k, v_k, w_k is a basis vector, r is a compression rank, and r is a tensor product. Constructing a final feature representation phi= Reshape (F ') #, wherein Γ is an adaptive feature selection matrix, Γ_ { ij } = sigmoid (ρ |f' _ij } |), ρ is a sensitivity parameter, and outputting the final feature representation phi.
The embodiment realizes high-precision characterization of the group state of the underwater detector through a multi-level feature extraction and fusion strategy. The method effectively solves the problem of inconsistent data scales of different sensors by adopting self-adaptive standardized processing, ensures that processed data has good statistical properties through dynamically-adjusted standardized parameters, combines measurement indexes of three dimensions of distance, angle and energy in the aspect of space relation quantification, ensures that a quantification result can accurately reflect the actual interaction relation between detectors through a dynamic weight adjustment mechanism, and adopts a graph embedding algorithm in a topological feature extraction link, so that the overall structural features of a group are reserved, the local connection mode can be reflected, and the uncertainty and dynamic change features of the group behavior are captured through the introduction of entropy feature vectors. The embodiment not only improves the accuracy and the robustness of state representation, but also provides a reliable data base for subsequent decision optimization, so that the system can be better adapted to complex and changeable underwater environments.
According to one aspect of the present application, step S11 is further:
S111, acquiring detector basic state data, forming a time sequence array according to time sequence arrangement, calculating mean deviation of all data through a sliding window based on the time sequence array to obtain a data fluctuation range, calculating data reliability weight by adopting an exponential weighting method based on the data fluctuation range to obtain a state data reliability matrix, and performing weighted combination on the detector basic state data and the state data reliability matrix to generate preprocessing state data;
S112, obtaining environment parameter data, removing high-frequency noise through wavelet transformation to obtain noise reduction environment data, applying local mean decomposition to the noise reduction environment data, extracting the change trend of the environment parameters to obtain environment trend data, comparing the noise reduction environment data with the environment trend data, and calculating the mutation degree of the environment parameters to obtain an environment stability matrix;
S113, obtaining a dynamic average value matrix through exponential sliding calculation based on the preprocessing state data and the environment stability matrix, calculating a fluctuation variance based on the dynamic average value matrix, weighting the fluctuation variance and the environment stability matrix to obtain a dynamic variance matrix, inputting the dynamic average value matrix and the dynamic variance matrix into a self-adaptive parameter generation unit, and obtaining a standardized parameter matrix through recursive optimization and calculation;
S114, constructing a mapping function of a dynamic interval based on the preprocessing state data and the standardized parameter matrix, performing preliminary standardization to obtain initial standardized data, calculating deviation between the initial standardized data and a prestored historical standardized result, dynamically adjusting the mapping function parameter based on the deviation to obtain an adjustment coefficient matrix, and performing self-adaptive correction on the initial standardized data and the adjustment coefficient matrix to obtain a standardized state matrix.
The embodiment realizes high-quality preprocessing and standardization of the detector state data, and improves the reliability of subsequent processing. The method and the device effectively identify and process the abnormal and noise in the sensor data through a data reliability evaluation mechanism, improve the quality of the data, accurately capture the environmental change characteristics through trend analysis and mutation detection of environmental parameters, provide important references for state evaluation, realize accurate depiction of the statistical characteristics of the data through adaptive calculation of dynamic means and variances, ensure the adaptability of standardized processing, and ensure the stability and reliability of standardized results through an adaptive correction mechanism. The embodiment not only improves the data quality, but also enables the system to be better suitable for the dynamic change of the data characteristics through a multi-level self-adaptive mechanism.
According to one aspect of the present application, step S12 is further:
S121, acquiring position data of a detector group, converting the position data into three-dimensional coordinate data, projecting the three-dimensional coordinate data to a unit sphere through a sphere projection algorithm to obtain sphere projection data, calculating great circle distances between every two detectors based on the sphere projection data to form an initial distance matrix, combining the initial distance matrix with a preset dynamic weight function, and generating a weighted distance matrix according to the distance attenuation characteristic;
S122, acquiring horizontal deflection angle data and vertical deflection angle data of the detector, calculating an angle change rate by applying a quaternion interpolation algorithm to obtain an angular velocity matrix, acquiring the velocity data of the detector, combining the angular velocity matrix and the velocity data, extracting motion characteristics by tensor decomposition to obtain a motion characteristic tensor;
S123, obtaining residual energy data of the detectors, predicting energy consumption trend through piecewise linear regression to obtain an energy trend matrix, calculating energy difference among the detectors based on the energy trend matrix, and generating an initial potential difference matrix by combining a pre-configured potential field model;
S124, extracting main features through a spectral clustering algorithm based on a distance measurement matrix, an angle correlation matrix and an energy potential difference matrix to obtain a feature component matrix;
S125, constructing a position matrix based on the position data of the detector group, constructing a topological structure based on a space relation quantization matrix and the position matrix, applying a graph embedding algorithm to obtain an initial topological graph, performing edge weight optimization on the initial topological graph, extracting key connection relations through a recursive minimum spanning tree algorithm to obtain an optimized topological graph, converting the optimized topological graph into an adjacent matrix to represent, extracting structural features through graph convolution operation to obtain a topological feature matrix, and performing feature fusion on the topological feature matrix and the space relation quantization matrix to generate a group topological feature matrix.
The embodiment realizes the accurate characterization of the topological structure of the detector group. The three-dimensional spatial position relation is calculated efficiently through a spherical projection algorithm, the motion correlation of the detector is accurately depicted through the analysis of angular velocity and motion characteristics, the accurate assessment of energy transfer efficiency is realized through energy flow analysis and potential field model, and the representation accurately reflecting the topological characteristics of the group is constructed through multi-characteristic fusion and graph structure optimization. According to the embodiment, the calculation efficiency is improved, the accurate depiction of the topological structure of the group is realized through comprehensive consideration of the multidimensional characteristics, and a reliable basis is provided for subsequent decision optimization.
As shown in fig. 3, according to an aspect of the present application, step S2 is further:
S21, constructing an action prototype matrix comprising a mobile operation set and a detection operation set based on the final feature representation, and calculating to obtain an action conflict detection matrix through an action coupling function based on the action prototype matrix and prestored inter-detector distance data;
S22, calculating energy constraint, distance constraint, angle constraint and speed constraint based on the group topology feature matrix to generate constraint condition sets, constructing an optimized weight matrix based on the constraint condition sets, performing matrix operation based on the optimized weight matrix and the action coupling tensor to obtain an action optimized matrix, and applying an action space contraction algorithm to the action optimized matrix to generate an optimized action space;
S23, calculating an efficiency evaluation value, a safety evaluation value and a cooperation evaluation value based on the optimized action space to generate an action evaluation matrix, inputting the action evaluation matrix into an action screening unit, calculating an action score, performing probability adjustment, selecting an action combination with the highest action score as an action set, and performing multi-level coding based on the action set to generate a coded action space.
In embodiment 2 of the present application, the final feature representation Φ is obtained, and an action prototype matrix a_base, a_base= { a_m|m e M }, where m= { moving operation set, detecting operation set }, moving operation set= { forward, backward, up, down, left turn, right turn }, detecting operation set= { sampling, data collection, sensor switch }. Each action prototype is denoted as a_m= (Δ_x, Δ_y, Δ_z, Δ_v, Δ_θ, Δ_Φ, Δ_e), and Δ_ is the amount of change in the corresponding state. Constructing action coupling tensors (Action Coupling Tensor, ACT), act_ { ijk } = ψ (a_i, a_j, d_k), wherein ψ is an action coupling function, ψ (a_i, a_j, d_k) = exp (- |a_ i A _j| 2 d_k/sigma) c_ { ij }, wherein d_k is the inter-detector distance, σ is a scale parameter, c_ { ij } is a collision detection matrix, and outputting the action coupling tensors ACT.
Constraint Constraints={Energy: g_e(A)=e_current e_required(A)≥0;Distance: g_d(A)=d_safe d_min(A)≥0;Angle: g_θ(A)= |θ_change|≤θ_max;Velocity: g_v(A)=|v_change|≤v_max;}, is constructed based on a group topology feature matrix GTFM, wherein e_required (A) is the energy required by action A, d_min (A) is the minimum group spacing after action A is executed, θ_change is the angle change amount, and v_change is the speed change amount. An action optimization matrix (Action Optimization Matrix, AOM) is constructed, am=Ω (iλ×l) ×act, where Ω is an optimization weight matrix Ω_ij=exp (- μ×Φ_iΦ_j| 2 ), L is a laplace operator, l= D W, w_ij=exp (- |gtfm_i gtfm_j|_f/η), D is a degree matrix, and λ is a smoothing coefficient. An action space contraction algorithm a ' = Shrink (AOM, constraints) is applied, shrink operation is defined as a ' _i=a_i (1 pi (1 satisfy (g_k))), satisfy (g) is a constraint satisfaction function, and an optimized action space a ' is output.
An action evaluation matrix (Action Evaluation Matrix, AEM) is constructed, aem_ij=ζ_1×e_eff (i, j) +ζ_2×e_safe (i, j) +ζ_3×e_chord (i, j), wherein e_eff is an efficiency evaluation function, e_eff (i, j) =exp (-t_ij/t_max), e_safe is a security evaluation function, e_safe (i, j) =1 exp (-d_ij/d_safe), e_chord is a collaborative evaluation function, e_chord (i, j) =cos (v_i, v_j) ×min (|v_i|, |v_j|)/v_max, and ζ is a dynamic weight coefficient. Applying an action screening algorithm a_feature=filter (a', AEM), defining a Filter operation as calculating an action Score, score (a) = Σ (aem_ij I (a_i, a_j)), I (a_i, a_j) being an action compatibility indication function, selecting k action combinations with highest scores, applying probability adjustment, P (a) =softmax (Score (a)/τ), and outputting an active action set a_feature.
Constructing hierarchical motion codes E (a) = Concat (E_base (a), E_context (a)), wherein E_base is a basic coding function, E_base (a) =MDS (a, A_feature), MDS is multidimensional scale transformation, E_context is a context coding function, E_context (a) =hash (GTFM) and generating a final motion representation A_final= { (a, E (a))|a epsilon A_feature }, and outputting a coded motion space A_final.
The embodiment improves the cooperative performance of the detector group. The method comprises the steps of generating an action prototype, analyzing action coupling, constructing a complete action space containing basic actions and combined actions, realizing self-adaptive contraction of the action space through dynamic generation and propagation of constraint conditions, effectively reducing interference of invalid actions, comprehensively evaluating the actions from three dimensions of efficiency, safety and synergy by adopting a multi-level action evaluation mechanism, ensuring feasibility and effectiveness of selecting the actions, and improving compactness and interpretability of action representation through coding optimization of the action space. According to the embodiment, the structure and the range of the action space can be dynamically adjusted according to the current environment state and task requirements, and meanwhile, through a multi-dimensional evaluation mechanism, the selected action can be ensured to meet the motion constraint of the single detector, the cooperative detection effect of groups can be promoted, and therefore the overall performance of the system is improved.
According to one aspect of the present application, step S21 is further:
s211, obtaining a basic motion element set through an action decomposition algorithm based on final feature representation, applying a motion feature extraction algorithm to the basic motion element set, extracting key motion features through principal component analysis to generate a motion feature matrix, carrying out matching analysis on the motion feature matrix and a preset physical constraint condition, and obtaining an action feasibility vector through a feasibility verification algorithm;
S212, acquiring relative position data and motion state data of the detectors, applying a dynamic association analysis algorithm to calculate a motion coupling relation between the detectors to obtain a motion coupling matrix, performing spectrum analysis on the motion coupling matrix, extracting a coupling mode through a feature decomposition algorithm to generate a coupling mode vector, performing space-time mapping on the coupling mode vector and a preset environment constraint, and optimizing the coupling relation through a dynamic programming algorithm to obtain an optimized coupling matrix;
S213, extracting the association features among the actions through a tensor decomposition algorithm based on the action prototype matrix and the action interaction tensor to obtain an association feature matrix, applying a hierarchical clustering algorithm to the association feature matrix, identifying action combination modes through a similarity calculation method to generate a combination mode matrix, adaptively matching the combination mode matrix with preset task execution constraints, and obtaining an adaptability grading vector through a multi-objective optimization algorithm;
S214, analyzing the feasibility of the action sequence to obtain a feasibility evaluation matrix based on the action combination set by applying a constraint propagation algorithm, carrying out probability modeling on the feasibility evaluation matrix, calculating state transition probability through a Markov decision process to generate a transition probability matrix, carrying out comprehensive evaluation based on the transition probability matrix to obtain an evaluation result, obtaining an execution cost vector through a dynamic programming algorithm based on the evaluation result, and generating an action constraint matrix based on the execution cost vector and preset feasibility constraint;
s215, constructing an action space topological structure through a tensor network algorithm based on the action combination set and the action constraint matrix to obtain an action topological graph, applying a graph embedding algorithm to the action topological graph, extracting action space features through a dimension reduction method to generate a space feature matrix, performing association analysis on the space feature matrix and preset action execution conditions to obtain an analysis result, obtaining a weight distribution vector through an adaptive weight algorithm based on the analysis result, and integrating the weight distribution vector, the action combination set and the action constraint matrix to generate an action coupling tensor.
The embodiment improves the coordination and feasibility of group actions. The method comprises the steps of accurately decomposing complex actions into basic motion units through an action decomposition algorithm, ensuring the feasibility of atomic actions through physical constraint verification, accurately identifying the motion coupling relation between detectors through dynamic association analysis and coupling mode extraction, effectively avoiding action conflict, realizing efficient generation and screening of action sequences through multi-level action combination optimization, ensuring the effectiveness of combined actions, and forming complete action coupling representation through construction and optimization of an action space topological structure. The method and the device not only improve the efficiency and quality of action generation, but also effectively solve the problem of conflict in the cooperative motion of the multiple detectors through multi-dimensional coupling analysis, and lay a foundation for realizing efficient group cooperative control.
According to one aspect of the present application, step S23 is further:
S231, obtaining each action sequence in the optimized action space, predicting action execution tracks through a space-time mapping algorithm to obtain a predicted track set, calculating task completion time and energy consumption based on the predicted track set, and generating a resource consumption matrix by adopting a multi-target weighing method;
S232, obtaining obstacle data in the environment, calculating a minimum safety distance through a collision prediction algorithm based on the obstacle data and a prediction track set to obtain a safety distance matrix, constructing a probability risk field based on the safety distance matrix, evaluating collision risk through a Monte Carlo tree search method to generate a risk evaluation matrix, combining the risk evaluation matrix with the environment stability matrix, and calculating a comprehensive safety coefficient through Bayesian reasoning to obtain a safety coefficient matrix;
S233, acquiring relative motion data of detectors in a prediction track set, calculating motion synchronicity through a group consistency evaluation algorithm to obtain a synchronicity matrix, evaluating information exchange efficiency by using an information entropy analysis method based on communication topology between the synchronicity matrix and the detectors to generate a communication efficiency matrix, inputting the synchronicity matrix and the communication efficiency matrix into a preconfigured cooperative evaluation model, and calculating a cooperative effect through deep kernel regression to obtain a cooperative evaluation matrix;
S234, based on the standardized efficiency index, the standardized safety index and the standardized coordination index, a multidimensional feature fusion algorithm is applied to construct an evaluation feature space to obtain a feature space matrix, a principal component analysis method is applied to the feature space matrix, key evaluation dimensions are extracted to generate an evaluation dimension matrix, and based on the evaluation dimension matrix, each dimension weight is calculated by adopting a recursive least square method to obtain a weight distribution vector;
S235, selecting a candidate action set through a random priority sampling algorithm based on an action evaluation matrix to obtain a candidate action matrix, applying a feasibility verification algorithm to actions in the candidate action matrix to generate feasibility grading vectors, combining the feasibility grading vectors with the action evaluation matrix, screening through a multi-objective optimization algorithm to obtain a preferred action set, applying an action smoothing algorithm to the preferred action set to generate an active action set, and performing multi-level coding based on the active action set to generate a coded action space.
The embodiment realizes accurate evaluation and optimal selection of group actions. The method comprises the steps of accurately predicting an action execution track through a space-time mapping algorithm, optimizing resource utilization through multi-objective balance, accurately evaluating action safety through probability risk field construction and Monte Carlo tree search, accurately quantifying a synergistic effect of actions through group consistency evaluation and information entropy analysis, and comprehensively optimizing an action evaluation result through multidimensional feature fusion and self-adaptive weight adjustment. The method and the device not only improve the accuracy of action selection, but also ensure the balance of the selection actions in multiple aspects of efficiency, safety, synergy and the like through a multi-level evaluation mechanism, and improve the overall effect of group control.
As shown in fig. 4, according to an aspect of the present application, step S3 is further:
S31, calculating a position change vector and energy consumption ratio to obtain efficiency rewards based on final feature representation, a group topology feature matrix and an encoded action space, calculating a distance between a detector and an obstacle to obtain safe rewards, calculating a trace and a maximum feature value ratio of the group topology feature matrix to obtain cooperative rewards, and calculating information entropy gain to obtain information acquisition rewards;
s32, calculating an action cost function and a state value function based on the comprehensive rewarding function to construct a strategy gradient estimator, inputting the strategy gradient estimator into a self-adaptive updating unit, and obtaining new strategy parameters through normalization and scaling treatment;
S33, constructing a local experience buffer zone based on the optimized strategy parameters, wherein the local experience buffer zone comprises state, action, rewards and transfer data of the next state; generating a global experience buffer zone through experience importance calculation and importance sampling based on the constructed local experience buffer zone; applying feature extraction, cluster analysis, representative experience selection and knowledge compression algorithm to the global experience buffer area to obtain an optimized experience pool;
S34, constructing a predetermined number of strategy networks based on the optimized experience pool, calculating performance evaluation values and strategy entropy of each strategy network to obtain a strategy weight matrix, carrying out weighted combination on the output of each strategy network based on the strategy weight matrix to obtain an integrated strategy, calculating KL divergence among the strategy networks, updating the weight of the integrated strategy based on the KL divergence to obtain an updated integrated strategy, and carrying out normalization processing on the updated integrated strategy to obtain a final optimized strategy.
In embodiment 3 of the present application, a final feature representation Φ, a group topology feature matrix GTFM and a final coding action space a_final are acquired, a basic prize tensor r_base, r_base= { r_eff, r_safe, r_coord, r_info }, wherein r_eff is an efficiency prize, r_eff=exp (- |Δx|/d_max) × (e_domain/e_init) α , Δx is a position change vector, d_max is a maximum reference distance, α is an energy consumption weight, r_safe is a safety prize, r_safe= pi (sigmoid ((d_ i d _safe)/κ)), d_i is a distance from an obstacle, κ is a safety threshold adjustment parameter, r_coord=tr (gtfm× T )/(n×λ (gtmax), and λ_max is a maximum reference distance, α is an energy consumption weight, r_safe is a safety prize, and k is a maximum value (-h_entropy) is a maximum value, and r_entropy is a maximum value, h_max is a maximum gain value, h=h_max. Constructing a dynamic weight adjustment matrix (DYNAMIC WEIGHT Adjustment Matrix, DWAM), DWAM =Θ (i+μ+g) ψ, wherein Θ is a basic weight matrix, Θ_ij=softmax (|Φ_ij| 2 ), G is a gradient influence matrix, g= v_Φ (r_base), ψ is a task correlation matrix, ψ_ij=cos (task_i, task_j), μ is a gradient weight factor, generating a comprehensive reward function r_total= DWAM o r_base, wherein o represents tensor reduction operation as r_total= Σ_ijk (DWAM _ij) r_base_ijk), and outputting a comprehensive reward function r_total.
Constructing a strategy gradient estimator (Policy Gradient Estimator, PGE), wherein PGE (θ) =e [ n_θlogpi_θ (a|s) ] (Q (s, a) b (s)), Q (s, a) is an action cost function, Q (s, a) =r_total+γ =max { a ' } (Q (s ', a ')), b(s) is a baseline function, b(s) =μ_q(s) +σ_q(s) ×tanh (V (s)/v_max), μ_q is a Q value mean, σ_q is a Q value standard deviation, and V(s) is a state value function. Applying an adaptive strategy update algorithm θ_new=θ+η Normalize (PGE (θ)); wherein Normalize operation is defined as normal (x) = (xμ_x)/(σ_x+ε) scale; scale is an adaptive scaling factor that is used to scale the image, scale=min (1, sqrt (Δ/|||x|| 2 )), Δ is the target update amplitude. The policy constraint optimizer (Policy Constraint Optimizer,PCO),PCO(θ_new)=argmin_θ||θ θ_new|| 2 ;subject to:KL(π_θ_old || π_θ)≤ε_KL;|E_π_θ[R_total] E_π_θ_old[R_total]|≤ε_R; is constructed, wherein KL is KL divergence constraint, epsilon_KL is KL divergence threshold value, epsilon_R is rewarding change threshold value, and the optimized policy parameter theta_optimal is output.
A hierarchical experience buffer (HIERARCHICAL EXPERIENCE BUFFER, HEB) is constructed, heb= { b_local, b_global }, where b_local is the local experience buffer, b_local= { (s_i, a_i, r_i, s' _i) }, b_global is the global experience buffer, b_global = aggreate (b_local_1,..b_local_n), aggreate operations are defined as computing experience importance w_i = exp (r_total_i/τ), and importance sampling P (sample_i) = w_i/Σwjis performed. An empirical distillation algorithm (Experience Distillation Algorithm, EDA) is applied, EDA (HEB) = { feature extraction f= ExtractFeatures (HEB), cluster analysis c=cluster (F, K), representative empirical selection e_rep= SELECTREPRESENTATIVE (C), knowledge compression k=compression (e_rep) }, where ExtractFeatures is feature extraction based on principal component analysis, cluster is a density clustering algorithm, SELECTREPRESENTATIVE is representative selection based on information entropy, compression is a compression algorithm based on maximum information retention, and the optimized empirical pool heb_optimized is output.
A Multi-strategy integrator (Multi-Policy Integrator, MPI) is constructed, pi_ensable (a|s) = Σw_i pi_i (a|s), wherein w_i is a strategy weight, w_i=softmax (pi_i)), performance is a strategy Performance evaluation function, performance (pi) = E [ r_total|pi ] +λ H (pi), and H (pi) is a strategy entropy. The method comprises the steps of adaptively adjusting Adjust (pi_sense) = { calculation strategy difference D_ij=KL (pi_i||pi_j), updating integration weight w_new=w_exp (-eta_D), normalizing w_final=w_new/sigma w_new } and outputting final optimization strategy pi_final.
The embodiment realizes the accurate guidance and continuous optimization of the detector group behaviors by constructing a multi-level rewarding mechanism and a strategy optimization framework. In the aspect of reward design, four dimensions of efficiency rewards, safety rewards, collaborative rewards and information acquisition rewards are fused, accurate reflection of reward signals on a current task target is ensured through dynamic weight adjustment, in the aspect of strategy optimization, a strategy updating mechanism based on KL divergence constraint is adopted, so that the stability of strategy updating is ensured, sufficient exploration space is maintained, in the aspect of experience management, the efficiency and quality of experience playback are improved through constructing a layered experience buffer zone and combining an importance sampling technology, and the advantage complementation of different strategies is realized through a multi-strategy integration mechanism, so that the adaptability and the robustness of the system are improved. The method and the device not only quicken the strategy convergence speed, but also effectively avoid local optimization, so that the detector group can keep high-efficiency stable detection performance in complex and changeable underwater environments.
In embodiment 4 of the present application, in underwater detector cluster detection, an environment and a state space are constructed that can fully express all conditions that a detector may encounter in a varied underwater environment. The state space (S) contains all underwater environmental parameters that can be sensed by the detector sets, such as water temperature, water flow velocity, depth, surrounding bio-ecological and geological features, etc., specifically to each detector, the state also includes its mechanical state such as position, velocity and direction. The state space may be represented as S t e S, where t is a time step.
The action space A is constructed, and comprises a direction adjustment { forward, backward, ascending, descending, left turning and right turning }, a speed adjustment { accelerating and decelerating }, an operation execution { sampling and data collection, and a sensor on/off }. Each action is implemented by a corresponding control command, which can be discrete or continuous, and is designed according to the specific execution capacity of the detector. The action may be denoted as a t e A.
Constructing and building a reward function, wherein the reward function R (s t ,a t ,s t+1 ) can finely map the instant return and long-term effect of action execution, and the formula is as follows:
R(s t ,a t ,s t+1 )=r data (s t+1 )+r safety (s t )-r cost (a t )+r completion (s t+1 );
Where r data is to assign rewards according to the quality and importance of the collected data, r safety is to assign rewards to avoid dangerous areas or injuries, r cost is to assign penalties to the cost of using energy and time, and r completion is to provide additional rewards for task completion.
The strategy was trained using the DQN and Actor-Critic approach, where DQN approximates the Q function Q (s, a, θ) with a neural network. Where s is the state, a is the action, and θ is the network parameter. The Q value update formula is as follows:
Q target =r+γ max a' Q(s',a',θ − );
Q(s,a,θ)←Q(s,a,θ)+α(Q target -Q(s,a,θ));
Where r is the reward, γ is a discount factor, typically between 0 and 1, to measure the current value of the future reward, α is the learning rate, and θ − represents a parameter of the target network that periodically replicates the parameter from the main network to increase learning stability.
The Actor-Critic method parameterizes the strategy pi (s, pi) and the value function V (s, θ v ). The strategy (Actor) here directly outputs the probability distribution of an action, while the value function (Critic) evaluates the expected return of taking an action in a certain state. The policy gradient update formula for the Actor is as follows:
▽ θπ J(θ π )=E[▽ θπ logπ(a|s,θ π )Q π (s,a)];
The Time Difference (TD) update formula for Critic is as follows:
V (s,θ v )←V(s,θ v )+β(r+γV(s',θ v )-V(s,θ v ));
where β is the learning rate of Critic.

In example 6 of the present application, a search and use strategy is implemented, and in DQN, the balance between search and use is often achieved by an epsilon-greedy strategy. Under this strategy, the detector selects the best action currently estimated with a probability of 1- ε, and randomly selects the action with a probability of ε. The epsilon value gradually decreases from higher (e.g., 0.9) to lower (e.g., 0.1) to facilitate a transition from initial extensive exploration to later accentuation. If rand () < ε, a random action is selected, and if rand (). Gtoreq.ε, argmax a Q(s t , a, θ), where rand () represents a function that generates a random number.
In distributed reinforcement learning, individual probes share their learning experience, such as gradients or parameters, over a network. This may be achieved by a parameter server learning model or federal learning approach. The parameter averaging method can be expressed as follows:
θ global =1/N∑ i=1 N θ i ;
Where θi is the local model parameter of the ith detector and N is the total number of detectors involved in learning.
After training, each underwater detector obtains own actions by using a training convergence strategy network according to own local observation state, and performs distributed execution, so that the self-adaptive detection of the underwater detector cluster is finally realized.
